jobs.title: Senior Systems Administrator II
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
ActBlue is a nonprofit organization dedicated to creating cutting-edge technology that fuels Democratic victories and enables progressive causes to thrive.

Our vision is simple: building change through the power of people. Since our founding, we’ve been building innovative solutions to revolutionize grassroots fundraising – if you’ve donated to a Democratic campaign or a progressive organization online, you’ve probably used our platform! We believe in putting power in the hands of small-dollar donors by helping thousands of groups — from local candidates to national movements — mobilize their communities and create a lasting impact. Every member of our team is deeply committed to advancing our shared mission and core values. Together, we are shaping the future of democracy.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Senior Systems Administrator II is an advanced individual contributor who leads the implementation, optimization, and governance of ActBlue’s internal IT systems, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and compliant with industry standards. You will work independently on large, complex projects with significant organizational impact, champion data protection, manage access and identity infrastructure, and guide technical decisions that shape the day-to-day experience of a distributed team. This role reports to the Sr. IT Manager and is part of the Systems Administration team, partnering closely with Desktop Support, Security, and stakeholders across the organization.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Lead the configuration, deployment, and optimization of secure, cloud-based IT systems — with a focus on identity management, MDM, endpoint security, and SaaS integrations

• Lead large, complex projects end to end with minimal guidance: break down epic-level work, set realistic timelines, weigh tradeoffs and risks, and surface blockers before they require escalation

• Partner with Security, Legal, and Data Governance stakeholders to ensure IT systems meet regulatory requirements, internal controls, and proper security configurations — including SOC 2, GDPR, and CCPA — and identify and reduce risk across systems

• Oversee the user identity lifecycle and access control, including RBAC, least privilege, and regular access audits

• Serve as a key partner in data governance, driving technical enforcement of data classification, data retention, data loss prevention, and secure data handling procedures

• Design, build, test, debug, and monitor IT process automation (e.g., onboarding/offboarding, software provisioning, and compliance checklists), including with workflow orchestration and emerging AI-driven tools

• Serve as a technical escalation point and mentor for the IT team, resolving complex issues and documenting solutions

• Serve as the point person for other departments and vendors on the systems you own

• Maintain systems documentation, playbooks, and user-facing knowledge resources, and write new guidance as emerging issues surface

• Support internal audits and evidence gathering for compliance reporting, including review of logs, change management records, and security controls

• Stay current on evolving regulatory, privacy, and security standards so systems stay aligned with industry best practices

WHAT YOU BRING

• 5+ years of experience in systems administration, including leading compliance- and security-driven projects

• Advanced proficiency administering core IT platforms such as Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, the Atlassian Suite, and modern MDM platforms

• Strong familiarity with macOS environments, including enforcing security policies, maintaining governance standards, and managing patch compliance across a device fleet

• Demonstrated ability to build, test, debug, and monitor automations, and to move quickly on project work because of a deep understanding of the systems you support

• Experience integrating SaaS tools and platforms, including planning and executing system and data migrations

• Strong understanding of identity and access management, endpoint hardening, and security configuration management

• Working knowledge of compliance and data protection frameworks, including SOC 1 & 2, NIST, and PCI DSS, plus experience with e-discovery, data governance, and data handling policies and procedures

• A track record of independently delivering large, complex projects with significant organizational impact, and of constructing sound technical solutions to complex problems

• Sound judgment in resolving complex issues and working through ambiguity, with the sense to know when to bring your manager in as a thought partner

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills — especially in technical documentation, technical proposals, policy writing, and explaining technical topics to broader audiences

• A proactive, collaborative mindset with dependable follow-through, open to feedback, and committed to equity and a people-first approach

WORK & BENEFITS SNAPSHOT

Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington D.C.

Work Environment:

Employees can expect to work with distributed teams across all U.S. time zones. Our roles require extended technology usage, and proficiency with virtual communication tools such as Zoom and Slack. Regular attendance in virtual meetings is inherent to every position.

Benefits:

About the Opportunity

You will work hands-on to move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and develop data pipelines that support training, evaluation, and real-time decisions. You will take ownership of your work, identify improvements proactively, and deliver with limited guidance

• Strong experience with Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.

• Experience with the model lifecycle, including training and serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel, Public Reporting
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced securities lawyer to join the Corporate Legal team as Corporate Counsel, Public Company Reporting & Governance. In this role, you will prepare our SEC filings, advise on securities law and corporate governance, and support the Board and its committees. You will also partner closely with finance, accounting, investor relations, and equity teams to build the systems, controls, and repeatable processes that accurate, timely disclosure depends on.

This is a hands-on role with meaningful scope and visibility. You will provide strategic, practical advice to senior leaders and teams across the company. You will draft and review disclosure yourself, while also helping build the processes and workflows that allow the function to scale.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and review SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, the proxy statement and Section 16 filings

• Advise on compliance with SEC and Nasdaq rules

• Help establish and run our disclosure controls and procedures, including the disclosure committee and the reporting calendar

• Support our securities compliance policies and the administration of the Insider Trading Policy, including trading windows, pre-clearance and 10b5-1 plans

• Review earnings materials, press releases, investor presentations and other significant external and internal communications

• Partner with Investor Relations on Regulation FD compliance, stockholder engagement and the annual meeting

• Prepare Board and committee materials, draft minutes and resolutions, and maintain governance policies and committee charters

• Support executive and equity compensation disclosure with the People and Equity teams

• Advise the teams that report publicly on our mission and safety work

• Keep partner teams informed of governance trends and SEC and Nasdaq developments

• Contribute to the processes and tools that let a small team handle public company work at scale

Minimum Qualifications

• Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you’ll be based (California or New York preferred)

• Significant public company reporting experience. This role is focused on periodic reporting and governance, and is not a capital markets or M&A role

• Deep knowledge of corporate and securities law, including SEC and Nasdaq rules

• Experience giving accurate, practical advice in real time at a fast-growing company

• A working understanding of accounting and corporate finance

• A track record of building strong working relationships across teams

• Clear written and verbal communication with executives and non-lawyers, without legal jargon

Preferred Qualifications

• At least 8 years of relevant legal experience, including securities and corporate governance experience at a law firm and in-house at a public company

• Experience building processes and procedures to public-company standards

• Experience supporting a public company board and its committees

• A track record of standing up a process or program

• The ability to translate securities law requirements into clear, practical guidance for business teams

• Sound judgment and the ability to advise with incomplete information

Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$265,000—$335,000 USD

Logistics

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
jobs.description:
What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role:

Halcyon is seeking a seasoned and collaborative Senior Information Security Specialist to support the advancement of our cybersecurity and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) programs. In this role, you will play a critical part in strengthening our enterprise-wide security posture by coordinating across teams, managing third-party risk, supporting compliance initiatives, and maturing internal security processes and documentation. Your responsibilities will span operational security, risk assessment, policy development, and incident response preparedness.

Responsibilities:

• Perform and maintain third-party risk assessments and track vendor remediation activities.

• Support coordination and analysis of internal and external security testing, including vulnerability scans and penetration tests.

• Develop, track, and follow up on corrective action plans for identified security gaps or audit findings.

• Collaborate with managed security service providers and internal stakeholders to monitor and manage security events and escalations.

• Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure implementation of security and compliance requirements across the organization.

• Assist in developing, maintaining, and communicating information security policies, standards, and procedures.

• Coordinate security incident response planning, disaster recovery testing, and business continuity exercises.

• Monitor and support enforcement of technical and administrative security controls across the enterprise.

• Stay current with evolving security and privacy regulations and frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, TX-RAMP, FedRAMP).

Skills and Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or IT risk management.

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts, controls, and risk frameworks.

• Demonstrated experience with third-party risk management processes and tooling.

• Proven ability to coordinate security testing and vulnerability management efforts.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to assess and implement technical and administrative controls across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Experience with regulatory compliance and audit support in fast-paced environments.

• Hands-on participation in incident response or disaster recovery exercises is a plus.

Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

• Experience with compliance platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta).

• Knowledge of security frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO 27001, such as NIST 800-53 or CIS Controls.

• Familiarity with secure software development practices or DevSecOps principles.

• Background in auditing or supporting third-party security assessments.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace security configuration.

• Exposure to regulatory environments such as HIPAA, GDPR, or CCPA.

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security+, or similar are a plus.

Benefits:

Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

• Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

• Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

• Medical and dependent care FSA options.

• 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

• Flexible PTO policy.

• Parental leave.

• Generous equity offerings.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

The expected base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $160,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but are not limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans, as well as our benefits offers, and equity awards.

In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company.

We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Manager, Healthcare & Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re building our Healthcare and Life Sciences leadership team to help organizations translate advances in AI into meaningful impact. We’re looking for sales leaders to build and develop high-performing teams, deepen strategic customer relationships, and shape OpenAI’s growth across this industry.

Our customers span health systems, payers, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical technology companies, and healthcare technology organizations. Your team will help customers identify opportunities to improve workforce productivity, accelerate research and discovery, strengthen operations, and enhance patient, member, and customer experiences.

You’ll be a hands-on leader who coaches teams through complex enterprise sales cycles, builds executive relationships, and helps customers move from experimentation to scaled deployment. Success requires understanding how healthcare and life sciences organizations evaluate technology, establish trust, and adopt AI responsibly.

You’ll also help define our industry go-to-market strategy, operating model, and playbooks. Working across commercial, research, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders, you’ll guide your team in identifying high-value opportunities and building credible business cases for adoption.

We’re hiring across our growing Healthcare and Life Sciences sales leadership team. Specific responsibilities and team scope will reflect the opportunity and your experience.

In this role, you will:

 - Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing enterprise sales teams serving strategic healthcare and life sciences accounts across North America.

 - Build a strong coaching culture through deal reviews, account strategy sessions, customer engagement, and structured development.

 - Shape industry and segment-specific go-to-market strategies, including account segmentation, prioritization, executive engagement, and territory planning.

 - Drive disciplined pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and consistent execution across complex enterprise opportunities.

 - Guide consultative sales cycles involving business leaders, IT, research and development, clinical teams, operations, security, privacy, compliance, procurement, and legal.

 - Help customers connect AI capabilities to measurable outcomes across knowledge work, research, administrative workflows, commercial operations, and patient and member engagement.

 - Coach teams to build business cases grounded in industry economics, implementation feasibility, organizational readiness, and customer priorities.

 - Help customers move from pilots to broader adoption through clear success criteria, executive sponsorship, deployment planning, and change management.

 - Partner with Product, Solutions Architecture, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Finance, and Marketing to support customer success and industry growth.

 - Bring structured feedback to Product and leadership on industry needs, integration requirements, adoption barriers, competitive dynamics, and emerging opportunities.

 - Establish a culture of accountability, customer focus, and operational excellence within a low-ego, collaborative environment.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 15+ years of enterprise sales, go-to-market, or sales leadership experience, including significant experience leading teams selling into large healthcare or life sciences organizations.

 - A proven track record of building and scaling enterprise sales teams responsible for complex strategic accounts and substantial revenue targets.

 - Demonstrated ability to coach senior Account Directors through opportunities involving multiple decision-makers, extended evaluation cycles, and significant organizational dependencies.

 - Deep expertise in one or more healthcare and life sciences segments, such as providers, payers, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical technology, or healthcare technology, including their distinct priorities, buying processes, and operating models.

 - Experience leading consultative, multi-product, or platform-based enterprise sales involving executive sponsors, technical buyers, and clinical, research, commercial, or operational stakeholders.

 - A track record of developing new go-to-market motions and turning early customer adoption into repeatable, scalable growth.

 - Demonstrated ability to help customers evaluate technology investments through measurable business value, implementation feasibility, and long-term adoption.

 - Strong operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, and performance management.

 - Technical fluency sufficient to discuss APIs, enterprise AI platforms, data integration, and deployment considerations with technical buyers and internal partners.

 - Sound judgment in positioning AI use cases with clear value, appropriate scope, and attention to customer requirements for privacy, security, governance, and human oversight.

 - Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with CIOs, CTOs, chief digital and AI officers, and senior research, clinical, commercial, operational, and business leaders.

 - The ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment while helping teams maintain focus and execution discipline.

 - A low-ego leadership style with a demonstrated commitment to developing talent, building trust, and creating high-performing teams.

Must Have Experience

 - Proven experience leading enterprise sales teams serving large, complex healthcare or life sciences accounts.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes within healthcare or life sciences, including how business, technical, operational, privacy, security, and compliance stakeholders evaluate and adopt new technology.

 - Track record developing new go-to-market motions and converting early customer adoption into repeatable, scalable growth.

 - Technical fluency sufficient to discuss APIs, enterprise AI platforms, data integration, and deployment considerations with technical buyers and internal partners.

 - Demonstrated ability to coach senior enterprise sellers through complex opportunities with multiple decision-makers, extended evaluation cycles, and significant organizational dependencies.

 - Ability to connect AI capabilities to measurable business value, with appropriate scope and an understanding of customer requirements for privacy, security, governance, and human oversight.

 - Highly collaborative leadership style with a strong focus on accountability, culture, and talent development.

Strong Preferences

 - Experience selling enterprise software, cloud, data, AI, or consumption-based platforms into healthcare or life sciences.

 - Experience navigating enterprise-wide agreements and expanding relationships across business units, functions, geographies, or affiliated organizations.

 - Familiarity with data environments, enterprise systems, and integration requirements across one or more healthcare and life sciences segments, including the practical challenges of embedding new technology into established workflows.

 - Experience partnering with customers on AI governance, technology evaluation, deployment planning, and organizational change.

 - Experience influencing product roadmaps, pricing, packaging, or enterprise commercial structures based on industry needs.

 - Public company operating experience with rigorous forecasting and performance accountability.

Nice to Have

 - Direct experience with generative AI adoption in healthcare or life sciences.

 - Experience across both high-growth technology companies and scaled enterprise organizations.

 - Established relationships with senior business, technology, research, clinical, commercial, or operational leaders within healthcare or life sciences.

 - Experience helping customers scale successful pilots across an enterprise and demonstrate sustained adoption and measurable value.

JOB TITLE: Analyst, Major League Strategy & Analytics

DEPARTMENT: Baseball Strategy

FLSA STATUS: Part-time/Seasonal

LOCATION: Baltimore, MD

REPORTS TO: Assistant General Manager

JOB SUMMARY: The Major League Strategy & Analytics Analyst connects Baseball Operations and Research & Development with the Major League coaching staff, using data, models, and scouting information to deliver clear recommendations that coaches and players can deploy. This position reports to the Assistant General Manager and works closely with the Major League Manager and coaching staff, Major League Advance Scouting, Research & Development, Player Development, Professional Scouting, and Major League players.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Primary duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Prepare opponent breakdowns in advance of each series across all pillars of the game, including offense, defense, baserunning, and pitching.

• Convert analytical processes and models into concise, actionable takeaways that players and coaching staff can use for decision-making and game preparation.

• Act as the coaching staff’s go-to analytical resource in the clubhouse.

• Serve as a liaison between the Major League staff and the Baseball Analytics department, ensuring coaching staff questions regarding advanced information are answered in a timely and accurate manner.

• Analyze and provide feedback to the Analytics department on which analytical tools have the highest impact among staff and players and which tools can be improved upon.

• Use SQL and R/Python daily to filter through large sets of information in an organized way.

• Travel with the club and willingness to work non-traditional hours (nights, weekends, holidays) as dictated by Orioles and MLB schedule.

WORK LOCATION & TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

• Position is based primarily in Baltimore, with travel alongside the Major League team during Spring Training and the regular season.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Completion of Bachelor’s degree, with a preference but not limited to Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or equivalent.

• Experience with creating and completing advance materials for a Major League club.

• Proficiency with SQL, R/Python, and familiarity with Statcast and Hawk-Eye data.

• Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to collaborate with players and staff members of various backgrounds and responsibilities, and present advanced information in a clear and actionable way.

• Familiarity with MLB’s in-game and transaction rules.

jobs.title: InfoSec Engineer (Risk and Compliance)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.


THE TEAM

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

 - Founded and exited successful companies

 - Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic

 - Won IMO and IOI gold medals

 - Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.


CORE PRINCIPLES


TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.


OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.


ACTION: GET IT DONE.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.


YOUR ROLE

Rox agents read and act on our customers’ most sensitive revenue data. Global 2000 security teams review us closely before they sign, and the trust we earn in those reviews is a core part of how we win and keep enterprise customers.

As an InfoSec Engineer (Risk and Compliance), you will own our compliance program as an engineer, not as a checklist keeper. You will run ISO 27001 and SOC 2, lead customer security due diligence, and manage vendor risk. You will also write the Python that collects evidence and monitors controls automatically, so audits stop eating the team’s time.

This is a senior individual contributor role and the second hire on our security team. You will report to Mike Tan, our Head of Security, and work closely with Engineering and Infrastructure on controls and fixes, and with Legal and Finance on security addenda, data processing agreements, and vendor contracts. Within your first three months you will fully own four areas with little supervision.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Compliance automation (30%): Build scripts and integrations in Python against REST APIs that collect evidence, monitor controls, and generate reports. Replace manual screenshots with compliance as code.

 - Audit operations (30%): Own the ISO 27001 certification program, including audit findings, the Statement of Applicability, the risk register, and internal audit. Keep SOC 2 compliance continuous: fix failing tests, answer evidence and auditor requests, maintain policies, and run access reviews.

 - Customer security due diligence (20%): Run the customer security review queue end to end, from questionnaires (CAIQ, SIG, and custom) to security addenda and due diligence calls with enterprise security teams.

 - Vendor and risk management (20%): Assess vendors, review sub-processors, and keep the risk register current as Rox adds new tools and partners.

 - Partner with Engineering and Infrastructure on the systems behind the evidence: AWS, the software development lifecycle, change management, and vulnerability fixes.

 - Partner with Legal and Finance on data processing agreements, customer security addenda, and vendor procurement.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 3 days: You have access to Secureframe, AWS, and GitHub, can explain our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control set and where each framework stands, and have worked a live customer security questionnaire with our Head of Security.

 - First 3 weeks: You run the customer security review queue end to end and have automated evidence collection for at least one recurring audit control.

 - First 3 months: You fully own ISO 27001, continuous SOC 2 compliance, customer security due diligence, and vendor risk management, and you have shipped tooling that cuts recurring manual audit work.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in GRC or security compliance, with hands-on experience running SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

 - You code. You write Python scripts and API integrations to automate evidence collection and control monitoring, and you are comfortable with SQL and Git.

 - Working knowledge of AWS security services and logs, such as IAM, CloudTrail, KMS, and Config.

 - Experience with a GRC platform such as Secureframe, Vanta, or Drata.

 - Experience answering enterprise security questionnaires (CAIQ, SIG) and joining due diligence calls with customer security teams.

 - Familiarity with GDPR and data processing agreement concepts.

 - You own outcomes with little supervision and can explain risk clearly to engineers, executives, and customers.

 - Be located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco. This role is onsite at our SF HQ five days a week.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Led an ISO 27001 certification or a first SOC 2 Type II from scratch.

 - Experience with JumpCloud, Datadog, or Semgrep.

 - Experience managing third-party risk at a fast growing B2B SaaS or AI company.


BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay with considerable equity upside (base salary range: $180,000 to $220,000 USD)

 - Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents

 - Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability

 - 401(k) with automatic enrollment

 - Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement

 - Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster)

 - Wellness stipend: $375/quarter

 - Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year

 - Internet & cell phone stipend: $25/month

 - Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation

 - Fertility & family-building support, plus backup care membership

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit & parking)

 - SF HQ: daily catered breakfast & lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting to the office


APPLY

To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

Pragmatic product sense — you optimize for the end user experience and business impact, and know when simple beats sophisticated

Comfort with ambiguity — much of this platform is being built from the ground up

A passion for the AI space: you stay up-to-date on the latest innovations and tools, and are excited to be at the frontier




NICE TO HAVES

Experience building recommendation systems, search ranking, or personalization

Experience designing eval frameworks for LLM or ML systems

Familiarity with modern data stack tools (Snowflake, dbt, Dagster) and data lake architectures

Experience in fast-moving startup environments




WHY CLAY

jobs.title: Senior Research and Development Technician
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a hands-on Senior R&D Technician to support and lead complex structural testing programs. This role is critical to ensuring components and systems are tested accurately, safely, and efficiently, while elevating test execution through expert methods, robust setups, and disciplined processes. The Sr. R&D Technician transforms test results into clear, actionable engineering insights that reduce technical risk, improve product quality, and keep development programs on schedule.

You will work closely with Test Engineers and cross-functional teams to plan, execute, and refine structural tests from concept through completion. As a senior subject-matter expert, you will proactively identify issues, define best practices, mentor others, and ensure testing is consistently executed to a high technical standard.

The Role

Technical Leadership & Subject-Matter Expertise

• Serve as a senior subject matter expert for structural test execution at component, subsystem, and vehicle levels.

• Lead complex testing activities, ensuring technical accuracy, safety, and efficiency of all test operations.

• Provide expert input on test methods, instrumentation, fixturing, and data quality, defining and maintaining best practices across the department.

• Troubleshoot and resolve advanced test setup, instrumentation, hydraulic, and control system issues with minimal oversight.

• Support and contribute to test strategy development in collaboration with Test Engineers and other stakeholders.

Test Execution & Integration

• Coordinate and integrate test support activities with Test Engineers and cross-functional teams (design, CAE, production, fabrication, manufacturing).

• Lead the setup, execution, and teardown of complex structural tests, including installation of hydraulic actuators, valves, hoses, and measurement systems.

• Support test rig design, prototyping, fabrication, and validation, providing manufacturability and testability input.

• Conduct visual inspections of test specimens during and after testing, identifying anomalies, damage progression, and failure modes.

• Perform system checks, preventive maintenance, and periodic inspections to ensure test readiness and reliability.

Equipment, Facilities & Continuous Improvement

• Oversee maintenance, calibration, and proper use of test equipment, ensuring compliance with internal standards and external requirements.

• Proactively identify, develop, and implement improvements to test processes, equipment, safety, and workspace organization.

• Support the development of new test capabilities, tools, and fixtures to meet evolving R&D needs.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASELAYER

Every business in America needs a bank account to exist. The system that decides whether they're real, who's behind them, and whether they're a risk, runs on infrastructure from the 1980s. We're rebuilding that layer from scratch.

Baselayer is the identity layer for institutions across the United States: the most complete business graph in America and every human tied to it. We fuse public records, IRS data, sanctions lists, web signals, and fraud telemetry from 2,200+ financial institutions into a single graph that resolves any business and the humans behind it in milliseconds. The legacy credit bureaus took 50 years to build something that gets 60% match rates. We've built something that gets 98% in under two years.

Today we're trusted by over 20% of financial institutions in America including FIS, Rho, Socure and top five US banks. But the graph is becoming infrastructure for anyone who needs to know if a business is real and worth trusting: gig platforms, marketplaces, AI companies, and commerce infrastructure at scale.

Trust is the substrate of every financial transaction. We're rebuilding it.

ABOUT THE TEAM

AI agents are starting to transact: opening accounts, buying services, moving money on behalf of the businesses and people behind them. Every one of those transactions has a counterparty asking the question banks have always asked: who am I dealing with, and can I trust them? Today's identity infrastructure wasn't built to answer it at agent speed.

The Agentic Economy team is extending Baselayer's business graph into the trust layer for agentic commerce: verifiable credentials that bind an agent to the verified business and human behind it, a registry counterparties can query in real time, and verification APIs that plug into the networks, platforms, and protocols where agent transactions happen.

We run like a startup inside a startup: a small senior team led by our GM of Agentic Economy, working directly with payment networks, banks, wallet providers, and agent platforms. The category is being defined right now; the standards, seats, and infrastructure decisions of the next 18 months will be consequential for a decade.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring our first Sr. Product Marketing Manager to own how Baselayer is positioned, packaged, and explained to the market. You’ll sit at the center of Product, Sales, and Marketing, translating a technically deep risk platform into a story that a Chief Risk Officer, a BSA/AML lead, and a fintech founder each understand immediately. This is a builder’s seat, not a maintenance one: there’s no messaging framework to inherit and no launch process to follow.

You’ll write the positioning, build the sales narrative, run the launches, and prove what’s working. You’ll partner closely with the founders, sales, and product to turn a differentiated platform into a category-defining story, and your words will show up in every deal cycle and every product release.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own positioning and messaging for the Baselayer platform and its individual products, grounded in real customer research rather than internal opinion

• Build the sales narrative end to end, including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, objection handling, and ROI framing that AEs actually use

• Lead go-to-market for product launches: define the audience, set the launch tier, coordinate Product, Sales, and Design, and own the outcome after ship

• Run competitive and market intelligence across the KYB, fraud, and onboarding landscape, and turn it into guidance the team can act on

• Partner with Sales to diagnose where deals stall, then build the content and enablement that unsticks them

• Interview customers and prospects regularly, and bring what you learn back into product strategy and roadmap conversations

• Drive pricing and packaging work alongside Product and Sales leadership as we expand the platform

• Write the substantive content that earns credibility with a risk and compliance audience: case studies, benchmark reports, webinars, and thought leadership

• Define what success looks like for your work and report on it honestly, including pipeline influenced, win rate, and launch adoption

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• 5+ years of product marketing experience at a B2B software company, including time at a startup or early-stage team

• A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a technical product, not just executing campaigns someone else scoped

• Excellent writing, with the ability to take a dense technical capability and make it sharp, specific, and free of buzzwords

• Experience running product launches from strategy through post-launch measurement

• Comfort working directly with sales teams and sitting in on customer calls

• Strong judgment about what to prioritize when everything is unbuilt and there’s no playbook

• Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward shipping over polishing

WHAT SETS YOU APART

• Experience marketing to banks, credit unions, fintechs, or other financial institutions

• Working knowledge of KYB, KYC, AML, fraud, underwriting, or merchant onboarding

• Experience marketing AI or data products to a skeptical, compliance-minded buyer

• You’ve been an early marketing hire and built the function from the ground up

• Fluency with analytics and CRM data, so you pull your own numbers rather than waiting on someone else

• Experience with pricing and packaging decisions across a multi-product platform

• You’re proactive, opinionated about craft, and motivated to build something that lasts

WORK LOCATION

• Based in New York City; Full-time in office

COMPENSATION

• Salary Range: $150,000 – $220,000 + Bonus + Equity

BENEFITS

• Time off when you need it: Flexible PTO so you can recharge without red tape

• In-person energy: We're based in NYC & SF and meet in the office full-time

• Competitive compensation: We pay well and back it with equity. We want you to think and act like an owner

• Career rocket fuel: You'll help build the foundation of a high-growth startup, working side by side with experienced founders and team members who've done it before

• Benefits on us: We cover 100% of your health, dental, and vision premiums. No surprise deductions from your paycheck

• 401(k) with company match: We match your contributions so your future self benefits too

• HSA contributions included: We contribute to your HSA on applicable plans, so your coverage works as hard as you do

• Stay healthy, stay sharp: A $250 monthly gym stipend to help you bring your best self to work, and everywhere else

• Lunch on us: Lunch stipend so you can stay fueled and focused without thinking about it

• A seat at the table: We believe in transparency, radical candor, and giving every team member a voice 🔥

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Frontier Data Products
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise.

We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real-world workflows.

Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence.

Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London.




ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor is defining the future of work. We partner with leading AI labs and enterprises to provide the human intelligence essential to AI development.

Our vast talent network trains frontier AI models in the same way teachers teach students: by sharing knowledge, experience, and context that can't be captured in code alone. Today, more than 30,000 experts in our network collectively earn over $2 million a day.

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society.

Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our new San Francisco headquarters.

About the Role
Frontier AI companies are increasingly bottlenecked on expert judgment and high-quality data workflows. This team builds the production systems that capture, coordinate, and validate that work at scale — directly between a customer request and the output that ships.
These are long-running, stateful systems. A single job can stay live for days, interleaving automated steps, model inference, and expert review. A step marked "done" can be reopened, re-reviewed, and redone — so "completed" is not always final, state has to tolerate late mutation, and correctness has to survive humans and models disagreeing with each other.
This is a backend systems and orchestration problem: distributed state machines, not pipelines. The architecture is not set. Early engineers will decide what it becomes, and the loop between "I shipped this" and "this mattered" is short.
What You'll Do

 - Design services and state models for multi-stage workflows that fan out across automated processing and expert reviewers, then reconcile results into a coherent whole

 - Build orchestration primitives — retries, failure recovery, idempotency, auditable state transitions — for jobs that run far longer than a request and can be partially redone after the fact

 - Integrate model inference into production workflows without sacrificing debuggability or human oversight

 - Build the APIs and tooling that let product, operations, and ML teams operate, debug, and trust these systems at scale

 - Own reliability and observability for workflows where a silent failure means a corrupted result, not just a 500
   What Makes This Role Different

 - You are building the core infrastructure that sits directly between customer requests and the outputs that ship — not internal tooling, not a support system

 - This product area is young and strategically central; early engineers are deciding the architecture, not inheriting it

 - The inputs are non-deterministic by nature — you are building durable orchestration over humans and models that can disagree with each other on hour 40 of a multi-stage job
   Day-to-Day

 - Moving fast on genuinely hard systems problems — ambiguity is the default, not the exception

 - Working closely with product, operations, and ML teams to translate a tangle of constraints into clean system design

 - Debugging complex stateful workflows where the failure surface spans automated steps, model calls, and human reviewers

 - Owning your systems end-to-end: design, ship, operate, improve
   What We're Looking For

 - Production backend experience with strong opinions about what ages well and why

 - Sharp instincts for system design, service boundaries, and where to put complexity — and where to refuse it

 - Fluency with the distributed systems toolkit: async workflows, queues, idempotency, retries, and long-running jobs as practice, not resume line items

 - Ability to take ambiguous product, operational, and ML constraints and turn them into a system that is clean and debuggable

 - Comfort working in Python on AWS with Postgres; experience with Temporal or similar workflow engines is a plus
   You're likely someone who:

 - Gets frustrated by systems that are hard to debug and takes that personally enough to fix it

 - Has strong opinions about where state should live and can defend them in a design review

 - Moves fast but doesn't treat reliability as someone else's problem

 - Wants your work to have a short, visible line to outcomes that actually matter to customers
   Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k Relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance

Benefits: 

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Unlimited paid vacation and sick days

 - Parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

 - Free mental health services

 - $200 monthly wellness reimbursement

 - $1.5K monthly meal stipend

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - Free Equinox membership

jobs.title: Senior Developer, NetSuite CRM
jobs.description:
Who is Trace3?

Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate.

Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it!

Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco.

Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?

Come Join Us!

Street-Smart - Thriving in Dynamic Times

We are flexible and resilient in a fast-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the “big picture.” We exercise sound business judgment in making high-quality decisions in a timely and cost-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems.

Juice - The “Stuff” it takes to be a Needle Mover

We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like.

Teamwork - Humble, Hungry and Smart

We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it’s due and demonstrate transparency. We “bring the weather” by exhibiting positive leadership and solution-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Developer, NetSuite CRM will serve as the dedicated technical owner responsible for the design, development, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of Trace3's NetSuite CRM platform. This role will support the end-to-end sales lifecycle, including lead and opportunity management, quoting, sales orders, customer engagement, pipeline management, and forecasting.

This individual will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Marketing teams to translate business requirements into scalable, high-performing CRM solutions. Responsibilities include CRM architecture, custom development, workflow automation, system integrations, performance optimization, and continuous improvement of the user experience.

As a senior technical resource, this individual will contribute to CRM technology strategy, establish development best practices, and mentor other technical team members to strengthen internal CRM capabilities. The role will also support CRM modernization initiatives and ensure the platform can scale with Trace3's evolving business needs, including acquisitions and organizational growth.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Own the technical design, development, configuration, and continuous optimization of NetSuite CRM capabilities, including Leads, Prospects, Opportunities, Quotes, Sales Orders, Campaigns, Partner/Customer Center, and Case Management.

• Develop and maintain custom solutions using SuiteScript 2.0/2.1, SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and SuiteAnalytics to support CRM workflows, sales processes, pipeline visibility, and forecasting.

• Design, develop, and support integrations between NetSuite CRM and enterprise applications, including Microsoft Outlook email and calendar platforms, marketing automation, CPQ/quoting solutions, Professional Services Automation (PSA) platforms, and downstream business systems, ensuring reliable data exchange and seamless business workflows.

• Develop and maintain APIs and middleware integrations using platforms such as Celigo, Boomi, or similar technologies, ensuring reliable and secure data exchange across enterprise applications.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve CRM performance issues, including slow record processing, inefficient scripts, workflows, saved searches, and integrations. Implement sustainable improvements to system performance and user experience.

• Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and business analysts to translate business requirements into scalable CRM solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual processes, improve data quality, and enhance sales productivity.

• Provide technical leadership for CRM modernization initiatives, including solution architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation optimization.

• Support NetSuite CRM enhancements, upgrades, and release impact assessments, identifying potential risks to existing customizations, integrations, and business processes.

• Ensure the reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability of CRM solutions and integrations, including dependencies between CRM and downstream ERP, financial, PSA, and order-to-cash processes.

• Develop and optimize CRM reporting capabilities, including saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks, dashboards, and sales pipeline and forecasting reports.

• Establish and reinforce CRM development standards, including code quality, documentation, version control, testing, release management, and change management.

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers and other Enterprise Platforms team members on NetSuite CRM architecture, development practices, troubleshooting, and system capabilities.

• Conduct technical design and code reviews, promote knowledge sharing, and maintain technical documentation to strengthen team capabilities and reduce dependency on individual resources.

• Collaborate with Enterprise Platforms leadership and business stakeholders to define and maintain a sustainable CRM technical roadmap aligned with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex CRM production issues, including data synchronization, workflow failures, lead routing, opportunity-to-project handoffs, and quote-to-order processes, focusing on root-cause analysis and long-term solutions.

• Participate in Agile development processes, technical planning, solution design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or equivalent professional experience.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting and developing NetSuite solutions, including at least 2 years of direct experience with NetSuite CRM capabilities.

• Demonstrated experience independently designing, developing, and supporting complex NetSuite CRM solutions in an enterprise environment.

• Proven expertise in SuiteScript 2.0/2.1, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteFlow, and SuiteBuilder, with experience developing custom CRM functionality and workflow automation.

• Strong understanding of NetSuite CRM architecture, lead-to-cash processes, data structures, performance optimization, and integration design.

• Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite CRM with marketing automation, CPQ/quoting, email and calendar platforms, and other enterprise applications using middleware and REST/SOAP web services.

• Experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations between NetSuite CRM or comparable enterprise CRM platforms and Professional Services Automation (PSA) solutions, including data synchronization, opportunity-to-project handoffs, order management, and downstream service delivery and billing processes.

• Experience with integration platforms such as Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, or comparable technologies.

• Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve NetSuite performance issues involving scripts, workflows, saved searches, record processing, and integrations.

• Experience with modern development practices, including source control, code reviews, testing, deployment management, and technical documentation.

• Experience supporting CRM implementations, modernization initiatives, upgrades, and enhancements while minimizing disruption to business operations.

• Working knowledge of NetSuite ERP processes, including financials, billing, and order management, sufficient to design and support CRM integrations and business process dependencies.

• Experience with ITIL, DevOps, Agile development methodologies, and enterprise change management practices.

• Demonstrated ability to provide technical mentorship, establish development standards, and share knowledge across engineering teams.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage competing priorities, technical deliverables, and production support responsibilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience supporting enterprise CRM modernization or transformation initiatives, including workflow redesign, performance optimization, and user experience improvements.

• Experience with HubSpot CRM, including integration with NetSuite, data synchronization, workflow automation, and supporting CRM modernization or overlay strategies.

• Experience integrating NetSuite CRM with Microsoft Outlook, Exchange, and calendar synchronization solutions, including Celigo ExtendSync or comparable platforms.

• Experience configuring and supporting NetSuite Partner Center, Customer Center, or customer-facing portal capabilities.

• Experience with CPQ and quoting solutions such as ConnectWise Sell or similar platforms.

• Experience supporting CRM solutions in organizations with complex sales processes, multiple business units, or acquisition-driven growth.

• Experience with NetSuite SuiteAnalytics, Performance Analytics, and CRM pipeline and forecasting reporting.

• NetSuite certifications, such as SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer, or Administrator, are a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

While performing the standard duties of this job, the employee can expect light physical exertion with long periods of sitting, occasional standing and walking; limited bending, crouching, stooping, stretching, reaching, or similar activities. Hearing and speech communication in person and over the telephone is essential to fulfilling the duties of this position.  Specific vision abilities required to read printed materials and a computer screen; including close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be surrounded by other employees and their conversations on the telephone and in person.  The noise level and indoor office temperature may vary.

Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, performance, licensure and certification, and business needs. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ. Certain positions may also be eligible for variable incentive compensation, such as bonuses or commissions, that is not included in the base salary.

Estimated Pay Range

$130,000—$150,000 USD

The Perks

• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long-Term Disability

• Competitive Compensation

• Training and development programs

• Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages

• Collaborative and cool culture

• Work-life balance and generous paid time off

Our Commitment

At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture.

As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3.com.

***To all recruitment agencies: Trace3 does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Please do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email addresses, Trace3 employees or any other company location. Trace3 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

jobs.title: General Manager, Marketplace
jobs.description:
ABOUT DAVID AI

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.




ABOUT DAVID AI

David AI is the first audio data research company. We bring an R&D approach to data–developing datasets with the same rigor AI labs bring to models. Our mission is to bring AI into the real world, and we believe audio is the gateway. Speech is versatile, accessible, and human—it fits naturally into everyday life. As audio AI advances and new use cases emerge, high-quality training data is the bottleneck. This is where David AI comes in.


David AI was founded in 2024 by a team of former Scale AI engineers and operators. In less than a year, we’ve brought on most FAANG companies and AI labs as customers. We recently raised a $50M Series B from Meritech, NVIDIA, Jack Altman (Alt Capital), Amplify Partners, First Round Capital and other Tier 1 investors.


Our team is sharp, humble, ambitious, and tight-knit. We’re looking for the best research, engineering, product, and operations minds to join us on our mission to push the frontier of audio AI.



ABOUT OUR MARKETPLACE TEAM

Our Marketplace team supplies the people behind David AI's Data Factory. Every dataset we deliver starts with contributors: voice actors, speakers, transcribers and annotators in more than 20 languages who record and label audio on our contributor platform. Our mandate is to make sure every production ramp has enough qualified contributors, at the right quality and cost, in the week it needs them.

This means running the full supply side of a two-sided marketplace. At the top of the funnel, we find contributors through paid channels, partnerships, referrals and community, and move them through application, review and approval. Further down, we get approved contributors to their first task, keep them engaged, and grow the hours they deliver each day. We work to weekly targets and fixed budgets, measure everything, and treat contributor supply as an input to data quality, not just a cost line. We are scrappy, analytical operators, as comfortable launching a new acquisition channel in a day as running a 20-language ramp end to end.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

As General Manager of Marketplace, you will own contributor supply for David AI end to end. Your mandate is to make our contributor marketplace a reliable source of qualified contributors and deliverable hours for every production ramp we commit to. You'll lead the team responsible for acquiring, activating, and retaining contributors across every production ramp (speech-to-speech, text-to-speech and voice acting, transcription), and you'll be the single accountable owner that every Data Operations GM relies on to hit their supply plan.

You'll also be the supply counterpart to our Data Operations GMs. You'll set targets with each production team, run the workback plan against them, decide where the marketplace invests (channels, partnerships, contributor experience, tooling), and own the outcome. You'll inherit a small, high-output team and a marketplace that is growing into new languages, modalities, and customer segments every quarter.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Build and lead a team of Marketplace Leads spanning contributor growth (applications, approvals and activations) and contributor engagement (daily active contributors, hours per contributor and retention). Set the team's priorities and decide which initiatives get its time.

 - Own supply for every production ramp. Work with each Data Operations GM and their Data Product Operations Leads to shape the project's initial budget. Build the ramp plan together, with that budget as the constraint, and agree the weekly targets the marketplace will hit.

 - Run the ramp operating rhythm: weekly plans with each project team, pacing reviews, and early escalation when a language, project or channel falls behind.

 - Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how the marketplace scales: which contributor segments to build, where to invest, and what supply next quarter's pipeline will need.

 - Own the marketplace's metrics and unit economics: pool size, activation, retention, productivity, and cost relative to what contributors deliver, by project and cohort. Partner with data science to decide which analytics are worth building, and use them to decide where to scale or invest next.

 - Allocate each project's marketplace budget between growth (recruiting new contributors) and supply (activating and retaining them). Within growth, split spend across languages and channels such as paid social, search, job boards, partnerships and referrals, and hold the team to cost-per-activation targets.

 - Improve the contributor experience from first application to first task and beyond. Run controlled experiments on the activation path, build a recurring contributor feedback loop, and fix the pain points behind it.

 - Own outcomes across functions, partnering with product, engineering, QA and payments to remove the bottlenecks that slow contributors down, from review queues to project access to payouts.


YOUR BACKGROUND LOOKS LIKE

 - 7 – 10 years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., GM, founder, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup), including direct experience running the supply side of a marketplace.

 - You have owned a gig or flexible-labor supply pool (e.g., drivers, dashers, shoppers, freelancers) at a company like DoorDash, Uber, Instacart, or a comparable marketplace, and were accountable for its acquisition, activation, and retention numbers.

 - Prior experience owning a supply funnel end to end, from first touch to first completed job, against weekly targets and a budget.

 - Prior experience building budgets and capacity plans with finance and operating partners, then running a team against them.

 - Prior experience balancing supply against demand across many markets at once (cities, languages or segments), and knowing when to throttle and when to scale.

 - Experience leading a team of operators or growth leads, and working as a peer to the GMs who own delivery.

 - A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.

 - Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience in AI training data, data labeling, or crowd-work and freelance marketplaces.

 - Experience recruiting a global, multilingual workforce across many countries at once.

 - Hands-on experience running paid acquisition (paid social, search, job boards) or referral programs for supply.

 - Experience with voice talent, creator or other creative communities.


BENEFITS

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.

 - FSA & HSA access.

 - 401k access.

 - Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.

 - Unlimited company-sponsored Barry’s classes.
