VISAS

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B transfers, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

jobs.title: Customer Care Associate (Full Time)
jobs.description:
Pay Rate: $19.00/Hr.

The Recruiting & Customer Care Associate serves as a primary point of contact for Tasteocracy participants while supporting participant recruitment and study fulfillment. This role provides responsive, friendly support across phone and digital communication channels, helps resolve participant questions and concerns, and assists participants throughout their research experience.

In addition to customer care, this position actively supports recruiting efforts by contacting potential participants, understanding study qualification requirements, identifying appropriate study opportunities, scheduling qualified participants, and helping the recruiting team prioritize studies with the greatest need.

Key Responsibilities:

Participant Customer Care

• Provide friendly, professional support through phone, email, SMS, live chat, and social messaging.
• Work toward resolving participant questions or concerns during the first interaction whenever possible.
• Respond to participant inquiries in a timely manner and ensure questions or concerns are followed through to resolution.
• Provide clear and accurate information while creating a welcoming, positive participant experience.
• Recognize when an inquiry requires additional support and appropriately escalate it to the recruiting management team.

Recruiting & Scheduling

• Understand active study requirements, qualification criteria, quotas, scheduling needs, and logistical information.
• Conduct outbound recruiting using internal participant lists and external potential-participant lists.
• Identify appropriate study opportunities for participants based on current recruiting priorities.
• Confirm participants meet applicable qualification requirements before scheduling.
• Maintain awareness of studies with the greatest recruiting needs and appropriately direct interested participants toward available opportunities.
• Support host communication and other recruiting activities as needed.

Participant Database & Administrative Support

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date participant information.
• Proactively update participant records during customer interactions when appropriate.
• Complete assigned recurring database maintenance and data-cleaning projects.
• Support participant communications related to database maintenance and research projects.
• Complete special administrative projects supporting the recruiting department as needed.

Performance, Training & Development

• Meet established phone and digital-channel performance expectations, including applicable handle time, response time and utilization metrics.
• Meet established productivity and billability expectations.
• Participate in required departmental training.
• Demonstrate an understanding of recruiting procedures, customer care expectations, and study-related processes.

• High School diploma or GED equivalent certificate required. Associate degree strongly preferred.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
• Comfortable communicating across phone and digital channels.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
• Ability to learn and consistently apply study-specific qualification criteria.
• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable conducting outbound recruiting calls.
• Proactive, dependable, collaborative, and adaptable.
• Strong computer skills and ability to learn multiple technology platforms.

Pay Rate: $19.00/Hr.

Schedule:

• Full- Time position, between 35 to 40 hours per week.
• Shifts may vary between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM Central Time.
• Most shifts are Monday through Friday, with a rotating Saturday and/or Sunday approximately every 3-4 weeks.
• When scheduled on Saturday and/or Sunday, an alternate weekday off will be provided Tuesday through Friday.

Candidates currently living within a commutable distance to Plymouth, MN are encouraged to apply.

What we offer:

• Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA Food Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Practice Manager I East Greenbush, NY I Full-Time I

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

East Greenbush Animal Hospital is seeking a full-time Veterinary Practice Manager who can do more than run daily operations. We need someone who will work with hospital leaders to develop and execute a strategic roadmap that includes building the leadership structure, accountability, and systems this practice needs to operate at its full potential. This is a hands-on operator role for someone looking for ownership and an opportunity to build.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• 5+ years of progressive management experience in a veterinary hospital, animal hospital, or other multi-department healthcare/service setting is required.

• Experience managing other managers or department leads is strongly preferred, given this role oversees leadership across hospital, daycare, grooming, and boarding.

• A track record of developing and empowering real ownership to develop future leaders.

• A track record of building or overhauling operational structure (SOPs, accountability systems, org design) is a strong plus.

• Experience reading and interpreting a P&L and operational data to drive decisions.

• Proven ability to balance business needs with team well-being, and to work in true partnership with doctor partners and the VPP Home Team.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, Slack, and veterinary practice management software (Pulse).

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried position.

Typical schedule: Monday through Friday, with occasional after-hours meetings, Saturdays, and community events.

Flexibility and discretion in creating your own schedule.

PAY

$100,000 – $120,000 per year, determined by the candidate's skills, experience, and qualifications. Eligibility for up to 15% performance-based annual bonus, tied to operational and financial results.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & REQUIREMENTS

As Practice Manager, you will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and building strong leadership across all four service lines: veterinary hospital, daycare, grooming, and boarding. You'll work closely with our doctor partners and VPP Home Team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations, capable department leadership, and an exceptional experience for patients, clients, and staff.

East Greenbush Animal Hospital is a large, full-service veterinary hospital offering preventative care, orthopedic and soft tissue surgery, dentistry with dental radiography, internal medicine, digital x-ray and ultrasound. As part of a growing network of veterinary hospitals, this role also offers strong opportunities for professional development and career growth within the broader organization.

We're dedicated to your well-being and offer a comprehensive package and professional development opportunities to support your work and home life.

These include:

• Competitive salary

• Medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug benefits for you and eligible dependents

• Paid time off for full-time employees

• 401(k) plan

• Guardian voluntary benefits

Ready to build something real? Apply today — we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director of IT
jobs.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: U.S. Based
Annual salary: USD 175,000 - USD 250,000
Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.
Type: Full-time
Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

About the Role

Nex is looking for an IT Director to own the strategy, delivery, and governance of our business systems and technology operations as we scale Nex Playground globally. This is a senior leadership role with broad scope — spanning enterprise systems, business systems integration and vendor relationships — and direct influence on how Nex operates and grows.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Technology Stack Oversight

• Lead the roadmap and execution of Nex’s corporate IT and business systems.

• Oversee the administration, maintenance, and reliability of the full corporate tech stack, ensuring systems are well-integrated, performant, and scalable.

• Own the company’s non-coding artificial intelligence use and access policy.

Corporate IT Procurement & Vendor Strategy

• Own all corporate IT and business system vendor relationships, including contract negotiation, performance accountability, and portfolio optimisation.

• Lead corporate IT system procurement — evaluating, selecting, and onboarding tools and platforms that meet Nex’s operational and security requirements.

• Partner on solution architecture and integration decisions with a focus on scalability and cost discipline.

Systems Implementation & Interoperability

• Serve as the internal consultancy lead for IT system rollouts, implementations, and integrations across business functions.

• Partner with respective internal system owners on integration and architectural decisions for payments, taxation, order orchestration, and global commerce workflows.

• Ensure business systems can communicate effectively with one another, maintaining data integrity and operational continuity across platforms.

IT Operations & Access Provisioning

• Own end-to-end corporate IT system maintenance and access provisioning, including identity and access management (IAM), user onboarding/offboarding, role-based access controls, and periodic access reviews.

• Own the full employee technology lifecycle, including device procurement, provisioning, asset management, refresh cycles, and secure device retirement.

• Oversee enterprise productivity and collaboration platforms (eg Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Zoom, Microsoft 365) and ensure reliable employee access and support.

• Partner with People Operations to deliver a seamless and secure new-hire experience across global locations.

• Manage IT Operations Specialist to support and execute the above responsibilities.

Corporate Data Security & Employee Training

• Own the implementation of Nex’s corporate data security posture — including identity management, endpoint management, device security, MDM, anti-virus, firewall, VPN, backup infrastructure, and corporate SaaS and cloud systems security.

• Support audit and due diligence readiness for corporate IT systems and implement compliance initiatives across corporate IT systems.

• Deliver employee security training programs, including anti-phishing, access hygiene, and applicable statutory requirements.

• Set the direction for Nex’s corporate IT infrastructure for internal use in partnership with internal teams and vendors, ensuring data integrity and appropriate access controls.

Team & Organisational Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing team of IT professionals.

• Serve as a thought partner to the executive team on technology investments, build vs. buy decisions, and organisational capability building.

Qualifications

What you must have

• 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, Business Systems, or Technical Program Management, with at least 3 years in a senior IT leadership role, ideally as the most senior IT leader at a company of roughly 100–500 people

• Demonstrated success owning enterprise-wide technology strategy and delivery in a fast-scaling company

• Track record of building and managing high-performing teams and external vendor relationships

• Strong executive presence and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience leading corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, IAM, employee onboarding/offboarding, and IT asset lifecycle management

• Deep understanding of enterprise security controls, device management, access governance, and compliance best practices

• Experience administering and securing productivity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Zoom and Microsoft 365

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with NetSuite, Shopify, Amazon ecosystems, and data/reporting platforms

• Deep expertise across e-commerce and D2C technology ecosystems

• Background in high-growth, hardware-enabled, or consumer tech environments

• Experience managing global, multi-region systems and distributed teams

What Success Looks Like

• A reliable, scalable technology foundation that supports Nex’s global growth without friction

• A vendor portfolio that is well-governed, cost-efficient, and accountable

• A team that is trusted, capable, and operating with increasing independence

We Offer

• Competitive compensation package.

• Flexible working hours and vacation policy.

• Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.

• Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about.

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

This policy applies to all individuals at every stage of the employment relationship, including all current and prospective employees, and covers all employment decisions including recruitment, hiring, job assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline and termination.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Vision AI
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast powers restaurants of every size, from neighborhood favorites to the largest multi-unit brands in the industry. We're investing in Vision AI to help operators see more of what's happening in their restaurants and act on it, so they can run more efficiently, provide better service, and become even more profitable.

We're looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Vision AI to build the platform and the products that bring it to restaurant operators. You'll own major parts of the system end to end, from the services that process video to the customer-facing features operators use every day, and you'll have real influence on how Vision AI is built.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Build ML systems and drive model choices. Select and integrate vision models, including vision-language models, and build the ML systems around them, such as inference pipelines, evaluation, and monitoring of model performance in production.

• Contribute to architecture and design. Help shape technical decisions with the team, building what's right for today while keeping a clear path to where we're headed.

• Collaborate across teams. Partner with product, design, and teams across Toast on integrations and dependencies when the work calls for it.

• Work AI-forward. Use AI coding tools and agent harnesses as a core part of how you design, build, test, and ship, and share workflows that make the team faster.

• Raise the bar. Set a high standard for quality, testing, reliability, security, and privacy in the areas you own, and help other engineers grow through code reviews and collaboration.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Solid engineering experience. 8+ years building and shipping models in production.

• Mastery of a modern backend language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Scala.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Vision AI
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast powers restaurants of every size, from neighborhood favorites to the largest multi-unit brands in the industry. We're investing in Vision AI to help operators see more of what's happening in their restaurants and act on it, so they can run more efficiently, provide better service, and become even more profitable.

We're looking for a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Vision AI to architect and build the platform behind these products. You'll have an outsized influence on how Vision AI is built and how it reaches restaurants across Toast. This is a highly hands-on role: you'll spend most of your time designing, building, and shipping, and you'll own the technical direction of the platform.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Architect and build the core platform. Design the video pipeline and other essential components, from how video is captured and ingested to how it's stored, processed, and delivered, so the platform is secure and reliable.

• Own the services that analyze video. Build the services that process footage, run vision models, and turn what they see into observations and metrics restaurants can act on.

• Build ML systems and drive model choices. Select and integrate vision models, including vision-language models, and build the ML systems around them, such as inference pipelines, evaluation, and monitoring of model performance in production. Partner with our ML engineers as models mature.

• Build customer-facing use cases across Toast. Bring vision-powered features to restaurant operators across Toast's products and surfaces.

• Set the technical direction. Make the key architecture decisions for the Vision AI platform, building what's right for today while keeping a clear path to where we're headed.

• Stay hands-on. Write production code, prototype new ideas, and ship. You'll lead through building, not just reviewing.

• Collaborate across orgs. Partner with teams across Toast on integrations, dependencies, and working models when the work calls for it.

• Lead with AI-forward engineering. Use AI coding tools and agent harnesses as a core part of how you design, build, test, and ship, and help the team adopt workflows that make everyone faster.

• Raise the bar. Mentor engineers, set standards for reliability, security, and privacy, and make the platform easier to build on with every use case.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Deep engineering experience. 10+ years building software, including designing and shipping distributed systems and data pipelines in production at scale.

• Backend and cloud expertise. Strong experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), event-driven systems (e.g. Pulsar or Kafka), storage, and APIs, in Kotlin, Java, or similar languages, plus comfort with Python.

• Experience with ML systems and video. You don't need to be a model researcher, but you understand how models are trained, tuned, and served, and you've built and operated ML systems in production, including inference pipelines, evaluation, and model monitoring. You're also comfortable working with video (streams, codecs, tools like ffmpeg).

• Pragmatic architecture. A track record of designing systems that fit the current stage, avoiding over-engineering while leaving room to grow.

• Zero-to-one experience. Experience taking ambiguous ideas from prototype to production with real customers.

• Hands-on keyboard. You still write significant production code and enjoy doing it.

• AI-forward ways of working. Daily use of AI coding assistants and agent harnesses (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), and experience building with LLM or vision-language model APIs.

• Collaboration and communication. Ability to align engineers, product partners, and other orgs around technical decisions and explain tradeoffs clearly.

This role may not be a fit for you if...

• You want a primarily cross-org or architecture-only role. This is a hands-on keyboard role. You'll spend most of your time building, with cross-org collaboration when the work requires it.

• You're more attached to the solution than the problem. We want someone obsessed with solving real problems for restaurant operators, who picks the simplest approach that solves them.

• You tend to build for scale before it's needed. We need someone who builds the right solution for where we are today and what customers are telling us, while keeping long-term direction in mind and knowing when to invest in it.

• You prefer established processes and tooling. This team moves fast and shapes its own ways of working. You'll help create the workflows, tools, and standards rather than inherit them.

• You're uncomfortable with ambiguity. The problems we take on and the best ways to solve them will keep evolving, and priorities will shift as we learn from customers.

• You'd rather be perfect than experiment. We move fast, test ideas with real restaurants, and accept that some of what we build will be thrown away once we learn what works.

• AI-assisted development isn't part of how you work. We expect AI tools to be central to how we design, build, and ship.

Special Sauce (Nice to Haves)

• Experience building computer vision, video analytics, or camera-based products.

• Experience with real-time video pipelines and streaming (e.g. Amazon Kinesis Video Streams, GStreamer, WebRTC).

• Experience with connected device fleets: device provisioning and authentication, remote updates, and constrained networks.

• Experience building privacy-sensitive systems that handle video or personal data.

• Background in restaurant, retail, hospitality, drive-thru, or other operationally complex environments.

jobs.title: Principal Member of Technical Staff,  ASIC Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
Lumotive is pioneering the era of programmable optics—where light is controlled as intelligently and flexibly as software.
 
At the heart of this transformation is a once-in-a-generation innovation: a flat CMOS-based “general purpose optic.” Lumotive’s Light Control Metasurface (LCM™) beam forming chips can be programmed to function as a beam steering mirror, a lens, mirror, a beam splitter—or any optical function—replacing bulky and mechanical optical components with a fully digital, reconfigurable semiconductor . This breakthrough lays the foundation for a massive shift in multiple technologies—from 3D sensing and imaging to optical networking, free space optical communication, and beyond. Like the shift from analog to digital in electronics, programmable optics will reshape industries from robotics, self-driving cars, AI, defense, and healthcare.

Lumotive’s first commercial application is in LiDAR, where its software-defined beam steering chips are already enabling compact, high-performance, solid-state sensors. These sensors are being deployed today in smart infrastructure, robotics, and mobility systems through leading module makers and solution integrators.

With more than 200 patents and growing commercial traction, Lumotive is delivering the world’s first digital platform for light—and redefining what’s possible in the optical age.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The HRBP team at OpenAI partners with leaders on complex organizational and talent decisions where the right path isn’t always obvious. We stay close to the business so we understand its realities, and focus our time where judgment, influence, and context can make the biggest difference: improving decisions, strengthening leaders, and helping teams work better.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Go-to-Market HR Business Partner, you’ll be a trusted advisor, sounding board, and hands-on problem solver for leaders in your client group. This is an individual contributor role. You’ll help leaders decide how to organize, grow, and lead their teams, bringing a point of view on the tradeoffs rather than simply executing the first request.

That starts with understanding the business problem. If customer coverage needs to change, for example, you’ll help leaders clarify what’s driving the change, weigh options for team structure and staffing, and work with them to put the decision into practice. The goal is to leave leaders better equipped to make the next decision, too.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Help GTM leaders make better decisions about team structure, workforce plans, and hiring. Work with Finance and Recruiting to turn those decisions into plans the business can execute.

 - Build leadership capability by giving candid, actionable feedback and coaching managers through complex performance, development, and succession decisions.

 - Lead the people side of organizational changes, from planning and communication to clarifying roles and supporting teams through transitions.

 - Work with regional HRBPs and People partners, including Compensation and Employee Relations, to apply consistent practices while accounting for local needs.

 - Build simple systems and routines that help GTM teams scale. Improve how leaders review talent, spot emerging issues, and follow through on decisions.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Install Base
jobs.description:
The Account Executive, Install is part of Cleo’s first-class Sales Team and is responsible for growing revenue within Cleo’s existing customer base. You will become a product knowledge expert across the Cleo Integration Cloud and focus on expanding the value customers get from Cleo by identifying new use cases, adding trading partners, volumes, and modules, and renewing and growing recurring revenue across a book of installed customers.

You will use modern AI tools as part of your everyday workflow to find whitespace in your accounts, spot expansion and renewal signals, personalize outreach at scale, and keep your pipeline accurate. Our goal is to help you take the next step in your sales career and give you the tools to do it successfully. We are looking for candidates who are eager to drive their business and set goals that align with company growth. Cleo is a growing ecosystem and we want the best and brightest on our team.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Manage and grow a book of installed customers, serving as the commercial point of contact for expansion and renewal opportunities

• Identify and close upsell, cross-sell, and add-on opportunities, such as new modules, additional trading partners, increased volumes, and new business units or use cases

• Execute a successful sales process from opportunity identification to appointment to close, with a high level of activity across a large number of accounts

• Own the renewal cycle for assigned accounts, forecasting renewals early, addressing risk, and negotiating terms that protect and grow recurring revenue

• Analyze customer usage, contract, and product-footprint data to identify whitespace and prioritize accounts with the highest expansion potential

• Partner with Account Managers, Customer Success, Support, and Professional Services to drive adoption, resolve issues, and make sure customers realize value from Cleo

• Work with SDRs and Solution Consultants to build programs that meet each client’s needs and budget

• Educate and advise clients on industry trends, EDI and B2B integration best practices, and the value of Cleo’s ecosystem to build strong, trustworthy relationships

• Obtain feedback from clients and adjust messaging to improve downstream execution; share customer insights with Product and Marketing

• Negotiate with clients, solve problems, and make sure deadlines are met

• Check and report on customers’ Cleo program progress and value realized

• Maintain accurate opportunity, account, and forecast data in the CRM and deliver reliable renewal and expansion forecasts

AI Fluency Competencies

At Cleo, AI is part of how our sales team works. In this role you are expected to use AI responsibly and effectively to improve the quality and speed of your work, while keeping your judgment and customer relationships at the center. Fluency in this role means:

• Whitespace and account analysis. Use AI to analyze usage, contract, and footprint data across your installed base and surface the accounts and use cases with the greatest expansion potential.

• Signal-driven prioritization. Interpret AI-driven intent, usage, and customer-health signals to decide where to focus expansion, renewal, and risk-mitigation efforts

• Personalization at scale. Use AI to tailor outreach, proposals, and renewal communications to each customer’s industry, trading partner network, and priorities, then edit them so they sound authentic and are correct.

• Prompting and iteration. Write clear prompts, give AI useful context, and refine outputs until they are accurate, specific, and ready to use.

• Conversation intelligence. Use AI-generated call summaries, themes, and action items to capture next steps, improve your own approach, and share insights with Account Management and Customer Success.

• Forecasting and CRM hygiene. Use AI assistance to keep records current, flag at-risk renewals and stalled deals, and pressure-test your forecast.

• Sound judgment and verification. Verify AI output before sharing it with a customer, know where AI helps and where human insight is needed, and keep your own judgment in every customer interaction.

• Responsible use. Follow Cleo’s AI, data security, and confidentiality policies. Never enter customer confidential or sensitive data into unapproved tools.

• Continuous learning. Stay curious about new AI capabilities, share what works with your peers, and help the team raise its collective AI skills.

Prerequisites

• Have received a Bachelor’s degree

• 3-5 years prior experience in an Account Executive, Account Management, SDR/BDR, or Inside sales role, preferably in B2B SaaS

• Experience managing renewals and driving expansion within an existing customer base is a plus

• Communicate confidently in person, over the phone, and online

• Comfortable using AI tools to research, plan, and communicate, with sound judgment about when and how to use them

• Strong organization and time management across a large portfolio of accounts

• Focus on the positive and strive for continual improvement

• Be ambitious and motivated to achieve results

• Collaborate and operate well in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

• Be effective at building strong, long-term relationships

• Adhere to a strong work ethic and sense of commitment

• Enjoy learning about supply chain, B2B integration, and the IT industry

• Ability to travel 30%

A few things we offer

• Compensation Range: $80,000 - $100,000 annual base salary + Commission Potential

• Great Healthcare + Dental + Vision

• Flexible PTO

• Culture of support, encouraging Life-Work balance

• 401k match

• FSA and HSA options

jobs.title: R&D Test Engineering Intern (SoFuel)
jobs.description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com.

Tempo is seeking a motivated, hands-on Engineering Intern to support the development and experimental validation of its high-temperature thermal energy storage technology.

The intern will work primarily on the SoFuel test stand, an experimental system designed to investigate high-temperature solid pellet storage, gas-solid heat transfer, granular material flow, and thermal system performance. This position offers an opportunity to work directly with experimental hardware, operate and improve a research-scale test system, analyze test data, and contribute to the development of next-generation energy storage technology.

We are looking for someone who enjoys building, testing, troubleshooting, and solving practical engineering problems in a laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experimental Testing and Test Stand Operation

• Assist in preparing, setting up, and operating the SoFuel experimental test stand under the supervision of experienced engineers.

• Execute experimental test plans to evaluate gas–solid heat transfer, particle flow behavior, and system performance.

• Monitor operating parameters, including temperature, gas flow rate, pressure, and particle movement.

• Conduct repeatability tests and evaluate the effects of changing operating conditions.

• Follow established operating procedures and safety protocols during testing.

2. Instrumentation and Data Acquisition

• Set up, calibrate, and troubleshoot sensors and measurement equipment, including thermocouples, flow meters, pressure transducers, and distance sensors.

• Monitor and record experimental data using the test stand's data acquisition and control systems.

• Verify data quality, identify measurement anomalies, and maintain organized experimental records.

• Support improvements to instrumentation and data collection procedures.

3. Troubleshooting and Test Stand Improvements

• Assist in identifying and resolving operational issues such as particle clogging, inconsistent flow, temperature fluctuations, and sensor malfunctions.

• Support mechanical modifications, component replacement, and routine maintenance of the test stand.

• Work with engineers to evaluate improvements to gas flow control, particle discharge mechanisms, and test stand reliability.

• Help implement and validate improvements to operating procedures and control sequences.

4. Data Analysis and Reporting

• Process and analyze experimental data using Excel, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

• Generate plots showing temperature profiles, flow behavior, pressure changes, and system performance.

• Compare experimental results across different operating conditions.

• Prepare concise technical summaries, test reports, and presentations documenting results and observations.

• Maintain accurate test logs and document experimental findings and recommended improvements.

Required Qualifications

• Currently pursuing a BS or MS degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related engineering discipline.

• Strong interest in hands-on experimental engineering and laboratory testing.

• Basic understanding of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics.

• Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation and data acquisition.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and basic engineering data analysis.

• Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating with a multidisciplinary engineering team.

• Good problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

• Willingness to work with experimental hardware in a laboratory environment and follow strict safety procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience with experimental test stands, laboratory equipment, or engineering research projects.

• Experience with thermocouples, pressure sensors, flow meters, valves, or data acquisition systems.

• Familiarity with Python, Arduino C#, LabVIEW, or similar software for data processing and automation.

• Experience with mechanical assembly, fabrication, or troubleshooting.

• Basic understanding of control systems, programmable controllers, or automated test equipment.

• Experience with high-temperature equipment, furnaces, granular materials, or gas–solid flow systems.

• Familiarity with CAD software such as SolidWorks is a plus.

What You Will Gain

• Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting a high-temperature experimental system.

• Practical exposure to thermal engineering, fluid mechanics, instrumentation, and control systems.

• Experience designing and executing experiments and interpreting real-world engineering data.

• Opportunities to work directly with experienced engineers and researchers developing advanced energy storage technology.

• Experience contributing to an active R&D program, from experimental testing through analysis and technical reporting.

Compensation

The pay rate for this internship is $30 per hour. Our pay rates are determined by role, level, and location. Within a range, individual pay may vary based on factors including academic level, relevant skills, and experience.

Working at Tempo

Tempo is a lean organization working on exciting challenges, and the people who thrive here share a few things in common beyond their technical skills.

• Clear, direct communication: You professionally say what you mean, lead with empathy, use tact, ask when you're unsure, and keep the people around you informed without being asked. At a company our size, communication gaps are expensive, and good communicators add to success and efficiency!

• Low-ego helpfulness: You're willing to jump in on work that isn't strictly yours, whether that's helping a teammate debug something, lending a hand in the shop, or flagging an issue you noticed outside your lane. No one here succeeds in a silo.

• Intellectual curiosity: You're genuinely interested in how things work, not just your piece of it, but the broader system. Tempo sits at the intersection of chemistry, mechanical engineering, power electronics, and software; the more you understand about the whole, the more valuable you become.

• Business awareness: You understand that your work exists in a business context. You think about cost, timeline, and tradeoffs—not just technical elegance—and you make decisions accordingly.

• Comfort with ambiguity: Processes here are still being built. You can make progress without a perfect playbook, and you know when to ask for direction versus when to use your judgment and move forward.

• Accountability: You own your outcomes, including the misses. When something goes sideways, the instinct here is to fix it and learn from it, not to explain why it wasn't your fault.

jobs.title: Certification Architect
jobs.description:
About the Team

Customer Education helps customers build the practical skills and confidence to use AI and OpenAI products safely and effectively. We bring together customer insight, learning and enablement expertise, product signals, and measurement to help organizations move from access to durable adoption.

Within Customer Education, the Certification team helps individuals demonstrate competence for in-demand AI skills and helps customers and partners validate that their workforce has the skills they need to meet their AI-enabled business goals. Our work centers on the belief that learners should understand where to go to build skills and capabilities, how to demonstrate them, and what to pursue next. Similarly, Enterprise leaders should understand what each credential signifies and how it supports workforce readiness. We do this with transparency for the overall OpenAI credential framework and providing trusted, role-based certifications that verify practical capability.

About the Role

As Certification Architect, you will define the framework, standards, and assessment architecture that make OpenAI certifications a trusted signal of demonstrated capability.

This is a senior hands-on role on the Certification team that will build reusable foundations for a growing portfolio: clear competency standards, defensible assessments, scalable in-product delivery, and evidence of continued competence.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep certification and assessment expertise with the ability to innovate new and meaningful ways to demonstrate practical AI competence. You will work closely with certification specialists, technical subject matter experts, learning product and engineering teams, operations and policy partners, and stakeholders across the go-to-market organization.

The program is early, and you will help shape how people demonstrate capability in ChatGPT and Codex. Success means building standards that are rigorous, usable, and adaptable as AI technology and professional roles evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the credential framework and shared competency standards, distinguishing completed learning, demonstrated skills, and formal certification, with clear capability claims and evidence requirements for each.

 - Establish reusable assessment standards and guidance for certification pods across job-task analysis, competency models, assessment blueprints, performance tasks, scoring rubrics, and passing standards.

 - Own the validation approach and evidence documentation requirements. Partner with pod leaders to validate certification proposals against job relevance, representative task coverage, scoring consistency, fairness, and appropriate interpretation of results.

 - Define exam delivery architecture and requirements with product, engineering, operations, and third parties, spanning registration, identity verification, monitoring, permitted assistance, evidence capture, scoring, human review, appeals, customer support, and record management.

 - Define expectations for continued competence validation post-assessment.

 - Partner with learning, operations, policy, legal, privacy, security, and accessibility teams to align preparation with competencies while protecting assessment integrity and establishing appropriate evidence access, retention, accommodations, and review processes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 10+ years experience designing and delivering professional technical IT industry certifications or assessments that support credible claims about what people can do.

 - Have led design of performance-based assessments for AI, software development, technical architecture, or customer-facing implementation roles.

 - Have built credential frameworks, competency models, or shared assessment standards that work across multiple roles or programs.

 - Have led job-task analysis, assessment blueprints, performance-based assessment, rubric design, standard setting, and the evidence needed to support valid and fair certification decisions.

 - Can translate assessment experience requirements into exam delivery specifications for third parties and learning product teams.

 - Have worked closely with certification specialists, psychometricians and subject matter experts to validate assessment and scoring standards and improve assessment quality.

 - Communicate complex standards clearly to technical and nontechnical partners, and build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority.

 - Enjoy hands-on work, from drafting standards and reviewing assessment designs to resolving practical delivery tradeoffs with a small team.

 - Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing rigor, candidate experience, delivery feasibility, and the pace of technology change.

 - Care deeply about accessibility, fairness, and the integrity of credentials that individuals and employers rely on.

 - Build reusable approaches while recognizing where different roles need distinct competency models, tasks, and evidence.

Additional experience that would be helpful includes:

 - Validating AI-assisted scoring, model evaluations, or other automated approaches to evaluating human performance.

 - Working with secure assessment delivery, identity verification, credential issuance, learner records, or assessment technology providers.

 - Developing innovative approaches to recertification, ongoing competence, or assessment of authentic work.

 - Building products that serve both individual users and organizations.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Site Acceptance Testing Technician
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About This Role:

The Field Service Technician – Mechanical Integration & Field Site Acceptance plays a vital role in the field deployment, mechanical integration, site acceptance testing (SAT), and field support for Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) data center infrastructure. Operating directly within client and enterprise data center sites, the technician ensures high-reliability installation and mechanical validation of Modular Data Centers (MDCs), power distribution skids, high-density GPU/server racks, thermal containment systems, and cooling manifolds.



This role focuses on field installation, precision physical alignment, site acceptance protocols, and non-licensed low-voltage support (24VDC/signal control circuits). This position operates strictly within a non-certified electrical scope; all high-voltage electrical connections and certified electrician tasks are strictly excluded.



What You’ll Be Working On:


MECHANICAL INTEGRATION & FIELD INSTALLATION

 - Perform on-site mechanical positioning, structural anchor mounting, and precision alignment for modular data centers (MDCs), GPU/server rack assemblies, power skids, and containment structures.

 - Rig, position, level, and secure heavy OEM sub-assemblies and fluid distribution manifolds using precision leveling gear, torque tools, and field rigging equipment.

 - Execute field installation of cooling lines, quick-disconnect (QD) fittings, and fluid interconnects following engineering drawings and exact torque specifications.

 - Conduct field structural integrity checks, vibration isolation verifications, and environmental sealing on modular enclosures.


SITE ACCEPTANCE TESTING (SAT) & QUALITY VERIFICATION

 - Execute Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) protocols for newly landed OEM equipment to verify mechanical integrity and installation readiness prior to final customer handover.

 - Perform mechanical and visual quality inspection checklists during uncrating, landing, and positioning at client facilities.

 - Document SAT outcomes, maintain field test logs, and compile detailed punch-lists for any mechanical or cosmetic anomalies observed on site.

 - Partner with client data center facility teams, general contractors, and commissioning engineers to resolve field integration issues efficiently.


NON-LICENSED LOW-VOLTAGE CONTROL & SIGNAL SUPPORT

 - Support low-voltage control circuits (24VDC, sensor loops, and signal lines) on OEM equipment as non-licensed field support.

 - Perform basic multi-meter continuity checks and voltage measurements on non-energized control loops and terminal blocks.

 - Execute precise wire stripping, terminal block termination, crimping, wire lacing, and cable management inside OEM control cabinets.

 - Observe strict electrical boundary limits: high-voltage AC connections, main electrical panel wiring, and licensed electrician duties are explicitly out of scope.


FIELD SERVICE & TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION

 - Serve as the primary technical field representative for OEM equipment landing, mechanical troubleshooting, and field modification kits.

 - Complete daily site logs, field service reports, redline drawing revisions, and material tracking forms accurately.

 - Adhere strictly to environment, health, and safety (EHS) guidelines, Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) rules, and site-specific Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures.



What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - High school diploma or equivalent; trade school diploma or technical certification in mechanical technology, field service, or industrial maintenance is highly desirable.

 - 2–5+ years of practical field service, mechanical installation, or field integration experience within data centers, critical facilities, industrial power, or HVAC environments.

 - Hands-on proficiency with mechanical hand/power tools, torque wrenches, precision measurement devices, and leveling equipment.

 - Ability to read and interpret mechanical assembly drawings, structural layouts, and field installation procedures.

 - Physical capacity to lift up to 50 lbs unassisted, work in confined spaces inside modular units, and perform work at elevated heights safely.

 - Mobility and willingness to travel to client data center project locations as required.



Bonus Points:

 - OEM Data Center Equipment: Direct field experience with modular data centers (MDCs), power skids, server/GPU rack containment, and fluid distribution manifolds.

 - Basic Electrical Wiring & Schematics: Familiarity with low-voltage wiring fundamentals, reading control schematics, wire stripping, terminal block wiring, and cable lacing techniques.

 - Low-Voltage Diagnostics: Hands-on experience operating digital multimeters for non-energized continuity verification and low-voltage (24VDC/signal) troubleshooting.

 - Hydraulic & Cooling Systems: Working knowledge of liquid cooling loops, pressure testing procedures, and quick-disconnect manifold connections.

 - Safety Credentials: Active OSHA 10 / OSHA 30 card, NFPA 70E awareness, and signalperson/rigging safety training.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $46.25/HR + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. (#INDMFG)

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Corporate Real Estate
jobs.description:
About the Job

Location: San Francisco Bay Area; Travel Required
Department: Real Estate
Reports to: Senior Director, Corporate Real Estate
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $155,000 – $180,000 + Bonus + Equity

About Ever

Ever is building the future of auto retail. As the first AI-native auto retailer, we are building the next $100B+ automotive business, starting with electric vehicles.

Based out of San Francisco and expanding nationwide, we are backed by leading investors and led by former tech & automotive professionals from Uber, Tesla, Rivian, Apple, Amazon, Carvana, J.P. Morgan, BCG, and more. After our recently completed Series B financing, we have raised around $200M in total equity and debt funding. We are growing rapidly and actively recruiting exceptional talent – to set a new frontier in the largest sector of the US retail economy.

Learn more about us at evercars.com.

About the Role

The Senior Manager will be Ever’s lead deal executor, taking sites from first tour through executed lease and hand-off to construction across multiple markets at once.

This role will work closely with co-founders, management, brokers, landlords, and legal counsel to secure locations that meet Ever’s operational needs, financial targets, and opening timelines. The ideal candidate is an exceptionally strong negotiator and deal manager with a proven track record of independently closing transactions. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, keeping many deals moving at once and making day-to-day decisions within approved parameters.

What You’ll Do

Site Sourcing and Evaluation

• Lead site requirements for retail, reconditioning, storage, and other operational uses.

• Source opportunities through brokers, landlords, developers, and direct outreach, and research trade areas, customer access, and competition for each site.

• Lead site tours and assess property suitability, including visibility, parking, vehicle circulation, building layout, power capacity, and expansion potential.

• Represent Ever with brokers, landlords, and municipalities as the day-to-day lead on assigned markets and transactions.

• Maintain an active, prioritized pipeline of sites and provide clear recommendations to co-founders and company leadership.

Negotiation and Deal Execution

• Lead negotiation of letters of intent, leases, amendments, and renewals within approved parameters, from first proposal through executed lease.

• Negotiate key business terms, including rent, TI allowances, free rent, term, options, use clauses, signage, and landlord work.

• Prepare site comparisons, occupancy cost analyses, project budgets, and approval materials, and present deal recommendations for approval.

• Coordinate with legal counsel and internal stakeholders to track business terms, resolve open items, and advance transactions.

• Manage transaction schedules, critical dates, dependencies, and documentation so deals close on time.

• Evaluate opportunities to improve occupancy costs, space utilization, and lease terms.

• Improve day-to-day deal tools, such as LOI templates, site scorecards, and critical-date trackers.

Due Diligence and Development Coordination

• Run zoning and permitted-use reviews, environmental assessments, property inspections, and utility and power capacity checks with qualified partners.

• Partner with construction, operations, and launch teams to evaluate feasibility, improvement costs, utility needs, and opening schedules.

• Identify site constraints early and escalate risks with practical recommendations.

• Track landlord deliverables, possession requirements, and key milestones through handoff to construction and operations.

What You Bring

• 7–10 years of commercial real estate experience in transactions, leasing, tenant-rep brokerage, or corporate real estate.

• A strong track record of personally negotiating and closing a high volume of LOIs and leases, ideally on the tenant or corporate-occupier side.

• Experience with retail, automotive, industrial, service, or other operationally complex properties.

• Deep knowledge of commercial lease economics, lease language, deal structures, and due diligence.

• Ability to run many concurrent deals with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

• Strong financial analysis skills, including proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Deep fluency working with AI platforms to produce analysis and reporting (e.g., Claude).

• Ability to interpret site plans, surveys, zoning information, and operational requirements.

• Clear communication, sound judgment, and effective negotiation and relationship-management skills.

• Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% of the time for market visits, site tours, and project meetings across California, the Pacific Northwest, Texas, and future markets.

• Bachelor’s degree in real estate, business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting expansion across multiple states.

• Familiarity with automotive-use approvals, permitting, EV charging infrastructure, and utility coordination.

• Experience in industrial or flex leasing.

Compensation and Benefits

The Senior Manager, Corporate Real Estate position offers an annual base salary of $155,000–$180,000, a 15% target annual bonus, and stock options. Base salary within the range will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

Equal Opportunity

Ever is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process.

We’re looking for a Head of Legal to run day-to-day legal work at Atlas. You’ll report directly to the founder and CEO and work closely with Finance, People, product and compliance colleagues.

This is a senior, hands-on lawyer role. You’ll draft and negotiate agreements yourself, manage outside counsel, and turn legal questions into clear recommendations and completed work. You’ll be the person who keeps priorities, deadlines and decisions moving across the business.

This role is a great fit if you enjoy being close to the business, taking responsibility for the details, and doing the work directly. It is not a role built around managing an internal legal team. There are no direct reports, and specialist outside lawyers remain an important part of how the work gets done.

We move quickly, expect a lot from ourselves, and value people who take ownership of their work and get things done well. You’ll need to distinguish what needs a careful review from what can move forward with a practical, well-understood solution.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO


LITIGATION & DISPUTES

 - Manage disputes and litigation with outside counsel, keeping the facts, deadlines, budgets and business decisions organized.

 - Coordinate internal information and keep leadership informed with clear recommendations and next steps.

 - Know when a matter needs specialist advice and make sure the right lawyer has what they need.


FINANCINGS & CAPITAL MARKETS

 - Manage legal work for fundraising, credit facilities and capital-markets transactions with Finance and outside counsel.

 - Keep closing checklists, approvals and follow-up obligations current so work does not fall between teams.


COMMERCIAL & PARTNERSHIPS

 - Draft and negotiate partnership, vendor and other commercial agreements with terms that support the business and protect its downside.

 - Build practical templates, negotiation guidance and approval rules that make routine work faster and more consistent.

 - Help business owners understand their commitments before signing and carry them through afterward.


REGULATORY

 - Coordinate advice on card programs, bank partnerships and consumer-finance questions with compliance colleagues and specialist counsel.

 - Keep applicable obligations, evidence requirements and escalation paths clear as products and partnerships develop.


EMPLOYMENT & CONTRACTORS

 - Review contractor and consulting agreements, offer letters, confidentiality terms and IP protections with People and outside employment counsel.

 - Identify gaps in existing agreements, agree a practical repair plan and follow it through.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - A JD and active New York or California bar admission, with authority to practice in the work location confirmed before starting.

 - Substantial legal experience, typically eight or more years, with hands-on ownership in fintech or another regulated business.

 - Strong commercial drafting and negotiation skills, including the ability to offer workable alternatives.

 - Experience managing outside counsel, budgets and complex matters through completion.

 - Familiarity with card programs, bank relationships, consumer finance, credit facilities or fundraising.

 - Clear, direct communication and good judgment about when to escalate.

 - Discretion with sensitive information and a willingness to surface difficult facts early.

 - The ability to prioritize and follow through without an internal team or constant direction.

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Leadership trusts you to run legal work independently and bring clear decisions when needed.

 - Outside counsel works to clear scopes, budgets and deadlines.

 - Business teams have useful templates and straightforward guidance for negotiations and approvals.

 - Contractor and consulting terms are current, consistent and properly documented.

 - Financing work moves through agreed milestones, with closing and ongoing obligations tracked.

 - Regulatory and bank-partner reviews are prepared, with clear owners and follow-through.

 


COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $240,000–$290,000, plus equity.

Team and Process

What You Bring

The Director, Corporate Real Estate position offers an annual base salary of $180,000–$220,000, a 20% target annual bonus, and stock options. Base salary within the range will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

jobs.title: Brigádnik/Brigádnička, Levice OC Dituria
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Brigádnik/Brigádnička v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.
• Majú viac ako 18 rokov
• Sú flexibilní a môžu pracovať na popoludňajších zmenách

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku.

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​ ​

Ide o pozíciu na dohodu s miestom výkonu práce v Leviciach. Typ mimopracovnoprávneho vzťahu bude upresnený v priebehu náborového procesu.

Platové ohodnotenie vo výške 6,12 € za hodinu.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 27.11.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

· Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

· During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

· During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

· Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

· Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

· Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

· Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

· Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.
