jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The New Product Introduction (NPI) Team develops and scales assembly, integration, and test operations for our next-generation satellites. Manufacturing technicians and engineers establish processes and work instructions for building and testing spacecraft from component level through final integration. As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will collaborate closely with design engineers, test engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and delivery. Ideal candidates are methodical, hands-on, and thrive in building complex aerospace products.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in our SF office 5 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

• Own the end-to-end execution of a satellite type, including completing guides, designing and improving tooling, and streamlining the build process

• Drive nonconformances to resolution and establish actionable process improvements

• Handle, coordinate, and document off-nominal build details to push the satellite forward in all special circumstances regarding build or schedule

• Determine the build flow for new satellite designs

• Work with the Manufacturing Ground Support Equipment (MGSE) team to scope and design tooling

• Create Manufacturing Execution System (MES) scaffolding, structured Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOMs), and build non-flight Structural Qualification Models (SQMs)

• Support the Assembly, Integration and Test of Satellites and subsystems

• Recommend facilities and capital equipment improvements for scaling our manufacturing processes to meet our production demand

• Provide DFM/DFA recommendations to design teams

• Monitor production metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions

What You Bring:

• 4+ years of manufacturing development experience

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field

• Experience building satellites or similarly complex optical and electromechanical assemblies in a cleanroom environment

• Experience reading technical drawings

• SolidWorks skills to develop tooling & fixturing interfacing with spacecraft and to extract views for work instructions

• Hands-on experience with hardware assembly, integration, and test

• Attention to detail and technical writing skills for documenting assembly and test processes

• Ability to climb, and lift/push/pull equipment up to 50 pounds

What Makes You Stand Out:

• Experience implementing successful continuous improvement processes

• Experience with MES and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software

• Experience calling on and presenting to C-Suite level contacts.

• Background leveraging an existing network of partners, distributors, and VARs to enable rapid growth and exceed sales objectives.

• The ability to evangelize and build new business opportunities within an assigned territory and/or accounts.

• Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most.

What you’ll get

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $139,000 to $213,000 and this position will also be commission eligible. This range is an estimate for what Tanium will pay a new hire. The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience.

In addition to an annual base salary, team members will receive equity awards and a generous benefits package consisting of medical, dental and vision plan, family planning benefits, health savings account, flexible spending account, transportation savings account, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, life, accident and disability coverage, business travel accident insurance, employee assistance programs, disability insurance, and other well-being benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Technical UI Designer
jobs.description:
Who we are: We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What We Need: We’re seeking a Senior UI Technical Designer with exceptional technical fluency, creative vision, and system-level thinking to own and evolve our in-game UI systems at scale. You’ll own and drive the implementation of key UI features, working closely with designers, artists, producers, engineers and more. We’re a studio that values autonomy and self-drive in developers who are empowered to do the best work of their careers. If this is you, let’s talk!

Responsibilities:

• System Implementation & Maintenance: Champion the design, iteration, and maintenance of various UI systems. This includes dynamic widgets, responsive menus, and high-fidelity animations using Unreal Engine, Blueprint visual scripting, and AngelScript at an expert level.

• Architecture & Best Practices: Establish, document, and promote UI Blueprint architecture best practices and workflows, driving optimization strategies to ensure consistency, scalability, and performance across all UI systems for multiple platforms.

• Tool & Technology Integration: Evaluate and integrate emerging tools and technologies to enhance Experience Design (XD) across gameplay and other interactive elements.

• Design to Engine Translation: Translate and improve UX designs and UI art into performant in-engine implementations while ensuring seamless integration of UI visuals and behavior with underlying game systems.

• UI Material Workflows: Establish and reinforce UI Material workflows for widgets, creating scalable, clear, and performant UI Materials.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with UX designers, UI artists, gameplay engineers, backend developers, and audio teams to align UI implementation with gameplay vision and technical feasibility.

• Foster Development Culture: Champion a collaborative development culture across the Experience Design department (UX, UI, UITD, and UI Engineering) by leading by example and sharing technical insights.

• Peer Mentorship: Act as a technical mentor to junior and intermediate technical designers and cross-functional peers, elevating the team's technical capabilities and standard of execution.

Required Qualifications:

• Engine Expertise: Extensive experience building, debugging, and optimizing UI systems in UE4 or UE5 using Blueprints and UMG. Familiarity with UI materials, animation systems, and widget architecture is essential.

• Problem Solving: Ability to analyze and solve sophisticated technical and design problems while collaborating closely with engineers to contribute to the technical roadmap for XD features.

• System Architecture: Deep understanding of data flow, modularity, and performance in UI systems.

• Autonomy: Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives independently, drive decision-making, and take full ownership of complex UI systems.

• Adaptability: Comfortable working in fast-paced environments and evolving pipelines. Eager to prototype, iterate, and respond constructively to feedback.

Relevant Experience:

• Prior experience shipping high-quality UI in a AAA game environment is highly desirable.

• Solid grasp of scripting and programming fundamentals such as C++ or C#.

• A proven track record as a senior individual contributor within a UI tech design team, taking point on complex, systemic UI challenges.

The pay range for this position in San Mateo, California at the start of employment is expected to be between $103,700 and $153,500 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

31st Union prides itself on the diversity of its team members, partners, and communities. For this reason, we remain committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all aspects of the employment relationship, from recruitment and hiring through compensation, benefits, discipline and termination. This means that employment at 31st Union depends on your substantive ability, objective qualifications and work ethic – not on your age, race (including traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles), height, weight, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), alienage or citizenship status, transgender, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability (actual or perceived), medical condition, AIDS/HIV, denial of family and medical care leave, genetic information, predisposition or carrier status, pregnancy status, childbirth, breastfeeding (or related medical conditions), marital status or registered domestic partner status, political activity or affiliation, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, arrest record, or taking or requesting statutorily protected leaves, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are also committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application and/or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need to request reasonable accommodation.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

jobs.description:

This role will be responsible for overseeing inventory and purchasing, coordinating production and inbound shipments, improving order fulfillment and logistics, supervising assigned staff, and implementing scalable processes, systems, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE (BUT NOT LIMITED TO)

o Manage inventory levels for finished goods, parts, and operational supplies to support business needs

o Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly inventory reports to support purchasing and operational decisions

o Coordinate physical inventory counts and parts audits, investigate discrepancies, and implement corrective actions

o Coordinate production schedules with the Korea manufacturing team to align product availability with inventory needs and customer demand

o Participate in regular inventory and operations meetings, including monthly meetings with the Korea team

o Assist with annual operational planning and process coordination

o Supervise repair and refurbishment team, set clear expectations, and monitor performance

o Review and approve employee timecards and PTO requests

o Conduct performance reviews, provide ongoing feedback, and address training and development needs

o Participate in the annual company workshop and contribute to operational planning discussions

• Supply Chain Transformation

o Design and implement scalable supply chain processes, systems, and SOPs to support business growth and operational efficiency

o Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for process optimization, automation, and cost reduction

o Establish best practices, performance metrics, and operational frameworks to support organizational scale and future growth

• Perform other related duties and responsibilities assigned by executive management

• Bachelor’s degree

• Minimum 10 years of progressive supply chain and operations experience

• Minimum five years of direct people management experience

• Bilingual in Korean/ English

• Experience with ERP systems

• Computer literate (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Strong organizational skills with a high attention to detail

• Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment

• Experience working with and leading highly collaborative cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, agile environment

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

BENEFITS

• 401K Retirement Plan

• Paid Sick Time Off, Paid Holidays, Accrued Paid Vacation

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Platform Integrations and Technology Alliances
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

Location: San Francisco Bay Area preferred



What you'll do:

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Marketing. You will be the close go-to-market counterpart to the Senior Product Manager for Platform and a day-to-day partner to the Senior Alliances Marketing Manager. Together with Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and technology alliance partners, you will make complex integrations, APIs, MCP, and developer experiences clear, credible, and commercially compelling.



The market problem you will help solve is bigger than a catalog of connectors: valuable security intelligence is often trapped in a portal, copied into tickets by hand, or disconnected from the workflows where teams act. You will help Horizon3 win by showing how NodeZero can embed into the customer’s existing security stack and contribute to a connected Hack, Fix, Verify loop.



Product Management will own product vision, requirements, roadmap, prioritization, scope, and technical trade-offs. You will own how the value is positioned, launched, activated, adopted, sold, and proven in the market.




OWN THE PLATFORM INTEGRATIONS NARRATIVE

 - Build and evolve the positioning and messaging for NodeZero’s integrations, APIs, MCP, and integration framework.

 - Explain the customer value of putting proven exploitability intelligence into SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability-management, and other security workflows.

 - Create a coherent platform story that connects native integrations, partner-built experiences, developer access, and agent connectivity without reducing the message to “we integrate with X.”

 - Develop audience- and use-case-specific narratives for security executives, security operations and vulnerability-management leaders, technical champions, developers, partners, and field teams.

 - Clarify the difference between NodeZero’s high-signal, attacker-validated intelligence and generic telemetry, vulnerability volume, or disconnected point-tool workflows.


PARTNER WITH PRODUCT AND ENGINEERING AS THE GTM COUNTERPART

 - Operate as part of the product trio with the Senior Product Manager for Platform and Engineering leadership, bringing market, customer, field, and partner evidence into product discussions.

 - Translate product direction, release state, and technical capabilities into accurate external promises, compelling use cases, and actionable launch plans.

 - Stay close to product details, integration behavior, API and MCP experiences, developer readiness, and customer workflows so the market story remains technically credible.

 - Partner on launch timing and readiness while preserving the ownership boundary between product decisions and go-to-market decisions.

 - Help identify adoption friction, messaging gaps, and unmet customer or partner needs that should inform future product iterations.


LEAD JOINT GO-TO-MARKET WITH TECHNOLOGY ALLIANCES

 - Work closely with the Senior Alliances Marketing Manager and technology alliance partners to turn selected integrations into coordinated launches and sustained GTM programs.

 - Develop partner value propositions, joint solution narratives, customer use cases, launch briefs, co-marketing plans, marketplace and listing inputs, and joint selling motions.

 - Coordinate partner-facing marketing work across Horizon3 and partner stakeholders without assuming ownership of partnership agreements, commercial terms, or relationship governance.

 - Create “better together” stories that demonstrate how NodeZero and a partner help customers act on proven exploitability in the systems they already use.

 - Build reusable alliance and integration marketing motions that make partner activation more consistent and scalable.


DRIVE LAUNCH READINESS, FIELD ACTIVATION, AND ADOPTION

 - Orchestrate launches across Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Demand Generation, Communications, and partner teams.

 - Equip internal and external audiences with messaging, demo flows, talk tracks, FAQs, competitive framing, solution briefs, technical explainers, customer-facing content, and enablement modules.

 - Support readiness across early access, general availability, and follow-on iterations—not only announcement day.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success to connect integration capabilities to customer outcomes, adoption paths, expansion opportunities, and time-to-value.

 - Capture field and customer feedback after launch and turn it into practical improvements to positioning, enablement, adoption programs, and future GTM plans.


BUILD EVIDENCE AND MEASUREMENT INTO THE MOTION

 - Define and track measures that reflect workflow value and commercial impact, not connector count or press-release volume alone.

 - Establish visibility into customer usage, shared-customer activation, adoption and engagement, integration-influenced pipeline, partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities, launch performance, and the reach of NodeZero through integrations, APIs, and MCP.

 - Partner with Product, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and Alliances to create a practical measurement approach and use the evidence to improve priorities and programs.

 - Develop customer proof points, references, and use cases that show how platform connectivity changes security-team behavior and outcomes.


CREATE LEVERAGE THROUGH REPEATABLE SYSTEMS

 - Build reusable integration and partner-launch briefs, messaging frameworks, launch checklists, enablement modules, customer-proof templates, and measurement plans.

 - Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch planning, partner coordination, readiness reviews, feedback capture, and post-launch learning.

 - Improve the quality and speed of GTM execution so each new integration does not require inventing a marketing motion from scratch.

 - Stay close enough to actual deals, losses, customer conversations, and partner feedback to ensure the system improves from real evidence.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

 - A clear, differentiated platform integrations narrative is used consistently across the website, sales conversations, partner materials, launches, and executive communications.

 - Priority integrations and platform capabilities have coordinated GTM plans, accurate positioning, launch-readiness materials, field enablement, and post-launch adoption follow-through.

 - The Product, Alliances, and Marketing teams share a repeatable operating model for turning integration work into joint launches, customer proof, and measurable business impact.

 - Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and partner teams can confidently explain, demonstrate, position, and activate the relevant integration and API/MCP use cases.

 - Horizon3 has a practical measurement framework for customer usage, workflow adoption, shared-customer activation, pipeline influence, partner contribution, and platform reach.

 - Customer, field, and partner evidence is consistently fed back into Product and Engineering discussions to improve the next iteration.

 - Reusable GTM systems reduce the effort required to launch and scale additional integrations and technology-alliance motions.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Experience in product marketing for technical B2B products, platforms, integrations, developer-facing products, or technology ecosystems.

 - A track record of taking ambiguous product or market problems from insight through positioning, launch, enablement, adoption, and measurement.

 - The ability to understand technical products—including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, developer experiences, or agent connectivity—and translate them into clear customer and business value.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence Product, Engineering, Alliances, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and external partners without relying on formal authority.

 - Experience developing positioning, messaging, launch plans, sales enablement, customer-facing content, and partner-facing materials.

 - Commercial judgment: you can connect product capabilities to customer workflows, pipeline, adoption, expansion, and retention without overstating product truth.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make complex concepts clear for both technical and executive audiences.

 - Comfort using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions, measure performance, and improve GTM programs.

 - A collaborative working style and the judgment to distinguish shared execution from direct ownership.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, exposure management, IT operations, or adjacent enterprise technology markets.

 - Experience marketing integrations across SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability-management, cloud, identity, or related security ecosystems.

 - Experience with APIs as a product surface, developer portals, MCP, agent workflows, marketplaces, or partner-built integrations.

 - Experience leading technology-alliance launches, co-marketing programs, marketplace listings, joint solution narratives, or partner enablement.

 - Experience working with a product-led, platform, ecosystem, or consumption-oriented business model.

 - Experience building repeatable operating systems for launches, enablement, customer proof, or GTM measurement.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - High agency: you can take an unclear problem, establish the next right actions, bring the right people together, and drive the work to a shipped outcome.

 - Whole-company awareness: you optimize for customer value and business results rather than treating content, launches, or partner activity as ends in themselves.

 - Technical curiosity: you are willing to go deep into product behavior, integration details, customer workflows, and partner requirements to get the story right.

 - Craftsmanship and precision: you care about the accuracy of claims, the quality of the customer experience, and the details that determine whether field teams can use what you create.

 - Evidence-oriented ownership: you stay close to customers, deals, losses, usage, and feedback; when something misses, you diagnose the system and improve the next action.

 - Influential leadership: you can lead across and up, create alignment among teams with different incentives, and keep momentum without creating unnecessary process.

 - Humility and clarity: you know what you own, what you share, and when to bring in Product, Engineering, Alliances, or other partners.




TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

 - Occasional travel as needed for customer meetings, partner engagements, team gatherings, industry events, and launches. 



Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $180,000 - $225,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Test & Evaluation Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril is integral to our mission, ensuring that every product meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. Our team specializes in a broad spectrum of testing activities, including developmental testing using surrogate vehicles. We are at the forefront of testing approaches, particularly in the domain of mission autonomy systems. We're seeking a motivated early-career engineer who is eager to learn and contribute to the testing and refinement of our autonomous systems.

As a Mission Autonomy Test & Evaluation Engineer at Anduril Industries, you will support critical testing activities that shape the future of defense technology. Your contributions will help ensure our autonomy systems empower users to execute multifaceted missions with precision and efficiency.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support planning and execution of test events in collaboration with the broader Mission Autonomy team

• Assist in developmental and operational testing of mission autonomy capabilities using surrogate vehicles

• Collaborate with Mission Autonomy T&E team members, customers, and vendor partners to meet test objectives

• Author test reports and contribute to basic test plan development

• Participate in data collection and analysis to improve system performance

• Develop and deliver presentations to internal Mission Autonomy leadership

• Identify problem areas and work to develop independent solutions

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related technical field

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Engineer, Hardware Reliability (Starshield)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, HARDWARE RELIABILITY (STARSHIELD)

Starshield leverages SpaceX’s Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads.

This is an opportunity to build and lead an electrical hardware reliability team for Starshield. In addition to hiring top-notch electrical engineers you will work on identifying, analyzing, and resolving hardware failures to improve the robustness and longevity of our PCBAs. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including electrical, mechanical, software, and supply chain, to enhance the overall reliability of Starshield hardware. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge R&D technology and some of the most complex applications of electrical engineering in the industry

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Lead and hire a team of electrical hardware reliability engineers supporting Starshield production

• Provide technical mentorship and guidance to team members leading root cause investigations of electrical hardware

• Align goals and priorities with production and partner engineering teams to achieve program reliability and rate objectives

• Collaborate with team members to create personalized career growth plans that build their technical capabilities and accelerate progress toward their professional goals

• Drive corrective action to products not meeting design specifications through data driven decisions using yield and defect monitoring to identify common failure modes

• Proactively escalate major hardware concerns, secure appropriate resources, and maintain clear communication to drive timely resolution and team alignment

• Maintain thorough documentation of failure analysis findings, test results, and corrective actions

• Collaborate with on-orbit reliability team, driving timely improvements to production through on-orbit investigation findings

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other engineering discipline

• 3+ years of experience in hardware development, failure analysis, or reliability engineering (internships and co-ops acceptable)

• 1+ years of experience leading a project, team, or people

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Strong analytical skills with an excellent ability to communicate and collaborate with partners in all disciplines at multiple levels in the organization

• Demonstrated ability to advocate for and implement robust solutions that stand the test of time

• Experience deploying large-scale and/or high impact solutions in a manufacturing environment

• Experience with digital and mixed-signal designs, power electronics, or RF electronics using oscilloscopes, signal generators, digital multimeters, power supplies, and soldering equipment

• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and root causing electrical hardware failures

• PCBA Fabrication experience (familiar with solder, flux, underfill, staking, reflow, temperature control, etc.)

• Experience with environmental testing such as HALT/HASS, thermal, vibration, and TVAC

• Experience with RF test equipment (e.g. vector network analyzer, spectrum analyzer) and concepts such as S-parameters, impedance matching, and antenna designs

• Active Top Secret, Top Secret SCI, or DOE Level Q clearance, or the ability and willingness to obtain one

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• An active clearance may provide the opportunity for you to work on sensitive SpaceX missions; if so, you will be subject to pre-employment drug and random drug and alcohol tests

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
$165,000.00 - $230,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Lead Technician
jobs.description:
About the Job

Location: Irvine, CA (Onsite)
Department: Vehicle Operations
Reports to: Reconditioning Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $55–$60 Per Hour

About Ever

Ever is building the future of auto retail. As the first AI-native auto retailer, we are building the next $100B+ automotive business, starting with electric vehicles.

Based out of San Francisco and expanding nationwide, we are backed by leading investors and led by former tech & automotive professionals from Uber, Tesla, Rivian, Apple, Amazon, Carvana, J.P. Morgan, BCG, and more. After our recently completed Series B financing, we have raised around $200M in total equity and debt funding. We are growing rapidly and actively recruiting exceptional talent – to set a new frontier in the largest sector of the US retail economy.

Learn more about us at evercars.com.

About the Role

As Lead Technician, you’ll be the technical leader of Ever’s Irvine reconditioning operation. You’ll spend much of your time on complex diagnostics and repairs on electric and conventional vehicles. You’ll also coach technicians, write and improve shop SOPs, and partner with the Reconditioning Manager to improve throughput, quality and safety. It’s a role for an experienced tech with shop leadership experience who wants to help build scalable shop processes from the ground up and mentor the next generation of EV technicians.

What You’ll Do

• Perform advanced diagnostics, repairs and reconditioning on electric and conventional vehicles

• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex mechanical and electrical repairs

• Coach, mentor and train technicians on repair quality, efficiency, safety and OEM best practices, and lead hands-on onboarding for new techs

• Develop, document and continuously improve shop SOPs, repair workflows, quality standards and inspection processes

• Standardize repair procedures across the shop to improve consistency and reduce rework

• Conduct quality control inspections before vehicles are released for sale

• Monitor repair quality, comeback rates and technician performance trends

• Assist with workload planning and daily shop prioritization

• Partner with the Reconditioning Manager on productivity and continuous improvement initiatives, identifying bottlenecks and recommending fixes

• Support lean shop practices, 5S organization, tooling and equipment improvements, and workplace safety initiatives

• Ensure all work follows OEM repair procedures, high-voltage safety procedures, OSHA standards and Ever quality standards, and is documented accurately in Ever’s systems

• Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performing shop culture

What You Bring

• 5+ years of automotive technician experience with demonstrated technical expertise

• Experience training, coaching or mentoring technicians

• Strong diagnostic abilities across electrical, mechanical and drivability systems

• Experience creating or improving shop processes and repair standards

• Strong communication, organization and leadership skills

• Passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (must be 21+ to road test per policy)

Technical Skills

• Advanced diagnostics using OEM and aftermarket scan tools

• Ability to interpret wiring diagrams and service information

• Experience with brake, suspension, steering, drivetrain, HVAC and electrical systems

• Experience developing repair documentation and SOPs

Preferred Experience

• Previous Lead Technician, Shop Foreman, Team Lead or similar leadership role

• Experience with EV platforms (Tesla, Rivian, Lucid, GM, Ford, Hyundai/Kia)

• High-voltage safety certification

• ASE Master Technician and OEM EV certifications

Physical Requirements

• Stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday

• Bend, kneel, squat, crawl and work underneath vehicles

• Lift, carry, push and pull up to 50 lbs

• Safely operate lifts, power tools, diagnostic equipment and shop machinery

• Work in a shop environment with exposure to noise, fluids and automotive chemicals, using required PPE

• Safely drive and road test vehicles

Compensation and Benefits

The hourly pay range for this Irvine-based position is $55–$60 per hour, depending on relevant experience, qualifications and internal equity.

Ever offers health, dental, and vision coverage, as well as time-off benefits.

Equal Opportunity

Ever is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process.

jobs.title: Art Director
jobs.description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who we are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What we need:

31st Union is looking for a strategic, supportive Art Director to own the visual direction for a major area of our game. Reporting to the Studio Art Director, you will lead Associate Art Directors and Art Leads, set the quality bar, and shape the visual storytelling of our game alongside the rest of our Creative Leadership team.

Responsibilities:

• Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop Associate Art Directors and Art Leads, including performance reviews and career paths

• Lead hiring for the department, including defining roles and growing the team

• Manage art resources and scope within budget and production constraints

• Art Direction and Quality

• Own the art direction and visual development for your area and its implementation in the game

• Translate the Creative and Art Vision into benchmarks, standards, and plans with stakeholders in other departments.

• Set quality assurance protocols and drive the review strategy for artwork

• Review and approve work and serve as an internal art critic, keeping style consistent across disciplines

• Communicate the visual plan through specifications, style guides, reference material, and presentations

• Technology and Pipeline Partnership

• Work with Tech Art, Engineering, and Tools teams to create a rendering and tools plan that supports art goals

• Partner with Creative, Design, Narrative and Production to keep a cohesive approach

• Recent Unreal Engine development experience

• Partners and Risk

• Evaluate and manage outsourcing partners and co-development vendors

• Identify risks across the art pipeline and drive mitigation

Who you are:

• Bachelor's degree in Art or Fine Art, or equivalent experience

• 10+ years in AAA game development, including at least 2 shipped AAA titles

• 3+ years in an Art Director, Associate Art Director, or equivalent senior leadership role

• Proven experience leading and growing best in class art teams

• Thorough understanding of the full development cycle, from concept through release

• Deep knowledge of the methods behind leading-edge visuals, from tools to techniques to technology.

• Strong visual taste and creative vision, with the ability to communicate it clearly

• Experience hiring, supervising, and writing meaningful feedback and performance reviews

• Strong communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills

• A champion of high standards who embraces change and pushes for progress

Nice-to-Haves:

• Experience with hybrid or distributed teams and co-dev

• Experience in a proprietary or in-house engine environment

• Passion for games and for pushing what is possible in interactive entertainment

The pay range for this position in San Mateo, California at the start of employment is expected to be between $182,800 and $270,520 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

31st Union prides itself on the diversity of its team members, partners, and communities. For this reason, we remain committed to providing equal employment opportunity in all aspects of the employment relationship, from recruitment and hiring through compensation, benefits, discipline and termination. This means that employment at 31st Union depends on your substantive ability, objective qualifications and work ethic – not on your age, race (including traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles), height, weight, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), alienage or citizenship status, transgender, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability (actual or perceived), medical condition, AIDS/HIV, denial of family and medical care leave, genetic information, predisposition or carrier status, pregnancy status, childbirth, breastfeeding (or related medical conditions), marital status or registered domestic partner status, political activity or affiliation, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault or stalking, arrest record, or taking or requesting statutorily protected leaves, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local laws.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are also committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the job application and/or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need to request reasonable accommodation.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Machine Tending
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.

We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.

Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.

About the team:

The Automation Engineering Team is responsible for delivering robotics-driven automation deployments across a wide range of customer applications. The team partners cross-functionally to translate customer requirements into deployed systems, ensuring solutions are integrated, commissioned, and validated to perform reliably in real manufacturing environments. Automation Engineering works closely with customers, internal technical teams, and external integrators to execute deployments on schedule while maintaining high standards for quality, safety, and repeatability.

About the role:

As Product Manager, Machine Tending, you will own the development, commercialization, and growth of Formic's machine tending offering across both tracks. You will decide which applications we pursue, define standard configurations and pricing, and lead the engineering work that makes them repeatable to deploy.
You will need enough engineering depth to make technical decisions and enough business sense to make commercial ones. You will set direction, get hands-on when needed, and serve as Formic's subject matter expert for the vertical. The goal is an offering Sales can confidently sell, Engineering can consistently deliver, and customers can rely on.

In this role you will:

• Own the machine tending product:

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and portfolio across third-party and internally developed solutions

• Prioritize applications across CNC mills, lathes, machining centers, and press equipment, and define standard configurations and application boundaries

• Set requirements for robots, CNC interfaces, workholding, EOAT, controls, software, and safety, favoring compact footprints, quick changeovers, and minimal programming

• Develop a robust portfolio of offerings that span the common use cases of our customers. This will include systems to sport a full range of offerings in the High Mix / Low Volume and High Volume / Low Mix applications.

• Develop third-party system integration and partnerships:

• Evaluate and select third-party machine tending platforms and integration partners against Formic standards for safety, uptime, serviceability, and cost

• Define integration standards for partner systems (Formic telemetry, remote monitoring, safety review, documentation, and spares) so each one is supported like any other fleet asset

• Negotiate and manage relationships with integrators, machine tool builders, and OEMs, including pricing, lead times, support terms, and co-marketing

• Aggregate lessons from partner deployments into the requirements for Formic's internal product

• Develop Formic-designed machine tending systems:

• Lead robot arm selection across collaborative and industrial platforms (FANUC, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, ABB, KUKA, Others), weighing payload, reach, cycle time, safety architecture, CNC integration support, cost, and serviceability

• Scope a modular design framework that covers turning, milling, grinding, Swiss-type, and press applications from a common base of cell frame, controls, safety, and software

• Define part presentation options (drawers, grids, carts, pallets) and EOAT libraries scaled to part size, weight, and batch volume

• Validate designs on reference cells before release, and partner with Project Engineering on controlled models, BOMs, and documentation

• Lead technical development and deployment:

• Turn requirements into development plans, scope, and milestones across mechanical, electrical, controls, software, and applications engineering

• Development of standardized options for Machine Tool interface. Determination of the best practice for the most common machine tools and supplementary system for models that are unique

• Own the deployment playbook from site survey through FAT, SAT, commissioning, and handoff to Field Operations, including safety risk assessments

• Reduce install time and support needs using field feedback, and evaluate vision and AI where they add reliable value

• Support sales and commercialization:

• Serve as the technical subject matter expert for Sales, Solutions Engineering, and customers across active and queued clusters

• Build a qualification framework that fits applications to standard offerings and flags custom work early, enabling accurate one-shot quoting

• Support scoping, estimates, and quotations, ensuring NRE and application-specific costs are captured

• Create specifications, application guidelines, and sales materials, and support launch events, IMTS, and named-customer case studies

• Manage product economics and partnerships:

• Own cost targets and improve margins through design, standardization, sourcing, and reconditioned equipment

• Compare the full cost of third-party versus internal products, including development, deployment, and support

• Build relationships with integrators, machine tool builders, and technology suppliers

What makes you a great fit:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering; MBA is a plus

• 7+ years in industrial automation and robotics spanning engineering and product or project management

• Direct experience deploying or productizing robotic machine tending for CNC equipment

• Hands-on CNC machining or machine shop experience

• Experience leading cross-functional development and owning product pricing, quotations, or cost

• Equipment commissioning, FAT/SAT, and on-site debugging experience

• Familiarity with FANUC, Yaskawa Motoman, Universal Robots, ABB, or KUKA robots and common CNC controls

• Knowledge of robot safety standards (ISO 10218, ANSI/RIA R15.06, ISO/TS 15066)

• Exposure to machine vision

• Commercially driven, comfortable with customers, and a strong communicator

• Ability to travel up to 30%

#LB1

Our Total Rewards:

At Formic, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package for full-time, U.S.-based team members, including:

• Equity in Formic: Participate in our stock option program and share in the success of a fast-growing start-up backed by leading global investors

• Competitive & Uncapped Commission Structure: Designed to reward performance and impact in commission-eligible roles

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Unum, with 99% of employee premiums covered and 75% coverage for dependents, with optional buy-up plans available

• Additional Insurance Benefits: FSA and DCFSA, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability through Unum, all 100% employer-paid

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Fully funded by Formic, offering support when you need it most

• Paid Parental Leave Program: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Company-sponsored 401(k): Invest in your future with our company-facilitated retirement savings plan

• Home Office Stipend: A one-time allowance for fully remote and hybrid employees to support an at-home or on-the-road work setup

• Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement: Monthly stipend toward personal phone and internet expenses

• Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need, when you need it, supported by our flexible PTO policy

Compensation Philosophy

Formic’s pay and equity packages are thoughtfully benchmarked against peer companies at a similar growth stage. Equity represents a meaningful part of our mutual investment: when Formic succeeds, so do you.

Final offers are customized based on experience, geographic location, market considerations, and a candidate’s preferred balance of cash and equity. Our goal is to attract and reward top talent who will have significant impact, and we are open to thoughtful discussions to align on the right structure.

Compensation Range:

$135,000—$175,000 USD

What we look for:

We’re building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you!

• Fearless Optimism: You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren’t paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn’t yet exist.

• Create the Magic: You absorb complexity so customers don’t have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value-added, and outcome-driven. You don’t say “not my job.” You make things work.

• Today, Not Tomorrow: You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don’t confuse activity with results.

• Seek Truth: You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer.

• Made of Rubber: You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit.

• One Formic: You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit.

jobs.title: Senior Model Based Manufacturing Capability Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build the software-defined shipyard. That means the full technology stack running Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, ArsenalOS, our manufacturing execution system that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

This work is anchored by Arsenal-2, our software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base. ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of that yard. It connects fabrication and outfitting to material movement and inspection. Planners get one real-time view of production. We aren't waiting for the yard to open. Development is already underway here in Orange County, California. The team is proving out the manufacturing methods and digital workflows that will scale across the shipyard network.

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is standing up model-based manufacturing in a managed NX CAM and Teamcenter environment. Others define the governing methods and build the platforms. The MB-Manufacturing Capability Engineer builds and matures the capability that sits on top of them: you design the process, program the part, build the automation and process tools that remove manual steps, cut it, find out what breaks, and turn what you learn into standard work the shop can repeat. You are a machinist-programmer who writes code, and you spend time at the machine and in the editor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop Manufacturing, CAM, and Tooling Tools and Methods - NX CAM templates and scripts, tool and fixture library structures, and post processor authoring technologies

• Develop process modeling and process design tools and methods that define how parts are made, so process plans are built from the model rather than by hand

• Prove each workflow on a real machine with real Anduril hardware before release, and record the evidence and defects found

• Mature CAM and tooling workflows to production readiness, and capture them as standard work, templates, and playbooks

• Troubleshoot failures across the model, CAM setup, post, program transfer, and machine, and fix the right layer

• Turn shop-floor pain points into scoped automation with a measured before-and-after

• Drive enablement: work instructions, walkthroughs, and training so programmers and machinists run each workflow without you

This role does not own governance or release authority for manufacturing processes, core NX/Teamcenter/Forge platform development, or standing production programming, and has no direct reports.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of CNC programming and machining, manufacturing process design and development

• Experience in an NSE MBE Maturity Level 4 Model Based Enterprise / Model Based Definition environment

• G-code fluency on two or more controls (Sinumerik, Heidenhain, Fanuc, Okuma) and post processor modification, verified on the machine

• Automation development in Python, NX Open, C#, or similar, kept in version control

• CAM simulation and verification development experience (Vericut or NX machine simulation)

• Tooling and fixturing knowledge, including tool library management

• Process planning, process modeling, or process design experience (e.g., routings, process flows, BOP)

• Troubleshooting skill and experience writing standard work or training that others adopted

• 5+ years in a regulated manufacturing environment (aerospace, defense, shipbuilding, or medical device)

• On site in Orange County, California; exceptions may be made for preferred candidates

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

• AI/ML injection into Manufacturing, Equipment, and Tooling digital workflows/processes

• New Product Introduction, Machine Procurement, Factory Acceptance Testing

• NX CAM and NX Open in a Teamcenter-managed environment

• Model-based CAM and process planning from staged NX models and PMI, including Teamcenter Manufacturing

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, the Air Defense Team provides mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) threats. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems (FoS) in challenging operational environments worldwide.

ABOUT THE JOB

Air Defense products are deployed to austere and often secure environments, some in contexts where the device itself is a sensitive asset and physical access by an adversary is a realistic threat. That makes product security a hardware-and-software problem, not a policy exercise. As our international portfolio grows—the compliance and exportability requirements on our platform are growing with it. We're hiring for someone to focus on these challenges, a Software Engineer to own product security for the Air Defense platforms.

This is a new role, born from the recognition that security for fielded defense hardware is a nuanced discipline that deserves focused investment rather than ad-hoc coverage. You'll be the technical driver for security on the platform—hands-on with embedded Linux, firmware, and hardware interfaces—while also serving as the connective tissue between the teams whose work has to come together for the product to ship securely. You'll also drive the hands-on platform work that supports it—updating firmware, updating fusing tools, improving encryption algorithms, and building and re-imaging towers using our NixOS-based build system.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive hands-on platform security work: updating firmware, improving encryption algorithms, updating fusing tools, and building and re-imaging towers through our NixOS-based image pipeline.

• Own the signed boot chain across compute generations: firmware and bootloader signing, UEFI Secure Boot key hierarchies, signed kernel and initrd, and full-disk encryption with automated unlock.

• Own signing key management and the infrastructure behind it: HSM-backed keys, separation of development and production trust roots, key rotation, and build-time enforcement that the right keys sign the right artifacts.

• Define and implement the platform's hardening postures, spanning network exposure and firewall policy, privilege and sudo restriction, serial console and USB lockdown, and the difference between a locked-down fielded system and a debuggable bench unit.

• Drive vulnerability management for the fielded fleet: track CVEs against our kernel and userspace, own the patching strategy for hardware approaching vendor end-of-life, and keep a clear picture of fleet security state.

• Serve as the technical interface between engineering, product, and program teams decomposing security requirements into concrete engineering tasks and driving them to completion across the platform.

• Partner with our product security organization to turn security requirements into shippable implementations, act as the team's security liaison, and support program-specific accreditation and exportability efforts as our international portfolio grows.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of professional software engineering with a security focus on embedded Linux systems.

• Hands-on experience implementing a secure boot chain: code signing, chain of trust, UEFI Secure Boot or an equivalent vendor secure boot implementation.

• Practical cryptographic engineering skills: PKI and certificate hierarchies, HSM or PKCS#11-backed signing, key lifecycle management, and full-disk encryption.

• Strong Linux internals knowledge, particularly in patching, boot flow, kernel and initrd, systemd, privilege boundaries, and filesystem and device access control.

• Proficiency in C, C++, or Rust, plus the ability to work fluently in shell.

• Experience building or modifying embedded Linux system images—Yocto, Buildroot, or NixOS. Comfort working at the layer where OS configuration meets hardware bring-up.

• Practical hardening and vulnerability-management experience on real systems: attack-surface reduction, CVE triage on a deployed fleet, and live patching strategies that don't break the product.

• Ability to work hands-on with hardware—comfortable at a lab bench interfacing with compute boards, serial consoles, and firmware tooling.

• Ability to explain a security decision to engineers who need to implement it, and to a program stakeholder who needs to accept the residual risk.

• US person status required. Active US Secret clearance, or a previously granted Secret clearance eligible for reactivation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with NVIDIA Jetson secure boot specifically, or with another SoC vendor's secure boot and fusing workflow.

• Familiarity with measured boot, TPMs, or remote attestation.

• Experience with NixOS or Nix for building system images. Adjacent depth in Yocto or Buildroot is a strong substitute—these are the most transferable skill sets to our NixOS-based platform.

• Background in defense or government accreditation processes, or work against a formal security controls framework. Experience with international exportability requirements is a plus.

• Offensive security experience, including hardware attacks such as bus sniffing, glitching, or JTAG and boot interruption.

• Experience with supply chain security, artifact provenance, or SBOM tooling.

• Experience bringing new hardware features to life through software—bridging the gap between hardware capabilities and the platform software that exercises them.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our growing team! As Product Manager, you’ll own the systems that keep our loans running after they close: servicing, payments and money movement, valuations, and the vendor integrations behind them. Our internal teams (Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, and Operations) are your customers, and the borrowers they serve feel every improvement you ship. You’ll own end-to-end execution across several products at once, work independently day to day, and partner with product leadership on the broader roadmap.

What You’ll Do

• Own the back office: drive products that move real money and real loans, such as borrower payments, bank account verification, appraisals and inspections, and the data feeds our capital and servicing partners depend on

• Execute end-to-end: take projects from early conception through design, development, launch, and post-launch measurement

• Find where automation and AI can take manual work off our operations teams, and where a simpler software fix is the better answer

• Collaborate with a dedicated engineering team, driving requirements and engineering prioritization

• Manage multiple products in different phases of their lifecycle in parallel, from new integrations to keep-the-lights-on improvements

• Turn internal and borrower pain points into a prioritized roadmap, balance new initiatives with production support and operational improvements, and keep a live, refined backlog

• Partner with Treasury and engineering on bank and payment integrations (ACH, wires, account verification), and with vendors on appraisal, inspection, insurance, and servicing data feeds, with close attention to detail since a small mistake means a bounced payment or money movement issue

• Triage production support issues to tell real bugs from expected behavior, find the root cause, and turn recurring manual workarounds into product improvements

• Identify where AI meaningfully beats traditional software for our operations teams, and navigate edge cases, accuracy, and adoption

• Use data to size problems, model ROI, and define and track success metrics for your areas, including operational metrics such as automation rates, error rates, and time saved

• Lead Servicing, Treasury, Capital Markets, Compliance, and Operations stakeholders toward a shared roadmap, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly

What We Look For

• 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in product management or a related field, with multiple release cycles and product lifecycles completed as a PM

• Technical fluency: comfortable working closely with engineers on integrations, data models, and APIs, and able to read data well enough to answer your own questions

About Ever

Ever is building the future of auto retail. As the first AI-native auto retailer, we are building the next $100B+ automotive business, starting with electric vehicles.

About the Institute of Foundation Models
We are a dedicated research lab for building, understanding, using, and risk-managing foundation models. Our mandate is to advance research, nurture the next generation of AI builders, and drive transformative contributions to a knowledge-driven economy.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Talent Operations Coordinator to support and strengthen its recruiting operations as the organization continues to grow.
