jobs.title: Technical Content Lead (EA or CPA required)
jobs.description:
About Collective:

Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork.

Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures, QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft.

About the role:

We're looking for a credentialed tax professional - an active EA or CPA - who can also write exceptionally well. You'll be Collective's in-house tax authority embedded directly in the content and marketing team: you write the hardest technical content yourself, you certify the accuracy of everything requiring technical review that the team produces, and you become a credible face of our expertise across channels.

This role exists because our content is only as valuable as it is correct. Our in-house team of experts produces everything from articles, to comparisons, to technical tools that can help solopreneurs at any stage in their journey.

What you'll do: 

 - Write and maintain the highest-stakes, highest-intent pieces across our pillars: entity strategy (LLC vs. S-corp), tax savings and write-offs, quarterly estimated taxes, 1099s, compliance, retirement, etc.

 - Translate workflows and technical topics in a digestible way, and verticalize by profession (designers, consultants, realtors, creators, etc.) while keeping the core accurate.

 - Be the first-line accuracy reviewer for the team’s technical content, so it ships correct and on schedule without needing additional review.

 - Build and maintain an approved-claims library of vetted claims, safe language and required disclaimers, so atomized cuts (shorts, hooks, social) reuse pre-approved wording instead of each triggering a new review.

 - Define what still needs escalation to the broader tax team (novel claims, edge cases) and partner with them on it. You reduce their load; you don’t replace their sign-off where it’s truly required.

 - Keep content current as tax law and deadlines change.

 - Use your expertise and our AI tools to build systems that push helpful content to 30+ million U.S. solopreneurs, and partner with Content and Brand on brand kits and AI agents that speed things up from concept to push.

 - Serve as the on-the-record expert for webinars, article review and the podcast, where a credentialed voice builds trust.

 - Work from the shared content calendar: you supply accuracy and authority, and the team supplies production and distribution.

 - Partner with SEO/GEO, Lifecycle/Growth and our SEO agency so high-intent technical content is structured, sourced and attributed to rank, convert and keep its authority.

 - Work with Product Marketing and Sales to turn common buyer questions into authoritative content that doubles as enablement and objection handling.

What you'll bring:

 - Active EA or CPA in good standing, with hands-on tax experience serving self-employed people, freelancers and S-corps (our member base).

 - Exceptional writing skills: you make technical nuance clear, engaging and trustworthy for a non-expert audience. (Portfolio or writing samples required.)

 - Experience working with AI tooling at scale.

 - Strong judgment on accuracy and risk: you know what’s safe to say, what needs a disclaimer and what must be escalated.

 - Comfort being a named, credentialed voice in public-facing content.

 - Bonus points for SEO/GEO knowledge, on-camera or webinar experience, high-volume AI content production (e.g., Claude, Jasper, AirOps), or a background advising solopreneurs.

What we offer:

 - Remote-Friendly Environment: Flexibility to work from home while staying connected to the team. Please note that we're open to remote candidates within the U.S. for this role, but Bay Area-based employees follow a hybrid schedule.

 - Health & Wellness: $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being.

 - Fresh Lunch: Provided on in-office days for those in a hybrid schedule.

 - Commuter Support: $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses for those in a hybrid schedule.

 - Time Off: Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays.

 - Comprehensive Coverage: 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents.

 - Parental Leave: 16 weeks fully paid.

 - Retirement & Ownership: 401k plan plus an equity package.

 - Team Connection: Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.

Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

What You Will Do

The Senior Program Operations Manager reports to the EOS Service Delivery Manager and provides hands-on execution and program administration support to keep the defined program of work on track.

Working closely with the client Service Manager, the Senior Program Operations Manager owns the day-to-day operational detail. This includes coordinating logistics, tracking progress against the agreed plan, maintaining financial and status reporting, and surfacing risks early so delivery stays aligned to the scope, standards, and timeline the client has defined.

Key Responsibilities

Execution & Delivery Support

• Act as the day-to-day execution partner for the defined program of work by interpreting the agreed scope and plan, coordinating activities, and maintaining accurate plans, trackers, and reporting.

• Own the operational detail and program administration workload on behalf of the EOS Service Delivery Manager, enabling focus on strategic decisions, KPIs, and stakeholder relationships.

jobs.title: Systems Integration Lead
jobs.company: Galactic Resource Advancement Mechanism Technologies Corporation
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States
jobs.description:
Systems Integration Lead

GRAM · Robotics · the Bay Area

About the company

GRAM Corporation scales skilled labor for the physical economy. We design, manufacture and operate insectoids, general-purpose machines not built in our image. They work in large populations on the critical infrastructure nations depend on. The electric grid comes first. Our research is in how those populations coordinate and keep themselves running. The goal is Self-Replication (SR), the point where a population of machines delivers more labor than it takes to build and run.

About the role

The Systems Integration Lead brings hardware and software together at the integration layer, which is where problems actually surface. You will own testing, reliability and safety across the whole robot. Software engineers write their own unit tests. You own the tests that prove the whole system works.

This is a hands on role for the first year, with the chance to build and lead a team as the company grows.

What you will do

• Own the verification and validation strategy: what is proven by analysis, simulation, hardware in the loop, bench and field testing, and how coverage is tracked.

• Build the test infrastructure from scratch: bench rigs, hardware in the loop setups, scenario based tests for edge cases and safety scenarios, and an automated regression suite with performance tracked over time.

• Run robot bring up and acceptance for each hardware revision, and run the field test program.

• Lead failure triage and root cause analysis across mechanical, electrical, firmware and software.

• Own reliability and safety: FMEA, hazard and risk analysis, safety functions such as E stop and safe state behavior, and the safety case for customers.

What you bring

• Verification and validation experience across hardware and software, especially at the interface between them.

• Experience building a test suite from scratch.

• Experience bringing up new robots or similar hardware and triaging early failures across mechanical, electrical and software.

• Working knowledge of reliability methods such as FMEA and root cause analysis.

• Hands on experience with hazard analysis and verifying safety functions on a physical system.

• Comfortable reading and writing code. This is not a pure hardware role.

Nice to have

• Robotics background. Autonomous vehicle backgrounds are also welcome, given their strong regression testing culture.

• Hardware in the loop and fault injection test design.

• Environmental qualification such as vibration, thermal and ingress testing.

• Experience running field test programs on robots operating outdoors.

• Depth in functional safety, such as IEC 61508 or similar.

Why join

• A clean slate: build testing and reliability the right way from day one.

• Early equity, included with this role.

• The chance to own a domain and build a team around it.

• A small, hands on engineering team where everyone does real work.

jobs.title: HTS Associate
jobs.description:
COMPANY

Octant is a clinical stage drug discovery company developing correctors for protein misfolding diseases with active programs in rare diseases and oncology. Octant’s platform, The Navigator, combines high-throughput synthetic biology, generative chemistry, and AI/ML to discover and develop therapeutics against complex cellular mechanisms in human cells.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Octant is seeking a High-Throughput Screening (HTS) Associate to join our team, where we develop, scale, and execute the high-throughput screening platform for Octant’s drug discovery programs.

As an HTS Associate, you will:

• Execute critical workflows of our high-throughput screening and synthetic chemistry platforms, generating key decision-making data for our drug discovery programs

• Operate and maintain our automation equipment, including our state-of-the-art integrated screening systems

• Coordinate closely with the team to schedule, plan, and prioritize across multiple lab activities

• Continually improve our workflows and help troubleshoot issues to make our platform operations more robust and effective

THIS JOB MIGHT BE GREAT FOR YOU IF YOU:

• Are familiar with basic biology and/or chemistry lab techniques

• Are excited to learn and master new skills, including mammalian tissue culture, chemical synthesis, and lab automation

• Are an excellent communicator, both verbal and written, and can coordinate proactively across multiple stakeholders

• Are exceptionally detail-oriented

• Are focused on clean execution – you love getting things done well

• Have relevant lab experience (including course labwork)

• Have experience operating automated laboratory instruments

You are motivated by Octant’s mission and have a team-first mindset. You will be expected to learn quickly and take pride and ownership in doing your work with care and urgency. We want to find the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may come from a less traditional background. If you have other skills and experiences that you feel help you to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic startup environment, we want to meet you. In your application, please highlight something you’re proud of, inside or outside of science!

Schedule: This is an onsite, hourly position requiring regular Sunday work to support screening operations and laboratory automation. The remaining hours can be scheduled flexibly across weekdays, with an anticipated average of 35-40 hours per week.

The base pay rate is $24-28/hr depending on experience level. We offer health benefits (medical, dental, vision), equity, and 401(k) matching.

Octant is located in Emeryville, California and our team works onsite.

Octant is an equal opportunity company that values applicants of all backgrounds. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive work environment. We value less traditional backgrounds, and may consider an equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education, and experience to meet minimum qualifications. We know that confidence-gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

OCTANT’S NAVIGATOR PLATFORM:

Octant’s Platform, “The Navigator,” accelerates the design, build, test, and learn iterations across chemistry and biology to build drugs against cellular mechanisms. The Navigator is an expanding set of drug discovery and development capabilities with three interwoven components that operate together:

• Generative Biology – Multiplexed measurements from engineered sensors in human cells to understand cellular mechanisms

• Generative Chemistry – Nanoliter-scale chemical synthesis for rapid exploration of local & targeted chemical space

• Generative AI – ML/AI ingests large-scale biological and chemical datasets and drives iteration of experiments to build better molecules faster

Together, the Navigator platform drives week-to-week progress on our drug programs, generative 3M+ readouts each week across multiple therapeutic areas.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

jobs.title: Staff Reactor Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based company building the world's only mass-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running.  Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Reactor Systems Engineer to own the technical integration of a first-of-a-kind reactor. With no operating predecessor to copy and no mature supply chain, you will be the person who holds the whole machine together, making sure hundreds of design decisions across nuclear physics, thermal-hydraulics, controls, structures, materials, fuel, and licensing add up to a reactor that works safely and is delivered to customers on time.

You will be the technical authority for how the pieces of Kaleidos fit together: translating top-level product and safety requirements into subsystem requirements, owning interfaces, and making sure the integrated system performs, is safe, and can be built, tested, and deployed repeatably. 

As a staff-level engineer, you will work across every engineering discipline, resolve the hardest cross-system tradeoffs, and set the systems engineering practices the team uses as Kaleidos moves from first-of-a-kind builds to scaled production. You will be instrumental in unlocking commercialization of the first mass-produced nuclear reactor. 

Responsibilities & Duties

 - Own the Kaleidos system architecture and serve as technical authority for integrated system performance, safety, and reliability.

 - Define and manage system budgets (e.g., thermal, mass, power, reactivity, and volume) and allocate margins across subsystems.

 - Own interface definitions and interface control documents between subsystems, including reactor core, primary loop, power conversion loop, shielding, controls, and structures.

 - Maintain the technical baseline (requirements, configuration, change control, risk registers, and documentation) using lightweight processes scaled to a fast-moving startup.

 - Identify cross-cutting risks early and drive them to resolution before they become safety or schedule problems.

 - Define the verification and validation strategy and partner with Test Engineering to turn requirements into test plans, success criteria, and acceptance tests.

 - Correlate analysis and test results against system requirements, and drive resolution of discrepancies.

 - Support safety-basis and licensing or regulatory documentation as needed.

 - Mentor engineers across the organization in systems thinking, requirements quality, and interface discipline.

 - Communicate system status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and program leadership.

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.

 - 10+ years of professional engineering experience, including meaningful time in systems engineering, integration, testing, engineering operations, or technical leadership on complex hardware.

 - Demonstrated experience owning requirements and interfaces for a complex system from concept through build, test, and operation.

 - Experience leading system-level trade studies and making sound decisions with incomplete information.

 - Strong working knowledge across several relevant disciplines, such as thermal-fluids, mechanical, structural, power systems, or controls.

 - Experience with verification and validation, and with hazard and risk analysis methods (e.g., FMEA, FTA).

 - Demonstrated technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams without relying on formal authority.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, including producing clear technical documents and presenting to varied audiences.

Desired Qualifications & Skills

 - Knowledge of nuclear reactor design, reactor safety, or nuclear regulatory frameworks.

 - Experience with high-temperature systems, thermodynamic power cycles, or power generation systems.

 - Experience with configuration management and change control for hardware programs.

 - Experience transitioning hardware from development builds to repeatable production.

 - Startup or fast-paced hardware development experience.

Additional Requirements

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

 - Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

 - Eligibility to work in the U.S. and ability to meet export control requirements.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.



Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s full-time new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director, Government Relations
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Anduril Government Relations (GR) team is responsible for developing and implementing Anduril’s government affairs strategy with the federal legislative and executive branches as well as state and local government officials.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking talented Government Relations professionals to join the team in Washington, DC. We are actively hiring for multiple roles across several key business lines, each offering unique technology focus areas, as well as Government Relations professionals with significant national security expertise in the legislative or executive branch with significant experience in budget, authorization, appropriations, and broader national security policy making.

Anduril Government Relations directly supports Anduril’s divisions and associated business lines. This role will be aligned across capability portfolios based on expertise and experience as well as the demands of existing and emerging business lines and capabilities. Specific focus areas include, but are not limited to the below:

• Maritime: Anduril’s growing maritime business line is building the next generation of autonomous maritime capability. In addition, Anduril recently announced Arsenal-2, a new, software-defined shipyard in Maryland, which will build complex components and large scale assemblies as a supplier in the submarine industrial base.

• Missiles and Advanced Effects: Anduril’s growing advanced weapons and autonomous effects portfolio. Anduril's Advanced Effects business line develops and manufactures autonomous air vehicles, cruise missiles, interceptor missiles, loitering munitions, and one-way effectors designed to give the U.S. military affordable, high-volume strike options to resolve the critical munitions gap.

• Space: Anduril’s growing space business line is expanding our AI-powered capabilities, enhancing space domain awareness, space control, and command and control for national security applications. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems to address growing threats in space to maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

• Unmanned and Counter Unmanned Systems: Anduril builds a comprehensive, AI-driven suite of Counter-UAS (C-UAS) solutions designed to detect, track, identify, and defeat unmanned aerial threats. In addition, Anduril builds unmanned aerial systems (UAS) ranging from small Group One sized quadcopters to larger UAS systems.

• Command and Control and Autonomous Systems: Anduril’s Lattice is the software platform that powers the capabilities of its software-defined weapons, and easily integrates with third-party and government-owned capabilities to create a comprehensive, extensible network of sensors and effectors.

As a Member of the Government Relations team, you will develop engagement strategies with Members of Congress and their staff, Committee Staff, Congressional Leadership teams, Caucuses and other bodies, as well as the executive branch in partnership with the Business Lines. You will also represent the company before a range of audiences to include Members of Congress and their staff, Committee Staff, executive branch officials, industry groups, and others as appropriate.

You must have significant knowledge and experience of the national security related US federal budget/appropriations and policymaking processes and how these processes impact and support the company’s business development agenda. You should be a self-starter with strong verbal and written communication skills, and work well as part of a team. If you take initiative and find innovative solutions to drive forward priorities in a dynamic, fast paced team-oriented environment, this might be the job for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a key Member of the Government Relations team, roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Support the development and execution of near term and long term government relations strategies to build the company’s reputation, enhance the strategic positioning in the industry, and increase the understanding of the company and its business objectives in Washington, DC.

• Develop and implement GR strategy across business lines and fiscal years and engage on company-wide efforts to enact strategic national security policy and funding priorities through the congressional and executive branch processes.

• Support the planning and execution of appropriations and authorization strategies leading to direct revenue capture for multiple business lines, to include the engagement strategy with Members of Congress and their staff, Congressional Leadership teams, Caucuses and other bodies to increase support for budgetary and policy requests that have direct and material impact on Anduril revenue targets.

• Coordinate and oversee visits by congressional Members and staff to Anduril facilities in the United States and, as required, internationally.

• Support the company’s congressional engagement process to include the drafting and submission of policy and funding requests and supporting documentation, white papers, power points, congressional testimony and hearing prep, and other required deliverables.

• Monitor, analyze, and engage the annual congressional policymaking process to support the company’s priorities with a particular focus on annual appropriations, and defense and homeland security policy.

• Collaborate internally and externally on Anduril priorities, messaging and general outreach to ensure coordination and integration across the business development teams, independent consultants and senior leadership at the company.

• Support the company’s Political Action Committee priorities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• At least 10+ years of experience in the national security, government relations, and/or federal executive or legislative arena is recommended. Title and Salary will be commensurate with experience.

• Has considerable defense/national security experience on Capitol Hill or government relations related positions either for the Executive Branch or in a similar defense industry position.

• Demonstrated success in planning and implementing strategies to promote government relations priorities and influence change in the legislative policy and budget process.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of US federal appropriations and policy making processes, including executive agencies, the White House, Senate and House and an understanding of how these processes impact the company’s business development agenda.

• Experience with defense policy and budget issues and knowledge of the defense and national security sector and key stakeholders.

• Ability to build coalitions and to develop and maintain relationships with key Congressional and executive branch officials and industry and trade associations.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proven ability to work independently to pursue short and long-term goals.

• The ability to work and be an integral part of an action-oriented, decision-making working environment.

• Bachelors degree required. Graduate degrees welcome but not required.

• Ability to travel approximately 25% or greater.

• Must be available to work on-site in our DC Office

• Position will require individual lobbyist registration under the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995.

• Currently possesses or is eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$191,000—$235,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Coordinator, Comms
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel Predicts is looking for a Customer Messaging Coordinator to help shape how we speak to customers across our owned CRM channels. This role sits at the intersection of messaging strategy, brand, personalization, and experimentation. You’ll create high-impact campaigns with compelling messages that drive customer intent and generate learnings that showcase what great CRM strategy looks like and how it should evolve over time.

You’ll partner closely with Lifecycle Strategy, Promotions Strategy, CRM Ops, Go-To-Market, Creative, and Commercial teams to bring our brand to life in a way that feels timely and relevant to our customers. If you’re obsessed with sports, culture, communications, and understanding what makes people click, tap, and come back - this role is for you.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Craft relevant and impactful messages for all CRM channels that drive engagement with FanDuel Predicts while building trust through a customer-first mindset and FanDuel Predicts brand voice.

• Bring personalization strategies to life through messages that feel relevant and personal, not templated.

• Translate promotions, product updates, and key sporting and cultural moments into compelling customer-facing narratives and stories.

• Be a key contributor to communication and experimentation planning cycles, ensuring the strategy is cohesive, effective, and consistently drives learnings.

• Analyze performance data to identify messaging patterns that drive customer engagement and assist in the implementation of those learnings.

• Partner with Go-to-Market to ensure messaging aligns with broader brand and campaign narratives.

• Work closely with the Customer Marketing Experimentation team to ideate and execute tests, then integrate and scale learnings.

• Coordinate with CRM Ops to bring campaigns to life from brief through execution and deployment.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into customer-first messages.

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent industry experience preferred.

• 1+ years of experience in copywriting, CRM, content marketing, or related field.

• An avid sports and gaming fan with a pulse on culture, trends, and moments that matter to our customers – have played FanDuel or competitive products.

• Curiosity about what motivates customer behavior and eagerness to test, learn, and iterate.

• Eager to explore new capabilities and deploy tactics that differentiate us from our competitors.

• Proficiency manipulating data and performing calculations in Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF statements, etc.).

• Strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once.

• Has a positive attitude and loves opportunities to collaborate with others.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with tight deadlines.

• A strong writer who is comfortable working within constraints - especially short-form, performance-driven channels.

• Familiarity with A/B testing or experimentation concepts is a plus.

• Capable and comfortable around engagement data and able to identify key drivers of business outcomes.

• Strong instincts around tone, voice, frequency and audience relevance with the ability to codify those ideas into a forward-looking comms strategy.

• Ability to turn insights into actions that drive positive results.

• Experience working within a heavily regulated industry is a plus.

• Willing to work some non-traditional hours.

ABOUT FANDUEL

FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product.

In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

PLAYER BENEFITS
We treat our team right

We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. *Benefits differ across location, role, and level.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
QUINDAR

Quindar builds modern, cloud-native satellite mission operations software with a simple mission: to operate satellites like servers. Our platform replaces fragmented, legacy ground systems with an integrated, automation-driven approach that brings modern software velocity to space operations.

We're a small, fast-moving team with deep aerospace and software roots, energized by big challenges and motivated by the impact we have on real missions in this next chapter of the Space Age. If you want to work with sharp, ambitious people who push boundaries, move quickly, and are excited to take space operations to the next level, Quindar is the place to do it.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING 👨‍💻👩‍💻 🛰 🛰

You will be responsible for developing ground satellite operations software using Python and AWS services. Don't worry, you do not need to be an expert in satellites or understand space! Satellites are just flying servers you can connect to every 90 minutes but we connect to hundreds of them.

You will develop APIs, integrate with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, and EKS with a focus on scalability, security, cost, and performance of the software. Working closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, you will implement new features and troubleshoot issues. Your strong knowledge of AWS services and best practices will enable you to optimize resource utilization and automate processes, ultimately contributing to the efficient and reliable operations of thousands of satellites.

You will primarily be responsible for developing backend software capabilities, but the ideal candidate can contribute across backend software development, generative AI integrations, DevSecOps and CI/CD tooling, and software architecture design and maintenance.

Day to day, you will be a part of the engineering team of frontend and backend engineers working in an Agile Scrum environment.

Tech Skills

 - Proficiency in Python, GraphQL, Docker, and Terraform (or relevant Infrastructure-as-Code tools)

 - Strong knowledge of containerized applications

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes cluster deployments

 - Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS

 - Fluency in collaborative development using Git with platforms like GitHub or GitLab

Soft Skills

 - Deep technical analysis and troubleshooting skills

 - Independent self-starter; able to complete projects on time with minimal guidance

 - A high standard for software maintainability, quality, resilience, and performance

 - Strong cross-functional communication between frontend and backend engineers and product managers

Background Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field)

 - 3+ years professional experience in backend development, full stack development or other related role. Professional experience can be replaced with a self-starter who has drive, the technical skills, and is obsessed with their product.

 - U.S. Person status required – we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

Role Requirements

Ability to obtain a U.S. government issued security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

 - To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT QUINDAR

 - We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each quarter we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 - Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Air Defense (SIP)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air Defense team builds autonomous robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. This team is the nexus of premier Anduril-built products such as Roadrunner, Sentry, Anvil, Pulsar, and Wisp integrated into a software-enabled Air Defense family of systems tailored to the modern battlespace. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, we provide critical force protection capabilities to support the warfighter. Our autonomous family of networked sensors and effectors enables our users to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats that continue to evolve at a rapid pace.

Within Air Defense, our SOF integration team fields counter-UAS capability for special operations users. We integrate Anduril and third-party sensors, effectors, and C2 onto towers, vessels, vehicles, and dismounted kits, often running several task orders in parallel, each with its own milestones, partners, and test events.

ABOUT THE JOB

We're seeking a Technical Program Manager to own engineering execution across a portfolio of concurrent counter-UAS programs. Our chief engineer leads and owns the technical decisions. You own making sure those decisions turn into delivered milestones: the integrated schedule, review readiness, partner deliverables, staffing, and follow-through across every program in flight.

This is not a status-reporting role. You will run the operating rhythm of the engineering team, close loops nobody else is closing, and spot schedule and resourcing problems weeks before they become escalations. You should be technical enough to read an ICD, follow a test plan, and push back on an engineer's estimate. You should also be organized enough that leadership trusts your tracker more than their own memory.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Integrated Engineering Schedule: Build and own one engineering schedule across every active program, tied to contract milestones, test events, and hardware lead times. Flag slips and cross-program conflicts early, with a recommended fix rather than just a red cell.

• Milestone Review Readiness: Drive SRR, PDR, CDR, and test readiness reviews end to end. Define entry and exit criteria, assign and chase the inputs, assemble the package, run the review, and drive every action item to closure.

• Partner and Subcontractor Execution: Own the technical deliverable tracking for subcontractors and integration partners. Hold partners to dates and quality, surface disagreements on scope or hours early, and keep engineering and contracts aligned on what was actually agreed.

• Operating Rhythm: Run the team's recurring program syncs so engineering leadership can step out of them. Set agendas, capture decisions and actions, and make sure follow-ups actually happen within days, not months.

• Staffing and Allocation: Own the team's allocation picture across programs. Keep the staffing data accurate, catch over-allocation before it burns people out, and build coverage plans for planned absences and peak test periods.

• Upward and Customer Reporting: Produce the weekly program roll-up for engineering and business leadership, and support customer-facing status.

• Proposals and Estimates: Support labor build-ups, ROMs, and schedules for new task orders so estimates are grounded in how the team actually executes.

• Test Event Execution: Plan and coordinate logistics, people, hardware, and readiness for field and range test events as needed, and be on site when it matters.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years in technical program management, systems engineering, or engineering roles on hardware/software defense, aerospace, or robotics programs

• Proven track record running DoD-style milestone reviews (SRR/PDR/CDR/TRR) or an equivalent gated engineering process

• Experience managing subcontractor or partner technical deliverables, including holding partners accountable to schedule and scope

• Experience managing multiple concurrent programs or workstreams with shared people and hardware

• Technical depth to understand system architectures, interface documents, test plans, and the software development lifecycle well enough to challenge estimates and spot risk

• Strong written communication: you can turn a messy week into a one-page roll-up a general manager reads in two minutes

• Comfortable with ambiguity and minimal structure; you build the process instead of waiting for one

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance

• Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active Secret or higher clearance

• Experience with SOCOM, special operations, or other rapid-acquisition customers

• Counter-UAS, air defense, sensors, or C2 integration experience

• Experience supporting proposals, labor build-ups, and basis of estimates for task orders

• Experience at a fast-moving defense or hardware startup alongside traditional primes

• Hands-on with Jira, Confluence, Airtable, or similar tools, and the discipline to keep them accurate

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering or technical discipline

US Salary Range

$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The team

The Tooling team builds shared systems that make data reliable, discoverable, governable, efficient, and easy to use. Our work spans data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management, optimization, and self-service workflows for Data Engineering, Data Science, Experimentation, Machine Learning, and product teams.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate high-leverage data tooling used across Roblox. You will own substantial technical work from problem discovery through production rollout, turning complex operational signals into clear, dependable workflows.

A key focus for this role is intelligent automation for data operations: helping people and systems discover relevant data, diagnose quality or pipeline issues, understand cost and lifecycle signals, and take safe next steps. You will build these capabilities with strong evaluation, observability, and human oversight.

You will

• Design, implement, and operate shared services, frameworks, and developer experiences for data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management, and optimization.

• Turn signals such as freshness, quality failures, lineage, usage, and compute or storage cost into actionable alerts, recommendations, dashboards, and workflows.

• Build AI-assisted or agentic experiences that help users investigate data questions and operational issues, with appropriate permissions, traceability, safety checks, and human approval for consequential actions.

• Develop evaluation infrastructure for automated recommendations and actions, including reproducible tests, measurable quality criteria, regression checks, and monitoring for failures or unintended behavior.

• Improve how teams discover, validate, govern, and operate data products, reducing toil while preserving clear ownership and reliable controls.

• Partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, Experimentation, ML, product, and infrastructure teams to understand needs and deliver reusable solutions rather than one-off fixes.

• Own production readiness for your work: instrumentation, service health, rollout plans, incident response, and follow-through on reliability and usability improvements.

• Lead technical design for projects or workstreams, communicate tradeoffs and risks clearly, and mentor engineers through reviews and collaborative problem-solving.

You have

• Strong software engineering experience building and operating production systems, platforms, or developer tools.

• Experience designing services or frameworks that are reused by multiple teams, with attention to reliability, maintainability, observability, and user experience.

• Experience with data systems or operational workflows, for example, metadata, data quality, lineage, orchestration, monitoring, or large-scale pipeline operations.

• Sound judgment for turning ambiguous problems into incremental, measurable solutions, and for balancing automation with appropriate safeguards.

• Experience evaluating automated or AI-assisted systems using representative tests, measurable outcomes, and ongoing production feedback; familiarity with agentic workflows is especially relevant.

• The ability to collaborate across engineering and data disciplines, influence technical decisions, and explain complex tradeoffs to varied audiences.

• A track record of mentoring peers and raising engineering quality without relying on formal authority.

jobs.description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a Construction Inspector to support large, complex heavy civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, and transit (bus and rail) projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. This position covers field inspection on transit facility and roadway work across civil, structural, mechanical, and roofing scopes. The goal is work that conforms to the contract documents, backed by field records that hold up from first inspection through closeout.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in the greater DMV Area.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Inspect contractor work on transit facility and roadway projects for conformance with approved plans, specifications, and contract requirements.

• Perform civil inspection of earthwork, underground utilities, drainage, paving, concrete flatwork, and site improvements.

• Inspect structural work, including concrete placement, reinforcing steel, structural steel, and repairs to existing structures.

• Inspect mechanical, plumbing, and fire protection installations, and observe functional testing and startup.

• Inspect roofing and building envelope work, including membrane systems, flashing, insulation, and roof drainage, against specification and manufacturer requirements.

• Prepare daily inspection reports, photo documentation, and field records that are accurate, timely, and defensible.

• Verify installed quantities submitted for payment against approved documents and field measurements.

• Document nonconforming work, notify the resident engineer, and track corrective actions to closure.

• Monitor contractor compliance with site safety, maintenance of traffic, and requirements for work adjacent to active transit operations, and report concerns promptly.

• Coordinate daily field activities with the resident engineer, contractor staff, materials testing personnel, and transit operations staff.

• Support punch list development, substantial completion inspections, and closeout documentation.

Attributes

• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

• Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.

• Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.

• Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

• Confidence to document nonconforming work and hold a position with contractor field staff.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, construction management, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 3+ years of civil, structural, mechanical, roofing, or general construction inspection experience for large (>$500M), complex, heavy-civil infrastructure projects.

• Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as required.

• OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety and Health certification.

• 5+ years of experience supporting multiple concurrent tasks or projects.

• Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and shop drawings in the field.

• Working knowledge of construction materials, testing requirements, and inspection documentation practices.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, or construction management.

• Active inspection certifications such as Transportation Construction Inspection certification through the National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET), Concrete Field Testing Technician Grade I through the American Concrete Institute (ACI), Commercial Building, Mechanical, or Structural Inspector certification through the International Code Council (ICC), or Registered Roof Observer (RRO) through the International Institute of Building Enclosure Consultants (IIBEC).

• Experience inspecting work at active transit facilities such as stations, bus maintenance facilities, or rail yards.

• Experience inspecting roadway and highway work, including paving, drainage, and maintenance of traffic.

• Roadway worker protection training or experience working adjacent to an operating rail system.

• Experience in an owner’s representative, program management, or construction management capacity.

• Experience with construction management and document control software (e.g., Unifier, e-Builder, ProjectWise, Procore, etc.).

jobs.title: Founding Outbound SDR
jobs.description:
We're building a new system of record for finance, one that understands not just the numbers, but the business context behind them. At its core is our Operational Ledger: a financial data layer that preserves every event, calculation, policy, source, and decision behind the financials, rather than reducing them to contextless entries.



Questions that once took weeks to answer become as routine as a Google search: Why did margins change? Which customers are actually profitable? How are we tracking against budget? We're not bolting AI onto legacy software. Quanta was built from the ground up around granular financial data, flexible primitives, and systems that agents can safely understand and act on.



We've spent years closing the books for real, fast-growing companies and turning what we learn into product. We've already replaced much of what QuickBooks and NetSuite can do and the manual work surrounding them. Customers are now turning off legacy accounting systems and moving to Quanta.



We're still early. The problems are hard, the ambition is enormous, and there's no playbook for what we're building.



We're looking for an Outbound SDR to help build Quanta's outbound sales motion from the ground up. This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature sequence library, work through a static account list, and optimize for meetings booked.



You'll spend most of your time doing the fundamentals exceptionally well; researching accounts, calling prospects, writing thoughtful outbound, qualifying buyers, and creating pipeline. You'll also have the opportunity to experiment constantly and turn what works into the playbook for the people who come after you. For someone who wants to become a great seller and eventually an AE, you'll get unusually close exposure to our customers, product, founders, and the process of building an early-stage sales organization.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build qualified pipeline. Prospect through cold calls, personalized email, LinkedIn, warm introductions, events, and whatever creative channels prove effective.

 - Become excellent at identifying the right companies. Research target accounts, understand how their businesses work, map finance stakeholders, and identify the right entry points.

 - Find signals others miss. Use funding, finance leadership changes, hiring, business-model complexity, existing accounting infrastructure, and other signals to prioritize where Quanta can create the most value.

 - Experiment relentlessly. Test messages, signals, offers, channels, and tactics. Understand why something works, not just whether it works.

 - Use AI as leverage. Find creative ways to improve research, account prioritization, personalization, preparation, and your overall effectiveness.

 - Bring the market back to Quanta. You'll be one of the people talking to prospective customers every day. Turn what you learn into useful feedback for sales, product, and the rest of the company.

 - Help build the machine. When something works, help turn it into a repeatable system that can scale to the next SDRs we hire.




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You are hungry to become exceptional at sales and want a path toward becoming an AE.

 - You're comfortable picking up the phone and creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.

 - You're resourceful. When the obvious approach doesn't work, your instinct is to find another one.

 - You're resilient enough to operate in outbound sales and analytical enough to continuously improve at it.

 - You want responsibility earlier in your career rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.

 - You're excited by the idea of joining a small company where the playbook is still being written.
   
   

We also welcome exceptional candidates from unconventional backgrounds. We care much more about initiative, judgment, curiosity, and learning speed than checking every box.




THIS ROLE PROBABLY ISN'T FOR YOU IF

 - You want a finished playbook to execute rather than helping build one.

 - You want to optimize for activity or meetings booked regardless of whether those meetings turn into real opportunities.

 - You dislike cold calling or expect technology to replace the fundamentals of outbound sales.

 - You want a highly specialized role with narrow ownership.

 - Or you want to join a company where most of the important questions have already been answered.
   
   


WHY QUANTA

Build a category, not just features. We're not selling a slightly better version of an established tool. We're changing what companies should expect from their financial systems.

Join early enough to matter. We're a small team. The things you discover, build, and prove can become part of how Quanta sells for years.

Learn directly from exceptional people. You'll work alongside founders, engineers, and finance leaders who have built financial infrastructure and operated finance functions firsthand.

Grow with the company. We're looking for someone who wants to take on increasing ownership, and help us build the sales organization that comes next.





BENEFITS

 - Competitive early-stage salary

 - Competitive early-stage equity

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k)

 - Take-what-you-need paid vacation

 - Commuter benefits

 - Wellness stipend

 - Paid lunches and dinners in the office

 - All the equipment and tools you need to do your best work

jobs.title: BIM Draftsperson / 3D Visualization Specialist - EV Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is looking for a BIM Draftsperson / 3D Visualization Specialist to support one of our Electrical Vehicle clients, who is expanding their Design Studio and looking for a BIM & Visual Communications Specialist to serve as the visual and digital execution engine of the team.

This is not a passive drafting role where you just receive redlines. In this role, you are the translator of spatial innovation. You will bridge the gap between technical standards requirements, design layouts, and polished visual communications. Whether you are building Revit models and families or creating highly stylized, publication-ready diagrams for our global playbooks for use within the Brightspot CMS, your work directly aids in establishing the visual language of our global physical footprint.

We operate with two core focuses in this role—standards modeling and graphics and project specific modeling —allowing you to showcase both your advanced technical Revit capabilities and your graphic design sensibilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Standards Visual Communications & Graphics:

• Generate high-quality, professional, and intuitive visual graphics, diagrams, and illustrative layouts (using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign) to accompany technical standards and written narratives in our web-based Content Management System (Brightspot CMS).
• Work with team Architects and Engineers to turn dense technical concepts (such as EV charging clearances, vehicle turning radii, and safety containment zones) into clean, digestible, and visually compelling infographics and spatial matrices.
• Ensure all visual standards materials adhere to corporate graphic guidelines, establishing a sophisticated and cohesive aesthetic across all digital and print A/E standards documentation.

BIM content & Family Creation:

• Assist in curating and maintaining our master architectural detail libraries and template files, ensuring all draft assets are updated and synchronized with changing A/E standards and design criteria.
• Build, test, and catalog parametric Revit families, equipment blocks, and standardized graphic components (such as EV charging hardware, fleet servicing equipment, and modular building details) to populate our master library.
• Assist the BIM Manager in maintaining and auditing Revit master files, standard details, and shared parameters to ensure perfect digital consistency.

Agile Internal Design & Production Support:

• Work with the project lead to generate lightning-fast schematic spatial layouts and site-specific documentation in Revit and AutoCAD to scope operational requirements for new sites.
• Draft site-specific schematic design scope packages, floor plans, equipment blocks, and elevations under the guidance of our Lead Project Architects.
• Actively implement core brand elements, finishes, and dimensional standards directly into Revit models, ensuring zero "standards drift" during rapid design iterations.
• Execute technical markups from architects, designers, traffic planners, and MEP engineers as needed, ensuring drawings are fully coordinated and clash-free before handoff to external partners.
• Work with team leads to seamlessly translate field-tested layout modifications back into standard BIM components, preventing technical drift.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s or Associate’s degree in architecture, Graphic Design, Architectural Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3–5+ years of experience in architectural production, detailing, or graphic coordination within a professional A/E or corporate design studio.
• Advanced Proficiency in Autodesk Revit & AutoCAD: Proven hands-on capability in architectural modeling, detail drafting, sheet set composition, and Revit view/parameter organization.
• Advanced proficiency in 3D rendering and AI supported postproduction processes.
• Advanced Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop): A strong portfolio showcasing clean layout design, diagramming, infographic creation, and visual standards communication.
• Proven ability to read and interpret complex architectural drawings, structural details, and engineering schematics.
• Demonstrated success working in a high-volume, rapid-turnaround environment with multiple concurrent projects.
• Candidates should be prepared to share a portfolio of modeled projects, graphic designs, and renderings.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE & CERTIFICATIONS:

Preferred Certifications:

• Autodesk Certified Professional (ACP): Revit Architecture (Highly desired to validate professional-grade modeling capability).
• Adobe Certified Professional (Illustrator, InDesign, or Photoshop) (Demonstrates professional visual layouts and graphics standards).

Preferred Experience:

• Experience designing templates, assets, or playbooks for Content Management Systems (Brightspot CMS) or digital wikis.
• Familiarity with digital whiteboarding tools (Miro, Mural) and agile task tracking (Asana).
• Experience with Revit Family Creation (building basic parametric Revit components and coordinating types).
• Background in corporate retail rollouts, hospitality, industrial site planning, or infrastructure design.

The salary range for this full-time role is $120K-$140K per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. jobs.title: Electrical Integration Manager
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Position Summary

IEM is seeking an Electrical Integration Manager to lead the electrical installation and integration of prefabricated electrical houses (e-houses), equipment skids, and related power distribution systems at our San Antonio facility. This role combines extensive electrical trade knowledge with hands-on leadership of electricians, foremen, and supporting personnel. The manager will plan and oversee electrical installation activities, apply electrical codes to practical installation decisions, and ensure work meets safety, quality, and schedule expectations.

The ideal candidate is an experienced licensed electrician who has progressed into a superintendent, supervisor, or management role within electrical contracting, industrial construction, or modular electrical systems integration. This position offers the opportunity to lead construction-style electrical work from a consistent facility location.

This position will be based temporarily in NE San Antonio while our new manufacturing plant is coming online. Our permanent location is approximately 25 minutes away at Brooks, 7515 Inner Circle Dr., San Antonio, 78235. The position is also 100% in-office and does not offer remote work.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage daily electrical integration activities across multiple e-house and skid projects, coordinating crews, work assignments, installation sequencing, labor priorities, and resource needs to support project schedules and prevent delays.

• Interpret electrical drawings, specifications, equipment layouts, and customer requirements to guide installation decisions, including conduit routing and sizing, conductor selection, circuit distribution, and equipment connections where drawings require further detail.

• Apply the National Electrical Code (NEC), relevant International Building Code (IBC) provisions, and project requirements to installation planning and execution.

• Lead, mentor, and develop electricians and electrical team leaders, setting clear expectations for workmanship, accountability, and performance.

• Maintain a visible floor presence to inspect work, identify deficiencies, and drive timely corrective action; coordinate with Quality and testing personnel on inspection checkpoints, testing readiness, punch-list completion, and project handoff.

• Partner with Mechanical Integration, Engineering, Operations, Quality, EHS, Materials, and Project Management to coordinate work and resolve barriers to completion.

• Establish repeatable installation practices and training; track progress, labor productivity, quality issues, and rework to identify improvements that strengthen consistency and execution while accommodating customer-specific requirements.

• Promote safe work practices and reinforce company safety procedures.

• Support the development and expansion of the San Antonio electrical integration operation and perform additional duties as needed.

Qualifications

• Must have an active journeyman or master electrician license.

• Extensive hands-on experience in industrial or commercial electrical installation, with demonstrated progression into a foreman, superintendent, supervisor, or manager role.

• Proven ability to lead multiple electrical crews and coordinate work across concurrent projects.

• Strong working knowledge of the NEC and the ability to interpret and apply code requirements to installation decisions.

• Experience with conduit systems, conductor sizing, grounding and bonding, power distribution, lighting, and auxiliary electrical systems.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, and technical specifications.

• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to recognize and correct installation issues through direct observation and technical judgment.

• Experience planning manpower, sequencing work, and coordinating material and equipment needs.

• Effective communication, coaching, and cross-functional problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work on-site in San Antonio and maintain an active presence throughout the facility.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience integrating e-houses, modular electrical buildings, equipment skids, power distribution centers, or similar packaged electrical systems.

• Leadership experience with a large electrical contractor or an industrial electrical integration operation.

• Experience building teams, developing foremen, or establishing electrical installation processes in a growing operation.

• Familiarity with switchgear, switchboards, transformers, control panels, and related power distribution equipment.

• Experience coordinating electrical installation with structural, mechanical, and HVAC work.

• Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement experience.

Workplace Conditions & Physical Demands

• This position is based on-site at IEM’s San Antonio facility, overseeing electrical installation within a factory environment. The role requires regular floor presence, direct engagement with electrical crews, and close coordination with other operational teams.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with industry experience who is eager to make a significant impact in the field of molecular sensors and biotechnology.

• Protect innovation through patent filings while contributing high-impact scientific publications and technical documentation.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in biosensors and bioelectronics, advising multidisciplinary teams on technical feasibility, risk mitigation, and system architecture.

• Electrochemical Sensing: experience with electrochemical systems and biosensors.
• Biochemistry: familiarity with the principles of biochemistry.
• Proven track record of scientific accomplishment/patent filings
• Soft skills: highly motivated and passionate about developing new technologies and products; strong documentation, oral and interpersonal skills, experience working in a multidisciplinary team.
