jobs.title: Content Producer, Social
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

True Anomaly's in-house Creative Content Production team tells the story of a company building space security. We cover the people, facilities, spacecraft, and test campaigns behind that work across Denver, Colorado Springs, Long Beach, and our test sites. The team is small and generalist, working in two pods (Denver and Long Beach), and everyone on it produces, shoots, and edits.

As Content Producer, Social, you will be the team's fastest maker. You'll shoot and edit short-form, platform-native video and photo from our Denver and Colorado Springs sites, capturing the work as it happens and turning it around while it still matters. You'll make content for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube, working from the master content calendar our team builds with the Head of Social Media and the wider Marketing team.

This is not a social media manager role, but you will know the platforms like the back of your hand. You'll report to the Director of Content Production and work day to day with our Denver-based Content Producer.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Capture

• Be on the ground for test events, milestones, facility days, visits, and company events, often with little notice.

• Shoot vertical-first and short-form video and stills, on cinema cameras and phones, as a one-person crew.

Edit and Ship

• Edit quickly and well, with same-day or 24-hour turnaround when it counts.

• Craft hooks, on-screen text, and animated captions, add simple motion and transitions within our social templates, and deliver platform-specific versions and specs.

• Pull social cuts and selects from the team's larger productions.

Formats and Feedback

• Pitch your own ideas with a clear point of view, drawing on what you see on the ground in Denver and Colorado Springs and what’s working on each platform.

• Help develop repeatable series and formats that the team can produce reliably every week.

• Adapt platform trends with good judgment for a defense brand, knowing which ones fit and which to skip.

• Review performance with the Head of Social Media and bring what you learn back into how we shoot and cut.

Be Part of the Crew

• Contribute camera, photo, and edit work on the team's bigger films and campaigns across both team pods.

• Work within True Anomaly's security and content-review processes, even on fast turnarounds.

• Keep media organized so social selects and raw footage are easy to find and reuse.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 3–5+ years of experience creating short-form social video and photo for a brand, agency, creator, or media outlet, with work you shot and edited yourself.

• A portfolio of social content, with evidence of results where you have it.

• Strong storytelling instincts. You can find the story in what’s in front of you, shape it with a clear point of view, and make deliberate choices about hook, tone, pacing, and what the audience should take away.

• Deep, current fluency in LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube (including Shorts): formats, specs, trends, and audience behavior, plus a sharp sense of what earns and holds attention on each.

• Fast, confident editing in Adobe Premiere Pro and short-form tools, including basic motion work: animated captions, simple transitions, and building within existing social templates.

• Comfort shooting video and photo, on cinema cameras (Sony experience is ideal) and on phone, with good instincts for light and sound in the field.

• A good design eye. You don’t need to be a designer, but you have solid instincts for typography, layout, and composition.

• Editorial judgment about tone. You can be engaging without being flippant about serious subject matter.

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the function, systems, and workflows are still being built.

• Genuine interest in aerospace, defense, or national security is a meaningful signal, though prior industry experience is not required.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Experience working alongside social media marketing teams.

• Social experience for B2B, deep-tech, aerospace, or defense brands.

• Advanced motion graphics in After Effects, such as custom animation or building new social templates.

• Comfort directing employees on camera for talking-head and explainer content.

• FAA Part 107 drone certification.

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $65,000 - 120,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver or Colorado Springs. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

• Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

• Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Verticals (AI Native)
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $103,500 to $192,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 149,500 to 177,500 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

• Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands.

• Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality.

• Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.

• Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions.

• Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

• Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.

• Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards.

• Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.

• Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

• 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services.

• 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.

• Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed.

• Hands-on experience with agentic workflows, prompt engineering, context window management, and MCP/function calling.

• A track record of using AI tooling to multiply your own output — not just as autocomplete, but as a development partner.

• A strong sense of ownership — you don't wait to be told what to fix, and you follow through past "it works on my machine" to "it works for the member, in production, at scale."

• Strong communication and collaboration skills — you work well with product, design, and platform engineers.

• Excitement for defining what it means to be AI-Native — you're not waiting for the playbook, you want to write it.

• Empathy for the humans behind the product — an aging parent trying to stay independent, or a family member trying to help from afar.

• Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience with IoT, telematics, or embedded/hardware-adjacent systems.

• Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other high-throughput streaming platforms.

• Background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, DataDog).

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

• Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner.

• Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.

• Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.

• Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.

• Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.

• 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.

• Paid parental leave.

• Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.

• Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.

• Learning & Development programs.

• Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.

• Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

• Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.

• Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

• Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.

• High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAD AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie https://www.radai.com/news/auntminnie-recognizes-rad-ai-omni-reporting-as-2023s-best-new-radiology-software, and ranked by Deloitte https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 https://www.cnbc.com/2025/06/10/2025-cnbc-disruptor-50-see-the-full-list-of-companies.html list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!



Why Join Us:

At Rad AI, we combine world-class radiology and AI expertise to build products that maximize radiologist productivity, expand access to high-quality care, and improve patient outcomes. Join us and help transform how radiology is practiced for patients and health systems around the world.

We are looking for an Implementation Project Manager with deep experience leading software implementation projects. As Rad AI’s award-winning platform continues its rapid adoption, you will play a key role in guiding customers through successful deployments. You bring a proactive, “can do” mindset and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where adaptability and collaboration are essential.

What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Work independently to plan, monitor, and manage multiple complex customer-facing projects

 - Lead the end-to-end delivery of Rad AI’s products to radiology practices and health systems, from kick-off to go-live and transition to support

 - Own implementation readiness and go-live planning, coordinating testing, training, customer preparedness, cutover activities, and post-launch transition. Identify readiness gaps early and develop actionable recovery plans when milestones or commitments are at risk

 - Maintain accurate, current project plans, milestones, forecasts, risks, decisions, and action items in established project management systems, ensuring clear ownership, timely follow-through, and reliable visibility for stakeholders

 - Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Integration resources, to meet project objectives and deadlines

 - Serve as the primary client-facing contact throughout the implementation

 - Ensure a smooth onboarding process by managing project timelines, dependencies, and communications with executive, clinical, and IT stakeholders

 - Track and manage feature requests, ensuring clear communication, documentation, and prioritization

 - Anticipate and actively manage project risks, dependencies, and potential delays; develop and track mitigation plans, communicate threats early, and escalate material issues with clear business impact, recommended actions, and accountable owners

 - Proactively investigate challenges, assess root causes and business impact, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions. Exercise sound judgment within established authority and escalate decisions with clear recommendations when needed

 - Conduct weekly status meetings with internal and external stakeholders

 - Collaborate and coordinate with Rad AI’s product, engineering, and customer success teams for project goal setting, data integration, testing, and product feedback

 - Provide ongoing updates to leadership throughout the project, via dashboards and reports

 - Foster transparent, respectful, and solutions-focused partnerships with customers and internal teams, navigating competing priorities, addressing difficult conversations constructively, and driving alignment on decisions and commitments

 - Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer outcomes; proactively propose and help implement practical solutions, contribute lessons learned, and support adoption of agreed improvements.

 - Contribute to building a world-class implementation organization that aims to exceed customer expectations with attentive, responsive, and knowledgeable service

Who We're Looking For:

 - Bachelor’s degree or above

 - At least 2 plus years of relevant project management, implementation management, technical project management, or similar client-facing experience, preferably within a healthcare/healthcare IT environment

 - Strong project planning and execution skills, including timeline, scope, and risk management

 - Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows and/or radiology-specific healthcare IT

 - Prior professional consulting or healthcare software implementation experience

 - Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows

 - Prior experience or familiarity with HL7, FHIR, and EHRs

 - Excellent people/relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to navigate challenging conversations, influence without authority, and hold stakeholders accountable respectfully

 - Practical working knowledge of SaaS solutions, implementations, and technical concepts

 - Eagerness to continuously learn, adapt, improve, and help others do so in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment

 - Ability to build and maintain relationships with all functions and areas of the company to share in challenges and successes, and work collaboratively towards common goals

 - Proficiency with project management tools

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission,  we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you're passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we'd love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it's like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/radai/?utm_campaign=Recruiting_2026&utm_content=recruiting-job-posting-website&utm_source=recru%5B%E2%80%A6%5Db-posting-website to stay up to date!


Location Details:

 - This role will be based in our San Francisco office and we expect employees to work onsite four days per week. The remaining time may be worked remotely or onsite, depending on team and business needs.

For roles listed as United States - Remote:

jobs.title: Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations

Own the supply chain and CMC project engine behind Nurix’s clinical programs and commercial readiness. In this multifaceted role, you will select and manage CMOs, keep clinical supply flowing to trial sites around the world, and drive cross-functional CMC plans from early development toward commercialization, in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities.

Position Description

The position is a multifaceted role supporting several areas within the Technical Operations group, including supply chain management, CMC project management, and clinical labeling and distribution. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated and self-directed, with experience and interest in working in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities and opportunities.

The Opportunity

• Lead the effort to identify, select, and manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for the development and cGMP manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and DS in support of ongoing clinical programs and commercial products (with finance and commercial teams)

• Manage global supply chains and logistics in support of demand for clinical studies and commercial products

• Working in conjunction with technical teams, provide vendor management support in all logistics and operations to ensure on-time delivery of materials

• Coordinate the design and execution of cross-functional CMC project plans and budgeting for early clinical development through commercial readiness

• Maintain frequent communication with cross-functional CMC project team members and key internal stakeholders so that all parties are aware of current project status, issues, contingencies, milestones, and budgets

• Proactively identify the CMC critical path, risks, and impediments to successful development, and drive the identification and development of solutions to mitigate these risks

• Serve as primary clinical supply chain contact, working collaboratively with internal and external partners

• Manage clinical supply planning and forecasting for study protocols and develop packaging/labeling and global distribution strategies

• Monitor IXRS portal processes, including high and low enrolling site settings, drug acknowledgement, depot and site supply levels, and IMP status of released lots or expired drug

• Coordinate the preparation and/or review of CMC sections of INDs, CTAs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submissions to ensure timely distribution of clinical trial materials

• Coordinate the process validation programs to support commercialization

• Initiate and manage high-value intercontinental, cross-border, and domestic shipments

• Coordinate the preparation, review, editing, and approval of cGMP batch records and CMC regulatory and Quality documents

• Coordinate the preparation of technical reports, publications, and oral presentations

What You’ll Bring

• BS with 15+ years’ experience; degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline

• At least 10 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC/cGMP environment

• Excellent project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally to develop and execute project plans

• Experience managing US and international CRO/CMOs for the manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and cGMP DS and DP for programs in development

• Experience with clinical supply chain, including forecasting supply needs

• Experience with cGMP manufacturing and IND, CTA, and NDA filings; thorough knowledge of relevant FDA and EMEA regulations

• Experience in supply chain management, and experience establishing pharmaceutical supply chain systems and networks

• Able to identify and resolve critical issues

• Sufficient technical background and experience to work closely with other technical functional areas

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and exceptional interpersonal and management skills to collaborate with others on assigned projects (including both internal teams and external collaborators)

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Operations
jobs.description:
The Company

Outrider, the pioneer in autonomous yard operations for logistics hubs, helps large enterprises improve safety and increase efficiency. The only company exclusively focused on automating all aspects of yard operations, Outrider eliminates manual tasks that are hazardous and repetitive. Outrider's mission is to drive the rapid adoption of sustainable freight transportation by deploying zero-emission systems. Outrider is a private company backed by NEA, 8VC, Koch Disruptive Technologies, and other top-tier investors. For more information, visit www.outrider.ai.

The Role

The Senior Manager, Customer Operations reports to the Director of Customer Success and leads Outrider's Customer Operations organization, including Customer Operations Managers, Associate Managers, and a frontline team of AV Site Leads and Autonomous Vehicle Field Technicians (AVFTs) across all active customer programs.

This role owns operational performance and customer operations relationships across Outrider's enterprise portfolio, serving as the senior escalation point for customer site and program leadership. This role connects Customer Operations performance to Outrider's commercial objectives, including renewals, expansions, and contract milestones.

The Senior Manager, Customer Operations also owns headcount planning, budget, and organization design for Customer Operations, and will lead the evolution of Outrider's operating model from site-based staffing toward scalable, travel-based implementation teams commissioning self-driving autonomous yard truck deployments.

Duties and Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop Customer Operations Managers and Associate Managers, building a strong, accountable leadership bench.

• Set clear goals, operating rhythms, and performance expectations across the Customer Operations organization.

• Own career progression and development for the organization, including frontline-to-leadership pathways.

• Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Customer Relationship Ownership

• Own customer operations relationships across the enterprise portfolio, from site leadership up to program and executive stakeholders.

• Serve as the senior escalation point for operational and safety issues, driving resolution across Customer Success, Technical Operations, Engineering, and Product.

• Partner with the Director of Customer Success and Customer Success Managers on program reviews, renewals, and expansion planning.

• Set the cadence for regular manager visits to customer sites, and personally lead executive-level relationships on key accounts.

Organization Design, Headcount, and Budget

• Own headcount planning, hiring plans, and budget for Customer Operations, aligned to the deployment roadmap.

• Design and lead the transition to travel-based implementation teams that support efficient, defined deployment cycles as sites move to driverless operations.

• Balance staffing across programs to meet customer commitments while improving efficiency and margin.

Operational Excellence

• Own operational KPIs across all programs, including safety, uptime, move volume, and service levels.

• Standardize operating procedures, Site Implementation Plans, ODD protocols, and weather procedures across sites.

• Lead response to significant operational and safety events, ensuring root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed.

• Design the standards, cadence, and reporting for auditing daily moves and move classification, and for monitoring site moves, video feeds, radio communications, and Slack channels, so issues are caught before they escalate.

Deployment and Scale

• Oversee staffing and operational readiness for new site launches, commissioning, validation, and go-live.

• Own and evolve Outrider's deployment playbook so each new site launches faster and more consistently.

• Resource and coordinate implementation work across Managers' portfolios, including customer training, project plans, onsite mapping, and launch weeks.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Reporting

• Represent Customer Operations with Engineering, Product, Technical Operations, Safety, and Finance, translating field needs into priorities.

• Own the escalation path and recurring reliability and uptime reviews with Technical Operations leadership.

• Deliver regular operational reporting to Outrider leadership and customer stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in field operations, logistics, robotics, autonomous vehicles, or industrial operations, including 5+ years leading people.

• Experience managing managers and leading multi-site or multi-program operations organizations.

• Experience owning enterprise customer relationships and escalations up to the executive level.

• Experience owning headcount planning, hiring, and an operating budget.

• Track record of designing or scaling an operating model through significant change.

• Ability to travel to customer sites up to 50% of the time.

• Unwavering focus on safety and the ability to lead a safety-first culture across an organization.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to customer and internal leadership.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to drive decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Logistics experience working around industrial Class 8 zero-emission electric vehicles, also known as heavy-duty electric vehicles (HDVs), with working knowledge of their charging, safety, and handling considerations.

• Experience operating or scaling autonomous vehicle or robotics deployments.

• Experience in distribution center, yard, or warehouse operations.

• Experience leading multi-site programs or implementation portfolios, including setting program plans and milestones, managing dependencies and risks across teams, and reporting progress to customer and executive stakeholders. PMP or equivalent certification a plus.

Physical Demands and Working Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met and encountered by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position requires walking, talking, seeing, hearing and other uses of the senses. While performing the duties of this job, an employee is required to frequently use hands and fingers and possess efficient means of communicating with others. Specific vision requirements include close vision. Occasional standing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, etc., is also required of this position. Occasional lifting up to 25 lbs., climbing, going up/down stairs and other physical exertions may also be required.

The working environment for this position is a combination of indoor office, warehouse and distribution yard, and outdoor environments, with travel to customer sites up to 50% of the time.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While this is an accurate reflection of the position, Outrider reserves the right to require that additional/different tasks be performed as needed.

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Fullstack

ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.




THE ROLE:

Every great product is built on a great platform. At Airbyte, the Platform team builds the systems that power every product we ship, including Airbyte Cloud, Airbyte Flex, and Airbyte Agents.



We create the infrastructure, internal tooling, developer platforms, and user-facing product surfaces that allow engineers to build quickly, deploy safely, and operate reliably at scale. Our work spans cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, engineering productivity, and the product experiences that our customers and engineers rely on every day.



As a Senior Fullstack Engineer on Platform, you'll work across the full stack to build both the internal tools that accelerate engineering and the user-facing features that customers interact with directly. You'll move fluidly between building an internal deployment dashboard and shipping a product feature in Airbyte Cloud.



This role is ideal for engineers who care about craft across the entire stack, whether the user is an internal engineer or an external customer, and who believe great platform work makes everything around it better.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:



Build Internal Platform Products

 - Design and build applications that power Airbyte's engineering platform and product surfaces.

Build Across the Stack

 - Create tools that help engineers and customers understand system health, deployment status, and service reliability.

 - Continuously identify opportunities to reduce operational toil through automation.

 - Raise the quality bar for frontend architecture, testing, accessibility, and maintainability.

 - Contribute to platform-wide engineering standards and best practices.

 - Help shape the future of Airbyte's platform and product engineering.

 - Deep expertise with React and TypeScript.

 - Strong backend engineering experience building APIs and distributed systems.

 - Experience shipping user-facing SaaS products alongside internal tools, developer platforms, or operational dashboards.

 - Experience working with product managers and designers to ship customer-facing features.

Success means the software you build makes both engineers and customers more effective.

Engineers deploy with confidence.

Infrastructure is easier to understand.

Operational workflows become self-service.

Development becomes faster, safer, and more reliable.

We integrate with tools like Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack, and more, helping teams stay aligned whether they're in the same room or across time zones.

From there, you’ll have full autonomy to experiment with how Read sells, uncover untapped distribution channels, and find new ways to scale.

jobs.title: Program Therapist, Eating Disorders
jobs.description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

We are seeking an experienced clinician with a passion for delivering evidence-based therapy within our Adult Eating Disorders Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient Program (PHP/IOP) young adults struggling with Mood and Anxiety. If you are passionate about working with patients to communicate, develop and carry out appropriate treatment plans and compassionate care, you would be an ideal addition to our team.

As a Program Therapist, you’ll work thoughtfully with our patients to develop and implement their individualized treatment plans. This role will consist of conducting individual therapy meetings, meal support, collaborating with patients’ outpatient teams, leading groups and guiding patients through their overall treatment program. You’ll partner closely with the entirety of our treatment teams, including Group Therapists, Family Therapists, Dieticians, Registered Nurses, and Prescribers Psychiatry Team Members to ensure comprehensive and compassionate care.

The staff in this role will be on-site Monday through Friday at our Northbrook location 8am to 4pm supporting the Eating Disorder PHP/IOP, as well as other adult programs based on census needs.

Our location in Northbrook is our first and largest facility, and consists not only of our widest variety of programs, but also serves as a pilot site for many of our new treatment offerings.

What You’ll Do

• Role function will be dedicated to Family Therapy and Primary Therapy based on census and program needs

• Provide evidence-based individual therapy and groups across the program curriculum, including CBT-E, exposure therapy, DBT and MED-DBT, ACT, and general CBT content

• Meet with patients individually to assess progress and guide treatment planning

• Coordinate care with patients’ individual providers to ensure continuity of care

• Assess patients’ progress and need for higher level of care or discharge

• Conducts assessments and consults with intake clinicians to aid in determining appropriateness of fit for patients

• Communicate with patients’ family members or support system when indicated

• Complete initial intake evaluations to determine diagnosis and appropriateness for program as needed

• Chart in our electronic medical records system

• Engage in crisis management as part of a treatment team

• Create and update treatment plans

• Participate in professional development activities

• Provide individual and milieu-based exposure therapy

Who You Are

• Hold the following licenses or certifications in the state of Wisconsin: LCSW, LPC, LCPC, LMFT, PsyD, or PhD with 2 + years of clinical experience conducting individual and/or group therapy.

• 1+ years’ experience with exposure therapy, preferred

• The ability to assist families and patients in talking about difficult topics is a necessity.

• Excellent time management skills, ability to juggle multiple demands simultaneously in a fast paced and changing environment.

• Value communication and teamwork

• Align with the mission and values of Compass Health Center

We are committed to a fair and equitable work environment. The expected compensation range for this role is below. This range includes multiple career path levels across the organization; where you fall in the range is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, your years of experience, type of experience, location, and education/certifications. Compass reserves the right to update these ranges.

Compensation

$55,000—$90,000 USD

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

For eligible positions, our other benefits include: comprehensive medical/dental/vision plans, 401k program with company matching, generous PTO (including competitive parental leave after 1 year of employment), and continuous training through CEU seminars and volunteering opportunities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

jobs.title: ASIC Characterization Engineer, Silicon
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on ASIC Bench Characterization Engineer to support high-volume production of millimeter wave RF Digital Beamforming (DBF) and RF front-end ASICs used in customer terminals and satellite payloads.
This is a role centered on bench-level RF characterization, with ATE correlation as a core part of the work. You will own and maintain the debug benches, characterize silicon across voltage, temperature and frequency, and use that data to resolve RMA and production issues that cannot be root-caused on a production tester. You will work closely with Product and Test Engineering, Design engineering, and OSAT partners to protect product quality, shorten RMA closure time, and qualify material and process changes.

Key job responsibilities
Bench Validation & RMA Debug
•	Set up and operate RF test bench equipment including signal generators, spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers (VNA), oscilloscopes, and power meters.
•	Own bench bring-up, instrument calibration schedules and measurement repeatability for the sustaining lab.
•	Perform bench-level RF characterization e.g TX/RX gain, noise figure, EVM, IMRR, etc
•	Correlate ATE measurements against bench data to determine whether an excursion is real silicon, a test program artifact, or a test hardware issue, and support lot hold or release decision.
•	Debug RMA returns and field failures at the bench, providing root cause reports and disposition recommendations
•	Validate ATE vs bench calibrations for QA failure and low yield issues.
•	Support test validation of the HTOL boards.
•	Support debug and qualification of load boards and probe cards, including S-parameter verification of signal paths.

Sustaining & Cross-team Collaboration
•	Support knowledge transfer from NPI teams and own test programs after production transfer
•	Maintain golden unit libraries and boards for production reference
•	Document root cause analysis, test methodologies and drive quality improvements and provide updates to wider teams in the company.
•	Participate in production readiness reviews, MBR updates, and transfer checklists

Basic qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or related field
- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor test engineering (ATE or bench)
- Hands-on experience with RF bench equipment — signal generators, spectrum analyzers, VNAs, power meters
- Familiarity with ATE platforms such as Teradyne UltraFLEX, Advantest, or similar
- Understanding of RF IC fundamentals — mixers, PLLs, amplifiers, filters, beamforming concepts
- Experience with test program debug, limit setting, and GR&R analysis
- Proficiency in Python or similar scripting language for data analysis
- Strong analytical skills with experience using data analysis tools

Preferred qualifications:
- Master's degree or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
- Experience working with cross-functional teams
- Experience with mm Wave or phased array / DBF / RFFE ASIC testing
- Experience with wafer sort and final test at OSAT facilities
- Exposure to RMA debug and failure analysis workflows
- Experience with digital ATE test development such as pattern conversion from DFT to ATE, SERDES testing is a plus

jobs.title: Sr. Aerospace Hardware Reliability Engineer, Prime Air
jobs.description:
Amazon Prime Air is seeking a Senior Hardware Reliability Engineer to define and lead reliability strategy for hardware used in airborne systems. You will develop reliability requirements, test methodologies, and environmental qualification programs while partnering with engineering teams to improve drone hardware reliability throughout the product lifecycle.

Working across drone system development and multiple engineering disciplines, you will lead design-for-reliability activities, verification planning, environmental and accelerated-life testing, and complex failure investigations. You will use test and field data to characterize failure mechanisms, quantify risk, and develop statistical models that predict product lifetime and reliability.

The ideal candidate combines strong cross-functional engineering fundamentals with demonstrated technical leadership. You must be able to communicate complex technical findings clearly, produce high-quality engineering documentation, and influence decisions across design, test, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

See your work take flight and help make history in autonomous aviation. If you are passionate about creating reliable hardware for demanding airborne applications, we want to talk to you.

This position may require a deemed export control license for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Placement is contingent on Amazon’s ability to apply for and obtain an export control license on your behalf.

Key job responsibilities
Own hardware reliability strategy across architecture, qualification, production, and field operations
Define quantitative requirements, success criteria, and validation plans based on mission profiles, environmental conditions, and service life
Lead design-for-reliability activities, including risk assessments, DFMEA, reliability block diagrams, and design reviews
Develop environmental, accelerated-life, and reliability-growth programs for airborne hardware, with test methods and acceptance criteria for temperature, vibration, shock, humidity, and ingress
Architect scalable test frameworks, fixtures, instrumentation, automation, and data systems
Apply Weibull analysis, design of experiments, confidence bounds, and accelerated-life models to quantify risk and predict product lifetime, and analyze qualification, production, and fleet data to prioritize improvements
Lead FRACAS and multidisciplinary root-cause investigations, driving corrective actions with design, systems, test, manufacturing, safety, quality, operations, and supplier teams
Provide data-driven recommendations in design and qualification reviews, maintain traceable hardware configurations and decisions, and serve as the hardware reliability authority across Prime Air, setting reliability standards and supplier controls and mentoring engineers

Basic qualifications:
- 7+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, hardware test and validation, product qualification, or failure analysis.
- Experience developing and executing environmental, accelerated-life, or reliability-growth test plans for complex electromechanical hardware.
- Experience using test instrumentation, data-acquisition systems, and analysis tools to characterize hardware performance and failure mechanisms.
- Experience documenting test methods, results, failure analyses, and technical recommendations

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in component selection and understanding of component reliability

jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how a global consulting organization builds software in an AI-first world? As Senior Consultant, Agentic Delivery Acceleration, you'll be the hands-on builder who turns the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) into the training, tooling, and agents that thousands of AWS Professional Services consultants use on customer engagements. AI-DLC is our methodology for how humans and AI work together to deliver software. It isn't a traditional software development lifecycle (SDLC) with an AI assistant added on. It defines what AI executes, what humans validate and own, and where quality gates sit when agents do most of the building. In this role, you'll write both the playbook and the code that brings it to life.

Key job responsibilities
- Build AI-DLC into the AI coding agents and frameworks used on customer engagements. Contribute steering files, hooks, skills, and prompts that embed AI-DLC phases, quality gates, and human accountability. Build agents that check and improve how well delivery agents follow the methodology, and create tested guidance and guardrails for running AI-DLC in customer environments
- Build modular, role-based AI-DLC training (labs, workshops, and assessments). Run early cohorts, measure what lands, and take it from beta to global rollout, using the same terminology at every level
- Track the capabilities AI-DLC depends on (such as context management, review agents, and security workflows) and how well common delivery tools support each one. Feed field evidence back into how the methodology and its terminology evolve
- Serve as hands-on AI-DLC subject matter expert on selected customer engagements and mentor a growing network of regional champions
- Publish blog posts, customer stories, and open-source contributions, then grow into tech talks, executive briefings, re:Invent sessions, and customer workshops that help establish AWS as a recognized voice in AI-native delivery

A day in the life
You'll split your week between building and teaching. One morning you might tune an agent's steering files after reviewing how it handled a customer engagement. That afternoon you might run a training cohort and gather feedback on what worked. You'll also join selected customer engagements to see the methodology in action, and bring what you learn back into the code and the curriculum.

About the team
Our team is transforming AWS Professional Services into an AI-enabled engine of productivity and value creation. We build for two groups: the thousands of consultants who deliver those engagements, and the customers they serve. Over the next few years, our focus is making AI-native delivery the standard way we work, and AI-DLC is at the heart of it. You'll work directly with the leader who owns the AI-DLC methodology, and your work is how the methodology reaches consultants as code and curriculum.

- 4+ years of software development, or 4+ years of relevant technical position experience

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a highly motivated Regional Chief Engineer (CE) to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports AWS. Specifically, this team works to ensure the safe and secure operation of the data center's Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) infrastructure to provide 99.999% availability for our customers.

The Regional CE is responsible for ensuring that all MEP equipment within the region is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The Regional CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with on-site Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT), CEs, Facility Managers (FM), and third party vendors.

The Regional CE also manages medium-to-large projects and programs from conception to completion. These projects and programs involve large amounts of independent work, as well as, collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The goals of such projects are for the Regional CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will work at the intersection of agentic AI research and production-quality delivery, often in areas where neither the business nor the architectural strategy has been defined, driving clarity where the problem itself is not yet clear. This is a highly visible role: you operate with complete independence, act as a force multiplier across peer teams inside and outside Alexa Shopping, and represent complex decisions and trade-offs to leaders up to three levels above (Directors and VPs). You will operate as an extension of the organization's leadership, anticipating where the org needs to go and building the programs to get it there.

Amazon Stores Agent
-Own and scale the Amazon Stores Agent on Alexa+ enabled Echo Family Devices — launching agentic store actions that let customers complete multi-step tasks across Registries, Payments, Subscribe & Save, Addresses, Orders, and Returns by gathering what's needed through natural conversation and completing the steps on their behalf.
-Drive the program from its first actions to a customer-complete experience, holding a high task-completion bar and standing up the shared foundations — routing, evaluation, and API integration — so customers finish whole tasks hands-free and new actions ship faster over time.

Horizontal Program Leadership
-Define and own a portfolio of very large programs that cut across Alexa Shopping teams and organizations, beginning with the Amazon Stores Agent, decomposing ambiguous, org-level goals into clear workstreams that teams can execute independently.
-Anticipate future needs and stand up new horizontal initiatives before they become blockers, defining the problem, scope, success criteria, and ownership where none exist.

jobs.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, EMR, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs support and risk management.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

• Logical, process-oriented thinker who can create and stick to plans, yet also maintain the flexibility our industry demands within changing procurement circumstances
• Comfortable working with a variety of stakeholders in a mutually respectful environment
• Quick learner who can use their experience to suggest process improvements

jobs.title: Associate Director, CMI - Dove Deodorants, North America
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

Unilever Consumer & Markets Insight (CMI) exists to provide the inspiration, intelligence and provocation that drive transformational growth. This means connecting consumer understanding with market realities and future possibilities to help the business make sharper choices and act with greater confidence.

This role will help accelerate North America Deodorants growth, with Dove as a critical engine of category growth. It will operate ambidextrously across today and tomorrow: combining consumer understanding with commercial and competitive intelligence to drive market share today, while using foresight and innovation to identify and unlock the growth opportunities of tomorrow.

The role will lead CMI for Dove Deodorants in North America, while maintaining a broader category and competitive lens to understand where growth is coming from, how consumer and shopper needs are evolving, and what Dove must do to continue leading and shaping the category.

Key Accountabilities

Business, Category & Competitive Growth

• Build a clear, ongoing view of category performance, market share, competitive activity, pricing, channels and emerging growth drivers, translating these into implications and actions for Dove.
• Develop a strong point of view on where Dove is winning, where it is losing and why, identifying the biggest opportunities to accelerate penetration, premiumization and market share.
• Connect consumer, shopper, category and commercial intelligence to help leadership make faster, sharper business decisions.
• Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Development, Finance and Performance teams to translate intelligence into tangible growth actions and track their impact.

Innovation & Future Growth

• Shape the short- and long-term innovation agenda for Dove Deodorants, balancing a stronger core, near-term growth opportunities and bigger future growth platforms.
• Identify emerging consumer needs, demand spaces, cultural shifts and category disruption that can create new sources of growth for Dove and the broader deodorants category.
• Ensure innovation choices are grounded in consumer desirability as well as incrementality, scalability, competitive advantage and commercial potential.
• Use AI, social intelligence, experimentation and emerging data sources to spot opportunities earlier, accelerate learning and improve innovation decision making.

Consumer, Brand & Market Intelligence

• Build a connected understanding of consumer, culture, category, competition and commerce, turning multiple signals into a clear growth point of view.
• Deepen understanding of Dove consumers while looking beyond Dove to anticipate changing expectations, competitive disruption and opportunities across deodorants and adjacent categories.
• Strengthen consumer and shopper connectivity across the business, building the team’s instinct for what will win with consumers and in the marketplace.
• Bring leading-edge thinking on social culture, content, media, discovery and purchase behaviors to strengthen Dove’s relevance, distinctiveness and competitiveness.

Strategy, Brand Equity & Portfolio

• Lead consumer and market intelligence to shape Dove Deodorants’ short- and long-term strategy in North America.
• Clarify how brand equity, superiority and distinctiveness translate into competitive growth and stronger commercial performance.
• Shape brand architecture and portfolio choices across core and premium tiers, ensuring clear consumer positioning, value differentiation and roles for each part of the portfolio.
• Connect brand-building choices with category growth, penetration, premiumization and market-share outcomes.

Strategic Leadership & Impact

• Act as a strategic partner to North America Deodorants and Dove leadership, bringing an independent CMI point of view to the biggest growth choices.
• Connect performance today with opportunities tomorrow, ensuring future strategies are grounded in current market realities and today’s decisions build toward where the category is heading.
• Influence across Marketing, Customer Development, R&D, CTI, Finance, agencies and the wider Personal Care CMI community to turn intelligence into action.
• Lead and mentor the CMI team, creating clarity, strengthening commercial and consumer judgment, and building a more future-fit capability across consumer insight, market intelligence, performance and foresight.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree required; 12+ years of experience in CMI, consumer research, market intelligence or a related discipline, including experience in the US market.
• Proven track record of turning consumer, shopper, category and commercial intelligence into measurable business action and growth.
• Deep expertise across qualitative, quantitative, primary and syndicated research, spanning brand strategy, equity and positioning, innovation, portfolio, market performance, and digital and media engagement.
• Strong commercial orientation, with the ability to interpret market share, competitive performance, pricing, channel and portfolio dynamics.
• High levels of strategic influencing with leadership and senior stakeholders.
• Strong people leader with experience leading direct and indirect teams.
• Effective storyteller and dot connector who can simplify complexity into clear choices and action.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree or MBA.
• Confidence to advocate for a clear business point of view and adapt quickly as new information emerges.
• Experience shaping both innovation pipelines and in-market performance agendas.
• Continuous learner who embraces fast-paced digital, social, AI and commercial evolution.
• Competitive drive to win in the marketplace, paired with a genuine passion for Dove, consumers and category growth.

Pay: The pay range for this position is $146,200 to $219,400. Unilever takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs.

Bonus: This position is bonus eligible.

Long-Term Incentive (LTI): This position is LTI eligible.

Benefits: Unilever employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance (including prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage), retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays, as well as access to numerous voluntary benefits. Any coverages for health insurance and retirement benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison - Rare Diseases (with Diagnostics responsibilities Oncology/Rare Diseases) - Lebanon
jobs.description:
Transform the future of patient care with AstraZeneca by bridging breakthrough science, diagnostic innovation, and clinical excellence. Join us in a unique combined Medical Science Liaison - Rare Diseases and Diagnostics Science Liaison - Oncology & Rare Diseases role, advancing scientific exchange and diagnostic strategies to help connect patients to the right test and the right treatment at the right time.

ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

Join a high-performing team, empowered to cut through the noise and drive real change. Our agility and pace, coupled with scientific focus, powers us to spot opportunities in the market that keep us moving forward and into new spaces.

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

Job Purpose

Combining Medical Scientific Liaison responsibilities in Rare Diseases and Diagnostics Science Liaison responsibilities across Oncology and Rare Diseases, with a 50/50 split between both roles, this position drives scientific engagement and medical education while advancing diagnostic strategies and testing pathways to support accurate patient identification, informed treatment decisions, and improved patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

MSL

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with Key External Experts (KEEs), healthcare professionals (HCPs), and key stakeholders across the Oncology space.
• Spend approximately 70% of time on field activities, including scientific exchange, stakeholder engagement, and visit preparation.
• Develop and execute strategic KEE engagement plans, ensuring clear objectives, relevant data sharing, and scientific alignment.
• Deliver timely, balanced scientific updates and respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in compliance with regulations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support pre- and post-launch activities, including diagnostics and brand strategy.
• Support local research initiatives, advisory boards, speaker training, and external medical education programs.
• Act as the internal expert on therapeutic area trends, clinical practice insights, and competitive landscape intelligence.
• Provide scientific support for formulary listings, product launches, and AZ-sponsored medical events.
• Continuously enhance expertise through congress attendance, AZ trainings, and the 70-20-10 learning model.
• Ensure full compliance with AstraZeneca and industry code of conduct, SOPs, and ethical standards in all scientific interactions.

DSL

• Develop and implement diagnostic strategies in alignment with global and brand plans.
• Establish testing solutions, identify and partner with qualified laboratories, and ensure diagnostic quality assurance.
• Build strategic relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), diagnostic companies, and healthcare providers to drive testing adoption.
• Provide scientific and diagnostic insights to cross-functional teams and support market readiness for product launches.
• Deliver internal training and external educational initiatives on diagnostics, biomarkers, and testing pathways.
• Monitor diagnostic performance, address gaps, and propose continuous improvement plans.
• Ensure compliance with AstraZeneca policies, local regulations, data privacy, and governance standards.
• Collaborate closely with global, regional, and local teams to share best practices and implement innovative testing solutions.

Essential Criteria:

• Bachelor’s degree in Medicine or Pharmacy.
• Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in Medical Affairs and/or Diagnostics, preferably within a multinational pharmaceutical company.
• Experience within specialty therapeutic areas, such as Oncology, Hematology, Rare Diseases, or Metabolic Diseases.
• Strong scientific acumen, with the ability to understand and communicate complex clinical, scientific, and diagnostic concepts to HCPs and KOLs.
• Proven track record in stakeholder engagement and relationship management with HCPs, KOLs, healthcare institutions, and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Demonstrated capability in project management and cross-functional collaboration.
• Strong presentation, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.
• Excellent communication skills in Arabic and English.
• Flexibility and willingness to travel as business needs require.
• Experience working directly with a brand-owning pharmaceutical company or, where experience has been through a distributor, clear evidence of close collaboration with the parent/principal company.

Preferred Criteria:

• Postgraduate qualification such as an MSc, PhD, or other relevant advanced scientific/medical degree.
• Experience in account management and/or managing complex healthcare accounts.
• Exposure to diagnostic pathways, biomarker testing, patient identification, or broader testing ecosystems within specialty care,

Please note that this position is based in Lebanon and is not open for relocation; only apply if you are located in or can easily access this location.

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. SUMMARY
Directs the activities of the Machine Support group.  Responsible for maintaining production schedules and ensuring that quality standards are adhered to by the group.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following.  Other duties may be assigned.

LEADERSHIP AND MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment and Retention:
·         Recruit, interview and hire Process Engineers, Industrial Techs, WAVE Techs, and Machine Support Techs
·         Communicate criteria to recruiters for Process Engineers, Industrial Techs, WAVE Techs, and Machine Support Techs candidates.
·         Coach machine support department staff in the interviewing/hiring process.
·         Monitor team member turnover; identify key factors that can be improved; make improvements.

Employee and Team Development:
·         Identify individual and team strengths and development needs on an ongoing basis.
·         Create and/or validate training curriculum in area of responsibility.
·         Coach and mentor tooling department staff to deliver excellence to every internal and external customer.
·         Create and manage succession plans for the machine shop function.

Performance Management:
·         Establish clear measurable goals and objectives by which to determine individual and team results (i.e. operational metrics, results against project timelines, training documentation, attendance records, knowledge of operational roles and responsibilities, personal development goals).
·         Solicit ongoing feedback from Workcell Manager (WCM), Business Unit Manager (BUM), peers and team member on the PE team member’s contribution to the workcell.  Provide ongoing coaching and counseling to team member based on feedback.
·         Express pride in staff and encourage them to feel good about their accomplishments.
·         Perform team member evaluations professionally and on time.
·         Drive individuals and the team to continuously improve in key operational metrics and the achievement of the organizational goals.
·         Coordinate activities of large teams and keep them focused in times of crises.
·         Ensure recognition and rewards are managed fairly and consistently in area of responsibility.

Communication:
·         Provide communication forum for the exchange of ideas and information with the department.
·         Organize verbal and written ideas clearly and use an appropriate business style.
·         Ask questions; encourage input from team members.
·         Assess communication style of individual team members and adapt own communication style accordingly.

TECHNICAL MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES

·         Oversees the maintenance management program including repair parts, preventative maintenance, feeder maintenance, and the support equipment maintenance program
·         Plans the activities of the technical staff
·         Develops and maintains all department reports/records
·         Supervises the planning and execution of line moves and builds
·         Schedules equipment vendors for installation, repair and updates of equipment
·         Assure that procedures and work instructions are efficient and not redundant.
·         Offer new ideas and suggestions for improvement.  Identify and implement new practices and processes that are “best in field.”
·         Demonstrate a commitment to customer service; anticipate, meet, and exceed expectations by solving problems quickly and effectively; making customer issues a priority.
·         Lead by example; “walk the talk.”
·         Utilize Jabil’s Advanced Engineering group to ensure useful support to Jabil South.
·         Establish new measurement systems if/where possible.
·         Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
Comply with all procedures within the company security policy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferred; and three years experience in maintenance management; or equivalent combination of education and experience.  Hands-on experience and knowledge of Surface Mount Technologies (SMT) and Thru-hole equipment/gear, process optimization, Statistical Process Control, Design for Manufacturability, Design for Test, Demand Flow Technology (line balancing), and Design of Experiment methodologies.  Knowledge of engineering disciplines including chemistry, mechanical, electrical, and industrial as it pertains to surface mount and final assembly.
