If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

jobs.title: Workplace Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Workplace Program Manager owns the strategy and day-to-day operations of Render’s San Francisco office: the space, the vendors, the supplies, and the daily needs of everyone who walks in. This role is the on-site face of Workplace, working in the office three to five days a week to keep the office safe, stocked, and welcoming for employees, new hires, and guests. 

This role sits on the People Operations team and partners closely with the Employee Experience Program Manager, who leads company culture, team onsites, and major events. As Render grows and prepares for an office move, you’ll work with People leadership, Finance, and an outside real estate advisor to make the move run smoothly. Following the move, you’ll lead workplace projects and programs to support the rapidly scaling business. This is a role for someone highly experienced in facilities and workplace management who knows how details, big and small, can have a significant impact.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO


OFFICE OPERATIONS AND FACILITIES

 - Run the day-to-day operations of the office, including greeting guests and deliveries, keeping common areas, meeting rooms, phone booths, and the all-hands space clean and ready for use, and responding quickly to employee requests.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for building management and the landlord. Submit and follow up on maintenance tickets, coordinate repairs and building maintenance, and inform employees of disruptions.

 - Manage vendors for cleaning, plant service, snacks and beverages, meals, supplies, and furniture. Track contracts, renewals, and service levels.

 - Order and stock office supplies, snacks, and beverages, and use employee requests and feedback to improve the mix over time.

 - Manage mail, shipping, and receiving, including certified mail and packages, and keep an organized inventory of swag and event materials.

 - Administer office access, including assigning and deactivating key fobs and badges, and keep desk and seating assignments accurate as the team and the number of shared desks grow and change.

 - Maintain basic safety and security practices, including emergency information, first-aid supplies, and visitor access, in coordination with IT and Security.

 - In partnership with People Operations, prepare for new hires’ first day by arranging their fob, desk, and workspace, greeting them on arrival, and giving them an office tour.

 - Track, manage, and report out on workplace budgets. Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives while maintaining a high-quality work environment.


OFFICE PROJECTS AND OFFICE MOVE

 - Project-manage the upcoming office move, including logistics and project coordination, in close partnership with an external real estate advisor. Work with People leadership and an external real estate advisor on mover and vendor coordination, space-planning input, furniture and decor, and employee communications. Seek, secure, and track Leadership decisions necessary to complete the project.

 - Manage office improvement projects from request through installation, such as furniture, soundproofing, signage, and desk nameplates, and coordinate the contractors involved.

 - Lead project management and share regular updates with leadership and stakeholders.

 - Gather employee feedback on the space and recommend practical upgrades.

 - Be the first point of contact for office questions and requests, and keep workplace documentation clear and up to date.


EVENT AND CULTURE SUPPORT

 - Support the Employee Experience Manager with the logistics of office events such as happy hours, celebrations, and all hands, including room setup and teardown, supplies, and day-of support.

 - Help host team onsites in the San Francisco office by managing space reservations, room setup, and capacity. Ensure remote employees’ experience in the office is supported by arranging desk space, guest access, and office tours, and by developing resources to help orient first-time visitors.

 - Bring ideas for thoughtful touches that make the office feel welcoming to employees and guests.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5-7 years of experience in workplace, office, or facilities management, or a related operations role, ideally in a technology or start-up environment.

 - Hands-on experience managing office operations and vendor relationships, including building management, cleaning, food and beverage, and supplies.

 - Has worked in a hybrid work environment, and understands the needs of in-office and remote employees.

 - Experience supporting employee experience programs or events.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage many small requests and several projects at once without losing detail.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a service-oriented, proactive approach.

 - Comfort working with budgets, purchasing, expense tools, and project management.

 - Good judgment and discretion with confidential or sensitive information.

 - Able and excited to work on-site in the San Francisco office three days per week. Availability to occasionally flex up to 5 days a week in the office and attend office events outside regular hours.

 - Able to lift and move boxes and supplies up to 50 lbs and to set up and break down event spaces.

 - Experienced to advanced fluency in Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, and Zoom.

 - Strongly Preferred: experience with an office move or build-out, or experience with rapid-scaling startups.

If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need.




BENEFITS

 - 4 weeks of paid vacation.

 - 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return.

 - Long-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans.

 - 100% employer-paid medical coverage and 99% employer-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well.

 - Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc.

 - Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy.

 - Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders.

 - Continuous learning benefits & related support.

This position is generally not eligible for new visa sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.

We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer, DFM
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

We are in search of a Manufacturing Engineer to join our Go-to-Market team, interpreting customer designs, providing DFM feedback, and working with sales and operations to turn requirements into manufacturable solutions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design for Manufacturability: Perform DFM analyses using Hadrian's internal software tools to determine compatibility with Hadrian's factories and make recommendations to the customer for cost and quality optimization.

 - Cost Analysis: Utilize part technical information to generate costing models and develop customer-facing proposals.

 - Internal Tool Development: Partner with stakeholders to strategize, plan, and implement software and manufacturing solutions, acting as the internal customer to ensure tools meet real production needs.

 - Marketplace: Gather and analyze industry data to help steer Hadrian’s automation technology and manufacturing market decisions.

 - Monitor factory performance to help optimize Hadrian’s software, ensuring quality standards, process integrity, and alignment with customer requirements.

 - Apply strong knowledge of materials, finishes, and manufacturing terminology to evaluate designs and ensure accurate, high-quality production outcomes.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related STEM field; in lieu of a degree, 4+ years of manufacturing experience in a high-intensity production environment will be considered

 - 3-5+ years of experience in a manufacturing role, with a strong preference for candidates who have led impactful projects

 - Proficiency in GD&T and demonstrated ability to interpret technical drawings

 - Proficiency with CAD tools and the ability to translate designs into manufacturable solutions

 - Experience developing and implementing production processes and systems in high-growth or fast-paced environments




WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience with basic software programming (SQL, MATLAB, Python)

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing tools such as CNC machines, sheet metal brakes, or lathes

 - Personal or project portfolio demonstrating applied manufacturing skills, or active involvement in manufacturing-related clubs or extracurriculars




COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $85,000 - $115,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

At New Relic, we believe in a virtuous cycle where customer success fuels improved revenue performance. Our Account Manager role is a pivotal function of an updated pod structure that sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Product. Focused squarely on securing and growing our existing revenue base. We are a passionate, upbeat, and highly motivated group committed to exceptional customer loyalty, support, and expansion.

We are seeking an Account Manager to join our team and make a positive impact in the continued success and growth of our organization. In this critical role, you will be a driver of retention, adoption, and expansion. Strong leadership ensures positive relationships and alignment across Product, Marketing, and Sales, and Support. If you are passionate about building deep, strategic customer relationships and thrive in a quota-carrying environment, let's talk!

What you'll do

You will utilize your skills in customer success, renewals, and sales methodologies to exceed customer expectations and deliver value across multiple key performance indicators.

Drive Revenue & Retention

• Pod Collaboration: In partnership with the Account Team, you will function as a secondary seller within a unified pod structure. This role is essential in supporting the Account Executive (Core Seller) through seamless cross-functional alignment and collaborative deal execution. You will review areas of opportunity (whitespace analysis), organize and manage enablement sessions with Technical Success Managers, and in partnership with the Solutions Consultants, help drive new growth opportunities for Account Executives.

• Secure & Negotiate Renewals: Build positive relationships with customers including economic buyers, decision-makers, champions and end-users, negotiating contracts for direct and partner managed agreements.

• Mitigate Churn: Proactively identify accounts running "cold" and/or at risk (downgrades, churn, low BCM Burn Rate) and develop strategic plans to mitigate uncertainty, drive customer satisfaction, increase consumption, and maintain high renewal rates.

• Deliver Expansion: Grow revenue at renewal time and throughout the customer lifecycle. Increase Billable Consumption Metric (BCM) for current subscription customers and convert Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG) customers through sub-account prospecting and finding new upsell opportunities.

Cultivate Customer Success & Adoption

• Improve Customer Relationships: Collaborate with Account Executives on accounts at key moments in the customer journey, becoming their voice within New Relic. Coordinate Customer Business Reviews Contribute to Account Plans Complete the Renewal Process & Discussions

• Increase Adoption: Support customer Onboarding and strengthen product knowledge through: Account Health Checks Business Value Assessments Enablement Sessions

• Advocate & Resolve: Collaborate with departments (Sales, Operations, Customer Solutions, Legal, and Collections) to resolve customer issues and advocate on their behalf.

Strategic Execution & Data Analysis

• Value Articulation: Effectively communicate company messages and our value proposition, both verbally and in writing.

• Data-Driven Strategy: Use strong analytical skills and experience working with data to professionally advise strategy, identify industry trends, and inform economic buyers and decision-makers.

• Operational Excellence: Maintain an accurate customer master record, including buying programs, contract renewal dates, customer contact information, and sentiment. Ensure proper Salesforce hygiene with thorough, accurate, and up to date information for all your accounts, opportunities, and contacts.

This role requires

• 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying role, managing renewals, or customer success role, closing large complex time-sensitive software contracts, preferably within the SaaS industry.

• Proven ability to build deep, strategic relationships with customer contacts at all levels of technical and non-technical depth, including senior leadership and C-Level Executives.

• Experience in building, analyzing, and interpreting datasets to accurately manage a pipeline for success.

• A track record of identifying key customer goals and steering value-based discussions that lead to growth and expansion.

• Excellent professional written and verbal communication skills that actively demonstrates true relationship-building, and the ability to work collaboratively with all internal and external points of contact effectively.

• Experience in mastering time management that yields retaining loyal customers and successfully renewing contracts early and on time.

• Experience using and learning new software (e.g., G Suite, Salesforce, Salesloft) MS Excel and PowerPoint presentations.

Bonus points if you have

• Thorough background in Observability, Application Performance Monitoring, and/or DevOps.

• Experience with Consumption-based Selling and Platforms.

• Experience with multiple defined Sales Methodologies including, Challenger Sale, Command of the Message, and MEDDPICC.

• Contributed to building a scaled Customer Success function.

• Project Management Experience (e.g., PMP, CSM, or CSPO, certifications).

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Control Plane & Regulatory and Sovereign Cloud
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager in the area of Control Plane and/or RSC (Regulatory and Sovereign Cloud).  Control Plane is the production platform layer that creates and manages the infrastructure Snowflake runs on, converting intent into continuously managed, reliable infrastructure across cloud providers and regions. RSC extends that foundation to regulated and sovereign environments, including US government, air-gapped regions, and sovereign deployments worldwide. Together, these teams play a critical role in making Snowflake available to new customers, clouds, and regulatory environments. This role will own one of these two areas, or both, depending on your background and the teams’ needs.



AS A SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

• Set the technical strategy and roadmap for your team, and be accountable for team plans and deliverables.

• Advance AI-driven automation and software development across deployments, operations, and compliance workflows to improve consistency, scalability, and efficiency.

• Own key delivery aspects of bringing up new commercial, regulated and sovereign deployments, and partner with product and other engineering teams to bring feature parity to existing and these environments.

• Partner with Compliance, Legal, Security, and IT on authorizations and access models for restricted environments.

• Recruit, develop, and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, while remaining technically engaged in end to end delivery aspects.



OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

• 12+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure, or cloud services.

• 5-7 years of engineering management experience.

• Significant cloud experience in one or more CSPs such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle Cloud or others including experience in IaC tools and infrastructure automation

• Experience operating highly available SaaS platforms, including release and configuration management and multi-region rollout

• Experience delivering in regulated or sovereign environments is a plus.

• A track record of leading cross-organizational programs with many dependencies and tight timelines.

• Strong hands-on technical ability, including diving deep into system design and implementation, and a working understanding of AI-assisted software development.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and regulatory topics to executive audiences.

• BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.



WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

• Build and secure the foundational infrastructure that the Snowflake AI Data Cloud runs on, for some of the most regulated customers in the world.

• Lead and grow a team of industry veterans and rising stars, in a role that will push you to grow both technically and as a leader.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

About Sensei

Founded by Dr. David Agus and Larry Ellison, our ecosystem of products and experiences is designed with one intention: to empower you to grow well and lead the world toward greater wellbeing.

Based on Dr. Agus’ philosophy, Sensei believes we can guide our guests to greater wellbeing by offering experiential movement, rest and nourishment classes and programs. The launch of the Retreats wellness brand took place on Lana’i, Hawaii in partnership with Four Season’s lodging and food offerings by Nobu.  In this location, Sensei Porcupine Creek, Sensei is operating the lodging operation, as well as world-class golf, tennis, spa, fitness, movement, nutrition, meditative, enrichment and body assessment facilities. In addition, Sensei will run the F&B operation, as part of a licensing agreement with Nobu. Sensei programs and continuing learning sessions are high-touch, evidence-led and supported by the latest technology.  You can read our story here.

Position Description

Exercise Physiologist will work in conjunction with nutritionists, mindfulness coaches, spa and wellness practitioners in a luxury resort setting, while leveraging evidenced-based content and technology, deliver the best practices in exercise physiology.  At Sensei, we balance purpose with play. Guests enjoy health coaching, 1:1 nutrition, fitness, meditation and mindset sessions, body treatments, educational lectures and a variety of outdoor activities – all designed to expand awareness and connection. The Sensei guide leverages data, self-awareness, self-efficacy and safety to deliver our guest experience through guided sessions with our guests. Combining spaces and environments to imbue feelings of safety and ease; domain expertise to interpret objective data and craft a personalized wellness plan; and health coaching to communicate this information in an empowering, affirming manner. Sensei has designed the guide program to support our guest in achieving greater wellbeing.

• Proficiency in multiple movement modalities and disciplines

• Experience with various populations and ability levels

• Experience working in a lab utilizing: VO2 max, FMS, gate analysis, force plates, and other assessments

• Passion to empower individuals seeking to optimize health and lifestyle

• Passion for continuing education, professional development and personal growth

• Works well with people and possesses a friendly and outgoing personality

jobs.title: Construction Quality Director – Building Enclosure
jobs.description:
Help deliver one of the most ambitious stadium projects in professional sports.

AECOM Hunt is seeking an experienced Construction Quality Director with deep expertise in building enclosure, building science, and construction quality to support the construction of the new Huntington Bank Field, the future home of the Cleveland Browns.

As part of the AECOM Hunt construction management team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to a landmark NFL stadium featuring a unique enclosed roof, complex exterior facade systems, and highly coordinated construction across multiple disciplines.

This position is ideal for a senior building-envelope professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, identifying construction risks before they become costly problems, and working alongside contractors, designers, and project leaders to ensure exceptional building performance.

We welcome professionals from building-envelope consulting, enclosure commissioning, architecture, construction management, and specialized construction QA/QC backgrounds. Prior stadium experience is valuable but not required.

This is a full-time, onsite position with relocation assistance available for qualified candidates.

What You'll Do

• Lead building enclosure quality initiatives across roofing, waterproofing, curtain walls, glazing, facades, air/vapor barriers, sealants, and other exterior envelope systems.
• Provide technical leadership through constructability reviews, submittals, shop drawings, material evaluations, mockups, and pre-installation planning.
• Identify potential design, material, sequencing, and installation issues early, partnering with project teams to implement practical solutions.
• Conduct field observations, inspections, and quality assessments to verify proper installation and construction performance.
• Collaborate with architects, engineers, specialty consultants, and trade contractors to resolve enclosure-related technical challenges.
• Support enclosure performance testing, investigation of deficiencies, corrective actions, and validation of completed work.
• Develop project-specific quality procedures, technical guidance, and training to strengthen quality across the construction team.
• Partner with AECOM Hunt leadership to improve quality practices, incorporate lessons learned, and support successful project delivery.

About Construction Management – AECOM Hunt

Founded in 1944 in Indianapolis, Indiana, AECOM Hunt has been building for over 70 years. AECOM Hunt’s storied history has encompassed many notable projects in the automotive industry; iconic sports stadiums; a broad portfolio in transportation; and many repeat clients in the hospitality industry. From iconic stadiums and arenas, next-gen transportation hubs and sustainable healthcare and academic buildings, AECOM Hunt’s expertise, leadership and dedication are unparalleled.

Minimum Requirements:

• BS Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related curriculum and 10 years of professional Construction Quality Management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership.
• Valid Driver’s License to operate an AECOM provided motor vehicle on construction project site(s) to support project tasks assignments and scope of work.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Strong technical knowledge of building enclosure and building envelope systems, including roofing, waterproofing, curtain walls, glazing, facades, air/vapor barriers, windows, and sealants.
• Experience with building enclosure consulting, building science, Building Enclosure Commissioning (BECx), or specialized construction quality management.
• Experience supporting large-scale, ground-up vertical construction projects, including sports stadiums, arenas, airports, healthcare facilities, high-rise buildings, or other complex commercial developments.
• Demonstrated experience conducting constructability reviews, reviewing submittals and shop drawings, participating in pre-installation meetings, and performing field inspections of building enclosure systems.
• Knowledge of ASTM and AAMA standards, building codes, construction testing procedures, and building envelope performance requirements.
• Experience identifying and resolving building enclosure deficiencies, including water intrusion, air leakage, installation defects, and material performance issues.
• Experience collaborating with architects, engineers, general contractors, specialty consultants, and trade contractors to resolve technical challenges and improve construction quality.
• Experience developing and implementing project-specific quality plans, conducting quality training, and driving continuous improvement across construction teams.
• Professional certifications, licenses, or industry involvement related to building enclosure, building science, construction quality, or enclosure commissioning, including IIBEC credentials or relevant professional licensure.

Physical Demands:

• The following physical demands represent those typically required of individuals working in construction field roles, with or without accommodation. Construction field positions require physical stamina and mobility, including the ability to climb ladders and stairs, use personnel hoists, and move through various terrain and active construction zones. Vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Team members must be capable of using their hands to handle tools and materials, and perform activities such as sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling. Lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted may be necessary on an occasional basis.

Work Environment:

• Individuals in construction field roles work primarily on active job sites where exposure to environmental and job-related hazards is common, with or without accommodation. These environments may include proximity to heavy machinery, elevated work areas, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and potential electrical risks. Noise levels may vary from moderate to high depending on the phase of construction. Employees may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and must remain alert to ensure safety. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on the scope and progress of the project.

• This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization now or in the future.
• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
• This position is not hybrid nor remote.
• This position may include relocation.
• Some travel is required for this position.
• For positions with driving responsibilities, Motor Vehicle Records are reviewed as part of AECOM’s background check process to ensure compliance with the Company’s driving standards.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Electromechanical Engineer, Anduril Expeditionary Systems - Costa Mesa, CA
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

*As the title implies, this role is based in our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA.  Please apply only if you are already living near there, or are open to a paid relocation to Orange County, CA.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Connected Warfare is the team at Anduril dedicated to the modernization of the command and control systems of U.S. and Allied forces.  New technologies and new adversaries demand a new approach to battlefield intelligence, and you will be the driving force behind the integration of cutting-edge edge compute and communications technologies that make that approach a reality.  Within Connected Warfare, the Anduril Expeditionary Systems (AES) team builds large form factor products that ensure our soldiers on the front lines have access to these computing and communications capabilities that they need to succeed and survive in any environment.  If this sounds exciting to work towards, we invite you to read further!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Senior Electromechanical Engineer within AES, you will play a critical, hands-on role in bringing our advanced defense products to life, demonstrating significant ownership and technical leadership. Your responsibilities will include:

• Lead System Integration: Drive the comprehensive integration of power, control, and harnessing subsystems into robust, finished products, ensuring seamless functionality and reliability.

• Robust Hardware Design: Design and develop critical mechanical hardware components, including durable enclosures, innovative electronics packaging solutions, efficient bus bars, and complex cable assemblies built to survive extreme conditions.

• Harnessing Expertise: Deliver conceptual and detailed harness routing schemes, define optimal mounting strategies, and implement best practices for reliable and maintainable electrical interconnects.

• Cross-functional Technical Partnership: Collaborate closely with electrical, software, and mechanical engineers to implement, rigorously test, and validate complex electromechanical systems throughout their lifecycle.

• Collaborative Innovation: Contribute actively within a dynamic, high-performing product development team, fostering an environment of rapid iteration and technical excellence.

• Direct Mission Impact: Travel to field exercises and work directly alongside warfighters, providing critical product support and gathering invaluable feedback for continuous improvement.

• Full Product Lifecycle Ownership: Iterate on your designs from concept to production, partnering with our manufacturing team to ensure efficient documentation, build processes, and successful delivery at scale.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of professional engineering experience specifically in electromechanical integration, hardware design, or systems engineering within a relevant industry (e.g., defense, aerospace, automotive, robotics).

• Demonstrated expertise and a proven track record in successfully integrating electrical components into rugged mechanical assemblies, with examples of past designs.

• Extensive experience with cabling design, wiring harness integration, and managing electromechanical interfaces for products designed for extreme or military-grade use cases.

• High competence with, and fluid application of, engineering first principles across disciplines, including but not limited to: thermal management, structural integrity, material science, power distribution, and signal integrity.

• Proficiency with CAD software and the ability to produce high-quality, manufacturing-ready engineering drawings that adhere to industry standards.

• BS, M.Eng, MS or PhD in an engineering field (e.g., Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics)

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

• Excitement to work onsite at our headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA!

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Deep familiarity with common electrical interfaces and communication protocols (e.g., USB, CAN, Ethernet, RS-485/232, SPI, I2C).

• Strong understanding and practical experience with EMI shielding, EMC best practices, and robust signal integrity design.

• Competency with 3D CAD harness routing tools (e.g., NX Electrical Routing, SolidWorks Electrical, CATIA Electrical).

• Advanced understanding of enclosure design, material selection, and manufacturing processes for various environmental protection levels.

• Hands-on prototyping experience including machining, shop tools, welding, soldering, and board assembly.

• Experience with power systems, battery management systems, PCBA design, controls, robotics, and/or motor/servo drive systems.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE:

• Direct & Meaningful Impact: Your engineering prowess will directly contribute to protecting those who serve, working on projects with critical national importance.

• Cutting-Edge Challenges: Engage with complex, first-of-their-kind engineering problems that push the boundaries of current technology.

• High Autonomy & Ownership: Take significant ownership of projects and systems, with the freedom to innovate and see your designs through from concept to deployment.

• Collaborative & Expert Team: Work alongside a highly skilled and passionate group of engineers, fostering a culture of mentorship, knowledge sharing, and mutual support.

• Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning, advanced professional development, and a clear career path within a dynamic and expanding company.

US Salary Range

$151,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Release Engineering
jobs.location: Hybrid- Any Office (Fremont, CA, Salem, OR, or Pittsburgh, PA)
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About The Role

Join the team building a modern Software Delivery System focused on secure, high throughput software delivery at scale — powering enterprise-grade, next-generation industrial humanoid robotics.

Every Digit we build, and every update that reaches production, passes through systems Infrastructure Release Engineering owns: the Bazel build system and CI runner platform our developers work in, the test platforms that gate every hardware and software release, the manufacturing software our production line runs on, and the release machine that delivers software over the air to a growing fleet.

We are hiring across this domain at multiple levels and in multiple locations. The software development organization is growing fast, and the platform has to scale with it — handling thousands of pull requests a day — keeping factory software in lockstep with what runs in the field. What we plan to build is orders of magnitude greater than what already exists — you get to shape critical systems in this unique product line.

This role sits at the intersection of:

• Build and CI platform engineering at organizational scale

• Test platforms that run component- and whole-robot-scale testing, serving as the enforcement point for hardware and software release gates

• Manufacturing and fleet software delivery — provisioning through over-the-air update

Key Responsibilities

The list below spans every track and level we are hiring for — specific ownership depends on your background and primary location.

• Test Infrastructure & CI Reliability: Build and own the platforms that run testing at component and whole-robot scale — runner capacity, test compute, hardware-in-the-loop benches, and flaky-test reliability — enforcing hardware and software release gates, not just software CI.

• Manufacturing & Line Software: Keep manufacturing and validation software in versioned parity with production robot software, own the test infrastructure it runs on, and automate the workflows and monitoring that keep on-call light as the line scales.

• Release & Fleet Delivery: Run provisioning and over-the-air update as one continuous, auditable pipeline — staged rollout, signed provenance, auto-rollback — and carry release and fleet on-call.

• Collaboration & Standardization: Drive adoption of build, test, and release standards across engineering teams, and work directly with robot software, firmware, manufacturing, test, security, and cloud teams to create clarity where ownership is ambiguous.

What We're Aiming For

• A CI platform that absorbs organizational growth without capacity firefighting — handling thousands of pull requests a day, core loop under 10 minutes, full pipeline under 20 minutes.

• A trustworthy signal — test flakes quarantined with owners and expiry dates, main branch kept green against a published SLO.

• Manufacturing software in parity with production, and provisioning/OTA managed as one auditable pipeline with signed provenance end to end.

Required Qualifications

• Professional software or infrastructure engineering experience with demonstrated ownership at your level — 2+ years for mid-level scope, 5+ years for senior scope.

• Strong proficiency in Python and real fluency on Linux systems.

• Hands-on ownership of infrastructure other engineers depend on: CI, build, test, release, or manufacturing and lab tooling.

• Hands-on experience with physical, on-prem infrastructure — manufacturing line stations, lab benches, or similar hardware you can walk up to — not purely cloud or remote-only tooling.

• Demonstrated experience turning ad-hoc scripts or manual processes into versioned, tested, maintainable systems.

• Debugging instincts and communication that hold up across functional teams — engineering, manufacturing, and test.

• Authorization to work in the USA.

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with Bazel or a comparable build system, remote execution/caching (EngFlow or equivalent), and test-impact selection.

• Robotics, embedded, or hardware-in-the-loop experience, including cross-platform targets (ARM, Jetson, Linux BSPs, firmware).

• Experience in manufacturing or lab environments: test benches, end-of-line test, MES or traceability databases, device provisioning, PKI, or secure/measured boot.

• Experience with Kubernetes, Datadog, Artifactory, and GitHub Actions at production scale.

Locations

• Fremont, CA — Hybrid. Integration testing, close to the robot hardware.

• Salem, OR — Hybrid. Manufacturing, at our validation line.

• Pittsburgh, PA — Hybrid. Integration testing, close to the robot hardware.

All openings on this posting are hybrid, based at one of these three offices — there is no fully remote option. Please specify your location preference, and we will work out the best fit for your background during the hiring-manager screen.

Why This Role?

• Build the foundation: Every line of code shipped to Digit flows through the systems you own. You'll close the scale gap before the load arrives.

• Zero-to-one + scale: You arrive before the patterns calcify.

• Define the standards: Your decisions become the defaults the organization operates on.

• High-trust culture: Collaborate directly with robotics, firmware, security, manufacturing, and cloud engineering teams across a distributed Infrastructure org.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to: market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This range may change based on geographical location and may be modified in the future.

Anticipated Salary Range

$175,000—$274,000 USD

In addition to base pay, our competitive total rewards package consists of the following for full-time employees:

• 401(k) Plan: Includes a 6% company match.

• Equity: Company stock options.

• Insurance Coverage: 100% company-paid medical, dental, vision, and short/long-term disability insurance for employees.

• Benefit Start Date: Eligible for benefits on your first day of employment.

• Well-Being Support: Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Time Off: Exempt Employees: Flexible, unlimited PTO and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown. Non-Exempt Employees: 10 vacation days, paid sick leave, and 12 company holidays, including a winter shutdown, annually.

• On-Site Perks: Catered lunches four times a week and a variety of healthy snacks and refreshments at our Salem and Pittsburgh locations.

• Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave programs.

• Work Environment: A culture that supports flexible work arrangements.

• Growth Opportunities: Professional development and tuition reimbursement programs.

• Relocation Assistance: Provided for eligible roles.

• Annual Discretionary Bonus: Provided for eligible roles.

All of our roles are U.S.-based. Applicants must have current authorization to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Group Therapist, Eating Disorders
jobs.description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

At the core of Compass, we believe in the power of community and connection, which is why we are committed to our group-based programming. As a Group Therapist in the Over-18 Eating Disorders Program, you’ll spend the majority of your time with our patient facilitating evidence-based groups and providing secondary support for meals and snacks. You’ll deliver a structured curriculum built on CBT-E, exposure therapy, DBT, and ACT, and you’ll partner closely with the entirety of our treatment teams, including Registered Dietitians, Primary Therapists, Family Therapists, and Psychiatry Team Members to ensure comprehensive and compassionate care.

The staff in this role will be on-site Monday through Friday at our Northbrook location 8am to 4pm supporting the Eating Disorder PHP/IOP, as well as other adult programs based on census needs.

Our location in Northbrook is our first and largest facility, and consists not only of our widest variety of programs, but also serves as a pilot site for many of our new treatment offerings.

What You'll Do:

Group Facilitation

• Facilitate evidence-based groups across the program curriculum, including CBT-E, exposure therapy, DBT and MED-DBT, ACT, and general CBT content

• Deliver curriculum content with fidelity to program design, adjusting intervention selection, pacing, and examples to fit group composition, acuity, and co-occurring presentations

• Recognize how co-occurring OCD, trauma, and mood presentations show up in group and during eating blocks and select interventions accordingly

• Draw on ERP, DBT, ACT, and behavioral activation as indicated when co-occurring symptoms surface in the groups

• Develop therapeutic group relationships that promote positive change in patients

Eating Support

• Provide therapeutic support during supported meals and snacks, including direct observation, coaching, and post-meal support

• Identify and respond to eating disorder behaviors, rituals, and accommodation-seeking

• Support patients in distress during and after eating blocks using skills consistent with the program’s treatment model

Team Communication

• Relay clinical observations from groups and eating blocks to the treatment team during daily rounds and as needed

• Contribute group-based observations to overall case formulation

• Document group participation and clinical observations in the electronic medical record

Program Operations

• Participate in required program training, fidelity monitoring, supervision, and consultation

• Provide feedback on curriculum content and delivery through program leadership

• Other duties, as assigned

Who You Are:

Credentials and Experience

• Psychologist or master’s level therapist (required)

• Hold, or be eligible to obtain, a master's level provisional or independent clinical license in the state of Illinois

• 1+ year of post-Master's clinical experience, or a relevant Master's level internship

• Experience treating eating disorders (strongly preferred)

• Experience treating OCD, anxiety, PTSD, and/or depression (preferred)

• Have experience in a PHP, IOP, residential, or inpatient setting (preferred)

• Experience with patients in crisis, and a strong passion for working within high acuity environments

Skills and Approach (preferred)

• Passionate about facilitating group therapy and seeking an environment to work collaboratively with others

• Possess a core skill set in CBT and DBT

• Working knowledge of conceptualization of eating disorder treatment and co-occurring conditions

• Ability to deliver interventions that reliably address maintaining mechanisms of disorders, and ability to tolerate patient distress without accommodating or reassuring

• Practices from weight-inclusive framework

• Adopts “all foods fit” approach towards clinical nutrition

• Works within defined curriculum and fidelity expectations rather than an idiosyncratic model

• Seeks and uses supervision and consultation

We are committed to a fair and equitable work environment. The expected compensation range for this role is below. This range includes multiple career path levels across the organization; where you fall in the range is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, your years of experience, type of experience, location, and education/certifications. Compass reserves the right to update these ranges.

Compensation

$47,000—$65,000 USD

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

For eligible positions, our other benefits include: comprehensive medical/dental/vision plans, 401k program with company matching, generous PTO (including competitive parental leave after 1 year of employment), and continuous training through CEU seminars and volunteering opportunities.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Velora:

📍check out our company website: joinvelora.com

Our product websites:

• keela.co

• raisely.com

• aplos.com

We’re excited to share that Aplos, Raisely, and Keela have come together to form one unified company, Velora, with a shared mission: to help nonprofit organizations thrive. While we continue to offer the products you know and love, we now operate as one team, dedicated to making nonprofit work easier, more impactful, and more sustainable.

Together, our combined expertise spans fundraising, donor management, financial tracking, and communications—offering a powerful suite of tools designed to reduce complexity so nonprofits can focus on what matters most: making a difference.

We’re one company with 3 products all servicing customers in the impact space. Working at Velora means that you have the opportunity to build one or across all our products.

We have a combination of merged teams and also teams dedicated to one specific product and you can find details about the work through our job descriptions under the “about the role” section.

About the Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer to help build Velora's AI-native software platform, giving nonprofit teams more time for their mission and less time spent on administration. You'll join the team that builds the CRM, data and integrations at the core of the platform, supporting donor management, communications, automation and reporting as a mature product moves into newer services.

This is a full-stack role where you'll own well-scoped features end to end, from a Product prototype through build, release and verification in production. You'll work across frontend, backend, infrastructure and data, own the testing and quality of your own work, and keep an eye on what you ship after it goes live. You'll grow your design and scoping skills with guidance from senior engineers and partner closely with Product along the way.

AI is central to how we work. You'll direct coding agents on your own features, review every output critically and stay accountable for what ships. You'll also take part in code reviews, giving thoughtful feedback and using what you learn to raise the quality of your own work.

What will you be doing?

• Own well-scoped features end to end, from a PM's prototype through build and release, engaging Product early and growing with guidance on scope and trade-offs.

• Work across the full stack—frontend, backend, infrastructure and data—on your own features, rather than a single layer.

• Work AI-native by default: direct approved agents in Cursor on your own work, review every output critically, and stay accountable for everything you ship.

• Own quality for your features with no QA handoff: write unit, integration and end-to-end (E2E) tests that prove the work, and flag higher-risk work so the team can decide whether to pull in central QA.

• Ship small changes to production continuously, often behind feature flags. Work is done when it's verified in production, not when it's merged.

• Own what you ship after release: monitoring, triage and fixes.

• Build securely from design onward, with particular care for donor data, and review for security in code review.

• Contribute to design on your features, learning how a mature core application is moving into newer services, and making code improvements with guidance.

• Participate in code reviews, giving timely, constructive feedback and using feedback to raise the quality of your own work.

How we build:

• We deploy to production many times a day; feature flags separate deploying from releasing.

• AI increases individual leverage; it doesn't replace pairing or peer judgment.

• Meeting-light: short daily standups, retros every two weeks and meeting-free Fridays.

What we're looking for:

jobs.title: AVP, Federal Sales
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Federal business, and we're looking for the Sales leader who will build out the team and strategy. As the AVP of Federal Sales, you will be the first and most senior specialized Federal hire, accountable for taking the Samsara Connected Operations Cloud into U.S. federal civilian agencies as part of Phase 1 and defense agencies as part of Phase 2 on a dedicated, FedRAMP-authorized government cloud environment.

Federal agencies run some of the largest vehicle and asset fleets in the world, and they are modernizing how they manage safety, maintenance, sustainability, and mission readiness. Samsara already partners with state and local government agencies across the country, including statewide programs. This role turns that foundation into a durable federal practice.

You will operate as the leader of a dedicated federal practice: you'll design the team, hire it, set the go-to-market strategy, shape our partner and contract-vehicle approach, and own federal bookings. You'll work hand in hand with Product, Security and Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to make Samsara easy for federal agencies to buy and trust. This role reports to the Vice President of Public Sector Sales.

This is a remote position open to candidates based on the East Coast (Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Florida), with a preference for candidates based in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. This position requires travel up to 40% of the time.

In this role, you will:

• Build and own Samsara's federal go-to-market strategy for civilian agencies, including agency prioritization, territory design, and a multi-year plan that sequences investment against certification milestones and the federal budget cycle - with a plan to expand to defense agencies in the future

• Build Samsara's federal route-to-market with Partnerships: distributors and resellers, contract vehicles such as GSA MAS and GWACs, and co-sell relationships with federal systems integrators

• Hire, develop, and lead a dedicated federal team of account executives, future business development and capture managers, and solutions engineers, starting with a focused pod and scaling headcount as pipeline and bookings prove out

• Own federal pipeline and bookings, with clear leading indicators (agency relationships, qualified opportunities, RFI and proposal activity) in the early stage and full bookings accountability once the authorized product is available to transact

• Develop senior relationships with agency fleet, logistics, operations, and CIO/CISO leaders, and represent Samsara at industry days, federal events, and with government affairs partners

• Partner with Security and Compliance and Product to translate FedRAMP authorization progress into a clear, accurate customer narrative and to bring agency requirements back into the GovCloud roadmap

• Work with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to design federal-specific pipeline stages, forecasting, quotas, and compensation plans for long-cycle selling

• Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts on FAR-compliant terms, teaming agreements, and federal ethics requirements, setting a high bar for compliance across the team

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 12+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with 8+ years selling to U.S. federal government agencies

• 5+ years leading federal sales teams, including leaders of account executives, as a second-line manager or above

• Track record of building or scaling a federal sales practice at a commercial-first SaaS, cloud, or IoT company, including selling through and after FedRAMP authorization

• Consistent over-achievement of federal bookings targets, with closed multi-year, seven-figure agency contracts

• Hands-on experience with federal acquisition: GSA Schedule and other contract vehicles, distributor and reseller models, and teaming with federal systems integrators

• Established relationships with federal civilian agency stakeholders, systems integrators, and the federal partner ecosystem

• Experience leading business development and capture for competitive federal procurements, from pre-RFP shaping through proposal and award

• Eligibility to obtain a Public Trust position

An ideal candidate also has:

• A network that includes experienced federal sellers, capture managers, and solutions engineers who would follow them to a new practice

• Experience co-selling with federal systems integrators inside a direct sales organization, including clear account ownership and compensation rules

• Familiarity with Shipley or a comparable capture and proposal methodology

• Experience designing activity-based or MBO compensation for federal teams before authorized product is available

• Working knowledge of FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS, Section 508 accessibility, and Buy American and Trade Agreements Act requirements, and how they show up in deals

• Experience with Department of Defense or National Guard fleet programs, as a foundation for future expansion

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that OTE pay may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary

$440,000—$550,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

The People Coordinator provides day-to-day operational support across the employee lifecycle and serves as a first point of contact for employee questions. This role coordinates onboarding and offboarding processes, responds to routine and moderately complex inquiries related to benefits and HR policies and processes, maintains accurate employee records. Supports Learning & Development Manager with training administration and logistics. The ideal candidate is highly organized, service-oriented, detail-focused, collaborative, and proactive.

 - Provide timely, accurate, and employee-friendly responses to routine and moderately complex inquiries, escalating issues requiring specialized knowledge.

 - Manage incoming requests through shared channels and ensure questions are routed, tracked, and resolved promptly.

 - Coordinate pre-boarding and onboarding activities, including background checks, new hire documentation, I-9 completion, E-Verify processing, and HRIS entry.

 - Support orientation, and implement process improvements to enhance the Day 1 employee experience.

 - Following up with employees and managers to ensure timely completion of all onboarding steps: feedback surveys, 30-60-90 day check ins, and buddy assignments.

 - Maintain and update company intranet (Confluence), including onboarding resources, process SOPs, manager hub, and other on-demand information.

 - Coordinate offboarding activities, including processing terminations in the HRIS, generating separation documentation, and coordinating exit interview logistics to support a smooth employee exit.

HR systems, records, and reporting

 - Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems and employee files; complete routine audits to support data quality, compliance, and reporting accuracy.

 - Assist with documentation and recordkeeping for employee lifecycle changes, including status updates, transfers, promotions, and separations.

 - Maintain required employee communications and compliance materials, including labor law postings, annual notices, and employee records.

 - 1+ year of experience in an HR Coordinator, HR internship, or other similar administrative role.

 - A proactive approach to responding to employee questions with professionalism, judgment, and discretion.

 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

 - Experience in a high-growth or fast-paced environment.
