jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Marketing Manager

Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA

Role type: Full-time

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our External Affairs team! We're a small, fast-moving group that is changing the narrative about what is possible in the criminal justice system. That's where you come in. We’re looking for a strategic storyteller who can define how corrections agencies understand what Recidiviz builds, and who wants to change what government expects from its software along the way. You'll build demand for technology that keeps agencies in control, keeps pace with innovation, and is measured by the change it creates: safer communities, happier staff, and more people thriving after release.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll own the product narrative and messaging for Recidiviz's corrections products and services, including our offender management system (OMS) modules and policy analytics offerings. You will build a deep understanding of the people who decide when and how to modernize agency technology: corrections directors, deputy directors, CIOs, and procurement leaders. You'll decide how to reach them and shape how they understand what we build and why they should care.

You're not just positioning Recidiviz products. You're shifting what the market expects from corrections technology, building demand for flexible, modular infrastructure, better contracts, interoperability, open standards, and iterative delivery.

The same is true for AI. Corrections leaders are being pitched AI from every direction, and the space is shifting fast. You'll help them pursue AI innovation and responsible AI together: building demand for tools that are safe, transparent, and accountable, helping buyers ask the right questions about every AI opportunity in front of them, and giving them the confidence to move forward even as the landscape changes.

You'll report to our CMO. Travel within the U.S. is required roughly once a quarter, to industry conferences and Recidiviz events.

Core responsibilities

• Own the product narrative: Build the positioning and messaging frameworks for our corrections products and services, so decision makers understand what each tool does and why it matters to them. Make the product story on recidiviz.org clear and compelling for that audience.

• Reshape how the market buys: Develop and lead a strategy to move corrections technology procurement away from long, rigid contracts and toward flexibility, interoperability, modularity, and open standards. Map the industry groups, associations, and individual voices that shape how agencies think about technology, and equip them to carry a new standard forward.

• Make outcomes the measure: Set the expectation that corrections software should drive results, not only track activity. Turn evidence from our partner states into impact narratives and case studies that are specific, credible, and hard to ignore.

• Set the standard for responsible AI: Build demand for AI that is both innovative and safe. Create frameworks, buyer questions, and content that help agency leaders evaluate AI opportunities from any vendor, and feel confident making decisions in a fast-moving space.

• Launch what we build: Partner with Product and our go-to-market teams to plan and run launches for new products and features, with consistent messaging from first announcement through adoption.

• Lead market intelligence: Track the corrections technology landscape and make sure our teams can articulate Recidiviz's differentiation clearly and accurately.

• Prepare the story for the stage: Own the product narrative talk at our annual Partner Summit, and create the talks, workshop submissions, and materials we bring to industry conferences.

Wild success

Here are a few things you might accomplish in your first year at Recidiviz that would demonstrate wild success in this role:

• The market speaks a new language of outcomes: Corrections agencies and vendors alike start describing their work in terms of the results it drives, and you hear your framing echoed in conference talks, trade coverage, and vendor marketing.

• Agencies start buying differently: Agency leaders ask for outcomes, interoperability, and modular, iterative delivery, rather than a decade-long list of fixed requirements.

• Buyers ask sharper questions about AI: Agency leaders use your frameworks to evaluate AI tools, and responsible AI requirements show up alongside innovation goals in how they scope and buy technology.

• Our teams reach for your work first: The narrative, case studies, and competitive positioning you build become the materials our teams use instinctively in every conversation with an agency leader.

Minimum qualifications

• Strategic, market-level thinking: You've shaped how a market or category thinks, not only how a single product is described.

• Exceptional writing and storytelling: You distill complex products and evidence into clear, precise, and defensible messages that move senior decision makers to act.

• Enablement that teams actually use: You've partnered closely with account management and sales teams to understand what they need in the room, and created pitch materials, demos, and case studies that help them win and grow partnerships.

• Influence through others: You know how to build momentum through coalitions, associations, and trusted voices, and you're comfortable working across a range of stakeholders diplomatically.

• Ownership and judgment: You're a self-starter who sets direction, works well in a small team, and drives work to completion with little oversight.

• 7+ years of marketing experience, including positioning complex B2B or B2G products for senior buyers.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience marketing to government, especially state agencies

• Familiarity with public sector procurement, RFPs, or the modernization of legacy enterprise systems

• Experience mentoring or developing other marketers

• Experience working in a fast-moving startup environment

• Personal or professional experience working with the criminal justice system

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. We encourage you to share your realistic base salary compensation need.

What we offer

• Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters

• 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents

• Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year

• 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period

• 12 weeks of paid parental leave

• Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)

• Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits

• Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness

• Free mental health support via Talkspace

• Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose

• An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings

• All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we've built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator's 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners, big and small, red and blue, and touches over 46% of the country's incarcerated population. We have helped to get hundreds of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners, from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and people directly impacted by the justice system, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you're really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

jobs.title: Director of Construction Quality – Aviation
jobs.description:
AECOM Hunt is seeking an experienced Director of Construction Quality – Aviation the new consolidated terminal redevelopment at St. Louis Lambert International Airport in St. Louis, Missouri.

This is an opportunity to take a senior quality leadership role on a major airport modernization program, helping establish and drive construction quality standards across terminal building construction, building envelope systems, major building trades, and aviation infrastructure interfaces.

The successful candidate will work closely with project executives, construction teams, designers, and trade partners to proactively identify construction risks, prevent defects, and ensure quality execution throughout the project.

This is a full-time, onsite position with relocation assistance available for qualified candidates.

Job Description:

• Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the project Quality Management Program, ensuring quality standards, inspection processes, documentation, and corrective actions are effectively managed.
• Provide hands-on quality leadership across airport terminal construction, with particular emphasis on vertical building construction, building envelope systems, and interfaces with civil, airside, and landside work.
• Partner with project teams and trade contractors during preconstruction and pre-installation activities, including reviews of submittals, shop drawings, constructability, and subcontractor quality plans to identify potential issues before installation.
• Conduct field reviews, evaluate construction quality, identify deficiencies, and coordinate practical corrective actions to prevent rework, delays, and recurring issues.
• Lead and coordinate project quality personnel and third-party inspectors, establishing priorities, providing technical guidance, and driving accountability for quality performance.
• Oversee construction testing, inspections, technical reports, nonconformance tracking, and quality documentation in accordance with project requirements and applicable aviation construction standards.
• Collaborate with project executives, superintendents, designers, engineers, and trade partners to resolve technical quality issues and improve construction execution.
• Promote continuous improvement through quality training, lessons learned, process improvements, and project-specific quality initiatives.

About Construction Management – AECOM Hunt

Founded in 1944 in Indianapolis, Indiana, AECOM Hunt has been building for over 70 years. AECOM Hunt’s storied history has encompassed many notable projects in the automotive industry; iconic sports stadiums; a broad portfolio in transportation; and many repeat clients in the hospitality industry. From iconic stadiums and arenas, next-gen transportation hubs and sustainable healthcare and academic buildings, AECOM Hunt’s expertise, leadership and dedication are unparalleled.

Minimum Requirements:

• BS Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related curriculum and 10 years of professional Construction Quality Management experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 2 years of leadership.
• Demonstrated construction quality assurance/quality control experience on airport or aviation projects. Direct airport experience is required for this role.
• Experience leading quality teams, third-party inspectors, and subcontractor quality activities on large construction projects.
• Valid Driver’s License

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with airport terminal or other vertical aviation construction, including building, civil, airside, and landside interfaces.
• Practical building-envelope experience involving systems such as roofing, waterproofing, curtain wall/glazing, facades, air/vapor barriers, and sealants.
• Experience with construction inspections, field testing, technical documentation, nonconformance management, and corrective actions.
• Working knowledge of major building trades, applicable building codes, ASTM standards, and airport authority construction requirements.
• Experience supporting quality planning, constructability reviews, and coordination across structural, architectural, MEP, and life-safety systems.

Physical Demands:

• The following physical demands represent those typically required of individuals working in construction field roles, with or without accommodation. Construction field positions require physical stamina and mobility, including the ability to climb ladders and stairs, use personnel hoists, and move through various terrain and active construction zones. Vision requirements include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Team members must be capable of using their hands to handle tools and materials, and perform activities such as sitting, standing, walking, speaking, hearing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling. Lifting and carrying materials weighing up to 50 pounds unassisted may be necessary on an occasional basis.

Work Environment:

• Individuals in construction field roles work primarily on active job sites where exposure to environmental and job-related hazards is common, with or without accommodation. These environments may include proximity to heavy machinery, elevated work areas, airborne particles, varying weather conditions, and potential electrical risks. Noise levels may vary from moderate to high depending on the phase of construction. Employees may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and must remain alert to ensure safety. Additional duties may be assigned as needed based on the scope and progress of the project.

• This position does not include sponsorship for United States work authorization now or in the future.
• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
• This position is not hybrid nor remote.
• This position may include relocation.
• Some travel is required for this position.
• For positions with driving responsibilities, Motor Vehicle Records are reviewed as part of AECOM’s background check process to ensure compliance with the Company’s driving standards.
• In order to receive a security badge at the client worksite for which you are being hired to perform services, you will be required to pass the client's security screening process to include SWAC (Secure Worker Access Consortium) and/or SIDA (Identification Display Area) and fingerprinting, which will be done after you have commenced employment and is a condition of your continued employment.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Manager/Director, People Business Partner
jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

Sila is seeking a Senior Manager / Director, People Business Partners in the People & Culture team who will lead our People Business Partner team and personally partner with leaders of our Operations & Manufacturing, Engineering, and Finance organizations. Based onsite at our Alameda headquarters, you will spend your days close to the work: coaching leaders and front-line managers through hiring, feedback, performance, and promotion decisions; handling sensitive employee relations matters with sound judgment; and helping leaders shape their teams as we scale anode production in Moses Lake and build toward our own cell manufacturing. You will lead a small team of business partners across Alameda and Moses Lake, set a consistent way of working so employees at both sites get the same fair, high-quality support, and build practical tools and programs that make our managers stronger. You build on what already works, bring data to every conversation, and earn trust by solving real problems quickly.

Why This Role

• Partner with the VP People & Culture: Work in close partnership with the VP to design and prioritize the People function’s work, share what you’re seeing across client groups, and act as a trusted thought partner on strategy and decisions.

• Lead our business partners across two sites and set one consistent way of supporting leaders and employees, with a keen eye to supporting both a culture of innovation via RD&E, and an effective operating model for our plant and operations.

• Start with momentum. Our Operations and R&D leaders have already built their own leadership training and feedback practices. You’ll connect what works and help scale it.

• Shape a company at an inflection point. As we expand Moses Lake and build toward our own cell manufacturing, how we organize, develop and lead people will define what Sila becomes.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Partner directly with the COO, VP Engineering, and CFO and their leadership teams on hiring needs, performance, promotions, and day-to-day talent decisions

• Build front-line manager capability through practical training, coaching, and tools, focused on giving direct feedback, running performance and promotion conversations, and leading shift-based teams

• Set one consistent business partner operating model and employee relations playbook across Alameda and Moses Lake, including investigations, documentation, and company policies with aligned site procedures

• Lead org design and workforce planning for growth, including Moses Lake expansion and new battery manufacturing capacity, in partnership with Finance and Talent Acquisition

• Use people data from ChartHop, ADP, and Lattice to spot trends in engagement, attrition, and performance and turn them into clear recommendations for leaders

• Partner with Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and EHS on compensation decisions, offers, compliance, and a strong safety culture

• Hire, coach, and support talent through consistent feedback, navigation of challenges, and celebration of wins

Knowledge and Skill Requirements (vs Preferred)

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in HR Business Partner or generalist roles, including partnering with senior technical leaders at a high-growth engineering, R&D, or hardware company

• Experience supporting manufacturing or hourly, shift-based operations, including non-exempt wage-and-hour practices (strongly preferred)

• Experience managing or mentoring HR Business Partners (strongly preferred)

• Strong working knowledge of employee relations, investigations, and California employment law; Washington experience a plus

• Track record of building practical, scalable people practices (manager training, performance processes, policies) in a growing company, with the judgment to keep them simple

• Comfortable working with data and HR systems such as ADP, ChartHop, and Lattice, and using AI tools to work faster

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. SHRM-SCP or SPHR (or similar) a plus.

Location: Alameda, CA, 5 days/week in-office required. Occasional travel to Moses Lake, WA (monthly). Typical business hours are 9am–6pm PST.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

Physical Requirements

Rarely: Climbing (stairs), Crouching, Kneeling, Stooping, Lifting up to 15 lbs

Occasionally: Standing, Walking, Carrying

Frequently: Grasping, Handling, Reaching, Hearing

Constantly: Sitting, Reading, Vision, Repetitive Motion (keyboard)

jobs.title: Warehouse and Logistics Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Warehouse & Logistics Supervisor reports directly to the General Manager, LWS NORAM, with a functional reporting line to the Director, Global Supply Chain LWS. As a member of the management team, this position has overall responsibility and accountability for supply chain performance, including short-term Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) planning, purchasing, inventory control, and warehouse operations.

The role supervises purchasing and warehouse personnel, translates demand into purchase orders, manages supplier delivery schedules, and ensures high inventory accuracy and order fulfillment. This hands-on position also supports receiving, packing, shipping, and warehouse equipment operation while collaborating with Customer Service, Sales, Service, and Finance.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

• Supervise purchasing and warehouse staff, including daily work direction, training, safety compliance, coaching, and performance management
• Align team priorities with customer commitments and maintain standard operating procedures across supply chain workflows
• Provide operational floor support during absences, peak periods, and urgent requirements
• Lead S&OE reviews covering demand, stock availability, incoming supply, shortages, and backlog to support S&OP planning
• Create and manage purchase orders with internal and external suppliers through receipt and invoice reconciliation
• Expedite critical orders and coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve inventory constraints and delivery risks
• Direct and participate in receiving, put-away, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and stand-up reach forklift operations in accordance with safety standards
• Manage freight bookings, carrier scheduling, cross-border documentation, and container drayage
• Maintain warehouse organization, space efficiency, equipment readiness, and quarantine controls for non-conforming goods
• Coordinate warehouse requests, order allocation, shipment confirmation and tracking, document retention, marketing-material fulfillment, and warehouse-supply replenishment
• Maintain accurate ERP inventory records, including serial numbers, batch tracking, shelf-life data, and physical bin locations
• Execute cycle counts and physical inventories, investigate variances, and initiate corrective actions
• Partner with Finance on inventory valuation, goods in transit, excess and obsolete stock, stock transfers, adjustments, intercompany reconciliations, and audit compliance
• Maintain accurate supply chain master data, including part numbers, lead times, pricing, and Incoterms
• Maintain operational dashboards for open purchase orders, shortages, backlog, supplier performance, and fulfillment metrics
• Drive continuous improvement and ensure purchasing and trade-logistics activities comply with company policy and applicable trade requirements

The job description is not designed to capture all the employees’ responsibilities but is intended to capture essential functions of the role. Responsibilities may change over time and may be assigned at any time.

Who You Are:

• Customer-focused
• Detail oriented
• Leader by nature
• Leverage strong communication
• Excel at fast-paced environments
• Committed to safety, compliance, and continuous improvement

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Knowledge of supply chain execution, purchasing, warehouse operations, logistics, and inventory control
• ERP proficiency and strong transaction discipline for purchasing, inventory, and master-data activities
• Superb supervisory skills, including task delegation, training, coaching, safety oversight, and performance management
• Strong communication, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional coordination skills
• Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and performance dashboards
• Great planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
• Ability to manage intercompany transactions, international freight documentation, and cross- border trade requirements

Education & Experience:

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

jobs.title: Visual Merchandising Associate, Full-Time - Flatiron
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

Work Location/ Schedule:

• Available to work a minimum of 35 hours per week

• Available to work a minimum of 5 days per week, Fridays and weekends included.

• Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business)

The Role:

The Visual Merchandising Associate is responsible for maintaining the highest visual merchandising standards within their store by following Reformation’s VM guidelines. This role plays a critical part in bringing our brand vision to life through compelling in-store visual merchandising. You will be responsible for supporting the execution of visual merchandising strategies that drive traffic, maximize sales, and enhance the customer experience.

What you’ll do:

• Ensure accurate and impactful product presentation including dressing room outfits, mannequin dressing and foldings following all corporate visual guidelines and weekly directives.

• Complete Go Lives weekly in an organized and timely manner following Visual Merchandising guidelines.

• Ensure all VM equipment and props are in good condition and located in one central location in the stockroom.

• Oversee VM recovery efforts, including swapping out low lines, moving slow sellers to hot spots, removing duplicates, and replenishing empty notches during the day.

• Facilitate an efficient shipment processing system in which product is placed promptly in order to maximise sales.

• As an associate, ensure the customer is always a priority and that tasks do not impact customer service.

• Ensure cleanliness and organization of the sales floor, fitting rooms and windows.

• Share feedback, insights and ideas with VM Manager weekly.

• Contributes to positive team morale by living our values.

• Weekly on Monday walkthrough with the Store Manager, utilizing the Customer Experience Tool to score the VM. The score is then shared with the Visual Manager and together you will work on an action plan.

• In the case of newness arriving on days off, plan for placement of upcoming products in advance by utilizing the RAV and Inbound Shipment Report. Ensure this is shared with the management team.

Visual Operations:

• Partner with leadership to ensure shipment is completed within 24 hour SLA. This includes processed, steamed and placed accordingly in the stock room.

• Place all newness on the shop floor as soon as it is processed. Placement must be carefully chosen, following each rack’s story.

• Be informed of all items that are directed RTVs, remove these from the shop floor and replace them accordingly.

• Expertly analyze the RAV report and Looker dashboards to provide data-driven insights that directly inform decision making.

• Analyze business weekly using company reporting tools to identify product opportunities. This includes the Retail Store Performance, RX Style Conversion and Retail Ops Report on Looker.

What you’ll need:

• Passionate about the Reformation brand

• Minimum 6 months working at Reformation

• Strong communication skills

• Strong organizational and time management skills

• Strong VM skills

• Proven team player with leadership skills

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional maturity

• Uphold time and attendance policy

• Bring an ambitious and passionate attitude to work daily

• Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts

• Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment

What you’ll bring:

• 1+ years relevant experience in a fast­ paced, creative service environment

• Familiarity with the user functionality of desktop, mobile, tablet and digital technologies

• Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business

• Ability to work in a fast-paced setting

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities

• Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career

Compensation:

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base hourly range is $16 - $21 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

• Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.

• We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.

• We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.

• We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.

• You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.

• We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.

• We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.

Still don’t know if you should apply? We get it—studies show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our general application.

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer (Portal)
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array and parabolic ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role:

Northwood is looking for a Principal Electrical Engineer to help drive the development of our digital compute and power electronics. These complex digital systems ensure that our antennas can meet high-rate processing needs no matter where they are deployed around the world. Our hardware team prioritizes excellent engineering, building end products that are known for their reliability, scalability, and cost.

 

Responsibilities:

 - Drive electrical design for high-speed digital communication systems, implementing RF and mixed-signal designs in complex, multilayer PCBs

 - Work with 100G high speed networking, complex digital power trees, and drive system trades for architecture decisions

 - Perform schematic capture, layout, and bring-up on a variety of different digital systems including FPGAs, microcontrollers, and their associated peripherals

 - Collaborate across hardware and software teams with RF engineers, antenna engineers, FPGA engineers, and firmware engineers to optimize system performance and overall design

 - Test prototypes and assess performance in the lab and in the field

 - Work with production teams to make testable and manufacturable products that we can integrate in-house

 

Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

 - 8+ years of professional experience in electrical design

 - Experience with end-to-end board design, from architecture and component selection through schematic capture, PCB layout, bring-up, debug, and production

 - Experience with mixed-signal electronics design and complex multilayer PCBs, including stack-up definition and material selection

 - Experience with troubleshooting EMI/EMC, either conducted or radiated
   
    

Preferred Qualifications:

 - High-speed digital design experience with interfaces such as multi-gigabit SerDes, DDR, JESD204B/C, and 10/100G Ethernet, including signal and power integrity analysis

 - Experience with FPGA-or processor-based systems and high-speed data converters

 - Deep understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC mitigation, PCB stack-up definition, and high-performance board layout practices

 - Hands-on experience debugging complex hardware systems using advanced lab instrumentation and driving root-cause analysis across board and system levels

 - Ability to lead cross-functional technical efforts, mentor junior engineers, and make sound engineering tradeoffs in fast-paced development environments



Additional Information:



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

jobs.title: Cell Engineer
jobs.description:
Founded with the vision to electrify everything, Group14 is the leading commercial manufacturer of advanced silicon battery materials. Our breakthrough technology, SCC55®, is a drop-in ready replacement for graphite that seamlessly integrates into existing lithium-ion manufacturing to unlock transformational energy density and faster charging. By delivering high-performance materials at commercial scale, we are strengthening global battery supply chain security and enabling the next generation of rechargeable batteries for global automotive OEMs, cell manufacturers, AI-enabled consumer electronics, grid-scale energy storage, and other innovative industrial segments.

Over the past year, Group14 reached major milestones that underscore our momentum. We closed a $665 million Series D round bringing our total equity raised to well over $1 billion. We have a truly global footprint, with locations in Asia, the US and Europe, supporting resilient, localized supply chains and scaling production to meet surging worldwide demand. Headquartered in Washington state, Group14 is backed by world-class investors and customers, including Porsche, ATL, Microsoft, and SK Inc. As we continue to grow, we are building a team united by passion for shaping the future of energy.

The Cell Engineer will play a pivotal role in supporting the commercialization of SCC55Ⓡ, Group14’s best-in-class silicon anode material. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and assembling silicon battery pouch cells for high-energy and high-power applications on our laboratory-scale production line. These cells will directly showcase the revolutionary capabilities of SCC55Ⓡ and drive customer adoption. Additionally, this role will spearhead the technology transfer of SCC55Ⓡ into commercial cell designs and prototype engineering solutions for the continuous improvement of our battery cell line.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

• Develop and establish cell design details required for high-energy and high-power applications.

• Design and execute protocols to optimize various processes in cell development, production, and testing—from concept through implementation.

• Testing the electrochemical performance profile and physical characteristics of silicon batteries.

• Conduct root-cause investigations, prepare detailed status reports on problems or issues, and make actionable recommendations as required.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• B.S. in Chemical Engineering, Electrochemical Engineering, Material Science, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience working at a lithium-ion battery manufacturer or within a battery-focused research lab.

• Proven experience maintaining and operating pouch cell assembly equipment at the laboratory or pilot scale.

• Expertise using advanced cell testing systems and methods to characterize battery performance.

• Knowledge of lithium-ion battery safety practices and the physical ability to wear a respirator.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• A self-motivated mindset with the ability to thrive as an independent contributor.

OTHER QUALITIES WE'D LOVE YOU TO HAVE:

• 1+ years of dedicated experience making multilayer pouch cells.

• In-depth knowledge of how mixing, coating, and calendaring directly impact cell performance.

• Strong background in cell design, formulation, and end-to-end cell development.

• Deep understanding of cell degradation mechanisms and failure mode analysis.

• Experience operating a pouch cell manufacturing line.

• Hands-on proficiency with precision metrology tools, including calipers, micrometers, and laser distance sensors.

• Experience designing and building custom fixtures and test leads.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD or 3D modeling software.

Base Pay Range

$95,000—$120,000 USD

GROUP14 OFFERS COMPELLING BENEFITS

• Medical, Dental, and Vision: 100% paid for by the company for employees (80% for dependents) with an HSA-eligible plan option for Medical

• Long-Term and Short-Term Disability Insurance

• Discounted rates on Pet Insurance

• 401(k) with Pre-Tax and Roth options and Company Match

• Paid Time Off and Floating Holidays

• Stock Options

GROUP14 IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. Being a diverse and inclusive company isn’t just something we strive for, it's who we are and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you belong and that Group14 is the kind of workplace where you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to thrive in your career.

jobs.description:

You’ll lead challenging analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and data improvement initiatives, building and optimizing models, dashboards, queries, and processes that support revenue forecasting, profitability, operational planning, and strategic decision-making.

Working independently and in partnership with business leaders and data teams, you’ll anticipate analytical and data-quality needs, solve complex problems, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations. You’ll also help strengthen the team’s analytics capabilities by mentoring analysts, sharing best practices, and providing technical guidance.

• Manage complex data analysis and business intelligence workstreams within assigned areas that support revenue forecasting, profitability review, operational planning, and business performance evaluation

• Build analytical models, queries, and data sets using SQL, Python, and other approved analytical tools to address complex business questions within assigned workstreams

• Resolve complex analytical issues within assigned workstreams and escalate decisions requiring broader business or technical authority

• Build dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that communicate complex analytical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences within assigned areas

• Manage analytical dependencies involving business teams, data engineers, and systems such as Salesforce and Workday within assigned workstreams

• Mitigate identified data-quality and reporting risks through validation, investigation, documentation, and coordination with appropriate stakeholders

• Resolve complex data issues within assigned areas in line with data governance, security, documentation, and quality practices

• Review analytical work, queries, dashboards, reports, and recommendations and provide constructive technical feedback

• Experience managing complex data analysis or business intelligence workstreams involving multiple stakeholders and data sources

• Experience building and optimizing dashboards, reports, analytical models, queries, and data workflows

• Experience translating complex analytical findings into clear business insights and recommendations

• Experience mentoring analysts or providing technical guidance and review

• Experience collaborating with business stakeholders and data engineering or technical teams

jobs.title: Sales Manager - California (Korean & English Bilingual)
jobs.description:
Chowbus is a leading Asian restaurant technology SaaS platform, with deep roots in the North American market for years. Currently, we stand as a pioneering enterprise in the North American Asian Restaurant SaaS sector. Driven by precise market positioning and efficient product services, our business has achieved doubled growth annually, covering over 30 core states and 100 key cities across the U.S., and partnering with more than 10,000 Asian restaurants. We build tech ecosystems that help restaurants grow, serve with heart, and uplift their communities. Our vision is to create a world where culturally rooted food entrepreneurs thrive everywhere.

As a Sales Manager, you own a territory and the full sales cycle: finding restaurants through cold calls and walk-ins, running demos, closing deals, and taking care of your accounts after launch. Many owners already run Toast, Square or Clover, so a big part of the job is showing them why switching is worth it.

What You'll Focus On

• Build your own pipeline through cold calls, walk-ins and referrals

• Run demos with restaurant owners and close deals, often against Toast, Square and Clover

• Hand signed restaurants to our technicians for installation

• Own your accounts after launch and grow them with additional Chowbus products

• Keep your pipeline up to date in our CRM

What You Bring

• 1+ years of quota-carrying, full-cycle B2B or outside sales; restaurant POS or payments experience (Toast, Square, Clover, SpotOn, Lightspeed, ISO/merchant services) strongly preferred

• A track record of hitting or beating quota, with numbers you can walk us through

• Comfortable cold calling and walking into restaurants to start conversations with owners

• Patient and service-minded with customers after the sale, not only before it

• Strong spoken and written English; fluency in Korean is required, as Korean will be used on the job to communicate with Korean-speaking customers and prospective customers.

• Self-directed and organized enough to run your own territory

• Lives in or near CA; valid driver's license and reliable transportation

What We Offer

• Uncapped commission on every deal

• Guaranteed commission draw during your first 3 months while you ramp

• A clear path from Sales Manager to Senior Sales Manager and team leadership

• Hands-on training on the product, the restaurant business and competitive selling

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k)

• 100% employer-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)

• 100% employer-paid Life Insurance and option for additional employee-paid Life Insurance

• 100% employer-paid Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance and option for additional employee-paid AD&D Insurance

• Company holidays

• Birthday off

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Fuel reimbursement

Target first-year earnings (OTE) for this role are $100,000–$120,000 – $160,000, made up of a base salary of $50,000 – $80,000 plus uncapped commission. Base salary depends on experience; commission depends on results, and top performers earn above the target range.

jobs.title: Site Operation Manager
jobs.description:
Cobot is putting Proxie — our mobile, human-scale robot — into live customer operations: hospitals, distribution centers and manufacturing floors where the work does not stop for us. The Site Operation Manager is the person who makes that work day to day. You lead the Deployment Engineers and Robot Specialists at your sites, own the fleet's operational performance, and are the customer's operational counterpart from the first robot delivered through to a stable, boring, high-performing operation. You will hold two sites at once, deliberately at different stages — one launching while the other matures — and you will be paired with a Deployment Program Manager who owns the customer program while you own the floor. This is a hands-on leadership job: you will be resident on site through launch, you will be the call for system escalations and you will build a team and a standard that makes the next site easier than this one.



Join us to reimagine the future of human-robot interaction.



Collaborative Robotics is a team of innovators and builders redefining the future of human-robot interaction. We are working to realize a world where robots are a trusted extension of your surroundings. They work, adapt, and react around you. Not the other way around.

This position offers the flexibility of remote work within the US, with a preference for those near major airport hubs to facilitate travel, which is expected to range between 50% - 80%.



Key Responsibilities:


 - Work with the onsite team of deployment engineers and robot specialists to deliver key project milestones.

 - Hire, schedule, coach and conduct performance management for team of robot specialists.

 - Own operational performance of the fleet at your sites: mission completion, autonomy rate, intervention rate, uptime, and the daily cadence that keeps all four moving in the right direction.

 - Be on site for launch through the operational stabilization for the weeks that follow.

 - Train robot specialists and customer operators, and leave the site with people who can run it without you.

 - Run the daily and weekly operating rhythm with the customer's floor leadership, and escalate cleanly and early to internal support teams.

 - Enforce and enhance deployment standards through SOPs, checklists, safety and change control.

 - Report operational data and issues internally and externally, surfacing trends and risks early.

 - Support the handover of a mature site to Customer Success.



Minimum Qualifications: 


 - 4+ years of operations leadership with direct reports in a live physical environment — distribution, manufacturing, healthcare logistics, field service or equivalent.

 - Experience standing up a new site, line or operation, not only running an established one.

 - Proven team building: you have hired, trained and managed the performance of a frontline team.

 - Technical enough to troubleshoot alongside your team and challenge an engineer's diagnosis, without needing to be the engineer.

 - Comfortable as the escalation point on a customer's floor, including outside normal business hours during launch windows.

 - Fluent with operational metrics — and skeptical enough to ask how a number is collected before you quote it.

 - Willing to be resident on site during launch and stabilisation windows; roughly 50% - 65% travel. Up to 80% when a site is launching, or relocation to a customer site region.

 - Highly motivated teammate with excellent oral and written communication skills.

 - Enjoy working in a fast paced, collaborative and dynamic start-up environment as part of a small team.

 - Must have and maintain US work authorization.


Preferred Qualifications:


 - Experience with complex systems/hardware, mobile robots, AGVs, or automation fleet operations.

 - Amazon-style operations or area management training, or another structured operations school.

 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or above, with a habit of applying it.

 - Experience running or handing off operations to a centralized remote operations function.

 - Background in hospital materials management, 3PL, or high-throughput distribution.

 - Experience hiring and training a frontline team from the ground up.

 - Formal safety qualification or experience owning safety for a site.



The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $150,000 base plus equity and comprehensive benefits including medical/dental/vision plans, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid vacation time, paid sick leave, and parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and experience level. The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position in the noted geographic area. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.



Cobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.



To all recruitment agencies: Collaborative Robotics does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our employees. Collaborative Robotics is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Prediction Markets)
jobs.description:
Phantom https://phantom.com is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.



Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/sites/ninabambysheva/2026/02/23/inside-phantoms-battle-plan-to-win-the-crypto-fueled-superapp-war/ and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 https://www.cnbc.com/worlds-top-fintech-companies-2026/! 



We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Prediction markets are one of Phantom's top priorities, and the category is still wide open. The interfaces everyone uses today are not the end state. As a Senior Product Manager on the Predictions team, you'll shape what trading on real-world events should feel like, from five-minute crypto markets to live sports, politics, and culture.

You'll start with something most prediction products spend years building: more than 20 million people who already hold and trade their money in Phantom, tokens, perps, and stablecoins in the same app. We're looking for someone with the creativity to use that, the judgment to decide what matters, and the drive to see it through without waiting to be asked.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading predictions simpler and more connected.

 - Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.

 - Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.

 - Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works.

 - Make every trade trustworthy. Own trade execution, position and PnL accuracy, and clear market resolution, so traders can rely on every number on the screen.

 - Own market discovery and retention. Decide which markets we list and feature, how we surface live events, and how personalization, notifications, and social features give traders reasons to return.

 - Make the calls. Decide what to build, what to cut, and when something is ready to ship, often with incomplete information, and own the outcome.

 - Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and our exchange and liquidity partners to ship in a regulated category. Set shared goals and report progress every week, including what isn't working.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years as a full-time Product Manager or founder, including a consumer product you owned end to end and grew through measurable improvements in adoption, retention, or revenue.

 - You trade yourself (prediction markets, perps, crypto, or something more exotic) and have strong opinions about which products do it well. Comfortable reasoning about order books, liquidity, pricing, and settlement.

 - Original product thinking, with a record of turning what you learned from users into something new that people adopted.

 - Strong design sensibility. You can point to work where you made something simpler without taking power away from the people who wanted it.

 - You stay close to users and use AI agents and data to test what you hear, investigate product performance, and measure whether your decisions worked.

 - You pick up problems without being asked and see them through. You know when to gather more evidence and when to make a call.

 - A close collaborator. You can lead engineering, design, legal, and marketing without formal authority, and you're technical enough to work through exchange, onchain, and data integrations in detail.

 - Bonus points if you have:
   
   - Worked at a prediction market, sportsbook, exchange, or brokerage.
   
   - Built something on crypto rails that could not have been built without them.
   
   - Built real-time, live-event, or high-frequency trading products.
   
   

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

 

 - Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

 - Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

 - Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.



Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered 

 - Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

 - Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Wellness stipend

 - Weekly meal stipend

 - Learning & Development stipend

 - Remote / WFH set-up stipend



We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.



By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
At SanMar, the work you do makes a difference.

What's the Short Version?

The HR Business Partner serves as a trusted advisor and HR business partner supporting team leaders and their teams through understanding desired business outcomes. They provide advice, counsel and support to leadership in the implementation and delivery of HR programs and the optimization of organizational effectiveness. They collaborate with HR and Legal to handle employee relations and all matters relating to HR policies and practices.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Proactively guide managers through complex employee relations cases by making recommendations that ensure successful resolution, legal compliance and minimal risk exposure to the company.

• Provide strategic business partnership, thought partnership, and coaching to all levels of the organization.

• Support employees and leaders across assigned departments and business units to develop HR strategies to support business goals.

• Partner with leaders to drive employee engagement, retention, and change management.

• Partner with business leaders to develop and execute HR strategies that align with business objectives and drive team performance.

• Lead and support change initiatives, fostering employee engagement and promoting a positive work environment.

• Partner with assigned business unit(s) to ensure a deep understanding of business strategy and implement high-quality HR practices within the team.

• Perform intake on Employee Relation issues, perform investigations, ensure that all employee relations issues are being handled consistently and within guidelines and practices.

• Provide guidance and coaching to management in the delivery of compensation programs including annual salary planning and promotion discussions.

• Support annual employee engagement survey efforts, coaching managers towards continued positive results.

• Cultivates and maintains strong partnerships with community organizations, including local youth programs.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

• 8+ years of Human Resources experience and/or education including

• 4+ years of experience collaborating with business management teams and forging strong relationships.

• 4+ years of experience delivering presentations and facilitating workshops to various audience levels within an organization.

• Effective oral and written communication

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills

• Strong organizational and conflict resolution skills

• Proven ability to effectively influence, build trust, communicate, and connect with all employees at all levels of the organization

• Knowledge of all current federal, state, and local labor laws

• Understanding of diversity and inclusion practices

• Ability to maintain confidentiality in all work performed

• Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% to support assigned departments and maintain strong, connected partnerships with leaders and employees

What's Our Offer?

Salary Range: You`ll earn between $102,600 - $135,000 annually, depending on experience.

Bonus: You`ll be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus up to 10% of base salary.

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a bi-weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

Hybrid: SanMar's Eastpointe office is located in Issaquah, WA in the Seattle metropolitan area. Employees are required to work in our offices Tuesday through Thursday each week and additional days may be added based on business needs. Our standard working hours are 8:00-5:00 PST. Periodic travel may be required. The employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods while working on a computer and participating in virtual and in-person meetings. Frequent use of hands for keyboarding and standard office equipment is required. Occasional standing, walking, and reaching may be needed to attend meetings or collaborate in an office setting. The role requires the ability to perform close visual work on a computer for extended periods. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10–15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Why Work at SanMar?

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. They bring their talent, passion and dedication to work with them every day. Their hard work inspires us and gives us purpose. We love working here together.

Whether you work in our headquarters, from your home or in one of our distribution centers across North America, we believe that investing in you is just the right thing to do. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and well-being, life balance, career growth and (eventually) retirement.

SanMar works with brands you already know, like Nike, The North Face and Brooks Brothers, as well as providing industry-leading private label apparel and accessories. Our people come to work excited to do their part, providing clothing that helps people feel that they’re a part of something special.

Here’s your chance to be a part of this story. If you’re ready to work in a place where your participation matters and your growth is a priority, we’re ready for you.

SanMar is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, whoever you love or follow in faith, whatever your disability or superpower status, whichever ethnicity or gender you identify with, you are welcome at SanMar.

SanMar participates in E-Verify.

jobs.description:

Responsibilities:

jobs.description:
Procurement Manager

About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Procurement Manager to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you’ll own procurement for our data center infrastructure, software, and technical services, from vendor selection and contract negotiation through demand planning and lifecycle management. Working closely with Engineering, Finance, and Inventory Management, you’ll translate technical roadmaps into multi-year supply forecasts, build a resilient supplier network, and control costs while upholding our standards for excellence, collaboration, and impact.

What You’ll Do

Procurement Management

 - Identify and manage technology vendors, component manufacturers, and cloud infrastructure partners.

Demand Planning & Lifecycle Management

jobs.title: Principal Lab Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

RevMed is seeking a Senior/Principal Lab Automation Engineer to join Platform Sciences and Automation (PSA) team within the Sample Management and Screening Platform Technologies (SM-SPT) function. You will bring deep automation expertise and a hands-on builder mindset to develop flexible systems, support reliable sample management and assay operations, and advance digital integration across Research. Working closely with scientists, engineers, research operations, and data and informatics teams, you will help build a nimble automation ecosystem that enables rapid adaptation and deployment of evolving scientific workflows through reusable laboratory capabilities. This role requires onsite presence at our Redwood City headquarters.

Key Responsibilities

• Translate scientific needs into automation. Partner closely with scientific teams to define and prioritize workflows, establish process-specific QC metrics, and implement reliable automated processes.

• Build reusable capabilities. Design, develop, integrate, and qualify workcells, liquid-handling systems, and protocols with the modularity and flexibility needed for rapid deployment across processes and technologies.

• Support reliable operations. Provide hands-on method development, optimization, and troubleshooting for standalone and integrated systems supporting both sample management and assay operations.

• Own digital automation and integration. Partner with research leadership, SM-SPT teams, IT, informatics, data engineering, and software teams to build digital products and drive LIMS integrations. Connect scientific intent, experimental planning, automated execution, and contextual data capture with downstream analytics and AI/ML to enable faster learning cycles.

• Shape strategy and investment. Collaboratively define near- and long-term physical and digital automation needs, align the roadmap with leadership, and guide internal development, build-versus-buy, and investment decisions. Evaluate emerging screening, assay technologies or data solutions for scientific impact within SM-SPT and across RevMed Research.

• Develop people and operational best practices. Work alongside and mentor engineers and operators through installation, testing, process validation, and continuous improvement. Drive documentation and training to strengthen business continuity, open communication, and shared accountability.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, a scientific discipline, or a related field.

• Relevant, hands-on biotech/pharma lab automation experience: BS with 10-12+ years, or MS with 8-10+ years

• Deep knowledge of the lab automation landscape, with demonstrated technical depth across systems of varying scale and a track record of delivering commercial or custom hardware or data automation solutions appropriate to scientific needs.

• Proficiency in sample management or assay operations instrumentation, systems development, and programming across commercial, custom, or open-source platforms—for example, High Res Bio Cellario, Mosaic, Hamilton Verso, Beckman Tempo, Hamilton Venus, Tecan Fluent, PyLabRobot, and Benchling.

• Hands-on LIMS integration experience to streamline and automate sample management and assay data flows.

• Ability to independently own and deliver complex automation initiatives while guiding colleagues in daily work.

• Excellent proactive stakeholder engagement, communication, and organizational skills, with a can-do, can-learn, hands-on builder mindset and a sense of urgency.

Preferred Skills:

• Hands-on custom automation integration experience, with the ability to build and troubleshoot beyond vendor-provided solutions.

• Working knowledge of HTS and biochemical, cellular, or biophysical DMTA assay workflows, including small-molecule compound management, TR-FRET, high-throughput transfection, high-content imaging, or mass spectrometry assays.

• Experience applying state-of-the-art LLM or agentic AI tools to custom data and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency, deployment speed, and user adoption.
