jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: San Francisco Bay Area

About the Role:

We are seeking an entrepreneurial Sales Director to lead our DN/AI Growth Segment, focusing on both the acquisition and expansion of our fastest-growing Startup accounts. In this role, you will scale a high-performing team tasked with bringing the world’s most innovative AI companies onto Cloudflare's platform.

To thrive, you must bring a founder mentality and deep familiarity with the VC ecosystem to capture high-growth startups at inception. You possess a sharp understanding of the dynamics of the hyperscaler market and the AI landscape, allowing you to position Cloudflare as the definitive infrastructure layer for modern workloads. Finally, you are highly familiar with PLG sales motions, knowing exactly how to identify high-potential, self-serve developer accounts and seamlessly transition them into enterprise expansions.

Responsibilities:

• Own and exceed quarterly revenue targets, driving both high-velocity new logo acquisition and strategic account expansion within the AI and startup ecosystem.

• Partner closely with Product, Growth, and Marketing to seamlessly convert self-serve developer usage into structured enterprise agreements.

• Act as a key executive sponsor for high-growth startups, founders, and VC partners, positioning Cloudflare as the foundational architecture for the next generation of tech.

You might be a good fit if you have:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with at least 3+ leading sales teams

• A proven track record of leading high-performing sales teams in the cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or developer platform space.

• A strong understanding of modern application architecture, serverless computing, and how AI startups utilize compute and data storage.

• Active connections within the tech startup and venture capital ecosystems, with an innate ability to spot and engage high-potential accounts early.

• Hands-on experience navigating hybrid sales models that blend product-led growth with top-down enterprise execution.

• A history of thriving in fast-paced, rapidly evolving markets where you can turn ambiguity into clear, actionable sales strategies

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $378,000 - $496,000 OTE.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Time Off

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

jobs.title: Staff Accountant
jobs.description:
WHAT TO EXPECT

Heron Power is a startup company building cutting-edge power electronics for the 21st-century grid. We aim to debottleneck the growth of electricity generation and consumption with scalable, innovative, and less costly hardware solutions, accelerating the electrification of everything.



Our first focus goal is to build better converters (inverters & rectifiers) to connect large-scale renewables, storage, and loads to the grid. Heron Power’s leadership team is made up of seasoned veterans who have designed and shipped gigawatts of power conversion products over the past decade.



We understand that no one individual knows everything. We will all learn a lot together and from each other. We strive to build a collaborative, enriching environment conducive to personal, technical, and career growth. You can expect to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, driven by first principles engineering, solving difficult problems.




JOB OVERVIEW

Heron Power is seeking a Staff Accountant to support the accounting function at a high-growth, impact-driven technology company. Reporting to the Controller, this role will help ensure accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial reporting by assisting with the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and by making sure all AP transactions are entered and processed accurately and on time.



The Staff Accountant will handle day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accruals, fixed assets, and general ledger activities, while supporting the processes and internal controls needed for a rapidly growing hardware manufacturing business. This role will work with finance, operations, supply chain, and engineering teams to support capital expenditure and operating expense accounting.




HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

Accounts Payable

 - Enter and code vendor invoices, expense reports, and purchase order receipts in the accounting system, confirming accounts, departments, and approvals are accurate and complete.

 - Ensure all AP is input and processed on time, including invoice matching, receiving, 3-way match, approval routing, weekly payment runs, and vendor record maintenance.

 - Reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, follow up on open items and vendor inquiries, and flag process or control improvements.

Accruals

 - Prepare and post monthly accrual journal entries so expenses are recorded in the appropriate period.

 - Follow up with department owners to identify received-not-invoiced goods and services and collect support for recurring and one-time accruals.

 - Prepare accrual schedules and reconciliations as part of the month-end close process.

Fixed Assets

 - Apply the company’s capitalization policy to equipment, tooling, leasehold improvements, and other fixed asset additions.

 - Track construction-in-progress activity, coordinate with stakeholders on project status, and support timely capitalization when assets are placed in service.

 - Maintain the fixed asset register and prepare depreciation and fixed asset reconciliations to support accurate financial reporting.

General Ledger

 - Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close by preparing journal entries and account reconciliations per the close calendar.

 - Research account fluctuations, clear reconciling items, and help meet close deadlines.

 - Support the creation of new processes and the continued improvement of existing ones.




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

We keep our must-have requirements focused. We value strong accounting fundamentals, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and the initiative to improve processes in a fast-moving environment. Domain-specific experience will help determine the appropriate career level for each hire.




MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field;

 - 3+ years of accounting experience, ideally in a high-growth or fast-changing environment.

 - Hands-on experience supporting month-end close, including journal entries, account reconciliations.

 - Experience with AP processing, including invoice entry, three-way matching, and payment runs; ability to follow and document accounting processes and internal controls.

 - Strong attention to detail and organization, with the ability to meet recurring close and payment deadlines.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with finance, supply chain, engineering, People Operations, and external partners.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics 365.

 - Experience supporting a manufacturing, hardware, or inventory-intensive business, including exposure to fixed assets, capitalization policies, and operational accounting workflows.



If you are passionate about technology and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in accelerating the electrification of everything at Heron Power.



Heron Power provides competitive compensation (salary and equity) and benefits. The salary for this role ranges from $100,000 to $120,000 per year.

JOB SUMMARY:

The System Integration Engineer supports the integration, testing, and operational deployment of the Missile Defense Agency's Command and Control, Battle Management and Communications (C2BMC) system. This role is responsible for integrating hardware and software components into test and operational environments, troubleshooting complex system issues, supporting test execution, and collaborating with government customers, developers, and Missile Defense System stakeholders. The engineer will analyze system performance, document issues, and contribute to the successful delivery and sustainment of mission-critical missile defense capabilities.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Systems Integration & Test

• Integrate C2BMC hardware and software components into testbeds and operational environments.

• Conduct system checkouts of virtual machines, networks, and message flow architectures.

• Support system integration activities, fielding efforts, and test events across the Missile Defense System (MDS).

• Execute test procedures and validate system functionality in distributed environments.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution

• Analyze and troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and interface issues across integrated systems.

• Collaborate with developers, engineers, and external stakeholders to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

• Author Problem Reports (PRs) and document technical findings, impacts, and recommendations.

• Review system logs, interface documentation, and network configurations to support issue resolution.

Data Analysis & Scripting

• Create and modify scripts to extract and analyze information from system log files.

• Perform analysis of system inputs, outputs, and internal message traffic.

• Support verification of system performance and operational readiness through data analysis and reporting.

• Develop tools and automation solutions that improve troubleshooting and integration efficiency.

Operations & Customer Support

• Operate and support C2BMC systems during integration events, testing activities, and operational exercises.

• Provide technical support to government customers and National Team stakeholders.

• Participate in meetings with Missile Defense Agency representatives, National Team organizations, and other Missile Defense System elements.

• Maintain technical documentation, integration procedures, and test artifacts.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or another STEM-related discipline from an accredited institution.

• 0-2 years of experience supporting systems integration, system administration, test, or engineering activities.

• Experience or academic coursework involving Linux, Windows, networking, or distributed systems.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment supporting government customers and cross-functional engineering teams.

• Understanding of hardware and software components operating within virtualized or distributed environments.

• Ability to analyze application logs, system logs, network traffic, and interface specifications to diagnose issues.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (Security+ or equivalent) required prior to start date.

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance as required.

EDUCATION: Bachelors with  2+ or Master with  1+ Years of Experience

LOCATION: Full Time/ On-Site in

CLEARANCE REQUIRMENT:  Secret

jobs.title: AVP, Strategic Partner Delivery
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an AVP, Strategic Partner Delivery, you will be tasked with leading SentinelOne’s relationship with a strategic global services partner, helping the two organizations deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for customers from the earliest proof of value through implementation, ongoing service, and renewal. Together, SentinelOne and its partner bring expert-led managed security services to more organizations in more regions. This is a hands-on executive player-coach role: you will lead a dedicated team, aligning Product, Engineering, Sales, Renewals, Legal, and Finance around a single operating model.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Serve as SentinelOne’s executive lead for the partnership, owning the joint operating plan, roadmap, and regular partnership reviews, and communicating progress, decisions, and risks to executives.

• Lead a team spanning customer experience, service quality, and technical validation; establish clear operating rhythms, shared decision-making, and issue resolution across both organizations; hire and coach leaders, and build a culture of ownership, transparency, and measurable results.

• Ensure customers have a named SentinelOne owner from proof of value through onboarding, deployment, ongoing service, and renewal, with smooth handoffs and fast time to value.

• Define customer experience standards and service-level expectations, and use clear metrics and scorecards to track service quality and drive continuous improvement.

• Own senior customer escalations and drive timely resolution and lasting corrective action, partnering with Product, Engineering, and technical teams to improve platform and service readiness.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 15 or more years of leadership across enterprise Customer Experience, cybersecurity services, managed services, technical operations, or strategic technology partnerships; leadership experience in cybersecurity, MDR/MSSP, managed SIEM, incident response, or enterprise professional services.

• Proven ownership of a complex global delivery, service-provider, or strategic partner relationship; experience launching or scaling partner-led delivery models while protecting customer trust.

• Experience building and developing senior cross-functional teams and influencing organizations beyond direct reporting lines; strong executive judgment in critical customer escalations and ambiguous delivery challenges.

• Expertise in partner management, service delivery, SLA/SLO management, and continuous-improvement programs; commercial fluency spanning renewals, delivery capacity, and customer outcomes.

• Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into operating plans, use metrics to drive decisions, and communicate effectively with C-level stakeholders; success in this role means faster resolution of customer issues, on-time delivery of the joint roadmap, strong partner relationship health, and improved time to value, service experience, and renewal outcomes.

• Knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity and the journey from technical validation and implementation to managed services and renewals.

• Familiarity with SentinelOne Singularity, endpoint security, AI SIEM, threat hunting, and regulated or large-enterprise customer environments.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

jobs.title: Quality Auditor (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
The Quality Auditor is responsible for ensuring that processes within the distribution center are aligned with Bosch’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ISO 9001 standards. This role involves conducting regular audits, performing ISIR inspections, managing Statistical Quality Control (SQC), and supporting quality improvement activities. The auditor will verify compliance, report deviations from standards, and ensure that countermeasures are put in place for the immediate containment of issues. The role is key in supporting quality assurance and continuous improvement across the distribution center.

Key Responsibilities

• QMS & ISO 9001 Compliance: Verify that processes within the distribution center are aligned with Bosch’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ISO 9001 standards, ensuring all processes are documented and compliant with quality standards.
• Internal Audits: Conduct regular internal audits to assess compliance with QMS and ISO 9001 requirements, documenting findings and reporting deviations from the processes or standards.
• Deviations and Corrective Actions: Report deviations from processes or standards in a timely manner. Ensure that countermeasures are implemented for immediate containment and that corrective actions are taken to address non-conformities.
• Quality Reporting: Compile and document daily reports on VQ audits performed, non-conformities found, and corrective actions taken. Ensure timely and accurate communication and documentation in compliance with Bosch standards.
• ISIR Inspections: Perform Initial Sample Inspection Reports (ISIR) inspections for new materials, ensuring that products meet quality requirements before being introduced into the distribution process.
• Method Support and Coaching: Support and assist in quality method coaching, including FMEA moderation and problem-solving techniques, to ensure continuous improvement and adherence to quality standards.
• Problem Solving: Assist in resolving non-conformities and quality issues by contributing to root cause analysis and the implementation of corrective actions.
• Quality Improvement: Participate in quality improvement initiatives, contributing to the enhancement of operational processes and product quality.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

• High school diploma or GED required.
• Experience with Bosch Production System (BPS) and familiarity with ISO 9001 quality standards and their application in the distribution environment.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Technical Expertise:Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 standards.Experience in conducting internal audits and verifying process compliance.Familiarity with FMEA, root cause analysis, and problem-solving methodologies.Knowledge of product quality assurance, especially in engineering and distribution processes.
• Professional Skills:Strong communication skills to report findings and collaborate with team members.Ability to support and assist in quality improvement initiatives.Analytical skills for problem-solving and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
• Behavioral Skills:Strong teamwork orientation and ability to support quality functions across departments.Attention to detail and ability to follow established quality processes.Resilience and adaptability in handling challenges and continuous process improvements.

Working Conditions

• Ability to work scheduled hours in accordance with Bosch policies, including potential overtime.
• Ability to work in various environmental conditions common to a warehouse setting (e.g., varying temperatures, noise levels).

By choice, we are committed to a diverse workforce - EOE/Protected Veteran/Disabled.

BOSCH is a proud supporter of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering & Mathematics) Initiatives

• FIRST Robotics (For Inspiration and Recognition of Science and Technology)
• AWIM (A World In Motion)

Thanks to the work of every associate, Bosch has been recognized for award-winning culture by the following organizations:

jobs.title: Patient Access Specialist
jobs.description:
The Patient Access Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NMHC, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Consistently practices Patients First philosophy and adheres to high standards of customer service. This includes setting an example to peers, coworkers, etc. by fostering a team atmosphere.
• Responds to questions and concerns.
• Forwards, directs, and notifies Team Lead or Operations Coordinator of extraordinary issues as necessary.
• Maintains patient confidentiality per HIPAA regulations.
• Provides exceptional customer service to patients which establish a positive first impression of Northwestern Medicine.
• Exceeds all consumer requests and alerts management of issues or concerns that require escalation.
• Correctly identifies and collects patient demographic information in accordance with organization standards.
• Interacts with various hospital departments and physicians offices to effectively schedule and direct patients through the NMHC systems in a patient/customer friendly manner.

jobs.title: Sales Leadership Trainer
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

The best sellers and managers remember the trainer who changed how they work. Be that person for Motive's upmarket teams: in the room, on the road, and accountable for win rates and manager behavior that measurably improve.

As Sales Trainer (US), a senior individual contributor role, you'll report to the Lead Enablement Business Partner, Enterprise Sales. You'll train across all GTM teams, with a primary focus on upmarket sales leaders, AEs and may also train CS, sales engineering, and other teams. You'll deliver deeper sales skills from our skills library, layered on the Motive Value Architecture (internal Sales Methodology), and own the definition of our manager and leadership coaching framework. Your first key project is building that framework for leaders at every level (or adapting what we have from our external skills vendors), tailored to Motive, and championing it with leaders until every level is bought into the same way of coaching. You'll also run in-office sessions that help ramping reps reach their goals faster. You'll pair with the Sales Trainer in Pakistan, who covers PK and downmarket teams. Expect to travel 25 to 45% of the time.

What You'll Do:

• Deliver deeper sales skills from our external skills library, layered on the Motive Value Architecture, live and virtually across our offices and geographies. The core focus is the US, with San Francisco, Austin, and Nashville as frequent locations, and sessions may extend to Canada, Mexico, and the UK.

• Run drills, workshops, and roleplays that measurably raise proficiency, and use AI roleplay tools to extend practice between sessions.

• Facilitate other methodologies where needed, including Challenger, and train CS, sales engineering, and other GTM teams as priorities require.

• Support upmarket accreditation with sessions, assessments, and coaching, working with the Upmarket Accreditation PM, the senior Accreditation PM on your team, who owns cross-segment accreditation standards.

• Own the manager and leadership coaching framework, defining the coaching behaviors expected of frontline managers in 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews, in partnership with sales leaders and the EBPs.

• Run cohort-based leadership programs for Motive's frontline sales managers on coaching, deal inspection, and pipeline management, and train managers before their reps.

• Give managers practical tools (coaching guides, inspection checklists, team drills) and reinforce until the habits stick.

• Measure what changes: coaching cadence and quality, team proficiency, win rate, deal velocity, pipeline health, and accreditation progress.

• Run a feedback loop with the Lead EBP, sales leaders, managers, and Sales Ops to sharpen programs each quarter.

• Pair with the PK Sales Trainer on shared materials and standards, partner with Role Readiness on new manager transitions, and connect your sessions to Kickoff, plays, and Skilljar content with the EBPs, Content & Academy, and GTM Activation.

What We're Looking For:

• 10+ years in sales training or enablement, plus quota-carrying sales experience, ideally selling upmarket or supporting complex enterprise sales in B2B SaaS.

• A facilitator senior sellers and leaders seek out, in person and virtually.

• You've defined a manager coaching framework and scaled frontline manager development in coaching, deal inspection, and pipeline management.

• You've tied training to results such as quota attainment, win rate, deal velocity, and pipeline health.

• You layer external sales skills content onto a company's own sales process, with facilitation experience in established methodologies (e.g., Challenger, Sandler, Command of the Message); certification a plus.

• You design drills, roleplays, and skill assessments, and use AI roleplay and call scoring tools.

• You run several programs at once and influence sales leaders you don't report to.

• Comfortable traveling 25 to 45% of the time.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Teaching AI to say yes is easy. Teaching it when to say ‘no,’ ‘I don’t know,’ or ‘let me get a human’ is the actual job. Our client is hiring an Applied AI Engineer to build the second kind.

The Applied AI Engineer designs, builds and tests the AI conversations and agents inside the client’s learner-facing products: advisory experiences, practice simulations and diagnostic coaching.

They work with Product, Content Studios, Engineering and subject-matter experts. They turn product and instructional requirements into reliable AI behavior, prove it through testing, and keep it performing after release.

This company is at the forefront of learning technologies, providing e-learning programs for professionals in regulated industries such as healthcare and finance. They’re constantly evolving and growing, run efficient Agile-first teams, and have a broadly distributed staff. They value good-natured, inquisitive, and methodical IT professionals who come prepared to collaborate and share their knowledge.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Turn scenario specs, decision models and assessment rubrics into prompts, application logic and testable behavior.

• Spot missing requirements and technical constraints, and raise them with Product, Engineering and SMEs.

• Define how AI models connect to application services and approved data sources: APIs, tool interactions, data structures, validation, error handling, permitted actions.

• Design prompts, structured outputs and validation logic, and catch invalid responses before they reach learners.

• Build conversational runtimes with controlled personas, session state and explicit state transitions.

• Keep simulation behavior, assessment logic and feedback separate, so feedback cannot change assessment results.

• Implement grounding and retrieval from approved knowledge sources, with source references where required.

• Keep code, prompts, schemas and evaluation assets under version control, and document them.

• Run bounded experiments with Product, with clear questions and success measures.

• Take validated prototypes into production with Engineering, and check behavior stays the same.

• Help build the technical controls that keep AI features compliant with accreditation requirements (issue flagging, review steps, disclosure, logging).

What are the required skills?

• Expert prompt and context engineering: system prompts, few-shot examples, prompt chaining, routing, breaking complex tasks into steps

• Structured outputs with JSON Schema, function calling and validation layers, with retry and fallback logic

• RAG design: chunking, metadata filtering, hybrid search, reranking, citation grounding

• Managing token budgets, prompt caching, context compaction and long-session memory

• Agentic systems: tool use, planner/executor patterns, multi-agent orchestration, state machines, human-in-the-loop checkpoints

• Defining tool schemas, permission scopes and action limits for agents

• AI evaluation: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, LLM-as-judge calibrated against human raters, regression testing

• LLM observability and tracing

• LLM security: prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks, unsafe tool actions, and guardrails

• Comparing prompting, retrieval and model options on quality, latency and cost

• Python or TypeScript, including API integrations and automated testing

• Git (e.g. Bitbucket), reproducible tests and CI

• Works with AI coding agents by default

• Explains technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues

• Sound judgment on privacy, human oversight and the limits of AI-generated assessment or advice

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications with multi-step conversational workflows

• Experience collaborating with subject-matter experts

Preferred

• Background in learning products, assessment, simulations or regulated professional content

If this looks interesting, please use the form below to apply! Remember, this is a fully remote, long-term opportunity :)

jobs.title: Mid Market CSM
jobs.description:
Envoy protects the places the world relies on most by unifying people, spaces, and communications in one secure, integrated workplace management platform and ecosystem. More than 16,000 workplaces around the world trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location.



From manufacturing sites and data centers to pharmaceutical labs, healthcare facilities, and corporate headquarters, Envoy makes safety, security and associated regulatory compliance something our customers can be proud of. The industry is littered with box-checking and arcane manual processes as the standard and we see our role as the company to bring experience, efficiency and simplicity everywhere. Great experiences bring great security – it's a requirement. We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Envoy, we believe in delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager, you'll own a book of 70–80 customers and make sure each one gets real, measurable value from the Envoy platform, from implementation through adoption to renewal.  - Build a success plan with clear metrics for every customer so they can see the business value they get from Envoy.

 - Spot low-usage and high-risk accounts early, and drive adoption, account health, and retention.

 - Partner with our Renewal Managers on renewals, including multi-year conversions, by making sure every customer reaches renewal with proven value.

 - Source expansion pipeline in your book and collaborate with AEs and RMs to help drive expansion conversion.

 - Use and help build tools, especially AI-powered technology, to deliver value to many accounts at once through email campaigns, trainings and webinars, new collateral, and office hours.

 - Turn happy customers into advocates who participate with Envoy on case studies, references, and testimonials.

 - Be the Voice of the Customer: drive escalations to resolution, gather and manage product feedback, and bring customers into product research.

 - Keep account records current and retention forecasts accurate.


YOU ARE 

 - Passionate about helping customers achieve stellar results.

 - An exceptional writer and verbal communicator.

 - Highly organized and autonomous.

 - Comfortable and energized operating in a fast-moving organization.

 - Passionate about technology and working with growing mid-market businesses.

 - Entrepreneurial and self-motivated.

 - Consultative, with demonstrable experience.

 - Enthusiastic about learning and growing at Envoy.

 - Intellectually curious and ambitious.


YOU HAVE

 - 3+ years in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success or Account Management at a B2B SaaS company.

 - Expertise managing the post-sale customer lifecycle across a book of 50–100 accounts.

 - Strong prioritization skills that let you run high-touch and tech-touch strategies at the same time.

 - A track record of identifying expansion opportunities and partnering with sales teams to close them.

 - Terrific presentation skills, with executive and end-user audiences alike.

 - The ability to use data to reach your customers' goals as well as your own internal goals.

 - Passion and skill using AI tools to work faster and scale your impact.

YOU'LL GET

 - An opportunity to partner and collaborate with other talented people.

 - An inclusive community where you feel welcomed and cared for as a person.

 - The ability to make an immediate impact in helping customers create a great workplace experience.

The Forward Deployed Design Lead — Planning is embedded directly with customer planning teams as the primary experience and implementation owner for Avathon's Planning deployments, starting with integrated demand planning. You live at the intersection of supply chain planning expertise and experience design, responsible for configuring, implementing, and continuously improving how demand planners, supply planners, and S&OP leaders actually use Avathon's platform and its AI planning agents day to day.

You will spend Monday through Thursday with client planning teams, in demand reviews and S&OP meetings, and in working sessions — translating real planning processes into configured solutions, designing the workbenches and exception workflows planners will rely on every cycle, and driving adoption from go-live through steady-state operations. Fridays are typically remote for synthesis, documentation, and collaboration with Avathon's Planning product and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Planning Implementation & Configuration

• Own end-to-end implementation of Avathon's Planning product at client sites — configuring product and location hierarchies, demand segmentation, forecast models and parameters, planning horizons, and time buckets to match each customer's planning process

• Lead functional configuration of demand planning: statistical and ML forecasting, demand sensing, collaborative demand review, consensus planning, forecast value-add (FVA), and bias and accuracy analytics

• Configure the flow from the consensus demand plan into supply decisions — demand-supply matching, inventory positioning, allocation, and S&OP scenarios — so planners can see the trade-offs

• Set up and validate integrations between Avathon's platform and client ERP, MES, and PLM systems (SAP, Oracle) — ensuring sales history, orders, BOMs, inventory, and master data flow accurately

• Bring B2B demand signals into the plan — customer contracts, project forecasts, production schedules, commodity indices, and macro indicators — validating their quality before they feed the forecast

• Conduct go-live readiness assessments — backtesting forecast accuracy and verifying configuration, user access, data completeness, and integration health before each deployment milestone

Experience Design & Workflow Mapping

• Lead onsite discovery sessions — interviewing demand planners, supply planners, sales, finance, and S&OP leaders to map the as-is planning cycle and define the future-state experience on Avathon's platform

• Design how planners supervise, collaborate with, and override AI planning agents that generate forecasts, flag exceptions, and recommend supply actions — with clear explanations and a full audit trail

• Produce implementation-grade design artifacts: annotated screen flows, planner workbench layouts, exception and alert rules, review and approval workflows, and role-based view specifications — directly actionable by the engineering team

• Design and validate the end-user experience within Avathon's Planning product: forecast review grids, exception queues, scenario comparisons, and S&OP dashboards — optimized for planners managing thousands of item-location combinations

• Facilitate working sessions with client stakeholders to validate designs against real planning cycles (weekly demand reviews, monthly S&OP) — iterating on planner feedback before configuration is finalized

• Ensure designs account for the realities of planning work: cycle deadlines, cross-functional handoffs, entrenched spreadsheet habits, and the trust planners need before accepting machine-generated forecasts

Client Engagement & Delivery

• Act as the day-to-day client contact for all design, configuration, and adoption activities — building trusted working relationships with planners, supply chain leaders, and S&OP owners

• Facilitate weekly client working sessions, design reviews, and sprint demos that keep stakeholders aligned, engaged, and confident in the deployment's progress

• Maintain implementation documentation — configuration logs, integration specs, training materials, and acceptance test records — that serve as the client's operational handbook post go-live

• Partner with Avathon's Planning product team to turn repeated deployment requests into reusable product requirements, and contribute configuration patterns to delivery playbooks that accelerate future implementations

• Identify opportunities to expand Avathon's footprint within accounts — additional product lines, sites, user populations, or adjacent planning modules (supply, inventory, S&OP) — and surface them to the engagement director

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning software implementation, professional services, or a UX/design role embedded in client-facing delivery — with hands-on configuration and deployment ownership

• Demonstrated demand planning domain knowledge: statistical and ML forecasting, demand sensing, segmentation, FVA, accuracy and bias metrics (MAPE, WMAPE, bias), and how demand plans drive supply, inventory, and S&OP decisions

• Hands-on experience implementing or configuring planning platforms: Blue Yonder, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP, Oracle SCM, RELEX, Anaplan, Aera, Coupa Supply Chain (LLamasoft), or similar

• Familiarity with ERP, MES, and PLM data (SAP, Oracle) and how it flows into planning — comfortable using SQL and Excel to validate sales history, orders, BOMs, inventory, and master data

• Strong UX and design execution skills — able to produce annotated wireframes, workbench layouts, and workflow diagrams that engineering teams can build directly from (Figma preferred)

• Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows for AI or ML recommendations — explainability, overrides, approvals, and audit trails

• Proven ability to facilitate discovery sessions and working meetings with mixed audiences of planners, sales, finance, and supply chain leadership — translating planning complexity into clear, actionable design decisions

• Experience designing and delivering end-user training programs for enterprise planning software

• Comfort with agile delivery rhythms: sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterating rapidly based on user feedback in live client environments

• Excellent written communication — able to produce configuration documentation, SOPs, and training guides that planners with varying technical backgrounds can follow independently

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, Computer Science, Industrial Design, or a related field

• Experience working in or closely with industrial B2B supply chains — manufacturing, mining, energy, or aerospace — is highly valued

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 80%; based in Pleasanton, CA or Austin, TX

Compensation & Benefits

• California Base Salary: $170,000 - $200,000

• Equity in the form of stock options

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) participation

• Generous PTO and company holidays

• All travel expenses covered per Avathon policy

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Vice President, Treasury & Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

The Vice President, Treasury & Enterprise Risk Management is a strategic thought partner who provides leadership for the organization’s capital structure, financing, liquidity, investment management, foreign exchange and interest-rate risk, working capital, Enterprise Risk Management, and Corporate Insurance programs. This role maintains stewardship of the organization’s liquid assets and debt, including cash and investment management, debt covenant compliance, and critical commercial and investment banking relationships, and rating agency relationships. The VP oversees the Enterprise Risk Management framework, partnering with business leaders to identify, assess, prioritize, monitor, mitigate, measure, and report on strategic, financial, operational, regulatory, and emerging risks. This role also oversees the Corporate Insurance program, including coverage strategy, policy placement and renewals, broker and carrier relationships, claims management and administration, and evaluation of insurance, self-insurance, risk-transfer, and risk-avoidance alternatives. As a collaborative business partner, the VP works with operating and functional leaders to ensure Treasury, Enterprise Risk Management, and Corporate Insurance support the organization’s strategic objectives, including strategic growth and investments.

Responsibilities

• Leads Treasury strategy focused on optimal capital structure, efficiency of financing and uses of liquidity.
• Acts as Treasury and Risk Management liaison for all strategic investment activity, inclusive of M&A.
• Identifies, evaluates, and recommends actions to manage the organization’s interest rate risk and foreign exchange risk.
• Provides oversight for global working capital needs and cash forecasting; establishes working capital optimization initiatives.
• Directs development and revision of financial policies for cash, investments, capital structure, working capital, treasury operations, foreign exchange and interest rate risk management, and insurance and other areas of risk management.
• Develops and maintains relationships with commercial and investment banks.
• Provides oversight and strategic decision-making advice related to debt instruments, including maintaining compliance with all debt instruments.
• Assists in developing plans for cash investments and capital requirements, including maintenance of intercompany loan positions, direct revolver utilization and alternative capital sources.
• Ensures that the investment portfolio is structured in compliance with the organization’s Investment Policy.
• Manages the organization's cash management activities including: communicating the daily cash position, establishing bank accounts, and managing all banking and treasury activities through the treasury management system.
• Manages the organization’s cash forecasting activities including: short- and long-term cash forecast accuracy and alignment to overall budget and forecasting processes, accuracy and reporting of cash forecasting for internal, executive, and regulatory reporting, and consideration of strategic and other investments impact to the cash forecast.
• Works with other leaders within the Finance function to develop short and long term cash management and debt management strategies in line with the organization’s strategic plan.
• Provides executive oversight of the Corporate Insurance program, including coverage strategy, policy placement and renewals, program administration, and the evaluation of insurance, self-insurance, risk-transfer, and risk-avoidance alternatives.
• Oversees relationships with brokers, carriers, underwriters, consultants, and third-party claims administrators to support appropriate coverage, competitive pricing, and effective claims management.
• Reviews coverage adequacy, loss experience, claims trends, emerging exposures, and total cost of risk; recommends program improvements as appropriate.
• Oversee insurance due diligence and risk-transfer considerations for significant contracts, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions.
• Evaluate corporate and operational risks, which can be mitigated with insurance, and make recommendations regarding insurance, self-insurance and avoidance strategies.
• Regularly evaluate alternative risk transfer structures, including alternative risk transfer vehicles, providing advice regarding risk transfer opportunities to executive management.
• Manage insurance relationships (brokers, underwriters) and ensure competitive pricing; administer annual renewals and premium payment process.
• Oversee administration of claims by third-party claims administrators under the organization’s insurance programs.
• Develops and oversees internal controls designed to safeguard corporate assets and ensures standardization of processes for banking and treasury activities are SOX compliant.
• Develops and manages strategies, operations, policies and budgets relating to treasury and risk management activities.
• Provides oversight of the organization’s Enterprise Risk Management framework, including the identification, assessment, prioritization, monitoring, and reporting of strategic, financial, operational, regulatory, and emerging risks.
• Partners with business leaders and risk owners to promote consistent risk-management practices, monitor mitigation plans, and escalate significant exposures.
• Oversee enterprise risk reporting to senior management and the Board, including key risk indicators, risk trends, and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.
• Ensure risk considerations and risk metrics are incorporated into strategic planning, major investments, mergers and acquisitions, and other significant business decisions.
• Serves as financial leader, as Treasurer, Covista Foundation, along with other committees providing oversight to financial decisions.
• Completes other duties as assigned.
• Performs other duties as assigned
• Complies with all policies and standards

• Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business or Accounting required.
• MBA Preferred
• CPA preferred
• 15+ years of progressively responsible banking and treasury experience with at least five years in a management position as well as exposure to Enterprise Risk Management required.
• Deep understanding of capital markets, international cash management and foreign exchange risk management.
• Understanding of financial forecasting and/or planning, money markets, FX and capital markets, as appropriate.
• Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skill set; ability to take large volumes of information and present it in a clear and concise manner to senior management, the Board and the global investor community.
• Understanding of financial modeling techniques and valuation methods used by analysts and investors.
• Knowledge of SEC laws and securities disclosure and filing requirements.
• Must be a strong leader with the ability to work independently.
• Strong project management skills.
• Excellent communication and analytical skills.

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected salary range for this position is between $220,000 and $296,747.32. Actual pay will be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements. The position qualifies for the below benefits.

Covista offers a robust suite of benefits including:

You are also eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Research Internship, AI for Neuroscience
jobs.description:
Persons in these roles are expected to work from our offices in Seattle. On-site requirements vary based on position and team. If you have questions about on-site work arrangements for this role, please ask your recruiter.

*Compensation dependent on current degree enrollment.
Research Intern, Undergrad: $94,320 (Annually)
Research Intern, Masters: $106,110 (Annually)
Research Intern, PhD: $140,000 (Annually)

Who You Are:

Are you passionate about AI, and its potential to help accelerate science?

Ai2's Asta Project (https://allenai.org/asta) aims to rapidly advance science, developing solutions in the areas of AI research assistants for scientists, literature understanding and synthesis, end-to-end discovery, human-AI interaction and intelligent interfaces, data-driven discovery, agents that can learn over time, methods for training agentic models, and the evaluation and benchmarking of agents.

Part of this work is conducted within a scientific domain rather than alongside one. We collaborate directly with research scientists at the Allen Institute and elsewhere on their primary data, including electrophysiology, single-cell, and spatial transcriptomic measurements of human brain tissue. Our aim is to build agentic workflows that meet the standards of rigorous scientific work and to push the tools we already have to their full potential in support of research that is only now possible with AI. Doing this well depends on knowing when an  AI-generated hypothesis or causal claim is scientifically sound, and this calls for researchers who can evaluate such a claim against the underlying biology. We welcome applications from candidates trained in neuroscience or another life science who bring strong computational skills to that training.

We are seeking ambitious researchers with a background in biology or neuroscience, prepared to take on problems at the frontier of AI for science. You will be working on a neuroscience project, helping to find ways to use and advance asta tools to rapidly advance neuroscience research.

Topics you can explore during the internship:

• Agentic planning, reasoning, learning, and evaluation.

• AI workflows for scientific discovery.

• Data-driven discovery (integrating your own or publicly available sequencing or electrophysiology dataset with AI workflows)

• Evaluation of AI-generated hypotheses, causal claims, and analyses against experimental data and domain expertise.

• AI workflows incorporating scientific literature and automated hypothesis generation and testing.

See our publications for examples of our work.

https://allenai.org/papers?tags=Asta

We will continue to consider applications on a rolling basis but for full consideration for start dates in summer 2027, please apply by December 1, 2026 to be included in the first round of reviews.

Ai2 Research Internship Information:

• Duration: 12 weeks

• Start Date: Flexible

• Candidates: A PhD student with a strong research background

Who We Are:

The Asta Research Team (Semantic Scholar and Aristo based in Seattle) at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) is an interdisciplinary research team focused on AI, HCI, ML, and NLP in support of our mission of accelerating science with intelligent and interactive research assistants. We regularly publish in high-profile conferences in NLP (e.g., ACL, EMNLP), HCI (e.g., CHI, UIST, CSCW), ML (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR), IR (e.g., SIGIR), and Accessibility (ASSETS). A portion of this work is conducted jointly with domain scientists, on their datasets and their open research questions.

Your Next Challenge:

Research interns on our team will have the opportunity to:

• Conduct high-impact research and author scientific papers for publication in high-profile computing and scientific venues.

• Collaborate with and learn from a dedicated Ai2 mentor and other team members across Ai2, including scientists and engineers.

To see more about our current, future, and past interns at Ai2, check out the  internship page on our website!

What You’ll Need:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in neuroscience, biology, or a related life science, or in a computational discipline with biological research experience.

• Demonstrated independent experience in performing and integrating biological research and computational analysis. Please reference the resulting publication, preprint, thesis chapter, code repository, or dataset. Peer-reviewed publication is not a requirement.

• Familiarity with Python, using AI agents for scientific data analysis (Claude Code, Claude for Science, Asta, Codex, etc.) and constructing reproducible analysis pipelines.

• Familiarity with the analysis of primary experimental data, including the judgment required to assess data quality and work within its limitations.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

• Must be able to remain in a stationary position for long periods of time.

• The ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

• The ability to observe details at close range.

• Can work under deadlines.

A Little More About Ai2:

Ai2 is a Seattle based non-profit AI research institute founded in 2014 by the late Paul Allen. Our mission is building breakthrough AI to solve the world’s biggest problems. We develop foundational AI research and innovation to deliver real-world impact through large-scale open models, data, robotics, conservation, and beyond.

In addition to Ai2’s core mission, we also aim to contribute to humanity through our treatment of each member of the Ai2 Team. Some highlights are:

• We are a learning organization – because everything Ai2 does is ground-breaking, we are learning every day. With a wide variety of world-class AI experts as guest speakers, and our commitment to your personal on-going education, Ai2 is a place where you will have opportunities to continue learning alongside your coworkers.

• We value diversity - We seek to hire, support, and promote people from all genders, ethnicities, and all levels of experience regardless of age. We particularly encourage applications from women, non-binary individuals, people of color, members of the LGBTQA+ community, and people with disabilities of any kind.

• We value inclusion - We understand the value that people's individual experiences and perspectives can bring to an organization, and we are building a culture in which all voices are heard, respected and considered.

• We emphasize a healthy work/life balance – we believe our team members are happiest and most productive when their work/life balance is optimized. While we value powerful research results which drive our mission forward, we also value dinner with family, weekend time, and vacation time. We offer generous paid vacation and sick leave as well as family leave.

• We are collaborative and transparent – we consider ourselves a team, all moving with a common purpose. We are quick to cheer our successes, and even quicker to share and jointly problem solve our failures.

• We are in Seattle – and our office is on the water! We have mountains, we have lakes, we have four seasons, we bike to work, we have a vibrant theater scene, and we have so much else. We welcome interest from applicants from outside of the United States.

• We are friendly– chances are you will like every one of the 200+ (and growing) people who work here. We do.

Ai2 is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. You may view the related Know Your Rights compliance poster and the Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision by clicking on their corresponding links.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to employees and applicants with disabilities to the full extent required by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). If you feel you need a reasonable accommodation pursuant to the ADA, you are encouraged to contact us at recruiting@allenai.org.

Benefits:

• Team members and their families are covered by medical, dental, vision, and an employee assistance program.

• Team members are able to enroll in our health savings account plan, our healthcare reimbursement arrangement plan, and our health care and dependent care flexible spending account plans.

• Team members will receive $125 per month to assist with commuting or internet expenses and will also receive $200 per month for fitness and wellbeing expenses.

• Team members will accrue sick days per year in line with Seattle sick time requirements. If you are usually scheduled to work on a holiday that Ai2 recognizes as a day off, you will be paid for this day.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role:

Curri is hiring its first dedicated Senior Security Engineer to join the Foundations team, which owns security, infrastructure, DevOps, and our AI engineering platform. Curri runs last-mile logistics for national retailers, industrial suppliers, and a growing list of Fortune 500 customers, and as we scale after our Series C, the security bar is rising fast. This is a builder role, not a monitoring role: you'll own security across our applications, cloud, and AI agents, write the tooling and guardrails that make the secure path the easy path, and be the person engineers, leadership, and customers trust to make the call on risk. As the first hire into this role, you'll shape how security works at Curri for years to come.

What you will do:

 - Own application and cloud security end to end: threat modeling, secure design reviews, and hands-on work on sensitive code paths across our TypeScript/Node GraphQL API, React and React Native apps, Go services, and AWS/EKS infrastructure defined in Pulumi.

 - Build internal security tooling and guardrails instead of gates, such as authentication services, access proxies, secrets handling, policy-as-code, and CI checks that developers barely notice until they save them.

 - Secure our AI-forward engineering platform. Curri runs autonomous agents that review, write, and deploy code; you'll own their access boundaries, credential handling, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trail, along with the policies for how staff use AI tools.

 - Turn our security scanning (SAST, secrets, container, and IaC) into a program with signal: tune it, triage it, and drive findings to closure against clear SLAs.

 - Stand up detection and response: build high-signal alerting across cloud, identity, and application logs, lead security incidents, and make sure postmortem follow-through actually happens.

 - Run the vulnerability lifecycle: scope and manage external penetration tests, validate and prioritize findings, partner with teams on fixes, and verify closure.

 - Partner on compliance and customer trust: help run our SOC 2 program, answer enterprise security reviews, and turn what customers ask for into program improvements, not just questionnaire answers.

 - Raise the security bar of the whole engineering team by mentoring engineers on secure design patterns, especially authorization, identity, and multi-tenant data isolation, and making security a normal part of how we ship.

 - Communicate risk clearly to engineers, executives, and customers in the terms that matter to each, and help shape the security roadmap as the function grows.

What you need to have:

 - 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering and/or security, including at least 3 years focused on application, product, or cloud security.

 - A track record of designing and building secure web applications, APIs, and internal tools. You read and write production code and are credible in a code review.

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of web and API vulnerabilities, especially authorization flaws (IDOR/BOLA), authentication and SSO (SAML, OIDC, JWT), SSRF, and injection, and how to find and fix them at scale.

 - Strong cloud security experience in AWS and Kubernetes: IAM, network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and infrastructure as code.

 - Experience leading security incidents, ideally as the person in charge, with calm, diligent response and clear communication.

 - The ability to work as a team of one: you prioritize by real risk, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship without a playbook handed to you.

 - Fluency with AI-paired delivery (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent), and a clear view of the new risks AI agents and LLM-integrated apps introduce.

 - Strong, direct communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and empathy for the developers and customers you're protecting.

Bonus points for:

jobs.title: Video Editor/Shooter
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is hiring a Video Editor & Shooter to create compelling, finished video for our content and social channels. Editing and social storytelling are the core of this role. You’ll find the story in footage, bring strong editorial recommendations, and own edits from selects through final delivery. You’ll also shoot executive content, interviews, events, and other planned capture. You’ll be one of the first two hires in a dedicated Content & Social (C&S) creative pod, alongside its creative lead. 

The role sits within the Harvey Creative Studio (HCS) for creative leadership, craft, and brand standards, with the C&S roadmap determining workload and priorities. Broader HCS projects are staffed separately.


You’ll work directly with C&S leads from briefing through delivery and with the pod’s creative lead on narrative and editorial direction. The creative lead retains overall narrative responsibility and accountability for the work through delivery. You own the editing craft and delivery of finished assets within that direction.


The Work You Will Support
The initial planning mix for the pod includes:

 - Supporting 1–3 recurring series each month, including executive content.

 - Covering 2–3 events per month and turning captured footage into content for our channels.

 - Producing product videos with Product Marketing and relevant HCS teams, including an ongoing cadence of feature videos, explainers, use cases, and demonstrations beyond launch.

 - Recurring series generally have longer planning cycles. Event and product launch work often needs a turnaround of one to two weeks. The creative lead and C&S agree the pod’s workload and resourcing upfront, including deliverables, capture, editing time, and reviews.

 - For product launches, this pod owns the content and social assets on its roadmap. Larger campaign and demo productions remain with the relevant HCS teams, with messaging, footage, and delivery handoffs coordinated upfront.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

Editing and Social Storytelling

 - Own edits from footage review and selects through finished assets ready for each platform, using footage you capture and material supplied by other teams.

 - Find the story in interviews, event footage, and product content. Recommend hooks, structure, pacing, and cutdowns that deliver the message and fit the audience and channel.

 - Finish videos with captions, on-screen text, basic graphics, music, sound design, audio mixing, and color correction. Deliver the required aspect ratios and channel versions.

 - Build and refine recurring formats with the creative lead and C&S. Use audience response and available performance insights to recommend editorial improvements.

 - Manage versions and feedback through final export, checking message clarity, caption accuracy, picture, sound, and platform specifications. 

Shooting and Planned Capture

 - Shoot executive content, interviews, events, and other capture planned on the C&S roadmap, with reliable camera, lighting, and audio setups.

 - Translate the brief and creative direction into practical capture plans and shot lists. Capture the coverage needed for the planned edits and channel versions.

 - Help executives and other non-professional talent feel comfortable on camera, working from the creative lead’s direction and agreed interview approach.

 - Coordinate capture and editing time with the creative lead and production support, raising resource needs early so planned shoots and finished asset delivery are both covered.

Collaboration and Delivery

 - Work day to day with C&S leads and the pod’s creative lead to confirm the message, audience, channel, deliverables, and timing before work begins.

 - Follow the approval model: C&S owns content and platform fit; HCS owns creative execution, craft, and brand standards. Incorporate both sets of feedback into the final assets.

 - Collaborate with copywriting support, when assigned, on scripts, interview preparation, and paper edits, with the creative lead retaining overall narrative ownership.

 - Partner with [named production owner to confirm], who owns scheduling, vendors, budgets, and shoot logistics. Provide capture requirements and flag capacity conflicts so editing time is protected.

Media and Equipment

 - Maintain organized project files, footage backups, templates, LUTs, export presets, and reusable assets so edits and handoffs move efficiently.

 - Keep the camera, lighting, and audio kit used for your shoots organized and ready. Handle routine setup and care, and flag repair, rental, or additional crew needs to the production owner.





WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of professional video editing experience, with a portfolio showing consistent delivery of strong social content.

 - Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, including captions, basic graphics, color correction, audio mixing, and exports for different channels.

 - Strong editorial judgment: you can find a clear story in footage and explain your recommendations on hooks, pacing, structure, and format.

 - Experience developing or improving recurring social formats and using audience response to inform the next edit.

 - Hands-on shooting skills for interviews, executive content, and events, including camera, lighting, and audio, with a calm approach to non-professional talent.

 - Experience balancing planned programming with shorter production timelines, managing feedback, and delivering finished work on schedule.

 - Clear communication, reliable media organization, and the judgment to raise scope or capacity issues early. Flexibility for planned event coverage, travel, and occasional early or late shoots.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience on a dedicated content or social team at a technology, SaaS, or B2B company.

 - Experience editing product demonstrations, screen recordings, explainers, or use-case videos.

 - Interest in AI, the legal industry, and making complex products understandable through video.





COMPENSATION

$159,200 - $225,000 USD

jobs.description:
This role will be based in Bellevue, WA.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Drive the development of LinkedIn's next-generation, public-cloud-grade blob storage platform. Guide the blob storage team to establish a scalable, durable, secure, and cost-effective storage foundation supporting LinkedIn's online services as well as offline data and AI operations. You will partner with defining the architectural vision and strategic roadmap, cultivate a high-performing engineering team, and collaborate with internal partners across LinkedIn to deliver high throughput, low latency, and scalable automated operations.

Construct an S3-compatible, public-cloud-grade blob storage system designed to support a wide range of LinkedIn workloads, such as Media, Ads, CTR, tracking events, analytics, AI/ML training, checkpointing, and artifact distribution. Streamline integration through seamless client adoption, robust multi-tenancy controls, quota management, and comprehensive observability. Optimize system performance by balancing throughput, latency, availability, durability, and cost using tailored replication and erasure-coding strategies. Scale capacity seamlessly to exabytes while reducing operational overhead through automated capacity management, self-healing recovery, continuous testing, and proactive rebalancing.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach and manage core team of engineers working on building the infrastructure.
• Participate with senior management in developing a long-term technology roadmap for the team and company.

• Communicate and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across engineering and business leadership.
• Help the team realize their potential by setting clear expectations, openly evaluating performance, upholding accountability, and providing challenges to stretch their skills.
• Drive a culture of operational excellence. Lead the team into defining performance goals, metrics and building the infrastructure and tooling necessary to maintain a high quality bar and detect issues in real time.
• Create an inclusive work environment that fosters autonomy, transparency, innovation and learning, while holding a high bar for quality.
• You will provide technical leadership, driving and performing best engineering practices to initiate, plan, and execute critical, large-scale, cross-functional, and company-wide programs.

Basic Qualifications

• BS/BA in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent related experience
• 1+ year(s) of management experience or 1+ year(s) of staff level engineering experience with management training
