jobs.title: Member of Product Staff, Core Product
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABRIDGE

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

THE ROLE

Core Product is responsible for how doctors and nurses use Abridge every day, and how deeply and broadly they engage with it. That covers the notes clinicians rely on after every visit, how care moves across the inpatient stay and the emergency department, the assistant clinicians ask questions of, nursing workflows, and the voice, mobile, and desktop experiences that clinician’s use.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own one of these areas end to end. You'll spend real time with clinicians, turn what you learn into product conviction, and ship with engineering, design, machine learning, and clinical science. Success means clinicians who come back to Abridge again and again, and health systems that can see the time saved and value created.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York. Please only apply or consider this opportunity if you are open to Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in office or relocation. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own product strategy and execution for your area. Define the vision and roadmap, decide what to build and what not to build, and own the outcomes.

 - Earn clinician love. Do deep discovery with physicians, nurses, and advanced practice providers across ambulatory, inpatient, and ED settings. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate on adoption, retention, and perceived time saved.

 - Ship AI experiences clinicians trust. Partner with ML and clinical science to define quality bars and evals. Design for uncertainty and edge cases, and know where AI shouldn't be used.

 - Make Abridge part of the workflow. Work across EHR integrations (Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and Abridge's own surfaces so the experience fits how clinicians already work.

 - Grow depth and breadth of engagement. Set clear success metrics, such as active use, retention, workflows per clinician, and time saved, and drive them across care settings and roles.

 - Prototype to build conviction. Use AI coding tools to sharpen your own thinking and get the team aligned before engineering commits.

 - Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of user-facing products you launched, not just optimized.

 - Hands-on AI/ML product experience with specifics. You've shipped AI features and have opinions on what makes them good or bad.

 - A visible building habit. You prototype, build with AI tools daily, and can show us something you made recently.

 - Strong product taste and user empathy. You describe a product by starting with the user and how it feels to use.

 - Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, and ML teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to create structure, sequencing, and measurable outcomes where little exists.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including with clinical audiences.

BONUS POINTS IF…

 - You have a technical background (former engineer, or a CS/engineering degree).

 - You have worked with clinical SMEs, health system stakeholders, or in clinical, healthcare, or other regulated environments.

 - You have experience with EHRs like Epic, Cerner, or Meditech.

 - You have built productivity tools, workflow automation, ambient intelligence, or agentic products.

 - You have shipped products that deliver measurable operational or financial ROI.


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

 - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

 - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

 - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

 - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

 - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

 - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

 - ... and much more!


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis between November 2026 and March 2027. We encourage you to apply early, as we may close the posting once the program is filled.

What You'll Do

Our Values

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Manager
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how Legion prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount.

The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

• Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy.

• Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy.

• Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones.

• Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff.

• Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook.

• Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development.

• Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail.

• Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds.

• Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation.

• Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions.

• Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS companies, including 3+ years owning Deal Desk operations end to end. Demonstrated experience building Deal Desk processes from the ground up at an early-stage or growth-stage company, with the ability to walk through what was built, in what order, and what you would do differently. Hands-on AI practitioner who has used AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Agentforce) to automate real Deal Desk or RevOps work, with an example to share. Hands-on experience structuring and contracting international SaaS deals across multiple regions, currencies, and legal entities. Deep expertise in SaaS pricing — subscription, usage-based, consumption-based, and hybrid models — along with discount governance and contracting best practices. Experience implementing CPQ and CLM systems; strong modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets. Proven ability to influence without authority across Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, including saying no to senior sellers while keeping the relationship intact.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

• Experience launching AI, agentic, or data product SKUs, or partner and marketplace deal structures. Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM Experience in WFM, HCM, or enterprise SaaS selling to retail, hospitality, or healthcare. Operates with a builder’s mindset — proactive, resourceful, and eager to create clarity from ambiguity with a high degree of independence. Strong personal ownership, high integrity, and a focus on outcomes over activity. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Thrives in a collaborative, mission-driven environment and embraces change with enthusiasm. Flexibility to cover urgent deal approvals across time zones, especially at quarter-end.

SALARY RANGE:

Base Salary Range  $100,000 - $140,000 + Bonus + Stock Equity

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.

Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

jobs.description:
SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

As Counsel, Commercial and Product, you will help drive SeatGeek's growth on two fronts: facilitating deal negotiation and execution for our enterprise SaaS business, and partnering with our product teams to bring new features and experiences to market. You’ll work directly with business stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations and you’ll have real ownership from day one on a legal team that is still building the playbooks it will scale with.

What you'll do

Commercial

• Draft, negotiate, and structure complex enterprise SaaS and sponsorship agreements with major sports franchises and other strategic partners, managing deals from first draft through signature and working closely with our enterprise sales team and prospective clients

• Review, draft, and negotiate a wide variety of other commercial agreements and amendments, including analytics, product integration, licensing, professional services, and general vendor and operations agreements

• Lead negotiations directly with counterparties and their counsel, driving open issues to resolution and keeping deals moving on business timelines

• Create and update contract templates and playbooks as our business evolves and grows

• Help develop processes to ensure ongoing compliance with contractual commitments, and provide practical, solutions-oriented advice to help client teams navigate issues that arise in the customer relationship, such as service outages and SLA remedies

• Build strong, day-to-day relationships with our sales and business leaders as a responsive and reliable point of contact

Product

• Partner with product and business teams throughout all stages of product development, from ideation and design through testing and launch

• Proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate legal and regulatory risks at every stage of the product life cycle, balancing risk against business opportunity

• Provide commercially focused product counseling on product design, user flows, fan experience, and UX copy

• Advise on new products and features in the US and select international markets, including the evolving regulatory landscape for ticketing

• Establish and maintain product-related legal documentation, including terms of service, marketplace policies, and consumer-facing messaging

What you have

• J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school and admission to the New York bar, or eligibility to register as in-house counsel

• 3+ years of experience; law firm and in-house backgrounds both welcome, prior in-house exposure preferred, tech experience is a plus

• Strong transactional background, with a track record of drafting and negotiating complex agreements and running deals end to end

• Skilled, efficient drafter: you turn documents quickly and precisely and adapt as deal terms evolve

• Advanced problem-solving skills and excellent judgment - you’re able to quickly digest a problem, evaluate solutions, and then weigh options and recommend a clear path forward

• Ability to balance legal risk mitigation against key business objectives and risks

• Passion for solving legal problems with the ability to explain legal concepts to non-lawyers

• You are a clear communicator who explains legal risk to non-lawyers and works well across business and legal teams

Perks

• Equity stake

• Discretionary annual bonus

• Flexible work environment, allowing you to work as many days a week in the office as you’d like or 100% remotely

• A WFH stipend to support your home office setup

• Unlimited PTO

• Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave

• 401(k) matching

• Student loan matching program

• Health, vision, dental, and life insurance

• Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care

• $500 per year for wellness expenses

• Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical

• $360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events

• Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music

The salary range for this role is $151,000 - $218,000 USD. This role is equity eligible. In addition, you may receive a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation packages within that range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location.

jobs.title: Senior Product Builder, Field Experience and GTM, Fusus
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About the Role

Axon Fusus connects cameras, drones, sensors, and real-time information to help public safety teams understand what’s happening and respond effectively. As our capabilities expand, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services need to understand what we offer and what is coming next, explain its value, demonstrate it reliably, and help customers put it to use.

We’re looking for a hands-on product builder to own that field experience. Your responsibility is to make the way we launch, equip, and support our customer-facing teams dependable, and earn their trust through accurate information, useful experiences, and consistent follow-through.

This is an individual contributor role with broad ownership and a strong expectation to create. You’ll work directly with the field, decide which problems matter most, and build solutions using AI, software, and better ways of working. You’ll have a substantial AI budget and room to experiment, with accountability for turning promising ideas into improvements people can depend on.

What You’ll Own

• Understand the field and earn its trust. Spend time with sellers, CSMs, and PSO teams. Observe customer conversations, launch preparation, demos, and deployments. Understand where they struggle, what they distrust, and what would help them work confidently. Stay close enough to see whether your changes make a difference.

• Make launches work for the field. Drive consistent launch definitions and readiness expectations with Product and other owners. Ensure teams understand what is available, whom it serves, what they can promise, and how to explain, demonstrate, and deploy it. Follow through on gaps that leave the field unprepared.

• Publish quarterly roadmap updates. Set and share publication dates in advance each year. Work with Product to publish one deck covering everything available and what is expected over the next two quarters or by year-end. Confirm roadmap inputs with the responsible PMs, distinguish planned work from available capabilities, and explain what has changed since the last update. Keep the latest deck in the field resource.

• Make the product demonstrable. Learn Fusus deeply enough to personally demonstrate its capabilities and explain their value through realistic customer scenarios. Build reliable ways for the field to do the same, including working demo environments, representative data, connected devices and integrations, and repeatable setup and reset workflows. Use AI and automation to simplify preparation and check that demonstrations work. Keep these experiences current as the product changes, and test whether colleagues can successfully use them without your help.

• Build the experience end to end. Own how people find product information, get contextual answers, prepare for customers, run demos, and establish trials. Connect those activities into a coherent experience and take responsibility for the points where it breaks down.

• Personally create solutions. Use AI, automation, APIs, and lightweight software to move from an observed problem to something people can try. Build and evaluate assistants, tools, content, and workflows. Choose the approach based on what helps the field accomplish its work.

• Drive the organizational work. Resolve conflicting information, clarify ownership, and bring teams together to make decisions. Partner with Product, Engineering, and operational owners to address the dependencies behind unreliable demos, confusing availability, or difficult trial setup.

• Own adoption and ongoing improvement. Put solutions into everyday use, learn from failures, and keep improving them as the product changes. Establish clear ownership and maintenance practices so improvements remain dependable beyond their initial launch.

What You’ll Bring

• 8+ years in product management, engineering, or founding and running a product, with direct ownership of a technical product.

• Evidence that you have understood a customer problem, personally built a solution, and improved it through sustained use.

• Strong product judgment. You can identify the underlying problem, choose where to focus, and explain how your work contributes to the outcome.

• Practical experience building with AI, automation, or software. You can prototype, connect tools and data, troubleshoot failures, and evaluate whether a solution works reliably.

• The ability to learn a complex product hands-on and demonstrate it convincingly. You can turn a customer use case into a working product experience, diagnose what goes wrong, and make that experience repeatable for others.

• The ability to combine creative exploration with operational follow-through. You care about what happens after something ships.

• Clear writing and presentation skills, including the ability to turn detailed product plans into a roadmap the field can use. You can earn trust and drive work across teams.

• Judgment about information accuracy, access permissions, customer commitments, and when human review is necessary.

You might be an engineer who has grown into customer and product ownership, a product person who builds, or a founder or operator who has created useful products. Experience supporting Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or Professional Services, or working in product marketing or GTM enablement, is valuable. We welcome varied paths that demonstrate customer understanding, building ability, and ownership.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

Base Pay Range

$141,000—$225,600 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: Senior Staff R&D Engineer – Thermal-Fluids & Process Modeling
jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

Sila’s Process and Equipment R&D group is seeking a Senior Staff R&D Engineer to help tackle hard technical challenges as we scale up next-generation battery materials and first-of-a-kind manufacturing technology. This team dives deep into the core principles governing our products and their production — including reaction kinetics, energetics, transport phenomena, process & equipment architecture, and material properties – to develop the fundamental knowledge required to design technology and predict behavior at giga-factory scale. You’ll explore new reactions and their impacts, lead root-cause investigations, develop novel experimental approaches, and lead R&D projects.

You’re an engineer with a curiosity and drive to understand how things actually work. You have a tendency to crush problems completely, breaking them down to interpret the relevant physics, ensuring you have a fundamental understanding, then applying that to a robust solution. You don’t need to be a CFD expert, you’re an engineer with breadth, having learned a wide array of skills and domains to stay unblocked on a problem, whether they be 3D simulation, designing experimental hardware, or hands-on know-how of tube bending or soldering custom circuits - anything to get to the answer. You’ll split your time roughly evenly between modeling and experimentation, and lead the projects that tie them together. As part of a team of R&D engineers, you’ll help Sila build the foundation of knowledge required to reach Sila’s ultimate goals of delivering advanced battery materials at world-scale.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Lead R&D projects, including method selection, experimental design, preparation, execution, and analysis

• Apply the scientific method to technology problems and convert learnings into robust solutions

• Build and validate physics-based models — from 0D/1D/2D models in Python to 3D simulation in COMSOL or similar — for thermal-structural, reactive, and flow problems in high-temperature reactor systems, including fluidized beds, and use them to drive R&D and process and equipment design decisions.

• Identify and evaluate new technologies and tools that will enhance our capabilities

• Work closely with engineering teams (e.g. process, equipment, controls, manufacturing) to translate fundamental knowledge into practical applications

• Synthesize, contextualize, document, and communicate learnings for technical and non-technical audiences

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

• A track record of technical leadership and mentoring without formal authority, particularly leading and delivering experimental R&D projects

• Demonstrated use of physics-based models to drive real R&D outcomes, with the judgment to know when a 0D energy balance answers the question and when a 3D model is worth building, and the skill to design real-world validation experiments

• Demonstrated excellence in data analysis; data cleaning, validating, and interpreting large experimental and process datasets to reach defensible conclusions

• Strong laboratory testing aptitude, intuition for what will work and ability to execute quickly and effectively

• Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages and data analysis tools

• Understanding, and proven application of, physics and engineering fundamentals: heat transfer, fluids, structures, thermodynamics, reaction kinetics, transport phenomena, and materials.

• 10+ years of relevant professional experience; an MS or PhD counts towards this

Preferred:

• Hands-on COMSOL Multiphysics (heat transfer, structural, CFD modules) or comparable tools

• Experience with high-temperature gas–solid reactors or chemical vapor deposition

Education

• B.S. in engineering or physical sciences (e.g. Mechanical Engineering, Physics, etc.), advanced degrees preferred.

Location

• On-site in Alameda, CA.

• Up to 15% travel, domestic or international.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The work environment and physical demands are representative of those the employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

• Wear personal protective equipment including, but not limited to, a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, and steel toe safety shoes

• Pass a respirator fit test and be able to wear respiratory protection

• Use a glove box and/or fume hood for experiments

• Move items up to 50 lbs with the assistance of lift equipment and carts

• Move long distances (such as from building to building) and be stationary for extended periods of time

• Reach low shelves or items on the floor

• Climb stairs or over containment walls

• Operate a computer and other office equipment, such as a laptop, copier/printer, etc in a fixed location

The starting base pay for this role is between $172,000 and $218,000 at the time of posting. The actual base pay depends on many factors, such as education, experience, and skills. Base pay is only one part of Sila’s competitive Total Rewards package that can include benefits, perks, and equity.  The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Mountain Operations Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, guests, and company property by monitoring premises, enforcing policies, and responding to incidents. This role requires vigilance, professionalism, and the ability to handle emergency situations with confidence and efficiency. This position serves as the point of contact for matters involving violations of municipal and state laws. This position reports to Office Manager.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until November 20, 2026, for the Winter 24-25 Season.

Essential Job Functions

• Monitor and patrol assigned areas to prevent unauthorized access, theft, vandalism, and other security threats
• Enforce company policies and procedures to maintain a safe and secure environment
• Respond to alarms, emergencies, and incidents, aiding as needed and documenting all occurrences
• Control access to facilities by verifying credentials, checking identification, and screening visitors
• Conduct routine inspections of doors, windows, and other points of entry to ensure they are secure
• Assist in investigations by gathering information, reviewing surveillance footage, and providing detailed reports
• Provide excellent customer service while maintaining a strong security presence
• Act as liaison with the Police Department, other law enforcement agencies, and security companies
• Increase security of buildings through current crime prevention and security techniques
• Assist with crowd control at peak times in high-traffic areas
• Assist in overnight operations and responsibilities
• Other duties as assigned

Education and Experience Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent required
• Law Enforcement, security, or related field experience required
• Valid Driver's License Required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong observational skills with the ability to recognize unusual behavior and security risks
• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to interact with employees, guests, and emergency responders
• Ability to handle difficult customer interactions and ensure high levels of satisfaction
• Ability to remain calm and take decisive action in high-pressure situations
• Basic knowledge of security systems, surveillance equipment, and emergency procedures
• Physical stamina to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods, sometimes in adverse weather conditions
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess situations quickly and respond appropriately
• Attention to detail for accurately reporting incidents and identifying potential security threats
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, maintaining professionalism in all situations

Work Environment and physical demands

• Ability to reach, crouch, kneel, stand or be on your feet, kneel and bend for extended periods of time.
• Regularly work in adverse conditions and required to use protective equipment to prevent exposure to hazardous materials as well as an office environment and may be required to walk on slippery and uneven surfaces.
• Must be able to lift, push or pull up to 50 lbs. individually or with assistance.

jobs.title: Account Executive, PR & Influencer (Consumer)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORCHESTRA

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Orchestra is looking for an Account Executive, PR & Influencer (Consumer) who loves the intersection of media, culture and influencer marketing, and knows how to turn a good idea into work that gets noticed. This person will help drive day-to-day PR and influencer work, working across consumer, travel and lifestyle campaigns. You’ll pitch stories, build relationships with media and creators, bring fresh ideas to the table and help turn those ideas into campaigns that show up in the places people are actually paying attention to. We’re looking for someone who is curious about what’s happening in culture, excited to work across different kinds of assignments and ready to take real ownership as part of a collaborative, fast-moving team.

Note: This role is based in our NYC office, working two-three days a week in the office on a hybrid schedule.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

As an Account Executive, PR & Influencer (Consumer), you will...

• Drive day-to-day PR and influencer work across a variety of client accounts

• Pitch stories and build strong relationships with reporters, editors, influencers and creators

• Spot timely trends, stories and cultural moments and turn them into creative opportunities for clients

• Draft strong media and client materials, including pitches, press releases, talking points, briefs and prep materials

• Help develop and execute paid and organic influencer campaigns, from creator identification and outreach through content approvals and reporting

• Help bring campaigns, launches, partnerships and brand experiences to life across earned, influencer and social channels

• Bring ideas and recommendations to client and internal team conversations

• Stay close to what’s happening across media, influencers and culture, and share relevant opportunities with your teams

• Take ownership of day-to-day projects and deliverables while beginning to support and guide junior team members

Essential skills:

• 2-4 years of PR, communications and/or influencer marketing experience; agency experience preferred

• Strong media relations and pitching skills, with experience securing meaningful coverage

• Experience supporting or executing paid and organic influencer and creator campaigns

• Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to adapt your voice and approach across different clients and audiences

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Comfort working across different industries and the ability to quickly get up to speed on new clients, audiences and topics

• A genuine interest in media, influencer marketing and culture, with a curious, proactive approach to bringing new ideas to the table

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA

Salary range (commensurate with experience and skills): $67,000-$72,000

Orchestra is the first communications company built for today’s media landscape. Since 2022, it’s acquired nine firms, including: BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communication professionals. Learn more at: www.orchestraco.com.

jobs.title: Tax Director
jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

Blend is seeking a Tax Director to lead our corporate tax function across compliance, income tax accounting (ASC 740), planning, and audit defense. This person is a strategic partner to Finance, Legal, Treasury, and executive leadership, advising on the tax implications of business decisions, transactions, and growth. The Tax Director manages a small team and external advisors and owns the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of all federal, state, and local income tax work.

How You’ll Contribute:

• Lead the U.S. federal, state, and local income and franchise tax compliance process, including returns, estimated payments, and apportionment.

• Lead international tax compliance, including foreign income tax filings, and coordination with local advisors in each jurisdiction.

• Oversee transfer pricing policies, documentation, and intercompany agreements.

• Own the quarterly and annual income tax provision under ASC 740, including deferred taxes, uncertain tax positions, valuation allowance analysis, the effective tax rate, and related footnote and 10-Q/10-K disclosures.

• Develop and execute tax planning strategies that reduce cash taxes and the effective tax rate while managing risk.

• Manage federal and state tax audits, notices, and controversies from start to resolution.

• Advise on the tax impact of M&A, restructurings, financing, equity compensation, and new products or markets.

• Monitor and communicate legislative and regulatory changes, and assess their impact on the company.

• Maintain strong internal controls over tax accounting and reporting, and support SOX and external audit requirements.

• Partner with the controller, FP&A, and treasury on forecasting cash taxes and the effective tax rate.

• Evaluate and implement tax technology and process automation to improve accuracy and efficiency.

• Hire, develop, and mentor tax staff, and manage outsourced tax service providers.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Active CPA license.

• 8+ years of progressive corporate tax experience, with at least 3 years in a tax leadership role (public accounting, corporate tax department, or a combination).

• Deep working knowledge of ASC 740 income tax accounting, U.S. federal corporate tax, and multi-state income and franchise tax.

• Experience at a public company, including SEC reporting and SOX controls.

• Experience managing tax audits and working with external advisors.

• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax topics to non-tax stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team.

• A track record of process automation, with a passion for applying AI to tax workflows.

At Blend, we are committed to offering a competitive compensation package.

To comply with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final base pay offer amounts will vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience. Beyond base pay, Blends benefits and perks are described below.

Compensation:

• Base Salary Range: $146,000 to $190,000 (This applies to full time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job related knowledge, skills, and experience.)

• Bonus: Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.

• Equity: Meaningful Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND) so you share in Blend’s long-term growth and success.

Our Benefits at a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

• We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.

jobs.title: Fulfillment Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT TIN CAN

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.

We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler & better for their kids than the tech-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to reach more families — through our own site and on the shelves of the retailers they already shop — we’re looking to bring on a Fulfillment Manager to help make it happen. You'll be accountable for operational outcomes end-to-end across DTC and B2B: proactively identifying gaps, troubleshooting issues, and driving execution across internal teams and external partners.




THE ROLE

The Fulfillment Manager owns everything that happens once units land in the 3PL: getting the right products to families who order from us directly, and to the retail and partners who put Tin Can on their shelves.

You’ll report to the Head of Operations and own our relationship with our 3PL, while partnering closely with supply chain, finance, and customer experience teams to keep inventory accurate, orders moving, and retailers happy. Your scope spans DTC and B2B order fulfillment, inventory management and allocation across channels, retailer onboarding and compliance, and the systems and processes that let all of it scale. You’ll have a clear view of where every unit is, which warehouse and channel it’s promised to, and what needs to happen next — and you’ll drive the follow-through to make sure it does.

This is a pivotal role at a company that's scaling fast. You'll be a decision maker on workstreams that affect hundreds of thousands of families getting their kids' first phone.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own B2B order management: run the operational execution of wholesale and retail orders end to end, including order processing, fulfillment, and replenishment.

 - Lead retailer onboarding: own the operational setup for new retail partners, including vendor setup, test orders, and first-shipment readiness, so every new account launches clean.

 - Own retailer compliance: oversee our 3PL’s execution of each retailer’s requirements, including EDI, routing guides, ASNs, carton and pallet labeling, and delivery SLAs. Hold them accountable to performance and drive chargebacks toward zero.

 - Own inventory management across channels: maintain accurate inventory visibility and allocation across DTC and B2B, reconcile 3PL counts against Shopify, drive root-cause fixes on discrepancies, and own the reporting and replenishment planning that keeps every channel in stock.

 - Own the 3PL partnership: run our 3PL relationship day to day and through business reviews; hold it to SLAs on receiving, pick/pack accuracy, and on-time ship, and make sure it can support both DTC and wholesale fulfillment as volume grows.

 - Build for scale: design and own the processes, systems, and workflows we need to support growth across multiple retail and distribution partners, without adding headcount for every new account.

 - Turn demand forecast scenarios into fulfillment capacity and allocation plans, so holiday peak never catches any channel at risk of stock outs

 - Keep the master SKU and UPC catalog clean across phones, bundles, and accessories, and consistent between Shopify, the 3PL, and retailer systems

 - Be the CX team’s voice for communicating late, lost, mis-picked, or damaged orders, and turn recurring issues into upstream fixes

 - Optimize fulfillment economics across DTC and B2B, monitoring costs, ship times, accuracy, chargebacks, and inventory health, and proactively  flagging risks and opportunities.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years in operations or fulfillment for physical consumer products, including both DTC and wholesale/retail channels

 - You’ve run B2B fulfillment for retail partners: you’ve onboarded new retailers, worked with EDI, ASNs, and routing guides, and know how to keep chargebacks down

 - You’ve owned a 3PL relationship end to end, including managing multiple FCs, provider SLAs, and rate negotiation

 - You’ve managed inventory across multiple channels and know how to allocate scarce units when DTC and retail both want them

 - You’ve built operational processes and workflows from scratch, and know what breaks when you go from two retail partners to ten

 - Fluency using AI as a multiplier across modeling, reconciliation, and documentation; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have

 - Clear communicator; you can brief a retail buyer, a warehouse operations lead, and a CX agent on the same problem in language each of them wants to hear

 - Hands-on; as ready to chase down a single lost package as to run a quarterly 3PL business review

 - Low-ego and collaborative; you share credit and pitch in on problems that aren’t yours

 - Bonus: Shopify experience

 - Bonus: Familiarity with CPSC or other consumer product compliance basics




WHY JOIN TIN CAN

 - We’re building tech that protects childhood: We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.

 - You’ll own how we reach families: From the warehouse shelf to a family’s front door or a store shelf near them, every order runs through you — and the systems you build decide whether Tin Can keeps its promise at scale.

 - Small, high-trust team: Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.

 - Room to explore, not just execute: You’ll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, provide real input, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.

If you’re excited by the idea of making sure every Tin Can shows up on time, in the right box, for a family that’s been counting down the days, please reach out. We can’t wait to meet someone who’s ready to jump in, untangle the hard stuff, and help us grow.

We’re based in Seattle and in the office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays remote.

It leads engagements that require integration of multi-channel data, development of insights frameworks, and translates analytics into business outcomes across verticals.

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Role

We are looking for talented engineers to join our Performance team to optimize the performance of Nuro’s AV software, ensuring our vehicles can react quickly and safely to the world around them. jobs.description:
ON.energy is setting the standard for large load interconnection. ON’s patented AI UPS™ is a medium-voltage UPS that serves as a firewall, protecting the data center from the grid, and the grid from the data center. With multiple gigawatts currently under construction, we are enabling grid-safe data centers.

The Principal Power Systems Modeling Engineer is ON.energy’s technical owner for power system modeling, model validation, and grid performance assessment. This role sets modeling standards, leads high-impact simulation work, and ensures models accurately represent ON.energy hardware, controls, firmware, protection settings, and plant-level operating modes.

The position supports product development, interconnection studies, grid requirements demonstrations, customer projects, and emerging large-load applications. It serves as a key technical bridge across R&D, Controls, Test, Product, Project Engineering, external consultants, customers, utilities, ISOs, and standards organizations.

Key focus areas include EMT and dynamic modeling, ERCOT Model Quality Testing, evolving large-load ride-through requirements, hardware-to-model matching, Hardware-in-the-Loop and real-time simulation, and project-specific modeling support for ON.energy deployments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Modeling Leadership

• Define modeling standards: Establish ON.energy’s modeling philosophy, validation methods, governance processes, and quality expectations across EMT, RMS, transient, steady-state, HIL, and real-time simulation environments.

• Own model lifecycle management: Ensure models remain aligned with released hardware, firmware, controls algorithms, protection settings, plant controls, and project-specific configurations.

• Serve as technical authority: Provide expert judgment on model fidelity, validation evidence, simulation assumptions, and external model submissions.

Project and Product Support

• Lead technical execution: Develop, review, and approve EMT and dynamic models supporting interconnection studies, customer applications, product qualification, and grid requirements.

• Support project modeling: Partner with Project Engineering on study assumptions, equivalent models, SLD representation, equipment settings, operating conditions, and data requirements.

• Assess system performance: Evaluate ride-through behavior, weak-grid performance, harmonics, generator interations, startup behavior, control response, and large-disturbance response.

Validation, HIL, and Hardware Matching

• Ensure hardware-to-model alignment: Confirm models represent inverter behavior, BESS response, EMS functionality, firmware, protection, controls, and fielded product configurations.

• Correlate models with evidence: Compare simulations against lab tests, HIL results, commissioning data, field measurements, disturbance records, and vendor model behavior.

Grid Requirements, Consultant Oversight, and Technical Leadership

• Lead grid requirements modeling: Serve as technical lead for ISO MQT, large-load ride-through evaluations, and evolving grid requirements.

• Oversee external studies: Direct and review work performed by consultants and study partners, ensuring technical quality, traceability, and consistency with ON.energy standards.

• Influence product and engineering direction: Translate modeling insights into recommendations for controls, firmware, hardware design, validation investments, customer applications, and roadmap priorities.

• Mentor and represent: Guide engineers across modeling, controls, test, and project teams, and represent ON.energy in technical discussions with utilities, ISOs, consultants, customers, and industry groups.

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIREMENTS

• Education: Masters Degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience: 12+ years of advanced power systems modeling experience, including EMT, RMS, dynamic modeling, inverter-based resources, BESS, large loads, or transmission-connected facilities.

• Tools: Expertise with PSCAD, PSSE, PSLF, MATLAB/Simulink, and related simulation platforms; experience with HIL or real-time simulation platforms strongly preferred.

• Grid requirements: Strong understanding of ISO and Utility interconnection requirements, MQT, NERC reliability standards, inverter-based resource requirements, and evolving large-load expectations.

• Technical breadth: Fluency in inverter controls, protection settings, firmware behavior, EMS functions, UPS/BESS architectures, and hardware/software integration.

• Leadership: Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, influence across engineering disciplines, review complex deliverables, communicate with external stakeholders, and create scalable engineering processes.
