jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

AlphaSense has the products, the content, and the customers. We are now transforming how Marketing brings that story to market through strategic campaigns run as a truly integrated effort. We need a leader who has built and led this motion before, at scale and ideally through the pre-IPO to IPO journey, to define, launch and manage this process at AlphaSense.

As Director of Campaign Strategy, you will define the campaign strategy and framework for the marketing organization and guide cross-functional teams as they build campaigns against it. You will own the thesis, audience, and measurement model for our campaigns, and the strategy that informs channel mix and budget. Your job is to make sure the integrated plan is comprehensive, aligned to the strategy, and executed well across channel owners and journey stages, and you will have the influence and the mandate to hold teams to that standard.

You will partner with every Marketing team: Product and Solution Marketing, Growth, Demand Gen and ABM, Comms, Brand, Content, International, Influencer, Customer Marketing and Education, Field Marketing and Events, and Marketing Operations to unify our collective efforts and align them tightly to business outcomes.

Who You Are:

• 12+ years of experience in high-growth, enterprise B2B SaaS marketing, including significant experience leading campaign strategy or integrated marketing at scale

• A track record of defining and implementing a campaign framework across a large marketing organization, with results you can show

• Experience at a pre-IPO company through IPO is preferred, but not required

• Proven ability to influence and hold accountable cross-functional teams you don’t manage directly

• Experience partnering across Product Marketing, Demand Gen, ABM, Brand, Content, Sales, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams

• Strong analytical skills and a habit of evidence over assertion: you set targets, measure honestly, and can say how you’ll know it worked

• Strategic judgment to connect business goals to campaign strategy, and channel and budget decisions

• Executive presence and excellent communication

• Fluency with the modern marketing stack and a point of view on using AI to raise the team’s leverage is preferred

• Budget ownership experience is a plus

What You’ll Do:

Own the Campaign Strategy and Framework

• Define the campaign strategy and operating framework for the marketing organization: how campaigns are prioritized, scoped, briefed, planned, launched, and measured

• Turn company priorities, product roadmap, customer insight, and market opportunity into a small number of well-defined campaigns, each with a clear thesis, audience, and success criteria, as well as content and offer strategy

• Set the strategy that informs channel mix and budget allocation, partnering with channel owners who develop to the final plan

• Build the playbooks, briefs, and planning standards that make the framework repeatable across products, segments, and teams

Drive Adoption and Accountability

• Lead adoption of the framework across the entire marketing team, including enablement, training, and change management

• Use indirect authority to hold program owners accountable for comprehensive plans aligned to the strategy and for execution that follows through

• Establish review cadences, effective and efficient communication structures, and governance that keep teams aligned without becoming a bottleneck

• Build a culture of shared ownership, honest measurement, and continuous improvement

Measure and Optimize

• Agree on what each campaign is accountable for before it launches, and share the results honestly afterward

• Work with Marketing Operations to build measurement models and dashboards that connect campaigns to pipeline, revenue, and other identified core KPIs

• Regularly report to leadership on campaign performance, give channel owners a stage to share insights, and demonstrate how the framework is improving marketing effectiveness

• Apply real-time learnings to in-campaign optimizations across channels, and evaluate post-campaign learnings to inform future strategy, amplify what is working, and help the team stop what isn’t working quickly

What You’ll Be Measured On:

• Adoption of the campaign framework across the marketing organization

• Pipeline sourced and influenced by strategy-led campaigns, against targets you help set

• Quality of campaign plans: clear thesis, audience, measurement model, and cross-functional alignment before launch

• Cross-functional alignment and integration, including consistent and efficient execution across channels and teams

• Speed from strategy to in-market, and the share of campaigns that ship on time and on plan

• Efficiency of spend against the strategy, where budget ownership applies

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

About the role

Flexport is hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to do full funnel marketing, including acquisition, expansion, and nurture. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in San Francisco, reporting to the Director of Growth Marketing.

You’ll manage channels directly, build the tracking and experimentation systems that show what works, and use AI-first workflows to get more done with a lean team. You’ll partner with Brand & Event Marketing, Sales, Sales & Marketing Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to win new accounts and expand existing ones.

What you’ll do

Channel owner & operator

• Manage paid media for acquisition and expansion across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and YouTube, from campaign structure and bidding to audience development.

• Forecast and allocate budget, and decide what to scale or stop based on qualified pipeline and expansion revenue.

• Own AEO and SEO: understand ranking factors, fill content gaps, increase share of relevant volume, and stay on top of changes in LLM and agentic search.

• Test new channels such as X, Reddit, and creator partnerships, and scale the winners.

• Manage our eCommerce store and direct mail, and support events and out-of-home campaigns, in service of brand, awareness, and sales.

• Build account-based programs with Sales and Customer Success: define target accounts, use buying signals, and coordinate campaigns with sales outreach and events.

• Lead agency and vendor partners with clear briefs and accountability.

Messaging, conversion, and customer marketing

• Develop value propositions, differentiation, and persona-based messaging grounded in customer research, competitive positioning, and Product narratives that convert in each channel.

• Optimize landing pages and conversion paths, including offers and personalization by segment.

• Build customer marketing programs for account expansion and attach: segment customers by usage and whitespace, and run cross-sell and upsell campaigns.

Measurement and experimentation

• Build and maintain the tracking foundation: tag management, server-side tracking, conversion APIs, and offline conversion imports that send CRM outcomes back to ad platforms.

• Connect spend to pipeline, expansion, and attach revenue using unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback period, contribution margin) and multi-touch and self-reported attribution.

• Prove incrementality with holdout and geo-lift tests, and model adstock and diminishing returns to guide channel investment.

• Run a documented, hypothesis-driven experimentation program across audiences, bids, offers, creative, and landing pages, with clear readouts.

• Use SQL and data science to segment audiences and analyze cohorts, and use reverse ETL to push modeled audiences into ad and lifecycle platforms.

• Work with Sales & Marketing Operations on campaign tracking, lead flow to sales handoff, and lead quality and account expansion analysis.

AI-first growth stack

• Build AI-first workflows for research, creative, analysis, QA, and reporting, using MCPs, computer use, and automation scripts, with expert human steering on strategy and output.

• Build and extend our growth stack and internal tools with code, APIs, command-line tools, and version control, and document each system for reuse.

• Track how AI is changing paid media and measurement, and bring what works to the team.

What you’ll bring

You bring paid media expertise, broad channel knowledge, and technical depth.

Experience

• 7+ years of B2B marketing experience reaching mid-market to enterprise buyers, with ownership of marketing-driven pipeline and account expansion.

• 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, managing 7 to 8 figure budgets and scaling spend to the efficient frontier.

• 2+ years of building with AI, shipping workflows, automations, or internal tools.

• Logistics, supply chain, or technology marketing experience (a plus).

Technical depth

• Command of tracking, attribution, unit economics, and incrementality methods, including multi-touch models and adstock.

• Comfort with querying data warehouses, segmentation, cohort analysis, and reverse ETL, with the judgment to apply data science where it changes a decision.

• Working knowledge of A/B testing tools and experimental design.

• Operate and be a stakeholder in the sales & marketing stack: CRM, ESP, CMS, account & transaction data, web analytics, and product telemetry.

Craft and judgment

• Strong copywriting and conversion optimization skills, from first touch through expansion.

• Great taste: you use AI to craft copy and experiences, and you can tell generic output from relevant, on-brand marketing.

• AI-first instincts: you know what to automate, what to review, and where your judgment matters.

• Clear, confident communication with senior leaders and partner teams.

• An organized work style across multiple campaigns and stakeholders.

Mindset

• Curiosity about our industry and customers, and the drive to learn ocean and air freight, customs, fulfillment, and the rest of the supply chain.

• Adaptable and eager to take on new areas of marketing. Entrepreneurial spirit is a must.

jobs.title: Director of Semiconductor Base Build, North Phoenix, AZ
jobs.description:
WORLD WIDE PROFESSIONAL SOLUTIONS is a project solutions organization committed to implementing lean constructions, collaborative contracting, and execution approaches to enable breakthroughs in performance.


WORLD WIDE PROFESSIONAL SOLUTIONS is a project solutions organization committed to implementing lean construction, collaborative contracting, and execution approaches that enable breakthroughs in project performance.
WWPS is seeking an experienced Director of Semiconductor Base Build to provide senior program leadership for a large scale semiconductor manufacturing construction project in North Phoenix, Arizona. This Director level position will lead the project management office responsible for construction governance, integration, controls, and delivery of the fab base build and supporting infrastructure.
This leader will work closely with the confidential semiconductor client and guide Project Managers, Construction Managers, project controls personnel, discipline leads, design partners, and construction contractors. The position requires executive level judgment, proven semiconductor fab construction expertise, and the ability to coordinate complex, concurrent construction work packages through facility readiness and turnover.
Direct semiconductor fab base build construction leadership experience is required.
Key Responsibilities
Provide executive leadership of the semiconductor base build PMO, establishing program governance, priorities, delivery standards, escalation paths, and accountability across major construction work packages.
Lead and mentor Project Managers, Construction Managers, discipline leads, and project controls teams. Coordinate CSA, MEP, process utility, and specialty construction resources against program commitments.
Represent the base build program in executive discussions with client leadership, Facilities, engineering and design partners, general contractors, trade contractors, and other project stakeholders.
Oversee integrated planning and execution of site and civil work, underground utilities, foundations, structural systems, building envelope, cleanroom construction, and supporting manufacturing facilities as assigned.
Drive delivery of base build mechanical, electrical, plumbing, controls, and process utility infrastructure, including central utility and process utility buildings, distribution systems, and plant support services.
Establish and govern an integrated master schedule linking engineering release, permitting and procurement interfaces, construction sequencing, long lead equipment, system completion, and facility turnover milestones.
Set consistent program controls and executive dashboards for safety, quality, schedule, cost, productivity, change management, forecasting, contractor performance, and critical risks.
Lead cross discipline interface management among CSA, MEP, cleanroom systems, process utilities, and building controls. Resolve access, design coordination, constructability, and installation sequence conflicts.
Provide oversight of constructability reviews, BIM and VDC coordination, design changes, procurement readiness, and contractor work plans to reduce rework and protect critical path milestones.
Direct program level staffing, labor, and contracting strategies across general contractors and specialty trades. Address workforce capacity, material availability, logistics, and competing site priorities.
Oversee budget performance, cost forecasts, scope gaps, change orders, commercial exposure, and schedule impacts. Lead resolution of significant contractor claims and delivery risks.
Establish high standards for environmental, health, safety, security, construction quality, and contamination control during transition into controlled cleanroom environments.
Hold construction and specialty contractors accountable for workface planning, measurable progress, inspections, quality documentation, punch list closure, and recovery plans where performance is at risk.
Align system completion, testing, commissioning, and turnover plans with client Facilities, operations, and equipment installation stakeholders, including cleanroom and utility readiness for tool move in.
Provide concise executive reporting, decision recommendations, risk mitigation plans, and timely escalation of issues that could compromise construction delivery or manufacturing readiness.
Champion Lean Construction, reliable planning, standard PMO processes, and continuous improvement to strengthen field coordination, safety, productivity, and schedule predictability.
Qualifications
15+ years of progressive construction, project, or program delivery experience, including executive or senior leadership accountability on major, technically complex capital projects.
8+ years of direct semiconductor fab construction experience, including significant leadership of base build, facility infrastructure, or large multidisciplinary construction scopes.
Demonstrated success directing multiple Project Managers and managing major construction work packages, contractors, and cross functional engineering and client stakeholders.
Strong understanding of semiconductor base build delivery from early site and structural construction through cleanroom fit out, MEP and process utility completion, commissioning readiness, and turnover.
Working knowledge of CSA systems, building envelope, cleanroom infrastructure, electrical distribution, central utilities, process utility facilities, and construction interfaces with equipment installation.
Advanced capability in CPM scheduling, Primavera P6, project controls, cost forecasting, executive reporting, contract interpretation, change management, and project risk management.
Proven ability to drive safety, quality, contractor performance, constructability, cost control, and critical path recovery on a fast paced semiconductor construction program.
Strong executive communication, organizational leadership, commercial negotiation, stakeholder management, and decision making skills.
Preferred Background
Experience as a Construction Director, Program Executive, PMO Leader, Project Director, or comparable senior delivery leader on semiconductor base build or fab infrastructure programs.
Background with an Owner's Representative, EPCM organization, general contractor, construction manager, or major specialty contractor delivering semiconductor facilities.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
Familiarity with PMWeb, Primavera, Excel, Word, BIM and VDC coordination, and integrated construction reporting systems.
Project Location and Work Arrangement
This position is based on a semiconductor construction project in North Phoenix, Arizona and requires close onsite engagement with construction teams and client stakeholders. Any travel, mobilization, relocation, or per diem arrangements will depend on project requirements and individual circumstances.
Why Join WWPS
This is a full time, direct employment opportunity with Worldwide Professional Solutions, offering the chance to lead a major semiconductor fab base build PMO and shape delivery of the facilities and infrastructure needed for manufacturing operations.
WWPS offers a comprehensive benefits package including:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Short term and long term disability coverage
401(k) with company match
Paid holidays and paid time off

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager, Construction Materials Testing and Geotechnical Services
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Principal Engineer in charge, this role will ensure the efficient daily operation of the Geotechnical and Construction Material Laboratory operations at our new Charlotte, NC location. SOCOTEC is looking for an autonomous self-starter who will relish the opportunity to set up a new laboratory focused on construction materials testing (soils, concrete, masonry, aggregate, asphalt) and geotechnical testing. Successful candidates will be responsible for supervising staff working in the lab, the general maintenance of laboratory equipment, quality assurance, safety, and lab productivity.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage, oversee, perform testing, review, and submit testing results for soils, concrete, masonry, asphalt, aggregate, and related construction materials testing, as well as geotechnical related testing.
• Generate, calculate, and compile laboratory testing reports and issue to clients and supervise others performing the same.
• Maintain and organize laboratory workload to meet given deadlines and be proactive in assessing bottlenecks in workflows and processes to ensure efficient laboratory operations.
• Oversee overall lab testing procedures, including setup, application of loads, instrumentation, data acquisition, analyses, and cleanup.
• Ensure the timely entry of lab KPIs and billing information weekly.
• Identify needs and perform the required research for new testing procedures.
• Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) and ensure testing is in accordance with applicable ASTM, AASHTO, AASHTO re:source, CCRL, and company quality system requirements.
• Lead the laboratory through initial AASHTO re:source and NCDOT accreditation, including document control, equipment records, calibration files, technician competency records, internal audits, and corrective action follow-up, and maintain accreditation status going forward.
• Recommend, specify, and manage procurement of new laboratory equipment to build out testing capabilities, in addition to overseeing ongoing calibration, maintenance, upgrades, and repairs.
• Internal and external communication with outside clients.
• Coordinate with Charlotte field staff, project managers, clients, and contractors to support timely sample intake, testing priorities, reporting, and project communication.
• Assist in cultivating client relationships with existing and new clients.
• Mechanically inclined to help with equipment troubleshooting and repairs is preferred.
• Ensure that the lab is clean, organized, and adequately stocked, including but not limited to supply inventory, labeling, and record-keeping procedures.
• Oversee lab safety and lab SOP (standard operating procedures), including but not limited to proper specimen and chemical handling, disposal, and storage processes and procedures.
• Communicating effectively and efficiently with contractors, clients, and team members.
• Work environment may include moderate to loud noise, dusty conditions, and require standing for extensive periods of time. The position may require occasional lifting and carrying objects weighing up to 50 lbs. Corrected vision, color perception and hearing to normal range are required.
• Weekend and overtime work may be required as needed based on laboratory workload; limited overnight or regional travel may be required with this position.
• Perform other work-related duties as assigned by their manager. The omission of specific responsibilities does not preclude their manager from assigning duties that are logically related to the position.

• BA/BS in a related discipline (BS in civil engineering preferred) or equivalent experience.
• 5-10 years of hands-on experience performing construction materials / geotechnical laboratory testing, including demonstrated experience leading and motivating lab technicians.
• ACI and NICET certification in Construction Materials Testing, including soils, concrete, or asphalt, and NCDOT certifications are preferred. Required certifications must be obtained within 1 year of your start date if not already held.
• Experience in soil and rock laboratory work is preferred.
• Field construction materials testing or geotechnical inspection experience is a plus, though not required for this laboratory-based role.
• Experience in process driven operations and people management.
• Valid driver's license and clean driving record.
• MS Excel and Word.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and 401(k)

For more information, please visit www.socotec.us

Job Type: Full-Time

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

SOCOTEC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI Data Engineering)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About NISC

NISC develops and implements enterprise-level and customer-facing software solutions for over 1200+ energy cooperatives and communication organizations across North America. Our mission is to deliver technology solutions and services that are Member-focused, quality-driven and valued-priced. We exist to serve our Members and help them serve their communities through our innovative software products, services and outstanding customer support. We are an AI-forward company committed to being a technology leader in our industry.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our growing team of data experts. This position will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing enterprise data solutions, including data pipelines, semantic data models, and AI-ready data architectures across our cloud-based data platform. The Senior Data Engineer will support our application experts, software developers, database architects, and data analysts on a Data Roadmap strategy and will ensure optimal data delivery architecture is consistent throughout ongoing projects.

This individual will play a key role in making enterprise data more discoverable, trustworthy, governed, and accessible for analytics, reporting, intelligent applications, and emerging AI solutions. They must be comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products. We look for individuals who will thrive in a team environment, be committed to accomplishing a common goal, and be excited by the prospect of building scalable data solutions that empower business insights and innovation while having some fun along the way.

Work Schedule:

• Hybrid from one of our office locations: Atlanta, GA Cedar Rapids, IA Lake Saint Louis, MO Mandan, ND

• Hybrid Schedule: Minimum of working 3 day per week out of an office location and ability to work up to all 5 days a week from an office location.

• Required Days from an Office Location: Tuesday and Wednesday - the third required day will be up to the candidate and their supervisor to choose.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and integrations that support enterprise analytics and business operations.

• Build and optimize data solutions across modern cloud-based data platforms and lakehouse environments.

• Design and implement semantic data models and business-ready data layers that improve data accessibility, consistency, and usability.

• Support AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives through the creation of trusted, well-governed, and scalable data assets.

• Partner with software developers, data analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data quality, reliability, and performance across the data ecosystem.

• Contribute to data modeling, metadata management, and data governance practices that improve enterprise data understanding and reuse.

• Research and recommend emerging technologies and best practices related to data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement.

• Create and maintain a culture of engagement and one that is conducive to NISC's Statement of Shared Values.

• Commitment to NISC's Statement of Shared Values.

• Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Preferred:

• 8 years of experience in a Data Engineering, Software Engineering or related role.

• Experience building and optimizing data pipelines, data integrations, and large-scale data solutions.

• Strong understanding of data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, and data modeling concepts.

• Experience designing semantic data models, business data layers, or related solutions that support reporting, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

• Familiarity with metadata management, ontology concepts, knowledge graphs, or similar approaches used to improve data discoverability and business understanding.

• Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation initiatives through scalable data architectures.

• Strong SQL and data analysis skills with experience working across structured and unstructured datasets.

• Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS analytics services, or similar technologies.

• Experience with AWS services, Spark, ETL/ELT processes, and modern data integration tools.

• Experience supporting and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions.

NISC’s Shared Values & Competencies:

• Integrity – We are committed to doing the right thing – always.

• Relationships – We are committed to building and preserving lasting relationships.

• Innovation – We promote the spirit of creativity and champion new ideas.

• Teamwork – We exemplify the cooperative spirit by working together.

• Empowerment – We believe individuals have the power to make a difference.

• Personal Development – We believe the free exchange of knowledge and information is absolutely necessary to the success of each individual and the organization.

Benefits:

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance.

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with $100 monthly contributions from NISC. Like to walk? Improve your overall wellness knowledge? Ability to earn up to $800 additional dollars into your HSA each year through our Wellness Rewards program.

• Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA) thru Paylocity.

• Fully covered life insurance up to x3 annual base salary.

• Fully covered short- and long-term disability.

• 401(k), traditional or Roth, with employee match up to 6% and employer 4% salary base contributions.

• PTO accrual levels dependent on years of service, 120 Life Leave Event hours, 10 paid holidays and an annual holiday week.

• $2,500 Interest-FREE technology loan program.

• $25,000 employee educational assistance program.

• Volunteer, Wellness, Family Events and other employee fun supplied by our committees.

• Employee Assistance Program; assisting employees and dependents with virtually any life event

• Benevolence Committee to support employees with financial hardships like unexpected medical bills, funerals and other unfortunate hardships.

Education Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science or similar discipline, preferred.

Minimum Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the essential functions of this position, employees must be able to see and communicate.  Employees are regularly required to maintain a stationary position, move, and operate computer keyboards or office equipment.

Disclaimer:

Management may modify this job description by assigning or reassigning duties and responsibilities at any time.

Key Words:

SQL | Data Engineering | Data Lakehouse | Semantic Layer | Semantic Modeling | Metadata Management | Data Governance | AI | Generative AI | AI Agents | Knowledge Graphs | ETL | ELT | Spark | Python | AWS | Databricks | Snowflake | Microsoft Fabric | Data Architecture

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Part-Time) - Carle Place, NY
jobs.location: Carle Place, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a part-time Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($27.00 - $48.00/hr)

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. jobs.description:

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are seeking a Sr. Trust & Safety Manager to build and lead our Trust & Safety program, ensuring a secure and reliable experience for the patients and providers who rely on us. As an individual contributor, you will coordinate the work of both technical and non-technical partners, including stakeholders in Legal, Compliance, Clinical, Product, Engineering, and Business teams. Your role will be to proactively identify risks and develop the solutions needed to address them before they impact the marketplace.

This role is a vital part of our Strategy & Operations team, offering you the chance to own complex, high-impact projects that transform how we manage safety at scale. We are looking for a person with a passion for rigor and smooth delivery who is comfortable working at all levels. The work will cover a spectrum that ranges from the design of complex internal mechanisms with no room for failure through identifying opportunities to further realize Rula’s high standards on regulatory and safety requirements.

Required Qualifications

 - 7+ years of combined experience in program management and business operations within high-growth and/or mid-sized companies

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.



Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.



POSITION SUMMARY

We are hiring an Executive Assistant to support both Yondr’s Founder and President, reporting to the EVP, Operations. The EA will manage calendars and travel, prepare for meetings and follow up on decisions and commitments.

The role also includes coordinating Yondr Presents, our phone-free live events, and managing assigned Operations projects. Based in Los Angeles, this full-time position requires in-person event support, occasional travel and some evening or weekend work.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONISIBILITIES

Executive Support

 - Manage both executives’ calendars, prioritize meeting requests and resolve scheduling conflicts. Allow time for preparation and travel, and reserve time for work that needs their attention.

 - Review the week ahead with each executive, confirm meeting details and obtain any missing materials.

 - Arrange domestic and international travel, prepare itineraries, manage booking changes and submit business expenses.

 - Prepare agendas and briefing materials for leadership and board meetings. Record decisions and action items, confirm who is responsible and follow up on deadlines.

 - Keep executives and colleagues informed of schedule changes and outstanding decisions. Raise delays or competing requests that need executive input.

 - Handle correspondence and requests from colleagues, board members and external partners on the executives’ behalf, with discretion when handling confidential information.

Events and Yondr Presents

 - Work with the EVP, Operations, the Entertainment team and production partners to plan Yondr Presents, leadership offsites and company gatherings.

 - Research venues and vendors, compare quotes and availability, and coordinate bookings and requirements.

 - Manage guest lists, invitations, event travel and materials. Distribute schedules and confirm responsibilities with the people involved.

 - Track event spending against approved budgets, submit agreements and invoices for review, and follow up on payment deadlines.

 - Prepare the run of show and contact lists. Support setup and guest arrivals, resolve issues on-site and reconcile costs after each event. Record any changes needed for future events.

Special Projects

 - Manage assigned projects with the EVP, Operations, from planning through completion. Set out tasks and deadlines, confirm responsibilities and identify decisions requiring approval.

 - Source vendors and partners for assigned Operations projects. Request proposals, compare fees, deliverables and timelines, and recommend a provider to the EVP, Operations.

 - Coordinate with colleagues on project tasks and resolve outstanding items. Assignments may include preparing launch materials, organizing a pilot or introducing a new process.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - At least five+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior leaders, including more than one executive at a time.

 - Experience coordinating events, including venue or vendor arrangements and on-site support.

 - Experience coordinating projects across departments and following up with colleagues to meet deadlines.

 - Proficiency in Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Slides, including preparing presentations and maintaining budgets and project trackers.

 - Strong written communication and discretion with confidential information. Able to handle routine requests independently and identify decisions that require executive input.

 - Experience in live entertainment, cultural events or a founder-led company is helpful.
   
   

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Ability to perform computer-based work, communicate effectively in person and remotely, and support on-site meetings and events, with or without reasonable accommodation.



YONDR BENEFITS

 - 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP

 - Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance

 - Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year

 - 12 weeks of paid parental leave

 - 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company-wide closure + 11 additional nationally recognized holidays

 - 401(k) offering

 - Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.

 - Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

Recruitment Fraud Notice: Yondr will never request payment during recruitment or onboarding. All recruiting emails from our team come from an @overyondr.com http://overyondr.com address. Please report any suspicious recruiting activity to support@overyondr.com.



Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Procurement
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Position Summary

The Director of Strategic Procurement, reporting to our VP of Supply Chain, develops and executes enterprise procurement strategies that support IEM’s manufacturing, supply chain, operational, and business growth goals. This role is responsible for building a high-performing procurement function, improving supplier performance, driving cost reduction, reducing supply risk, and ensuring IEM has the supplier base, contracts, and processes needed to support a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate has strong strategic sourcing, supplier management, procurement leadership, and manufacturing experience. This individual should be able to partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and executive leadership to improve material availability, cost competitiveness, supplier accountability, and long-term business continuity.

Note: While candidates based near one of our US plants are preferred, we are open to remote candidates. This role requires approximately 50% travel.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute strategic procurement plans that support cost, quality, delivery, inventory, working capital, and business continuity goals.

• Lead procurement strategy across assigned commodities, suppliers, materials, components, and services.

• Build, lead, coach, and develop a procurement team capable of supporting IEM’s growth, production demands, and operational priorities.

• Establish supplier strategies that improve cost competitiveness, lead times, capacity, quality, and delivery performance.

• Lead supplier negotiations related to pricing, contracts, payment terms, lead times, minimum order quantities, stocking agreements, blanket orders, and long-term supply agreements.

• Drive cost reduction, supplier consolidation, dual sourcing, localization, value engineering, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.

• Partner with Procurement, Planning, Operations, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to align supplier strategies with business and production needs.

• Analyze spend, supplier performance, market trends, supplier capacity, demand signals, lead times, cost drivers, and supply risks to support sourcing and procurement decisions.

• Establish procurement processes, tools, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.

• Manage supplier performance through business reviews, scorecards, corrective actions, escalation management, and long-term supplier development.

• Support supplier issue resolution related to delivery delays, defects, nonconformance, pricing discrepancies, capacity constraints, and recurring performance concerns.

• Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring suppliers are held accountable to IEM’s expectations.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to support new product introduction, capacity expansion, operational improvements, and strategic business initiatives.

• Ensure procurement data, supplier records, pricing, contracts, and sourcing documentation are accurate and maintained in applicable systems.

• Support continuous improvement efforts related to procurement processes, supplier performance, material flow, cost reduction, and supply chain reliability.

• The candidate will be expected to perform additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or supplier management in a manufacturing environment.

• 5+ years of experience leading procurement, sourcing, or supply chain teams.

• Experience developing and executing procurement strategies across multiple commodities, suppliers, or business units.

• Strong experience leading supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, contract management, cost reduction, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing supply chains, supplier lead times, material planning, cost drivers, inventory management, and production support.

• Ability to make practical procurement and supplier decisions while partnering appropriately with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain.

• Strong leadership, analytical, negotiation, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience building processes, KPIs, reporting tools, supplier scorecards, and procurement operating rhythms.

• Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, Microsoft Excel, spend analysis, and supplier performance reporting tools.

• Demonstrated career growth and increasing responsibility, with the ability to operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on problem solver in a fast-paced, high-growth organization.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in electrical equipment, power distribution, switchgear, industrial manufacturing, or engineered-to-order manufacturing.

• Experience with supplier development, localization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, material flow, and value engineering concepts.

• Experience supporting high-growth manufacturing environments with complex supplier networks and production demands.

• CPM, CPSM, CSCP, or other procurement/supply chain certification preferred.

• Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Working Conditions

• Manufacturing and office environment.

• May require travel to suppliers or IEM facilities.

• Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, production demands, supplier constraints, and executive-level expectations.

Compensation actually offered for this role will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at https://www.iemfg.com

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being, growth, and long-term success. View a snapshot of our benefits at https://www.iemfg.com/careers

Recruiting Scams

Beware of recruiting scams. IEM never charges candidates fees, and all recruiter emails come from an @iemfg.com address. If you suspect fraudulent activity, do not share personal information and report it to us at iemfg.com/contact

Non-Discrimination Statement

IEM does not discriminate against any applicant based on any characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is hiring a Head of Partner Marketing to build and lead the function that turns our partner ecosystem into a durable source of pipeline, trust, and customer value. You’ll set the partner marketing strategy across our data, product, AI, and professional services partners, own the budget, lead the team, and partner closely with Partnerships, Product Marketing, Sales, and Demand Generation. You’ll report to the VP of Product Marketing.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the strategy. Define how Harvey markets its partners, markets with its partners, and reaches its partners’ customers across the ecosystem. Build tiering and prioritization tied directly to company goals. Define and lead how our partnerships show up in-market.

 - Own partner and integration announcements. Lead go-to-market for integrations and partnerships, from announcement through adoption, with a tiering model that gives each partner the right level of marketing. Work with Product Marketing and Product to define our partner narrative.

 - Drive pipeline. Work with Partnerships and Sales on co-sell motions and joint account plans. Set targets for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in partnership with Demand Generation.

 - Build co-marketing programs. Run joint content, customer stories, webinars, events, and executive roundtables with partners, with playbooks that scale beyond any single relationship.

 - Enable partners. Create the messaging, toolkits, training, and certification that help partners position, sell, and implement Harvey, building on resources like Harvey Academy.

 - Run the partner marketing engine. Own approvals, brand guidelines, and timelines with partners, and keep cross-functional teams informed on what’s live and what’s next.

 - Build and lead the team. Hire, develop, and manage a team of partner marketers and program managers, and set the operating cadence, budget, and priorities.

 - Measure what matters. Establish attribution and reporting for partner-driven pipeline and ROI by partner and program, and implement a data reporting structure.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 10+ years in B2B marketing, including significant experience leading partner, channel, or alliance marketing, and managing a multi-person team.

 - A track record of building or scaling a partner marketing function at a fast-growing company, with measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

 - Enthusiasm, growth-mindset, and a collaborative spirit when working in a high-growth environment.

 - Experience across more than one partner type (technology and ISV, cloud marketplace, SI and consulting, and channel) and the co-sell motions that go with them.

 - Experience marketing to sophisticated, relationship-driven, risk-aware buyers such as law firms, professional services firms, or other regulated industries.

 - History of implementing metrics and attribution for partner programs.

 - A record of hiring and developing strong people and holding a high bar in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

Nice to haves

 - Experience in legal tech, professional services, or enterprise AI.

 - Experience launching and marketing integrations and partnerships with major platforms, cloud marketplaces, or large content providers.

 - Experience building or scaling an ecosystem or partner program from an early stage, including across EMEA and APAC.

 - Comfort using AI tools to scale content, enablement, and reporting.




COMPENSATION

$250,600 - $344,500 USD

jobs.title: Senior Manager,  Engineering
jobs.description:
The weaponization of AI is driving a paradigm shift in the cyber security industry from proactive to preemptive security:  clients must now invest more intelligence and effort in understanding their vulnerabilities before their adversaries do (Open AI).  The only way to achieve this is to simulate future attack scenarios at scale, and to run them in high fidelity digital replicas of production environments (Gartner/Forrester).  SimSpace serves as the AI Proving Grounds to generate hypersynthetic data which pressure tests controls, tools, teams, and agentic capabilities in full kill chain attacks hidden in realistic environmental traffic and patterns of life. 



Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform was initially conceived to assist in Offensive Cyber Operations (OCO), to quickly replicate target environments to conduct mission rehearsal of human operators and their tools to deny (disrupt, degrade, destroy) or deceive (manipulate or exfiltrate data) adversaries.  The company has since expanded to serve over a dozen allied governments in OCO/DCO as well as critical infrastructure enterprises around the world.  The company is actively investing in the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe and the Middle East through direct sales and channel partners.  SimSpace has launched the AI Proving Grounds Consortium, leading the revolution by creating an open platform for the InfoSec ecosystem to train, validate and operationalize their agentic capabilities before committing to production.



Why join SimSpace?

We are a team united by a shared purpose and four core values: Serve to Protect, Acquire Understanding, Teamwork without Borders, and Operate as Innovators. We value candid, constructive feedback and create opportunities for personal, professional, and financial growth. Our vision, “Defend the Free World,” drives our mission: “Defeat Any Adversary in Any Cyber Terrain at Machine Speed.”



How Do We Work?

We listen to customers and colleagues, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into meaningful results. We expect everyone to embrace emerging technologies, simplify and automate work, and use AI to learn, solve problems, and help deliver quality with speed. We apply human judgment and take responsibility for outcomes. Whether remote or office-based, we collaborate across teams and time zones.



We invite you to apply today!




ABOUT THE ROLE

SimSpace builds the environments where the world's leading organizations train, test, and operationalize their cyber capabilities with confidence. We want the engineering teams behind that platform to set the standard for building software in the age of AI, not catch up to it.



As a Senior Software Engineering Manager, you'll lead and grow one of our engineering teams, make spec-driven development and AI-native workflows the way it builds software, and take charge of initiatives that reach well beyond it. You'll be accountable for the health of your team, the quality of what it ships, and the careers of the engineers who build it. You'll also keep your director, the leadership team, and cross-org partners clear on how effectively the team is delivering.



This is a people-leadership role with deep technical grounding. You lead through your team while staying close enough to the work to unblock hard problems and make smart trade-offs. We're looking for a high-agency engineering leader who doesn't just lead a team but leads initiatives—someone who takes charge, drives things forward, and never waits to be told how.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


LEAD AND GROW YOUR TEAM

 - Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers; own hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, performance, and career growth.

 - Invest in your engineers as people—coaching, mentoring, and creating the conditions for them to do the best work of their careers.

 - Set the team's direction, goals, and priorities, translating product strategy into a clear plan and predictable execution.

 - Partner with your team's technical leaders as true counterparts—they own day-to-day technical direction, freeing you to focus on team health and org-wide initiatives.


MAKE SPEC-DRIVEN, AI-NATIVE DELIVERY THE NORM

 - Lead your team in spec-driven development: specs, plans, and acceptance criteria come first; AI agents implement against them; and reviews verify the result.

 - Make AI-native workflows the team's default, and judge them by team outcomes—delivery, quality, and predictability—rather than tool usage.

 - Set clear standards for how AI-generated work is specified, reviewed, tested, and owned, and hold the team to them.


UNBLOCK THE TEAM AND DRIVE DELIVERY

 - Own the delivery of your team's work end to end, balancing scope, quality, and timelines.

 - Spot what's slowing the team down and remove it—technical, process, or cross-team—before it becomes a schedule problem.

 - Stay close enough to the technical decisions to review work credibly and unblock the hard problems.

 - Take real ownership of outcomes, holding the team accountable to a high bar while keeping delivery moving.


LEAD INITIATIVES AND DRIVE ENGINEERING MATURITY

 - Take charge of initiatives that span teams—from framing the problem and building alignment through delivery—and drive them to completion.

 - Drive engineering maturity forward—from AI-native workflows and spec-driven development to end-to-end testing in CI/CD—on your team and across the organization.

 - Influence how the broader organization works—improving processes, standards, and ways of working beyond your own team.


COMMUNICATE UP AND ACROSS

 - Communicate your team's effectiveness—delivery, quality, and health—to your director and the leadership team, with evidence and trends rather than anecdotes.

 - Keep cross-org partners in Product, QA, platform teams, and other engineering teams informed of progress, risks, and trade-offs before they have to ask.

 - Bring risks forward early with a proposed path, not just a problem.

 - Partner with Product Management to align engineering work with business objectives and maintain plans and resourcing for predictable delivery.




WHAT YOU BRING


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years in software engineering, with 6+ years directly managing or leading engineers.

 - Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams, including distributed or hybrid teams.

 - Extensive experience leading teams in spec-driven development with AI—specs, plans, and acceptance criteria written first, then implemented by agents and verified against.

 - AI-native engineering experience as a leader, not necessarily as an individual contributor: you've led a team in adopting AI coding agents and can show how it changed the way the team delivers.

 - Years of experience reporting out to and communicating with cross-org partners, keeping them aligned on progress, risks, and trade-offs.

 - Experience communicating team effectiveness to directors and other leadership team members—clearly, candidly, and with evidence.

 - Demonstrated ability to unblock teams, drive engineering maturity forward, and lead cross-team initiatives to completion.

 - Strong technical depth—ideally in TypeScript, React, or Kotlin—enough to guide architecture and review work credibly.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience driving the maturity of end-to-end testing in CI/CD pipelines, making suites fast, reliable, and trusted enough to gate a release.

 - A track record of moving fast with teams: small batches, short feedback loops, and frequent releases without lowering the quality bar.

 - Comfort owning services in production—CI/CD, observability, reliability, and operational ownership.

 - Experience adapting teams through reorganizations, roadmap shifts, or rapid growth.

 - Bachelor's in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).




WHO YOU ARE

 - High agency—you see what needs to happen and make it happen, without waiting for a ticket, a meeting, or permission.

 - You step up when an initiative needs a leader, and you drive it to done.

 - You genuinely care about people—you build engineers up, grow careers, and create teams others want to be on.

 - You're AI-native as a leader: you know what good looks like for spec-driven, agent-assisted work, and you hold the team to it.

 - You communicate up and across with clarity and candor, and you close loops without being chased.

 - You lead through your team but stay close enough to make—and unblock—hard technical calls.

 - You influence how things work across teams, improving the system rather than just working within it.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

AI is changing how software gets built, and the teams that learn to direct it well—specifying clearly, verifying rigorously, and shipping in fast, safe increments—will set the pace. As a Senior Software Engineering Manager, you'll build one of those teams and lead the initiatives that bring the rest of engineering along—setting the standard for how work gets delivered, how problems get solved, and how teams grow. Your impact compounds: a strong team, a more mature organization, and leadership that always knows where things stand.




OUR TECH STACK INCLUDES

Codex, TypeScript, React, Kotlin, Git/GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and Playwright.




WE’RE PROUD TO OFFER A COMPETITIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE PACKAGE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR WELL-BEING, GROWTH, AND SUCCESS:

 - Compensation. Base salary range: $180,000 - $250,000, reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

 - Health & Wellness. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans—coverage starts on day one!

 - Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

 - Financial Well-Being. Plan for your future with a 401(k)-retirement savings plan featuring a company match.

 - Flexible Time Off. Take the time you need with unlimited vacation and dedicated health & wellness days. SimSpace provides flexible solutions to meet the diverse work-life needs of team members.

 - Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

 - Ownership Opportunities: Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

 - Referral Rewards: Earn $1,500–$3,500 for every qualified hire through our employee referral program.

 - Peloton Interactive Wellness Program: Full- and partial- subsidized membership plans and equipment discounts to help you reach your personalized fitness goals.

 - Continuous Learning: Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

 - Social Connections: Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

 - Extra Perks: Legal plan coverage, pet insurance, wellness reimbursements, and more to simplify life’s details.

jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist II

jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

• We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

Key Responsibilities

Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

• Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.

• Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.

• Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.

• Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.

• Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.

• Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

• Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.

• Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.

• Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.

• Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.

• Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.

• Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

Quality & Documentation

• Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.

• Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.

• Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

• D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

• Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.

• Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.

• Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.

• Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.

• Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

• Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.

• Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.

• Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.

• Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.

• Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).

• Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.

• Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

What Success Looks Like

• Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.

• Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.

• Contributes high-quality analyses that inform key development decisions.

• Builds effective partnerships across wet-lab and computational teams.

• Continuously learns new technologies, methods, and scientific domains.

• Grows toward increasing technical ownership and leadership within assay development programs.

#LI-Hybrid, or #LI-Remote

For candidates based in our San Diego office, the range is $134,000 - $166,000.

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the range is $152,000 - $170,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the range is $122,000 - $158,000.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$122,000—$170,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).
