jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Nursing Shift Lead (Full-Time) - Carle Place, NY
jobs.location: Carle Place, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($28.00 - $50.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

BAYADA HOME HEALTH CARE is seeking a Registered Nurse (RN) Clinical Educator for our Garden City Skilled (GCS) office. The educator supports nurses caring for medically fragile adults and children at home by building clinical skills, confidence, and competency through practical education and coaching.

At BAYADA, our mission is to help people have a safe home life with comfort, independence, and dignity. In this role, you’ll partner with clinical leaders and field staff to strengthen the knowledge and skills that support safe, reliable skilled nursing care in the community.

If you are an RN who enjoys teaching, coaching, and helping other nurses grow—and brings strong clinical credibility alongside an engaging, hands-on education style—this opportunity may be a strong fit.

What you’ll do

• Assess staff and client learning needs in relation to applicable regulations, nursing standards, BAYADA policies, and the needs of the adults and children served

• Plan, develop, and deliver educational programs based on identified learning needs and performance-improvement data

• Lead hands-on skills labs, simulation, in-services, and other learning activities for field staff

• Support clinical managers with initial and ongoing competency assessment and validation for field staff

• Use insights from incident reports, infection-control trends, chart reviews, survey results, performance evaluations, and supervisory visits to guide education

• Provide coaching and feedback that helps staff build clinical judgment, confidence, and consistent practice

• Evaluate training effectiveness and adapt program content using feedback from staff, clients, and caregivers, as appropriate

• Support professional growth and continuing-education opportunities for staff

• Maintain current nursing knowledge and identify appropriate education materials and resources

• Collaborate with clinical and office colleagues to support safe, high-quality care and the development of the skilled nursing team

What you bring

Required

• Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing in New York

• At least 2 years of staff-development or nursing-education experience

• Demonstrated subject-matter knowledge and expertise

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with staff and other audiences

• Basic computer skills

• Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English

• Ability to meet BAYADA’s pre-employment assessment requirements

• Commitment to BAYADA’s values of compassion, excellence, and reliability

Preferred

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)

• Recent hands-on clinical nursing experience, ideally supporting medically complex adult and/or pediatric clients

• Experience facilitating skills labs, clinical simulation, orientation, in-services, or competency validation

jobs.title: Nursing Supervisor (Full-Time) - Carle Place, NY
jobs.location: Carle Place, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Nursing Supervisor, you’re not just overseeing the floor—you’re empowering a team of emergency pros—our Credentialed Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants—to show up as their best selves, every shift. You help your VEGgies grow in skill, in confidence, and in community. You keep care quality high, team morale higher, and culture at the center of it all. This is a role for someone who leads with empathy, tackles tough conversations head-on, and thrives in an environment that moves fast and thinks forward.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Coach and mentor credentialed veterinary technicians and assistants at all levels, with feedback and structure that helps them grow

• Address team issues with clarity and care, always protecting the patients and the team

• Collaborate with hospital leadership on performance, feedback, recognition, and big-picture planning

• Help design and maintain hospital flow to reflect the VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Jump in to address customer concerns in real-time and partner with leadership for lasting solutions

• Keep people and pets together, supported, and cared for throughout their visit

• Manage the nursing schedule, PTO requests, and daily coverage needs

• Guide team utilization to meet operational needs and individual development goals

• Lead team huddles and meetings to keep everyone aligned and inspired

• Collaborate across the leadership team to ensure smooth, efficient hospital operations

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a clinical veterinary nursing or technician role

• A focus on developing leadership skills

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($32.00 - $50.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Regional Account Executive, Florida
jobs.description:
Territory: Florida

Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

This role is specifically responsible for building and growing Flai’s presence across Florida. The Regional Account Executive will regularly meet with dealerships throughout the state and should be comfortable traveling across the territory.


ABOUT FLAI

AI has transformed B2B SaaS but has struggled to reach many of the real-world industries that shape our lives. Flai is building the leading AI-native communications platform for automotive dealerships.

Auto retail is a $1.3 trillion industry. Dealerships sell 96% of the 16 million new vehicles purchased each year, yet many still rely on outdated systems and manual processes. Dealerships spend approximately $36 billion annually on operations, creating a significant opportunity for Flai.

We launched our first voice AI product a year ago. Since then, we have introduced multiple products across hundreds of dealerships throughout the United States. We have partnered with the country’s second-largest automaker and many leading dealership groups.

Flai is backed by Toyota Ventures, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Innovation Endeavors, SV Angel, and Liquid 2. We have grown rapidly with a small, scrappy team and continue to operate with that speed and ambition.


ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a Regional Account Executive to own and grow Flai’s go-to-market presence across Florida.

You will develop the territory strategy, build the prospecting motion, establish an in-person presence, and drive revenue across the state. You will work directly with the founders and help shape how Flai wins the dealership market.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the full sales cycle: Prospect, book meetings, pitch, and close dealerships and dealer groups across Florida.

 - Build and manage pipeline: Map priority accounts, identify decision-makers, and keep opportunities organized and moving forward.

 - Sell in the field: Meet dealership leaders in person to build trust, understand their needs, and create momentum.

 - Build the go-to-market motion: Shape the territory strategy, outreach approach, and field sales playbook alongside the founders.

 - Strengthen the product feedback loop: Share market insights directly with Product and Leadership to influence our direction as we scale.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven sales execution: Experience owning and closing deals from prospecting through signature in a high-velocity or high-stakes environment.

 - Automotive experience: Direct experience selling to dealerships or working inside one. You understand dealership organizations and how purchasing decisions are made.

 - Strong communication skills: Clear, persuasive, and confident when presenting in person or remotely.

 - Solution-oriented thinking: Able to understand dealer pain points and recommend the right solution instead of simply pitching a product.

 - Comfort with field sales: Willing and able to travel throughout Florida to meet customers and prospects.

 - A high-speed operating rhythm: Energized by a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

 - Operational discipline: Comfortable maintaining CRM hygiene, managing a clean pipeline, and following structured, repeatable processes.

 - A founder mindset: Self-directed, persistent, and motivated by ownership. You focus on outcomes and do not require extensive direction.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Designer at Commure, you'll design intuitive productivity experiences for healthcare providers. Your work will span interaction, systems, and service design, grounded in a user-centered process that balances provider needs, business goals, and technical possibility. You'll simplify complex, multi-dimensional workflows and contribute across the full product lifecycle: discovery research, ideation, iteration, and client launch. We're a build-oriented team, so fluency in AI-native design tools and processes is a plus.



About You: You're proactive, detail-oriented, and effective under ambiguity. You are a strong communicator both in writing and collaborative settings. You thrive in fast-paced environments and bring genuine curiosity to understanding healthcare, from clinical workflows to the business and operations of running a practice. You don't just execute PRDs and hand off specs; you help define the problem and you stay engaged through execution.



Logistics: This is a full-time, on-site role based at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA, with occasional travel to client sites for field research and direct user engagement. This posting covers multiple open roles across Commure.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



END-TO-END PRODUCT DESIGN:

 - Create and deliver high-quality, polished, and intuitive UI/UX designs that enhance the overall visual appeal and user experience of Commure Ambient AI.

 - Create wireframes, low and high-fidelity interfaces, and interactive prototypes in Figma, Cursor, and other AI-powered tools to support the development of new features and product enhancements.

 - Conduct user research, develop insights through journey mapping, UX workflow analysis, and testing to validate design decisions and improve user experiences.

 - Develop design briefs and PRDs framing product opportunities and translating them into actionable projects.


COLLABORATION AND STRATEGY:

 - Work closely with design and cross-functional partners, including product managers, engineers, and customer success teams, to conceptualize and refine product features.

 - Solicit and share feedback for continuous improvement, articulating your design decisions throughout the process.

 - Identify future opportunities and influence product roadmaps as a key thought partner to your product and engineering counterparts, balancing business requirements and end-user needs.

 - Work alongside a talented and passionate team of designers, polishing your design craft through fast-growing products.


BEST PRACTICES AND DESIGN SYSTEM:

 - Stay up to date with the latest best practices of design systems, user-centered design principals, and accessibility standards.

 - Support and contribute to the Commure design system, ensuring consistency in design across all platforms and devices.

 - Develop discourse with teammates on design quality through a deep understanding of consumer and enterprise products, from design inspirations to competitive analysis.

 - Champion user-centered design principles, continuously improve your design craft, and elevate the design culture within the company.
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE



EXPERIENCE AND EXPERTISE:

 - 6+ years of professional experience in end-to-end product design.

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in product design, industrial design, architecture, human-computer-interaction, or other related fields.

 - Strong portfolio showcasing research-driven UX design, exceptional visual design and problem solving abilities.

 - Proficiency in designing high-fidelity interfaces and building interactive prototypes in Figma, Cursor, and various AI-powered tools.

 - Experience working with and contributing to a design system


SKILLS AND TRAITS:

 - Strong sense of craftsmanship from creating refined interaction experiences, paying attention to details, addressing edge cases and building delightful micro-interactions.

 - A self-motivated, proactive mindset - you are always looking for opportunities to improve a product and drive projects forward.

 - Strategic thinking - you are a high-level thinker that always think about the larger picture of product experience as a whole, beyond the specific feature you are working on.

 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills - you can understand business priorities and technical constraints, and articulate your design solutions to stakeholders and cross-functional team members.

 - Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity, and propose design concepts with an informed POV with incomplete information.

 - A passion for learning directly from users and building meaningful products

 - You write to think, with experience developing design briefs and PRDs, and the ability to integrate complex business information into actionable design propositions.

 - Strong organizational and management skills - you can bring structure to ambiguity, organize your work through setting expectations and timelines, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.


WHAT WE OFFER:

 - A collaborative and dynamic work environment where your contributions directly impact the future of healthcare technology.

 - We have a close-knit design team that operates like a design studio where we develop design discourse, learn about the latest trends and up-level our craft together.

 - Opportunities to grow and take ownership in building a product from the ground up.

 - Competitive compensation and benefits package.

 - Support for your professional development and learning goals.



Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com http://commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
GovDash helps businesses win and deliver government contracts that advance American interests.  Our AI platform is a single, secure, workflow-driven system for the full contracting lifecycle, from opportunity discovery and capture through proposal execution, award, and post-award operations.  We’re building Dash, an AI coworker that takes action across every part of the government contracting workflow to help real businesses be more successful.  To date, our customers have won over $15B in awards while using GovDash.  



Our engineering team is a tight knit group of incredibly talented people. We’re lean and bias toward action, which allows for a high level of ownership and accountability. We treat our engineering organization as the GovCon AI research lab. We experiment with cutting edge techniques to meet the stringent requirements that the government and our customers demand. The bar is high. We have a unique customer base and complex environments that are FedRAMP certified, support ITAR, or are self-hosted and run in a customer’s cloud. Our team enjoys working with these unique security and compliance constraints and all the complexities that come with them.  





WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Ship features customers use every day, from design through production.

 - Talk to customers and use their insight to guide your prioritization and decision making.

 - Build agents that call tools, cite their sources, and show their work.

 - Write evals and verify outputs that don’t always seem black and white.

 - Take workflows people run by hand and make them autonomous, with verification, traceability, and observability built in.

 - Improve how we build: our model harness, our coding agents, our infra, etc.


WHO YOU ARE:

Everyone we hire:

 - Has high agency. You see a problem and fix it without being asked.

 - Has a bias to action and works with urgency.

 - Brings real effort and drive; we can teach you Typescript, we can’t teach you to care.

 - Cares about America and her interests.

Things we look for:

 - You've shipped things we can look at: open source, side projects, a portfolio, or something you launched publicly at a company.

 - You've written an eval, compared models against each other, or built with coding agents.

 - You've taken a loop a person was running and made it mostly run itself. You can show how you know it works.

 - You might be a deep specialist in evals, infra, testing, or systems.

Going above and beyond:

 - You've owned a large part of a product, or made high-impact contributions across several product areas.

 - You've been a lead, done well at a startup like ours, worked on a stack like ours, or written code at big-tech scale.

 - You have strong opinions on technical design and product direction, and you can defend them.

 - You're fully self-directed. You may lead other engineers.


OUR STACK:

 - Our primary app is written end-to-end in TypeScript and Effect, React and Next.js on the front end, and some Rust in our infrastructure (e.g. agent sandboxes).

 - Prisma, tRPC, Postgres, Redis, and Temporal for background workflows.

 - Models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, run through our own harness.

 - Cursor, Linear, Slack, and Google Workspace.

 - Access to Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Grok Bot, etc.


WHERE YOU MIGHT WORK:

 - Capture: finding and qualifying opportunities, and managing pipeline.

 - Proposal: drafting and reviewing content with AI that cites its sources and satisfies compliance requirements.

 - Contract: deliverables, modifications, and past performance management for active contracts.

 - Platform: Dash itself, its sub-agents, automations, and integrations like Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, and Google Drive.

 - Data Library: how customer documents and records feed every AI workflow, with the user in control.


LOGISTICS AND COMP:

 - In office 4 days a week in Flatiron with 1 flex day from home.

 - Salary: $160,000 – $200,000.

 - Equity in a fast growing start up.

 - Health, dental, vision insurance.

 - 401K & company match.

 - Paid time off and off for all federal holidays.

 - A collaborative and supportive team culture.

 - Dinner on us when you work past 7pm.

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant III, Enterprise Restaurants
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life

As an Implementation Consultant III, you architect complex technical setups and lead high-stakes, multi-location rollouts for Enterprise clients. Leveraging deep expertise in Toast's technology suite, configurations, content hierarchies, and integration frameworks for multi-site operations.

Your day might start with a working session with a brand's corporate IT team to map network requirements across multiple locations, move into a hierarchy that a franchisee can update without breaking corporate brand standards, and end with unblocking a peer on a tricky hardware escalation. You move fluidly between the technical detail and the executive conversation — one moment troubleshooting an integration, the next reframing a rollout timeline for a regional VP.

You are a leader on the Technical Onboarding team. You mentor peers, spot workflow gaps before they become fire drills, and serve as the primary escalation point when advanced hardware and software challenges surface across the Enterprise deployment organization.

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

• Architect complex technical setups and design scalable configurations for multi-site operations

• Lead high-stakes, multi-location rollouts for Enterprise brands from design through go-live

• Lead integration frameworks that hold up across dozens or hundreds of sites

• Independently manage intricate franchisee and corporate relationships, proactively mitigating brand-level risks before they surface

jobs.title: Electrical Project Manager (Industrial)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Electrical Project Manager (Industrial)

Company: Loenbro, LLC
Business Unit/Department: Southeast
Location: Rome, GA / On-site
Reports to:  Project Executive
Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Classification: Exempt

About Loenbro

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

At Loenbro, we don’t just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose. Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

Job Summary

As an Industrial Electrical Project Manager at Loenbro, you will lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of industrial electrical construction projects. Projects may include power generation facilities, substations, manufacturing plants, industrial processing facilities, renewable energy installations, water and wastewater treatment plants, and other heavy industrial construction projects.

The Project Manager is responsible for the full project lifecycle, including estimating support, project planning, budgeting, procurement, field execution, contract administration, scheduling, safety performance, commissioning, and project closeout. This role partners closely with customers, field leadership, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Essential Job Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

• Develop and manage project execution plans, schedules, manpower forecasts, budgets, and procurement plans for industrial electrical construction projects.

• Collaborate with clients, engineers, superintendents, and project stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, deliverables, and success criteria.

• Ensure projects are executed in accordance with contract requirements, specifications, drawings, and applicable industry standards.

• Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize schedule, cost, and operational impacts.

Team Leadership

• Lead and support project teams, including electrical superintendents, foremen, field electricians, subcontractors, and vendors.

• Establish clear performance expectations and accountability measures.

• Foster a culture centered on safety, collaboration, quality, and operational excellence.

Financial Management

• Develop, manage, and maintain project budgets, forecasts, cost reports, and earned value metrics.

• Monitor labor productivity, equipment utilization, material costs, and subcontractor performance.

• Manage change orders, claims, contingencies, and project financial reporting to maximize project profitability.

Scheduling & Resource Management

• Coordinate labor, equipment, tools, and material resources to support project milestones and client commitments.

• Work closely with procurement teams and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of critical electrical materials and equipment.

• Monitor project schedules and implement recovery plans when required.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers and project stakeholders.

• Facilitate project meetings, provide status updates, and communicate project risks, opportunities, and progress.

• Build long-term customer relationships through effective communication and project execution.

Safety & Quality

• Promote and enforce Loenbro's safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, NFPA standards, customer requirements, and company EH&S policies.

• Conduct site visits, safety reviews, and quality inspections to verify compliance with project specifications and workmanship standards.

• Support incident investigations and implement corrective actions when necessary.

Contract & Change Management

• Review contracts, specifications, and scope documents to ensure project compliance.

• Manage Requests for Information (RFIs), submittals, field directives, and change order documentation.

• Evaluate and negotiate scope changes while minimizing impacts to project schedules and budgets.

Project Closeout

• Coordinate system startup, testing, commissioning, and turnover activities.

• Ensure completion of punch list items and final project documentation.

• Conduct project reviews and capture lessons learned to support continuous improvement.

Travel

• Travel up to 25% as required to support project activities and customer needs.

Skills

• Strong knowledge of industrial electrical systems, power distribution, substations, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), instrumentation, grounding systems, and industrial control systems.

• Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA regulations, and industry best practices.

• Proficiency with project management, scheduling, and construction software.

• Strong understanding of industrial construction means and methods.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining deadlines and customer expectations.

• Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

• Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost controls, and productivity analysis.

• Commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Required:

• 5+ years of project management experience in industrial electrical construction.

• Experience managing projects in one or more of the following markets:

• Power Generation

• Utilities

• Manufacturing

• Renewable Energy

• Oil & Gas

• Water/Wastewater Treatment

• Data Centers

• Heavy Industrial Construction

• Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, subcontractors, schedules, and field operations.

• Strong understanding of electrical construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents.

• Valid driver's license and ability to travel as needed.

Preferred: *if any

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.

• Journeyman Electrician License or Master Electrician License.

• OSHA 30 Certification.

• NFPA 70E Certification.

• PMP (Project Management Professional) Certification.

• Experience utilizing Bluebeam, Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Accubid, and/or SAP.

• Experience managing projects valued at $5M+.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Environment:

• Safely navigate active industrial construction sites, including uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, scaffolding, and elevated work areas.

• Frequent exposure to active construction, manufacturing, power generation, and industrial operating environments.

• Exposure to varying weather conditions, noise, dust, vibration, and industrial hazards.

• Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety glasses, FR clothing, hearing protection, gloves, and fall protection equipment.

• Combination of office and field-based work, with significant time spent on construction sites.

This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.

Benefits

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Paid time off (PTO)

• Life and disability insurance

• Professional development and training opportunities

• Employee assistance program (EAP)

Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.

Guided by Core Values (LEAD), grounded in grit and a commitment to excellence, Loenbro betters our families, customers, and local communities.  If you’re ready to be part of a company that LEADS by:

• Living with Integrity

• Exceeding Expectations

• Acting with Urgency

• Delivering Excellence

…we want to hear from you.

Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Exploration Geologist
jobs.description:
About the Company:

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 80 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the position

In this role, you will lead evaluations of potential properties for acquisition, generate targets, and design and oversee field programs from target definition through to resource expansion. You will be part of a multidisciplinary team and will work closely with data scientists, using KoBold’s technology to help guide our field programs and decision-making. You will also work directly with our senior technical advisors and with the executive team on making the investment case for acquisitions and field programs.

Ultimately, your role is to help KoBold make valuable discoveries by identifying opportunities with rigorous evaluation and by ensuring that we safely and effectively conduct our field programs.

Responsibilities

• Demonstrate in all activities a commitment to the highest standards in health and safety, environment, and community relations

• Rigorously analyze geoscientific datasets across a range of scales from provinces to prospects to determine exploration potential and to identify, rank, and prioritize exploration targets

• Design, budget, permit, and execute field programs ranging from geological mapping and sampling of grass roots prospects through to large drilling programs on advanced projects, with leading industry practice in data acquisition and validation

• Provide technical guidance and support to local in-country project teams during the design and execution of exploration programs, including site visits and engagement with other project stakeholders (e.g., community representatives, regulatory authorities, and joint venture partners)

• Work collaboratively with data scientist colleagues to conceive and implement insightful analytical methods

Qualifications

A great Exploration Geologist candidate will have:

• Strong technical knowledge of one or more ore deposit types. Experience working on sediment-hosted stratiform copper or magmatic sulfide deposits will be considered an advantage

• Excellence in generative analysis ranging from new concepts to integration, interpretation, and modeling of large datasets

• Good field skills and experience conducting field programs across a range of project stages from grassroots prospects through to advanced projects with significant drilling campaigns

• Baseline level of proficiency in standard desktop software packages (e.g., ArcGIS or QGIS)

• Strong leadership skills including the ability to motivate and inspire others, to share ownership and responsibility for project outcomes, and to work effectively in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams

• Previous experience in coaching and training geoscientists of varying experience, educational backgrounds and cultures in leading-practice mineral exploration

• Demonstrated commitment to high standards of health and safety in the workplace

• A minimum of 3-7 years experience in the mineral exploration industry

• A valid passport (or the ability to obtain one) and willingness to travel to Mingomba or other exploration sites worldwide.

It is helpful but not required to have:

• Working knowledge of one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, R, C/C++)

• Knowledge of geostatistics and/or other statistical methods relevant for analysis of geoscientific data

• International experience, particularly in the Central African Copperbelt

Note: Candidates who are specialists in geochemistry or geophysics but open to doing significant project work are encouraged to apply.

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

The US base salary range for this full-time exempt position is $70,000-$110,000.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: United States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, United Kingdom, Zambia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Namibia, Finland, Sweden, or Botswana.

Why Verifone

For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.

What's exciting about the role

2Checkout, a Verifone company, is an all-in-one monetization platform that helps businesses expand internationally and optimize recurring revenue streams by simplifying the back-end complexities of modern digital commerce. With 20+ years in business, 2Checkout has built a track record of delivering mission-critical functionality for enterprise technology companies monetizing through digital commerce.

We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Account Executive to join our Americas digital sales team. This is an individual contributor role for a proven seller who combines the mindset of a hunter with the skills of a trusted advisor — someone who can win new logos among software, SaaS, e-commerce, and digital goods merchants while growing share of wallet within an existing portfolio of recurring clients.

This role can be based out of any Verifone office in North America or performed remotely, with occasional travel to visit merchants and attend industry events.

Responsibilities

New Business Development

• Prospect, identify, and pursue net-new digital commerce opportunities across the Americas, targeting software, SaaS, e-commerce, digital goods, and other online merchants

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through strategic outreach, networking, partner and referral channels, and market intelligence

• Drive new and recurring revenue across sales-assisted and self-service channels

• Consistently meet or exceed individual pipeline generation, new logo, and revenue quotas

Account Management & Growth

• Develop and grow an assigned portfolio of recurring merchant accounts in collaboration with Account Management team members

• Build account plans that drive revenue growth, retention, and platform adoption

• Expand share of wallet through cross-sell and upsell of 2Checkout capabilities, new markets, and additional payment methods

• Collaborate with Customer Success, Account Management, Compliance, Product, Solutions Architecture, and other internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless merchant experience

Consultative Solution Selling

• Conduct deep discovery to understand each merchant's business model, billing and subscription needs, technology stack, and international expansion goals

• Develop tailored business cases and ROI-driven recommendations that directly address merchant needs

• Present the 2Checkout value proposition compellingly to senior stakeholders across the decision-making process

Deal Management

• Lead multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through contract execution

• Navigate competitive situations and clearly differentiate 2Checkout in the digital commerce and online payments market

• Coordinate internal resources including Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Product, Risk/Compliance, Legal, and Implementation teams

• Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline reporting, and CRM hygiene

Team & Market Contribution

• Partner with the Head of Digital Sales on regional sales strategy, account targeting, and territory planning

• Share customer, market, and competitor insights with Product, Marketing, and Operations to help shape positioning and product direction

• Contribute to deal reviews and team best-practice sharing, and represent 2Checkout at industry events and merchant visits

Qualifications

• 5+ years of sales experience in the payments, e-commerce, SaaS, or fintech industry; experience in digital commerce or online payments a strong plus

• Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota and driving new net and recurring revenue

• A strategic hunter mindset — skilled at generating pipeline through relevant outreach, network leverage, and identifying and converting buying signals into conversations

• Proven success closing complex opportunities with multiple decision-makers while also managing and growing existing accounts

• Ability to convey compelling value to a wide range of stakeholders and personas across the decision-making process

• Strong understanding of consultative and solution-based selling methodologies such as Challenger Sale, Force Management, and Command of the Message

• Experience presenting and negotiating with senior executives

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

• Proficiency in CRM software and sales analytics tools

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Willingness to travel occasionally across the Americas for prospect meetings and industry events

• Experience with merchant of record, payment gateway, subscription billing, or online payment platforms is a plus

• Established network across the e-commerce and fintech industry in the Americas is a plus

• Experience selling to software, SaaS, e-commerce, digital goods, e-gaming, or AI companies is a plus

Our commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations.  Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions.  Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment.  Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology.  At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

LG Magna e-Powertrain USA, Inc. is a newly established US subsidiary headquartered in South Korea, formed through a joint venture by LG Electronics Vehicle Solution and Magna International, created to bring new synergies based on LG’s electric vehicle component capabilities and Magna’s experience in the traditional automotive industry. Located in Southeast Michigan, LG Magna USA provides engineering, sales, and quality solutions for developing various electric vehicle products such as drive motors, power conversion devices, and related integrated systems. LG Magna USA, as part of the global LG Magna team, strives to become the global No.1 e-Mobility solution partner by providing the highest value technologies and products, securing profitable growth together with customers, and contributing to a sustainable society. Our team takes pride in driving progress by developing innovative solutions for electric vehicle industry customers. Powered by a culture of passion, teamwork, customer focus, initiative, and creativity, we are pushing the boundaries every day. Overall Responsibilities:

The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for analyzing and managing the Company’s business performance and operations, and for delivering accurate and timely financial information that enables management to make sound decisions and achieve the Company’s goals. The role serves as a key point of communication with Headquarters (HQ) on the Company’s operations, management, and performance.

Major Tasks Listed Below:

Business Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting:

• Establish and forecast the Company’s short-term and mid- to long-term business plans.

• Develop and prepare the organization’s financial plans and budgets, and interpret financial reports.

• Create financial forecasting scenarios to support future business planning decisions.

• Manage and monitor the execution of annual budgets allocated to business units.

• Manage investment activity and the related budget.

• Communicate with HQ regarding the Company’s operations, management, and performance.

• Prepare presentations for management on business operations and financial results.

• Provide financial information to management accurately and on a timely basis.

Performance Analysis and KPI Management

• Analyze and manage the Company’s business performance and support analysis of overall Company results.

• Manage and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

• Evaluate and report on inventory KPIs by comparing and analyzing actual results to plan and latest estimates.

• Conduct variance analysis and identify the key underlying drivers of differences between actual, plan, and forecast.

• Conduct financial analyses and perform economic research and studies.

• Collect, compile, verify, and analyze financial information and economic indicators so that senior management has accurate and timely information for strategic and operational decisions.

• Analyze and forecast financial, economic, and other data to support strategic and operational decisions.

• Analyze the financial implications of proposed investments or other transactions so that senior managers can evaluate alternatives against the organization’s business objectives.

• Data analyzed may include revenues, expenses, costs, prices, investments, cash flow, profits, labor market trends, inflation, interest rates, and exchange rates.

• Develop, establish, and continuously improve financial procedures and reporting.

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

• Proficient knowledge of accounting and finance, including variance analysis.

• Expert knowledge of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, etc.), PowerPoint, and Word.

• Ability to deliver timely and accurate information.

• Ability to identify patterns across situations that are not obviously related, and to identify key underlying issues in complex situations.

• Experience working with online analytical processing databases and preparing executive-level reports and presentations.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Working knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards and U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

• Demonstrated ability to build accurate financial models, communicate complex information clearly, and deliver compelling presentations.

• Bilingual in the Korean language - conversational or higher level of expertise is desirable

jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Full-Time) - Carle Place, NY
jobs.location: Carle Place, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($27.00 - $48.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

Orchestra is a strategic communications and marketing company built for today’s complex and fragmented world. From decoding audiences to designing bold strategies, Orchestra integrates people, platforms, and stories that stick to help clients build lasting influence. The company offers programs that span from the highest level strategic business counsel through to tactical execution. Orchestra brings together 700+ people with experience across consumer and lifestyle, technology, nonprofit and philanthropy, real estate, sports, travel, hospitality, and more. Made up of leading firms BerlinRosen, Civitas Public Affairs Group, Derris, Glen Echo Group, Inkhouse, M18, Message Lab, Onward and Small Girls PR. It also launched Brightmode, a talent acquisition firm for communications professionals, and Versus Media Group, a strategy-first political media team. Learn more at www.orchestraco.com.

People of all backgrounds and abilities are strongly encouraged to apply. Orchestra is committed to building and maintaining a diverse staff, and recognizes that its continued success depends on hiring and retaining high-quality creative professionals with a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Opportunities for advancement exist, and we are committed to helping all staff develop and grow.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Orchestra is looking for a Director who lives and breathes consumer culture and knows how to turn what people are talking about into ideas that get brands noticed. You’ll lead integrated communications work for consumer brands, developing creative strategies and campaigns that connect earned media, influencer marketing, partnerships, events and cultural moments. You’ll be a senior day-to-day partner to clients, a creative and strategic lead for your teams, and someone who is always looking for the next idea, story or opportunity. We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable setting the strategy, selling a big idea and rolling up their sleeves with the team to make it happen.

Note: This role is based in our NYC office, working two-three days a week in the office on a hybrid schedule.

ACCOUNTABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

As a Director, you will...

• Lead integrated communications strategies and campaigns for consumer brands, from the initial idea through execution

• Serve as a senior client partner, bringing strong counsel, creative thinking and proactive ideas to the table

• Develop big, culturally relevant ideas that can come to life across earned media, influencer marketing, partnerships, events and other channels

• Lead media strategy and storytelling, helping teams find the angles and moments that will get people talking

• Stay close to what’s happening across consumer culture, media and influencers, and translate those shifts into opportunities for clients

• Guide teams in bringing launches, partnerships, activations and other brand moments to life

• Lead client presentations, strategic planning and high-stakes conversations with confidence

• Oversee multiple workstreams while keeping the work creative, strategic and moving forward

• Lead and develop account teams, giving people clear direction, thoughtful feedback and room to grow

• Identify opportunities to expand the work and deepen client relationships

Essential skills:

• 7-9+ years of consumer PR, communications or integrated marketing experience; agency experience strongly preferred

• Significant experience leading communications programs for consumer and lifestyle brands

• Strong media relations expertise and a deep understanding of what makes a consumer story break through

• Experience developing integrated campaigns that bring together PR, influencer marketing, partnerships, events and other channels

• Strong creative instincts and a genuine pulse on consumer culture, trends and the conversations shaping what people care about

• The ability to turn a client challenge or business objective into a compelling communications idea

• Excellent client counsel, writing, presentation and communication skills

• Experience leading and developing teams across multiple accounts and workstreams

• A proactive, entrepreneurial approach and comfort moving quickly from idea to execution

WORKING AT ORCHESTRA

Salary range: $110,000 - $125,000, commensurate with experience
