jobs.title: Senior Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager, AMER
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Revenue Strategy & Operations is the team behind how Horizon3's go-to-market organization is planned, run and measured. We own budgeting and headcount planning, quota and compensation, territory planning and management (accounts, opportunities, leads and routing), goals for pipeline and performance, forecasting, performance management, and the operating process the sales organization runs on. Regional partners carry that scope for their sales leaders in AMER, EMEA and APJ. Global Centers of Excellence set the standards they all run on. This role sits on the AMER team, which carries that scope for the Americas sales organization, the largest in the company.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager, AMER to join our Americas team during a period of fast growth. You will run the operating cadence for your assigned segments, own the analysis behind forecasting and planning, and make sure the territories, data and reporting AMER sales leaders rely on are accurate and trusted.

This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership. You will work directly with first-line and second-line sales leaders and their teams, act as the backup for AMER Revenue Strategy & Operations leadership, and help build an operating model that scales with the business. You run on the global standards our Centers of Excellence set for planning, process and compensation, and you have a hand in improving them.

The role takes high agency: think for yourself, dive into ambiguity, and drive work through to done.



WHAT YOU'LL DO


RUN THE RHYTHM OF THE BUSINESS

 - Run the weekly forecast and pipeline review cadence for your segments: the inspection views, call-outs and roll-ups leaders use to call the number.

 - Own pipeline and performance analytics for your segments, including coverage, pipeline creation, conversion, velocity, win rates and rep productivity, and turn the analysis into clear narratives for monthly and quarterly business reviews.

 - Partner day to day with first-line and second-line sales leaders and the overlay leaders in your segments, resolving issues and anticipating what they need next.

 - Deploy the pipeline and performance goals set for your segments, track them by team and rep, and flag early when a team is off pace.

 - Serve as backup to AMER Revenue Strategy & Operations leadership across forecast, review and planning activities.


EXECUTE PLANNING, TERRITORIES AND QUOTAS

 - Provide the capacity, productivity and territory inputs for annual and in-year planning, pressure-test the plan for your segments, and deploy it when it comes back.

 - Run territory and account assignment for your segments: annual carves, mid-year changes, new-hire territories, account moves and routing, through the global change process so Salesforce, routing and reporting match what the field expects.

 - Apply the global rules of engagement day to day: account ownership and crediting questions, exceptions, and the recurring issues that should go to Core Operations as policy candidates.

 - Deploy quotas and issue quota letters, and support crediting validation and dispute research with Sales Compensation and Finance.

 - Keep an auditable record of territory, routing and crediting decisions so changes can be traced and repeated.


OWN DATA QUALITY AND REPORTING

 - Hold the data quality standards for your segments: regular audits, dashboards and follow-through with reps and managers.

 - Manage Salesforce records at scale for your segments: accounts, opportunities, ownership, hierarchies and territories, including controlled bulk updates and merges.

 - Build and maintain the reports and dashboards your leaders use on top of the standard reporting, and route data model, routing and workflow changes to GTM Systems through Core Operations.

 - Monitor lead and deal registration routing exceptions, diagnose root causes across data, process and system logic, and drive permanent fixes.

 - Work across Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo and related tools to keep your segments' data accurate and usable.


SOLVE PROBLEMS AND IMPROVE HOW AMER OPERATES

 - Use a structured approach to operational problems: define the issue, quantify the impact, find the root cause, align the stakeholders, fix it and confirm it worked.

 - Lead projects that improve sales effectiveness, planning accuracy and data quality for your segments.

 - Simplify processes and remove manual hand-offs, one-off workarounds and repeated questions, using automation and approved AI tools where they cut manual work without losing control of the data.

 - Document what you build so improvements outlast the person who built them, and share standards and practices with the EMEA and APJ teams.
   


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 5 to 8 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations or a closely related analytical role in B2B SaaS.

 - Sales operations expertise: You have run or supported forecasting and pipeline inspection, managed territories and account assignments, and deployed quotas and goals for a sales team.

 - Salesforce and data fluency: Strong Salesforce skills across opportunity management, reporting, territory and ownership data and data governance, including managing records at scale and troubleshooting routing and reporting issues. Experience with Gong, ZoomInfo, Everstage or BI tools is a plus.

 - Analytical rigor: You turn operational data into short, clear insights for leaders, and you notice when a number is off before they do.

 - Partnership: You have worked directly with sales leaders and earned their trust as a credible, responsive partner.

 - High agency: You think for yourself, dive into ambiguity, own work end to end and drive it through to done.

 - Experience with Enterprise, Mid-Market or high-velocity segments, or with partner, channel or MSSP motions, is a plus.
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Leaders in your segments have a reliable, timely view of forecast, pipeline, territories and performance, and they get it from you before they ask.

 - The forecast roll-up matches what the leaders say on the call, every week.

 - Territory and account changes land right the first time, and the field, Salesforce and reporting agree on who owns what.

 - Every new seller in your segments has a territory, routing and quota in place on their first day.

 - Routing is accurate and measured, and the recurring exceptions you raise turn into fixes or policy.

 - Business review prep is about decisions, not assembling data.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range [or Total On-Target Compensation]: $140,000 - $175,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Mechanical Engineer must utilize creativity and sound engineering judgment in the design of parts and subassemblies of next generation mechanical systems for medical capital equipment. The Mechanical Engineer is expected to use machine design and analytical skills to conceptualize, develop, and verify new mechanical designs.

They are responsible for parts and assemblies from concept, design, verification, and product launch.  They provide technical leadership and inspire and guide and guide the team to successful product launches.

The Mechanical Engineer should be capable of making sound decisions when faced with time constraints and ambiguous or incomplete information typical a research and development environment.  They will interface with suppliers and manufacturing to build high-quality hardware prototypes and productize new designs.

Essential Job Duties

• Design components and produce mechanical drawings in a regulated environment for volume manufacturing processes. May include billet machined parts, sheet metal enclosures, cast metal, injection molded plastic, sheet metal stamped, etc.
• Perform various types of detailed engineering analyses (tolerance stack, process simulation, structural FEA) to ensure fit/form/function of complex tooled parts
• Support production via troubleshooting process and component problems, acting as a primary troubleshooter for line down issue recovery
• Rapid development and iteration of full-scale prototypes of candidate designs and that satisfy design requirements.
• Collaborate with manufacturing to create product assembly tooling, fixtures and instructions.

Required Skills and Experience

• Experience with machine design, preferably robot or mechanical systems design experience. Surgical product experience is a plus
• Experience in ASME Y14.5 GD&T
• Experience using CAD and creating technical drawings. SolidWorks experience preferred
• Comfortable with various phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, qualification, and transfer
• Excellent communication (written, oral) and interpersonal skills, and ability to communicate effectively.

Required Education and Training

Minimum of 5 years related experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics or equivalent; or 3 years experience and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Preferred to have proficiency performing FEA , tolerance stacks or other advanced analysis tools to design components or assemblies
• Preferred to have demonstrated effective collaboration with cross-functional teams like system analysts, field/clinical engineers, human factors, industrial design, UI design, etc.
• Preferred to have experience with design processes including Failure Modes and Effects Analyses (FMEA) and/or synthesizing design requirements for systems

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer:  In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

jobs.title: Apartment Community Manager - Mountain Gate and Trails
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are hiring an Apartment Community Manager for our apartment community Mountain Gate and Trails in Las Vegas, NV.

Our Community Managers are true business leaders who direct operations, sales, finances, and team development. They are industry front-runners and influencers who deliver extraordinary customer experiences and always strive to exceed business goals.

Community Website: Mountain Gate and Trails

What We Offer

AIR offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to reward performance and support your success, including:

• Base Pay annual range $85,000 - $95,000 + 15% target bonus opportunity. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• Commissions for new leases and renewals.
• An Apartment Discount Benefit option is available to live on-site at the community you are working.
• Additional Benefits listed below.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of leasing and maintenance professionals
• Drive leasing performance, resident retention, occupancy, and revenue growth
• Oversee day-to-day operations across both communities while ensuring exceptional customer service
• Manage budgets, financial performance, expense controls, and property goals
• Foster a positive resident experience and promptly resolve concerns
• Ensure compliance with company policies, fair housing requirements, and operational standards
• Analyze performance metrics and implement strategies that improve property results
• Partner with regional leadership to support long-term business objectives

What You Have

• 4+ years of experience in sales, customer service, and property operations, preferably within multifamily housing, hospitality, retail, or a similar service-focused industry
• 2+ years of property management leadership experience
• Experience leading teams in a fast-paced sales and customer service environment
• Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members
• Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets and financial performance
• Demonstrated success using sales processes, performance metrics, and operational strategies to drive results
• Experience with property management technologies such as Entrata, OneSite, SmartRent, Salesforce, or similar platforms
• Availability to work a schedule that typically includes Tuesday-Saturday, 10:00 AM-6:30 PM, with flexibility based on community and business needs

Benefits

• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• An Apartment Benefit option is available to live on-site at the community you are working

• Tuition assistance program and up to 100% reimbursement for job-related certifications and licenses.

• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.
• Consumer discounts on various products and services.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Workplace Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

 


YOUR ROLE

As the Senior Manager, Workplace Operations, you own the operational engine behind Zip's global workplace portfolio and ensure our SF office is running smoothly. You are building the systems, standards, and partnerships that keep every office running safely, consistently and efficiently at scale.

You lead our distributed team of Workplace office managers and security staff across multiple locations, creating the structure, accountability, and support they need to operate with confidence and autonomy. You also manage our real estate portfolio, partnering with Finance and our brokers.

This role is responsible for the operational backbone of Workplace, from vendor strategy and contract governance to security, maintenance, and playbooks, ensuring our teams can deliver a consistently high caliber employee experience without relying on manual effort or heroics.

You balance speed, quality, and cost across a growing global portfolio while continuously raising the operational bar as the business scales.




YOUR IMPACT

 - Own our global vendor strategy and performance, including sourcing, RFPs, contract negotiations, SLAs, KPI development, compliance, credentialing, renewals, and ongoing benchmarking.

 - Build and continuously evolve Workplace's operational framework, partnering with your operational teams to create scalable playbooks, SOPs, escalation paths, incident response protocols, and location-specific operating standards.

 - Serve as the site lead for our San Francisco office, ensuring operations run smoothly and uphold a workplace that is safe and delightful.

 - Manage Workplace's operational budget in partnership with Finance, tracking spend, governing contracts, managing renewals, and proactively identifying risks or opportunities.

 - Coach and develop our distributed onsite Workplace team, establishing clear operating rhythms, coaching, accountability, and consistent service standards across every location.

 - Collaborate to develop safety and security programs and processes, including onsite security operations, emergency preparedness, and incident response.

 - Oversee facilities maintenance programs across the portfolio, balancing preventative maintenance, reactive work, and capital improvements to ensure our spaces remain safe, reliable, and well maintained.

 - Set and uphold the operational standards for every Zip workplace, creating environments that are safe, thoughtful, and consistently delightful for employees, whether they're working from an office or remotely.

 - Lead our real estate strategy and build outs across sites in partnership with Finance and our brokers.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience leading Workplace, Facilities, Corporate Real Estate, or Workplace Operations within a high-growth organization, including managing distributed teams and multi-site operations.

 - Proven success building, transforming, or scaling a workplace function by establishing the systems, standards, and operating rhythms that enable sustainable growth.

 - Strong financial and operational acumen, with experience managing operating budgets, contract governance, forecasting, and long-range planning.

 - Experience managing global or multi-country workplace operations, with an understanding of regional compliance requirements, vendor ecosystems, and local operational considerations.

 - Experience partnering closely on physical security programs, including access control, vendor management, emergency preparedness, and incident response.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment while balancing strategic priorities with operational excellence.


HOW YOU LEAD

 - You believe exceptional workplaces are built through disciplined execution, thoughtful systems, and a relentless focus on the employee experience.

 - You love rolling up your sleeves to uphold the employee experience and inspire your team to do the same.

 - You build systems that scale, creating structure, standards, and repeatable processes that enable consistent execution across locations in a tiered model.

 - You bring clarity to complexity, translating operational data, risks, and tradeoffs into actionable recommendations that help leaders make confident decisions.

 - You lead with data, using operational metrics, occupancy insights, employee feedback, and financial performance to continuously improve how we operate.

 - You build trust through partnership, developing strong relationships with frontline teams, cross-functional stakeholders, vendors, and executives alike.

 - You balance urgency with thoughtful execution, knowing when to move quickly and when to invest in long-term, scalable solutions.

 - You take ownership, proactively identifying opportunities, solving problems before they escalate, and continuously raising the bar for operational excellence.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience scaling workplace operations across an international portfolio.

 - Experience supporting both office-based and distributed employees through thoughtful workplace programs and operational strategies.

 - Experience implementing workplace technology platforms, operational reporting, or process automation to improve scale and efficiency.

 - Familiarity with capital projects, office openings, relocations, or large-scale workplace transformations.

 

The salary range for this role is $180,000-$200,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise. This role requires 5 days onsite in our SF office to ensure the office is running smoothly.

 


PERKS & BENEFITS

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

 - 📈 Start-up equity

 - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options

 - 🍽️ Catered breakfast, lunch, & dinner

 - 🌴 Flexible PTO

 - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership

 - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit

 - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

 - 💻 Home office stipend

 - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement

 - 🍼 Paid parental leave

 - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend

 - 💸 401k plan

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Experience Manager is responsible for creating, incubating, selling, planning, and executing private and public experiences on and off the mountain across the winter and summer seasons, in partnership with the Experience Director. This role is highly client-facing, leading sales calls and meetings with both internal teams and prospective clients to bring new experiences to life. The Experience Manager also provides hands-on, on-site management of event experiences and staff, ensuring seamless execution and a high-quality experience for every attendee. Success in this role requires close collaboration across departments throughout the organization, from sales and operations to marketing and mountain teams, to deliver experiences that are both innovative and flawlessly executed. This position reports to the Director of Client Experience.

The salary range for this position is $65,000 to $80,000. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience; all our salaried roles are eligible for bonus.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until December 1, 2026.

Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities

• Work with Director of Experiences to ideate, curate, deliver and incubate world-class experiences across Aspen One
• Serve as a key connector across Aspen One, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Hospitality Operations and Mountain Operations to align experiences with broader company goals and ensure consistent, on-brand execution.
• Identify market trends and drive innovation for new experiences across Aspen One
• Give attention to every detail around event planning and execution, from guest greeting to exceptional standards for service and aesthetic on site.
• Sell experiences for Aspen One across all channels (email/phone/in person), proactively prospecting new business and building a pipeline of private and corporate clients. Provide timely follow-up with guests and convert leads into sales with confidence, meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
• Create a warm, welcoming environment and build personalized relationships with guests, using names and preferences to deliver tailored service
• Partner with the Director of Experiences to bring new experiences to life, from concept and planning through execution — collaborating cross-functionally with partners, brands and marketing teams at every stage
• Client management, providing tailored offerings based on guests needs from creation through execution and follow up, as necessary.
• Work with Director of Experiences to hire staff to execute experiences
• On-site management of staff during event and experience execution
• Hosting, assisting and collaborating with our key partners and brands such as LVMH, Burgess and many others.
• Develop and maintain relationships with key Aspen Skiing Company and Aspen Hospitality personnel to facilitate effective communication and execution with the following departments - Product Sales & Services, Hospitality Operations, Ski and Snowboard Schools, Rental/Retail, Administration, Guest Services, Online Services, Events & Partnerships and Mountain Operations
• Share feedback with management regarding products and procedures to enhance the guest experience and immediately address opportunities
• Possess intimate knowledge of local mountain terrain, snow conditions, and department programming to make accurate and appealing recommendations
• Understand the department’s budget and operate within it while analyzing trends from daily financial snapshots, historical reports and forecasts
• Complete tasks and projects delegated by your manager and assist other departments as business volumes and staff levels demand
• Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience Requirements

• College degree preferred
• At least 2 years of experience working in a role responsible for delivering a high level of guest service required
• At least 2 years of experience working events required
• Sales experience preferred
• Managerial experience in an event setting preferred (servers, kitchen staff, drivers, etc.)
• Previous experience using Microsoft Office Suite required
• Bi-lingual preferred

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate proficiently verbally in English and Spanish is preferred
• Knowledge of customer preferences and how to meet or exceed them
• Proficient knowledge of Microsoft applications including Word, Excel and Powerpoint
• Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
• Demonstrated active listening and interpersonal skills used to personalize the guest experience
• Ability to build relationships with clients while anticipating and exceeding their needs and troubleshooting issues in a timely, calm and professional manner
• Ability to function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment
• Ability to act professional in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Skilled in creating exceptional guest experiences through personalized service and attention to detail
• Ability to quickly adapt to changes in processes, customer flow, environments, and tasks
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously without sacrificing quality
• Ability to manage and lead diverse teams, fostering a positive and productive work environment
• Ability to delegate tasks effectively, empowering teams while maintaining accountability
• Ability to assess team performance, provide feedback, and implement development plans
• Proficient knowledge of industry regulations and how they affect business operations

jobs.title: Veterinary Nursing Shift Lead (Full-Time) - Carle Place, NY
jobs.location: Carle Place, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

Veterinary nursing Shift Leads are the glue that holds each shift together—and the spark that keeps it moving. You own the rhythm and flow of each shift, making sure patients get top-tier care and every VEGgie has what they need to thrive. From team huddles and rounds to break coverage and on-the-floor coaching, you’re the steady presence keeping things smooth, safe, and supported. You don’t need to know every detail, but you do keep a big picture view—anticipating what’s next and jumping in wherever needed. You lead with heart, hustle, and a belief that when your team is empowered, great care follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep a clear pulse on patient status, team bandwidth, and shift-wide needs

• Manage daily workflow and help the team pivot when the unexpected hits

• Ensure shift roles are assigned and adapted as needed, with clarity and care

• Jump in on the floor when help is needed—no task is too small

• Coordinate breaks, assist with conflict resolution, and model calm under pressure

• Lead shift transitions, team huddles, and start/end-of-day wrap-ups

• Communicate clearly, direct questions appropriately, and elevate key issues

• Help the team turn downtime into learning time—or just a moment to breathe

• Flag incidents or notable events with a mindset of transparency and growth

• Work with hospital leadership on coverage, call-outs, and ongoing coaching

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) or enrolled in the VEG Credentialing Support Program preferred

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician or assistant role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Strong grasp of clinical workflow and team dynamics

• Confidence in navigating floor operations while guiding others with empathy

• Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills

• Flexibility and a willingness to step in wherever needed

• Leadership instincts, an ownership mindset, and a desire to grow professionally

• Basic computer skills, comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($27.00 - $48.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (West Coast)
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.

Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

 


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.

This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.

You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.

 - Partner tightly with enterprise AEs on account strategy you'll co-own named accounts, align on entry points, and run coordinated multi-threaded plays to break into large organizations

 - Research target accounts to craft highly personalized, technically credible outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone

 - Book discovery calls and product demos for enterprise AEs; provide full context so they walk in sharp and prepared

 - Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion

 - Surface market intelligence back to the product and GTM teams as you're often the first to hear what buyers care about

 - Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - 3–5 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company

 - Genuine curiosity about technology; you don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold an intelligent conversation about why a company might choose a managed WebRTC platform over a self-hosted stack

 - Strong written communication - you know the difference between an email that gets deleted and one that gets a reply

 - Experience with sales engagement tools and Salesforce

 - Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where the playbook is still being written and flexibility is required

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Background selling to engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML teams

 - Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communications, or WebRTC concepts

 - Experience at an open-source company with a PLG motion - you understand what it means when a developer has been building with your product for 6 months before the first sales conversation

 - Experience using AI tools to accelerate prospecting and personalization at scale

 


WHY LIVEKIT

 - Enormous market. Real-time AI is becoming a requirement for nearly every enterprise application. We're the infrastructure layer, and we're well ahead of the field.

 - Incredible developer traction. Our sales team doesn't cold-call strangers they engage with a community that already loves the product.

 - Technical credibility. You'll sell something that engineers respect. That matters if you care about representing products you believe in.

 - Trajectory. This is a ground-floor opportunity on an enterprise sales team at a company with serious investor backing, strong revenue growth, and the reference customers to close big deals.

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

 - Competitive comp: Base + uncapped commission + equity. We want SDRs who want to win.

 - An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

 - Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

A day in the life

As an Implementation Consultant III, you architect complex technical setups and lead high-stakes, multi-location rollouts for Enterprise clients. Leveraging deep expertise in Toast's technology suite, configurations, content hierarchies, and integration frameworks for multi-site operations.

Your day might start with a working session with a brand's corporate IT team to map network requirements across multiple locations, move into a hierarchy that a franchisee can update without breaking corporate brand standards, and end with unblocking a peer on a tricky hardware escalation. You move fluidly between the technical detail and the executive conversation — one moment troubleshooting an integration, the next reframing a rollout timeline for a regional VP.

You are a leader on the Technical Onboarding team. You mentor peers, spot workflow gaps before they become fire drills, and serve as the primary escalation point when advanced hardware and software challenges surface across the Enterprise deployment organization.

What you'll do (Responsibilities)

• Act as the primary escalation point for resolving advanced hardware, software, and networking challenges

• Lead cross-functional initiatives and drive project success across the Enterprise deployment organization

• Partner with Integrations, Product, and Sales to remove blockers for large brands

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Clinical Research Coordinator

Overview

Vascular Breakthroughs manages clinical trials for a growing group of vascular surgeons.  Trials managed include device and drug trials. The trials range from being first in main pilot studies, IDE trials to post-market registry trials.  We utilize a robust clinical trial management system that enables us to store all subject binders and regulatory binders electronically greatly facilitating remote management of trials and regulatory compliance.

This role is responsible for supporting clinical trials start-up activities and coordinating enrollment of patients across The Vascular Care Group (“TVCG”) in clinical trials.

Willingness to drive between TVCG sites to fulfill research requirements required; primary locations for work will be located in central massachusetts and sourthern Maine. This role is comprised of 80% in person work, 20% remote.

Responsibilities

• Organize and facilitate weekly meetings with clinic and OBL staff across all practice sites to examine schedules and identify eligible patients

• Assist with assessing patient records to identify patients who are eligible to participate in specified clinical research protocols

• Assist with monitoring patients for adverse reactions to study treatment, procedure, or medication and notify appropriate clinical professionals to evaluate patient response, identify the status of complications, & provide the appropriate level of care

• Assist with device accountability (transport or ship devices to practice site for procedures) on an as needed basis

• Assist with gathering required regulatory documents for new trials and attend training sessions for new trials

• Assist with collecting source data to enter into CTMS, enter source data into EDC systems, respond to queries and work with monitors to resolve queries

• Assist with adding/training additional personnel in MA to be delegated to work on the various clinical trials

• Support activities to ensure compliance with all Institutional Review Boards (IRB), FDA (Federal Drug Administration), federal, state, and industry sponsor regulations

• Assist in building electronic templates into CTMS for new trials to create eSource

• Regular travel to TVCG offices to assist in trial start-up activities and enrollment activities

Education/Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in biological sciences, health sciences, social sciences or other medical field or an equivalent combination of education and experience required

• 3-5 years of experience in a clinical research capacity or knowledge in clinical research preferred

• Clinical experience in a surgical specialty field required; vascular preferred

• Patient facing experience perferred

jobs.title: Staff Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager, Core Operations
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

Revenue Strategy & Operations is the team behind how Horizon3's go-to-market organization is planned, run and measured. We own budgeting and headcount planning, quota and compensation, territory planning and management (accounts, opportunities, leads and routing), goals for pipeline and performance, forecasting, performance management, and the operating process the sales organization runs on. Regional partners carry that scope for their sales leaders in AMER, EMEA and APJ. Global Centers of Excellence set the standards they all run on. This role is the Core Operations center of excellence: the operating process, the territory and change management standards, and the data the whole organization runs on.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Staff Revenue Strategy & Operations Manager to own how our global Sales organization operates: the core processes, the rules of engagement, and the way territory and org changes are managed and tracked. The goal is one standard across every region, with systems that match what the field is actually doing.

You will work with Sales leadership, the regional Revenue Strategy & Operations partners and GTM Systems. The regional partners own the relationship with each sales leader. GTM Systems builds and runs the tools. You own the process in between, and you make sure it gets done.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who likes fixing how things work and keeping them fixed while the company doubles.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Operating framework: Own how the global Sales organization runs day to day: core processes, territory management, change management and cross-functional hand-offs. Find where teams lose time or consistency and fix it.

 - Rules of engagement: Own the global rules of engagement and sales process standards across direct, channel, MSSP and all regions. Keep them documented, current and consistently applied.

 - Territory and change management: Run it as one global process. Track every new hire, org move, territory change and account reassignment in one place, and make sure each lands the same way in Salesforce, Gong, the roster and reporting.

 - Process design: Map how work actually gets done, find where processes and systems create friction, and redesign what is broken. Write clear requirements for GTM Systems, prioritize the queue, and confirm that what gets built matches what the business needs.

 - Data quality and standards: Set and hold standards for data quality, process adherence and documentation. Define what accurate means for account and pipeline data, run the recurring hygiene checks, and build the scorecards leaders use to see operational health.

 - Metrics and pipeline accuracy: Partner with Planning and Analytics to standardize sales performance metrics, and make sure the data and systems behind them support pipeline accuracy.

 - Operating partner: Be the operating partner to Sales leadership on how the organization runs. Work with the regional partners to keep every region on the same standards, including when new sales motions and org changes roll out.

 - Execution: Run the team's operating rhythm, drive cross-regional execution, and own the operational work that belongs to the company rather than to one region. Make sure it gets done.
   


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a related GTM operations function, ideally in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment, with global or multi-region scope.

 - Sales operations expertise: You understand how sales organizations run day to day, including territory management, account ownership and routing, rules of engagement, hand-offs, pipeline management, forecasting inputs and funnel conversion.

 - Systems and data fluency: You know Salesforce and the adjacent GTM stack well enough to connect business requirements, workflows, data and systems, spot where a system no longer matches the process, and write requirements a systems team can build from.

 - Analytical and operational rigor: You have set standards for data quality and process adherence, built the scorecards leaders use to check operational health, and you notice when the field and the systems drift apart.

 - Change and process leadership: You have redesigned inefficient processes and driven adoption of new workflows and ways of working across teams and regions.

 - Execution: You finish things. You run a backlog of global work, keep it moving and close items instead of letting them drift.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - One set of rules of engagement and process standards used in every region.

 - Every new hire, org move and territory change tracked in one place and reflected consistently across systems and reporting.

 - Data quality standards for account and pipeline data defined and met.

 - GTM Systems builds from clear, prioritized requirements.

 - Cross-regional work has a named owner and gets done.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $170,000-$210,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Safety Coordinator (Bilingual)
jobs.description:
About Rent the Runway:

Rent the Runway (RTR)  is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world’s first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in-house proprietary technology and a one-of-a-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC’s “Disruptor 50” five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies list multiple times.

Position Overview:

This role is an hourly entry-level position.

The Safety Coordinator serves as a designated safety representative of the assigned dream fulfillment center (DFC), coordinating and implementing all areas of the Rent the Runway’s (RTR) Safety Program as directed by the Sr. Manager of EHS. You will influence behavior and inspire commitment on the part of all personnel in complying with RTR’s safety standards and maintaining a safe work environment. This will include conducting training and coaching associates on observed work habits in support of this effort. A Safety Coordinator is a servant leader; dive in, roll up your sleeves to help in any situation, make tools available, remove obstacles for associates to excel in their roles, have empathy and compassion for associates, and the passion and leadership to stand up for them when the time arises.

What You’ll Do:

• Identify and inform management of compliance issues, safety risks, and improvement opportunities through the process of doing daily, weekly, and monthly audits.

• Facilitate incident investigation process

• Lead and participate in any investigations involving workplace incidents involving equipment and employees, along with investigations related to fleet safety.

• Conduct risk assessments related to jobs performed (Job Hazard Analysis) and new equipment introductions. Recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures to Management, including ergonomic considerations, in all such efforts.

• Ensure compliance with all RTR Safety Program expectations and applicable federal and state law.

• Maintain required paperwork to comply with RTR’s standards.

• Facilitate access to immediate aid for associates, visitors, vendors, or guests that need assistance or medical attention.

• Maintain accurate daily, weekly and monthly metrics to report to onsite management teams.

• Document safety incident information in RTR’s OSHA 300 log and 300a in a timely manner.

• Perform safety observations and audits.

• Train and assist the operations staff to comply with RTR’s safety responsibilities.

• Perform specific safety training as required by the company.

• Conduct documented monthly facility inspections and document findings.

• Partner with the security team to ensure that the security team is aware of RTR’s safety policies.

About You:

• Associates’ degree or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Environmental, Ergonomics or a related field required.

• 1+ year of growing responsibilities in safety and/or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, security or service operations.

• Bilingual in Spanish.

• Experience maintaining confidentiality in all matters involving personnel issues in the workplace.

• Knowledge of OSHA regulations applicable in RTR’s industry.

• Calm demeanor in emergency situations.

• Must be flexible regarding shifts as safety incidents can happen at any time.

• Computer skills relevant to reviewing security footage and creating documents and incident logs.

• Proficient with Google Suite, Google Sheets, Looker, and Jira.

• Strong written and verbal communication; bilingual in Spanish is highly preferred.

• Enforce safety guidelines, cleanliness and security standards.

• Ability to quickly recognize, diagnose and solve for challenges for associates in partnership with leadership.

• Must operate with a sense of urgency and have attention to detail.

• Align with the company's core values to ensure a world class customer experience.

• Ability to lift a maximum of 50 lbs based on the needs of the role.

• First Aid/ AED / CPR Certified.

• Distribution Center or Manufacturing Safety experience at a site of at least 500 non exempt employees is a plus.

• OSHA Outreach Instructor (OSHA 30/10) is a plus.

Benefits:

• Paid Time Off including vacation, paid bereavement, and family sick leave - every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family.

• Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents + flexible return to work program - because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention.

• Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of continuous service - Unplug, recharge, and have some fun!

• Comprehensive health, vision, dental, FSA and dependent care from day 1 of employment - Your health comes first and we’ve got you covered.

• 401k match - an investment in your future.

• Company wide events and outings - our team spirit is no joke - we know how to have fun!

• Office centric work - our corporate employees and technical leaders have the option to work remotely on Fridays, in accordance with Company policies.

Rent the Runway is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

_________

• Support activities to ensure compliance with all Institutional Review Boards (IRB), FDA (Federal Drug Administration), federal, state, and industry sponsor regulations

Education/Experience

$60,000 - $70,000 per year. Negotiable dependent on skills and experience

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst  (PST)
jobs.description:
Come join us in the battle against bad bots and web threats! We are looking for driven and talented employees to work as Security Operation Analyst on our Customer Operations team. 

As part of our leading team fighting off cybercriminals, you’ll be working side by side with customers, analyzing their traffic, and cleaning up the internet from bad bots. For this position, we are looking for someone who would be open to work on weekends (in rotation).



What you'll do:

 - Analyze customers’ traffic to identify undetected threats and false detections using mostly ElasticSearch (Kibana), SQL, Snowflake, etc.

 - Support customers in real-time and provide professional technical responses.

 - Work side by side with customers providing insightful incident reports.

 - Communicate with global customers and provide quick responses and resolutions.

 - Work cross-functionally with RnD and Research teams to optimize Human Security’s ability to detect and mitigate real-time Cyber Attacks.

 - Design, plan and implement projects and automation for internal use.

 - Follow runbooks to tune onboarding customers and retune existing customers.

 - Hold shifts as part of the job (including weekend shifts).
   
   

Who you are:

 - Excellent English communication skills are required, including clear, confident customer conversations and polished writing skills. 

 - Analytical mindset and data driven decision making.

 - Passionate about data, security, and customer service.

 - Hands-on experience (1+ year) with data analysis of large and complex data sets (data manipulation, statistical analysis, conclusions, etc.).

 - Knowledge of web architecture and protocols (CDN, HTML, DOM, JS, HTTP, HTTPS, IPv4/v6, etc.).

 - Understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape.

 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

 - SQL Proficiency.

 - Candidate must be domiciled in the PST time zone, Bay Area preferred

 - B.A/B.S in related domains.

 

About HUMAN Security



HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.



HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.



HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.



If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

jobs.title: Private Equity Accounts Director
jobs.description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

Private equity firms are rapidly consolidating the roofing and exteriors industry, and the platforms they build want one standard technology stack across every brand they own. Hover already partners with PE-backed customers at every stage, from large accounts to rollouts underway, but there's no dedicated owner and no repeatable way to sell to a PE firm as a whole. That's where you come in. You'll build Hover's private equity segment from zero, with real authority over the sales playbook, pricing and contract structures, and how the team supporting it works. You'll start with live customer relationships, not a cold list, and you'll shape what Hover builds for PE customers alongside Product and executive leadership.

You will contribute by

You'll protect and grow Hover's current book of PE-backed accounts, partnering with a dedicated Customer Success Manager to build a stage-based plan for each account, secure every renewal, and expand our mature accounts beyond their baseline. You'll land Hover's first pilot partners: PE firms or platforms that roll Hover out across several brands and help shape our PE offering, each with clear success criteria and a path to full rollout. You'll turn those pilots into portfolio-wide commitments, designing master and portfolio agreements with Deal Desk that bring Hover to multiple brands and future add-on acquisitions while protecting margin. As the voice of PE customers, you'll partner with Product to define needs like multi-brand account structures, portfolio-level benchmarking, and integrations, and get them onto the roadmap with dates. Along the way, you'll write the playbook for how Hover sells to PE firms, operating partners, and their brands.

• Build relationships with PE firms, operating partners, and portfolio CEOs through executive meetings, industry events, and portfolio mapping

• Run long-cycle enterprise deals with rigor: mutual action plans, accurate forecasting, and clean Salesforce hygiene

• Lead executive business reviews and steering committees with your CSM partner

• Keep leadership informed through clear written updates

Your background includes

• 10+ years in enterprise SaaS business development, strategic sales, or partnerships, including building a new segment or sales motion from the ground up

• A track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with VP and C-suite buyers, and growing revenue within an existing book of accounts

• Experience selling to private equity firms, operating partners, or PE-backed companies

• Strong business acumen: you connect product value to margin, growth, and enterprise value, and you're comfortable discussing EBITDA and ROI with executives

• Executive presence with operating partners and portfolio CEOs, including running executive business reviews and steering committee meetings

• Enterprise sales discipline, such as MEDDPICC and mutual action plans, accurate forecasting, and strong Salesforce habits

• A builder's mindset: self-directed, comfortable selling a product that is still evolving, and energized by shaping it with Product

• Ability to travel up to 30%

Nice-to-haves:

• Working knowledge of PE operating models: buy-and-build strategies, add-on integration, and standardizing tools across a portfolio

• Experience in vertical SaaS for the trades or home services, construction tech, or building products distribution

Benefits

• Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company

• Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents

• Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy

• Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave

• Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge

• Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance

• Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications

Hybrid roles at Hover

Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles.
