We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications.  This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range

$68,000—$80,000 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees.   Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

• Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance

• Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Supplemental Life & AD&D; Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance

• Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.

• Kaiser Medical plans available in California

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.

• Two comprehensive Dental Plans

• Vision Insurance Plan

• Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.

• 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.

• Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days

• Employee Assistance Plan

• Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

8am is looking for a professional and highly motivated problem solver to join our Customer Support Team.  As a Tier 1 Customer Support Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring every 8am customer receives consistent and reliable service and support through every interaction.  Our ideal candidate has excellent interpersonal skills and is analytically minded, self-starting, detail oriented and skilled at solving problems and explaining complex issues.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

• Answer inbound customer support calls and provide necessary product troubleshooting and support

• Timely response to incoming customer support inquiries via email, phone, and chat

• Ensure customers receive consistent and reliable service and support during every interaction

• Stay informed and knowledgeable regarding new product releases

• Educate our customers on how to use Mycase/LawPay/CPACharge products

• Investigate customer reported issues and attempt basic troubleshooting before escalating to Tier 2 if it is a technical escalation

• Document every support interaction in Salesforce to ensure complete records.

About you:

• Bachelor’s degree preferred

• 1+ year/s of experience in a customer service role or equivalent preferred

• Must have excellent interpersonal and professional communication skills; both written and verbal. Must be friendly, clear, and strong speakers.

• Maintain a high level of professionalism, integrity, and ethics

• Excellent time management and people skills

• Works well in a team setting

• Ability to remain respond calm during challenging customer situations

• Knowledge of Salesforce, Workforce Manager, Zoom Contact Center, Slack, Google Suite or similar programs preferred

• Must be able to answer inbound support calls, chats and emails daily

Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Overview:

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (SIGNING BONUS UP TO $25K) (Full-Time) - New Dorp/Staten Island, NYC

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match (Base compensation $140,000 - $200,000k + production)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Staff Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of the Position

Intuitive Surgical designs and manufactures highly complex mechanical systems for use in surgery. These systems include both capital equipment and “consumables” in the form of surgical instruments and accessories. The Staff Mechanical Engineer for Instrument and Accessory Advanced Product Development will be a member of a small team responsible for exploring and developing early product concepts and technologies that will help feed the da Vinci product pipeline. The successful candidate will lead early assessment, design, development, sourcing, testing, and integration of novel concepts for instrument and accessory related products.

The candidate will help to identify and evaluate new candidate technologies, establish design requirements and create novel designs to meet customer needs, work with suppliers and other outside companies to realize viable technical solutions, and refine designs for transfer to the New Product Development organization. He/she/they must excel in a high-energy team environment and be capable of creative problem solving when faced with the time pressures and incomplete information typical of early-stage product development. The successful candidate must have outstanding technical depth in relevant areas and be as comfortable collaborating and leading across organizational boundaries as they are working independently.

Essential Job Duties

• Work within cross-functional project teams to create, evaluate, and prove out new product architectures and refine them for hand off to new Product Development
• Collaborate with subject matter experts to understand the clinical, usability, and other needs of users of da Vinci systems as they relate to surgical instruments and accessories. Assist with market research and surgeon discussions around concepts, approaches, and procedures
• Develop technical requirements for designs based on an understanding of customer needs, commercial objectives (e.g. cost of goods), regulatory requirements, and feasibility constraints
• Perform conceptual design, detailed design, analytical modeling, prototyping, data analysis, and troubleshooting of novel instruments and accessories for the da Vinci robotic surgical system
• Develop and perform early design verification and validation testing, with assistance from other functions as needed
• Assist with clinical evaluation of prototypes by supporting bench, ex-vivo, and in-vivo laboratory testing
• Provide written protocols, reports, and presentations related to design activities on an ongoing basis
• Refine and document product designs as needed to support successful transfer into the new product development organization

Technical leadership

• Act as technical lead on product development projects
• Mentor and train less experienced engineers in the art of product development and mechanical design
• Review mechanical engineering designs of other Intuitive engineers in both a formal and informal capacity
• Lead or assist other design engineers through brainstorming, detailed reviews, and collaborative problem-solving, resulting in compelling product architectures
• Develop and manage relationships with key partners and suppliers
• Assess technologies from outside entities for potential licensing and adaptation to the da Vinci product line
• Identify, test, and report on new materials, manufacturing processes, and technologies that could benefit existing products or enable new product designs
• Provide detailed input to project planning, including objectives, budgets, staffing, schedules, milestones, etc.
• Make recommendations to senior management about the direction, activities, and staffing of ongoing projects, as well as recommendations and proposals for new product/project opportunities
• Identify resource gaps and make recommendations to address issues and prioritize

Other Functions

• Document, prepare and review patent submissions
• May supervise or direct the activities of others

Required Skills and Experience

• Twelve (12) years of experience in mechanical product design, or eight (8) years with MS, five (5) with PhD
• Extensive experience taking products from concept to production. Medical and/or regulated product experience highly preferred
• Familiarity with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, validation, qualification, and transfer
• Understanding of mechatronics, robotics, and servo-controlled systems strongly preferred. Experience developing software control algorithms a plus
• Proven ability to apply the basic laws of physics to understand and achieve quick and reliable solutions to engineering problems
• Exceptional mechanical aptitude and visual thinking skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills such as finite element analysis, statistics, and experimental designs
• Experience with and knowledge of a wide range of prototyping processes, both rapid and conventional with a variety of metallic and non-metallic materials
• Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to present to a wide range of audiences, including senior executives
• Ability to interface with customers and potential business partners in a highly professional manner
• Proven ability to work well in a team environment and drive individual projects. Experience managing external partners, suppliers, and small project teams
• Proficiency using CAD to create and document mechanical designs. SolidWorks preferred
• Proficient with hands-on development work for electromechanical products:Operating standard machine shop equipment for prototyping (mill, lathe, etc.)Techniques for rapidly fabricating proof-of-concept and functional prototypesStandard mechanical and electrical measurement and test equipment

Required Education and Training

• BS (Mechanical Engineering or related engineering field) required, MS or PhD preferred

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience and skills in design of high volume (e.g. injection molded, MIM) components, and design for reliability and manufacturability strongly preferred

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager - Sponsorships
jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job Summary:

Sponsorships and charitable donations are strategic investments in the communities Mercer Advisors serves. Done well, they build local brand awareness, create goodwill, and open doors to new client relationships through organizations deeply rooted in each market. The Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) is a key contributor to the operational success of these investments, working alongside the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and broader sponsorship team to ensure opportunities are thoughtfully evaluated, consistently executed, and measured against defined business objectives.

This role plays a key role in supporting the sponsorship and charitable giving process from intake and evaluation through negotiation, formal approval, payment, activation, and measurement, while also supporting the operations of key event programs and third-party partnerships.

Working closely with the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and broader sponsorship team, this role will partner with market leaders, advisors, Marketing, Vendor Management, Compliance, Finance, and Accounts Payable to help ensure sponsorships are thoughtfully evaluated, properly approved, consistently executed, and tied to measurable business outcomes.

This is an individual contributor role that blends hands-on operational support, cross-functional collaboration, and strategic judgment. The Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) will be responsible for:

Sponsorship & Charitable Giving Operations:

• Intake & evaluation

• Partner with the sponsorship team to support the intake and coordination of sponsorship and charitable giving requests, helping ensure requests move through the appropriate process and stakeholders remain informed along the way.

• Participate in the internal review of opportunities against the firm’s criteria, including employee or client involvement, community impact, ROI potential, attendee or participant data capture, and alignment with market goals and budgets.

• Work alongside market leaders to gather necessary information, facilitate discussions, and support documentation of move-forward decisions before the organization is engaged.

• Negotiation & documentation Serve as the single point of contact with third-party organizations and negotiate terms, benefits, and activation rights on behalf of Mercer Advisors. Identify branding and collateral needs, including logo placement, branded merchandise, and content. Collect and maintain required documentation, including W-9s and invoices, for every sponsorship and donation.

• Formal approval & payment Assist in guiding each request through formal review and sign-off by the local leadership, Marketing, Vendor Management, Compliance, and Finance. Build the 10- to 15-business-day approval cycle and three- to four-week payment window into planning so commitments to organizations are met on time.

• Program administration Assist the Sponsorship team in maintaining a central sponsorship tracker covering status, spend by market, contract terms, deliverables, and renewal dates. Monitor sponsorship and donation spend against market and national budgets.

Sponsorship Strategy & Portfolio Management:

• Support the development and maintenance of a consistent evaluation framework and scorecard to help the sponsorship team compare opportunities based on audience alignment, relationship value, activation potential, and expected return.

• Participate in regular sponsorship portfolio reviews, providing data, insights, and recommendations to help the broader sponsorship team determine whether investments should be renewed, optimized, or discontinued.

• Partner with the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition and sponsorship team to develop activation strategies that extend beyond logo placement, including speaking opportunities, hosted events, advisor participation, contact capture, and structured follow-up.

• Help identify and evaluate new sponsorship and nonprofit partnership opportunities within priority markets and audiences, including opportunities that support business development and community marketing objectives.

• Support the sponsorship team in providing guidance to market leaders and advisors on opportunities where sponsorship investments may have the greatest potential impact.

Activation & Event Operations:

• Collateral & activation Coordinate the creation and delivery of branded items, logos, and content to partner organizations on schedule. Make sure attendee and participant information is captured where possible and handed off to local teams for follow-up.

• Event support Assist Event Manager in managing logistics for sponsorship-related events, including vendors, timelines, budgets, onsite coordination, and post-event reconciliation. Support the Event Marketing programs, including timelines, communications, onsite roles, and follow-up materials.

Measurement & Reporting:

• Define success metrics for each sponsorship before commitment.

• Support the Sponsorship Project Manager in creating Salesforce campaigns for approved sponsorships and charitable donations, and partner with local teams to help ensure outcomes are accurately tracked and recorded.

• Report on sponsorship-sourced activity, including contacts, leads, pipeline, new clients, and spend by market.

• Translate results into clear recommendations that inform future sponsorship investments.

Process, Tools & Enablement:

• Work alongside the Director of Event Marketing Acquisition to maintain and update Sponsorship and Charitable Donations Guidelines, approval workflows, and supporting templates as needed.

• Partner with the broader sponsorship team to develop playbooks, checklists, intake forms, and supporting tools that create consistency and clarity across markets.

• Collaborate with the Director and Sponsorship Manager to educate local teams on the sponsorship process, providing ongoing guidance and support as questions arise.

• Identify bottlenecks and improve cycle time while keeping the process compliant with firm policies.

Qualifications:

• Five or more years of experience in event operations, sponsorship management, marketing operations, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience managing sponsorship or partnership programs end to end, including negotiation, vendor onboarding, and payment.

• Strong project and process management skills, with the ability to manage many concurrent requests and deadlines.

• Experience working with Compliance, Finance, and vendor management teams, ideally in a highly regulated industry.

• Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM system, including campaign setup and reporting.

• Analytical mindset, with experience using data to evaluate return on investment and recommend where to invest.

• Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills with internal and external stakeholders.

• Exceptional attention to detail and comfort operating as both a strategic thinker and hands-on executor.

• Ability to manage programs across multiple markets from a remote position.

• Experience in financial services, wealth management, or professional services preferred.

• Experience with nonprofit, philanthropic, or institutional audiences is a plus.

• Familiarity with ticketing and event registration tools (Halo, Cvent, or similar) is a plus.

• Must be able to travel 25-30%

What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means every sponsorship and charitable giving request moves through a clear, consistent, and predictable process, with stakeholders having visibility into status, decisions, and next steps.

It means working closely with the broader sponsorship team to help ensure decisions are thoughtful, data-informed, and aligned with business goals, with defined success metrics, Salesforce campaigns, and follow-up plans established for each investment.

Over time, the Event Operations Manager (Sponsorships) becomes a trusted and valued contributor to the sponsorship team, helping keep the program organized, compliant, and efficient while partnering with others to continuously improve the business value and overall effectiveness of Mercer Advisors’ sponsorship investments.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications.  This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range

$76,500—$90,000 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees.   Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

• Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance

• Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Supplemental Life & AD&D; Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance

• Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.

• Kaiser Medical plans available in California

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.

• Two comprehensive Dental Plans

• Vision Insurance Plan

• Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.

• 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.

• Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days

• Employee Assistance Plan

• Family Medical Leave

• Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)

• Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.

• Adoption Assistance Reimbursement Program

• Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life’s challenges and more.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option

• Pet Insurance

• Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting.

jobs.title: Legal Technology & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

About this role

Faire is hiring a Senior Legal Technology & Operations Manager (Contracts) to shape the next chapter of how contracting works at Faire. As the business grows, you’ll help our contracting processes grow with it.  You’ll design how agreements move from intake to signature to renewal, expand our contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform into a true system of record, and bring AI and automation into every stage.  You will also run the systems and programs that allow Legal to scale with the business with a focus on Contracts, Marketing, and Compliance.

We're looking for someone with deep familiarity across the legal technology stack and a strong track record in cross-functional program management. Success in this role requires being both a builder and an architect, pairing the ability to develop a long-term vision for world class legal operations with an operator’s willingness to drive execution and make it happen (fast).

What you'll do

• Own, configure, administer, and continuously improve our CLM platform (Ironclad), including workflows, approval logic, reporting, and integrations with Procurement (Zip) and GTM systems (SFDC)

• In partnership with Procurement and GTM, map Faire’s end-to-end contracting lifecycle, redesign it to reduce manual work and identify areas for efficiency across intake, routing, review, approval, signature, storage, and post-signature obligations

• Build Faire’s contract data foundation, including defining the metadata model to address business needs, cleaning up the existing repository, and making contract data searchable and reportable for Legal and the business

• Track and report contracting metrics, such as volume, cycle time, bottlenecks, and self-service rates, and use them to diagnose issues and inform the roadmap

• Identify and lead AI and automation pilots across contracting, marketing, and compliance, taking each from build-vs-buy evaluation through adoption and ROI measurement

• Partner with commercial and marketing counsel to turn templates, playbooks, and fallback positions into self-service tools and guided workflows the business can use

• Drive adoption of new processes and tools through training, documentation, and feedback loops with cross-functional partners

• Serve as a project manager for high-impact legal initiatives, scoping the work, partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive alignment, map timelines, and deliver on schedule

• Generally support legal operations at Faire, which may include intake and service delivery model, project management, and technology management.

What it takes

• 5+ years of experience in legal operations, legal technology, and contract management

• Fluency operating at the configuration layer of CLM (e.g., Ironclad) and contracts redlining tools (e.g., Ivo), including building and evolving workflows, approval logic, integrations, and reporting

• Strong working familiarity with procurement tools (e.g., Zip) and tools for managing online terms (e.g., Zendesk)

• Strong execution and project management skills, able to concurrently drive multiple work-streams and deadlines, with experience defining KRs and building dashboards a plus

• Significant experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude) and developing AI powered legal workflows

• A builder’s mindset - when a process isn’t working, you're energized to redesign it, including diagnosing pain points, collecting stakeholder input, and iterating over time

• Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to move fluently between a legal conversation and a Finance, Sales, Product, or Engineering conversation

Salary Range

San Francisco: the pay range for this role is $136,000 to $187000 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Why you’ll love working at Faire

• Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days

• Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks

• Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location

• Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance

• Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health

• Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs

• Employer-sponsored retirement plan, dependent on country of employment

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.  To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire-form)

Privacy

jobs.title: Director, DMO Sales
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.



As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.



KAYAK is seeking a Director, DMO Sales to lead our partnerships with tourism boards and destination marketing organizations. You will build and run the DMO sales function within KAYAK Media, working closely with NORAM Commercial leadership in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.



This is a leadership role with ownership of the NORAM DMO revenue number. You will lead a team of sellers, set the strategy for how KAYAK sells to destinations,  and personally lead the most strategic DMO relationships and executive-level deals. You will report to the Senior Director NORAM Ad Sales and partner with Product, Client Success, and KAYAK Media leadership. This role is for a proven sales leader with an established network of senior contacts in destination marketing.



This role is required to work from our Cambridge or Concord, MA office 3 days a week.

 

In this role, you will:

 - Own the DMO revenue target. Be accountable for the DMO quota, including forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and attainment across your team.

 - Set the DMO go-to-market strategy. Define territory plans, account segmentation, pricing, and packaging across regions, and iterate on our playbook to grow DMO revenue across NORAM

 - Lead the most strategic accounts and deals. Personally own executive relationships with top DMOs and their agencies, and step in on complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations.

 - Drive new business and growth. Set the prospecting strategy, open new markets, and push renewals, upsells

 - Shape the offering with Product and KAYAK Media. Bring market feedback, a competitive read, and business cases for new products, pricing changes, and investment decisions.

 - Champion data-driven selling. Set the standard for media plans that tie KAYAK data to destination outcomes like visitation and incrementality, across custom, programmatic, OOH, and influencer.

 - Partner with Client Success on performance. Make sure insights turn into optimizations that drive renewals and growth.

 - Represent KAYAK in destination marketing. Speak at industry events, lead executive pitches, and present results and strategy to senior leadership.

 

Please apply if you have:

 - Required: prior experience selling to or working directly with DMOs or tourism boards, with existing relationships in the space.

 - 8+ years of media sales experience, ideally in Travel/Tourism or Content/Integrated Media.

 - Proven track record of exceeding high quotas, including consistently generating new business.

 - Expert-level data storytelling skills, including a strong understanding of incrementality, visitation trends, and how to connect campaign results to destination outcomes.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently launch and sell new-to-market products.

 - Strong public speaking skills and experience presenting at industry events, conferences, and to senior stakeholders.

 - Expert-level negotiation and communication skills, with experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

 - Prior experience working directly with media agencies, including planning and buying teams.

 - High level of fluency with custom executions, programmatic, OOH, influencer campaigns, and other integrated media.

 - Strong analytical skills and a strategic approach to solving complex business problems.

 - Industry knowledge and contacts within the online media landscape and the travel search ecosystem.

 - Ability to thrive in an unstructured, fast-paced environment, with a collaborative, results-oriented approach.

 - Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

 - A relevant BA/BS degree is desirable.



Benefits and Perks

 - Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

 - Focus on mental health and well-being:
   
   - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
   
   - Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
   
   - Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
   
   - No meeting Fridays
   
   - Paid parental leave
   
   - Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
   
   - Paid volunteer time

 - Focus on your career growth:
   
   - Development Dollars
   
   - Leadership development
   
   - Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

 - Travel Discounts

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Competitive retirement and health plans

 - Free lunch 2 days per week

 - Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more



Compensation
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $140,000-170,000, not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants.

 

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

 

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We've got you.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT BESTOW

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov http://e-verify.gov.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Bestow is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead a platform configuration and implementation team. The Engineering team is the core of Bestow, driving all technology for our SaaS platform that empowers life insurance carriers. We build and operate the systems that serve our enterprise carrier partners across the entire lifecycle of a life insurance policy, our consumers, and our employees. Engineering partners closely with Product Management, Experience Design, and Delivery Management to define and prioritize the roadmap and to hold our commitments to carrier partners and to the business.

Our primary technologies are a microservices architecture in Golang, Python, and TypeScript on PostgreSQL, integrated over gRPC, REST, and asynchronous messaging, with event sourcing in our configuration and domain layers. We deploy and operate on Kubernetes in Google Cloud Platform.

This role reports to the Director of Engineering and is open to Remote (US). #LI-REMOTE



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Bestow is looking for an Engineering Manager to contribute in the following ways:

•  Lead your team's technical direction. Work with your team's senior and staff engineers to shape the design of the services you own across the configuration layer, the enrollment workflow engine, and the event-sourced domain services. Keep them scalable, reliable, secure, and performant, and make sure your roadmap ladders up to the broader platform strategy.

•  Favor repeatability and platform over bespoke work. Steer your team toward configuration-driven solutions so that each new carrier implementation costs less and ships faster than the last.

•  Collaborate beyond your reporting line. Partner with your two peer Engineering Managers and with teams outside IPC to deliver work that spans team boundaries. Clarify ownership of shared interfaces early, and escalate to your leadership when ambiguity threatens a date or becomes an incident.

•  Own your team's delivery commitments. Be accountable for what your team commits to carrier partners, including UAT handoff dates, and report status accurately and early to leadership.

•  Develop requirements early. Partner with Product, Delivery Management, Underwriting, and Compliance to surface missing requirements and cross-team dependencies during discovery, when a gap costs a conversation rather than a release.

•  Use data and metrics. Track delivery, quality, and system health for your team, and use that data to make technical and staffing decisions. Balance near-term commitments against long-term maintainability and security.

•  Grow your engineers. Run a healthy 1:1 and feedback cadence, set clear expectations against the career ladder, and write calibrated performance reviews. Build personalized growth plans, address individual or team challenges promptly, and develop senior engineers toward staff and tech lead roles. Keep knowledge spread across the team so a single departure does not put a partner commitment at risk.

•  Own hiring for your team. Act as hiring manager for your open requisitions, partner closely with recruiting, and raise the bar with every hire. Manage contractor and vendor partners as part of one team, with the same expectations and quality bar as full-time engineers.

•  Make the team faster. Run lightweight processes and ceremonies that help your team ship, and drop the ones that do not. Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning alongside our Principal engineers and other engineering leaders.

•  Put AI to work in how your team builds. Lead adoption of AI development tooling (Claude Code, Claude Tag, GitHub Copilot) and AI-first delivery practices such as AIDLC, and measure whether they are producing real leverage. Hold AI-generated code to standards that reduce technical debt, and coach engineers against the AI competencies in our career ladders.

•  Expand what AI tooling you can safely use. Work with Security, IT, and Compliance to propose compensating controls rather than stopping at a blocked request. Turn recurring questions from Product, Design, and new engineers into durable, self-serve knowledge.

•  Stay hands-on to be credible. Join design and architecture reviews, review code when it matters, and stay current on emerging technologies and what belongs on our platform. Occasionally ship some software!

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you will sit at the nexus of high-performance server hardware (GPUs, CPUs, high-speed network optics, liquid cooling distribution units) and global data center expansion. You will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Data Center Operations, Strategic Sourcing, and Finance to track lead times, eliminate delivery bottlenecks, reconcile capital expenditure cycles, and ensure cluster deployments meet committed customer Go-Live dates.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive federal government experience, a strong understanding of domestic and economic policy, and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.

This individual will collaborate with internal policy, product, and business teams to develop policy positions, analyze regulatory developments, and support strategic engagement with federal agencies and key government stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About the Role:

As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a team of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation.

We know that greatness is achieved through collaboration and diverse points of view, so we work closely with partners around the globe. As a team, we assume positive intent in each other’s words and actions, value constructive discussions, and foster a respectful working environment built on integrity, growth, and business value. We invest heavily in our people, who are eager to learn and constantly improve. Join our team and grow with us!

Primary Job Responsibilities:

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a member of the Pitchbook Cybersecurity Team and is a key leader in embedding security into the fabric of PitchBook products by maturing the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and conducting in-depth security design reviews. An employee in this role will design, engineer and use security solutions that safeguard PitchBook systems and the PitchBook platform.

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer will leverage subject matter expertise and experience in a fast-paced environment to solve cybersecurity problems in a way that is collaborative and connected directly to PitchBook engineering practices. In this role, you will be provided with opportunities to learn, grow and develop your career while being supported by a growing cybersecurity team and leadership that understands the need to align cybersecurity practices with customer satisfaction and company profitability.

Additional responsibilities:

• DriveSecure SDLC Initiatives: Provide expert advice to Engineering teams to drive secure software development and platform design throughout the entire Software Development Lifecycle.

• Lead Security Reviews:Lead the Security Review program by performing in-depth security assessments, threat modeling, and architecture reviews of new products and features.

• Enhance cloud and enterprise security posture: Identifying control gaps, implementing best practices, and driving continuous improvements across infrastructure, applications, and security processes.

• Drive Vulnerability Remediation:Proactively identify and drive the efficient remediation of known security vulnerabilities across our technology stack to continuously improve our security posture.

• Uphold Our Values:Apply the company value, "The Customer is King," through your daily work, ensuring security practices enhance platform integrity and customer trust.

***4 days in office, 1 day remote/telecommuting. Occasional travel to other PitchBook office locations (less than 5%).

Skills and Qualifications:

This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, IT Management, Management Information System, Information Technology or related field, or foreign equivalent and 5 years of experience in Information Security or a related technology function such as engineering or software development in Software Developer, Cyber Engineer, or other relevant position.

This position also requires: experience with Penetration Testing; experience with Vulnerability Assessment; experience with Security Review. Experience with Software Development; experience with secure code

Reviews & architecture security reviews; experience leading end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle, including identification, risk-based prioritization, remediation coordination, and continuous monitoring across enterprise systems and applications; experience in one or more programming or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Node.js, Java, UNIX shell); experience with Layer 7 protection platforms like Cloudflare or CloudFront, and analysis tools like Mixpanel or Splunk; experience with coordinating end-to-end penetration testing with external vendors, validate and reproduce reported vulnerabilities, and partner with SAT teams to drive timely remediation and risk mitigation; and experience working with cloud security controls in AWS or GCP environments. *Will accept any suitable combination of education, training, and experience.

Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Additional medical wellness incentives

• STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Emotional Health

• Paid sabbatical program after four years

• Paid family and paternity leave

• Annual educational stipend

• Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement

• CFA exam stipend

• Robust training programs on industry and soft skills

• Employee assistance program

• Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days

Social Health

• Matching gifts program

• Employee resource groups

• Subsidized emergency childcare

• Dependent Care FSA

• Company-wide events

• Employee referral bonus program

• Quarterly team building events

Financial Health

• 401k match

• Shared ownership employee stock program

• Monthly transportation stipend

*Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.

Compensation

• Annual base salary: $187,179-$187,179

• Target annual bonus percentage: 10%

Working Conditions:

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

jobs.title: Associate, Mapping & Spatial Insights
jobs.description:
LA28 does not provide relocation assistance for any positions. If you are based outside the Los Angeles area, we still welcome your application — we value talent from all geographic backgrounds and want to hear from you if you are able to work on-site in LA.

LA28 is the independent, non-profit, privately funded organizing committee for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. We are on a singular mission to create an Olympic and Paralympic Games that celebrate all that this city and country have to offer, delivering an unparalleled experience for athletes, fans, partners and our community.

The 2028 Games mark the return of the Summer Games to the U.S. for the first time in 32 years and Los Angeles’ third time hosting an Olympic Games and first time welcoming the Paralympic Games. This presents the unique and exciting opportunity to celebrate our legacy with the Games and push the Olympic and Paralympic Movements forward, writing a new chapter of Games history in Los Angeles.

Putting on an Olympic and Paralympic Games is a team sport. To build a Games unlike any the world has seen before, we need the best team in place–a team full of perspectives, experiences and expertise. We are guided by the following set of values and behaviors–optimism, integrity, excellence, inclusion, co-creation and boldness–and look forward to hearing about how your past experiences align with them.

Associate, Mapping & Spatial Insights

Role Purpose

You will build the maps and spatial visualizations that help Venue Transport and City Operations plan for the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Using Esri ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online, you will turn complex operational and spatial data into clear interactive dashboards and static cartographic maps. Your work will help transportation teams plan together, communicate with other functional areas, and make informed decisions about Games-time operations. This role offers cross-functional exposure and practical growth as Games-time transport and venue plans take shape.

Key Responsibilities

·       Support the design and production of interactive ArcGIS Online web map dashboards for transportation and venue operations.

·       Produce static cartographic maps that present transportation and venue operations plans clearly and consistently.

·       Transform complex operational and spatial data into clear, user-friendly visualizations using Esri ArcGIS Pro.

·       Help Venue Transport and City Operations plan internally, communicate with other functional areas, and make informed decisions.

·       Supply accurate, consistent, and visually effective mapping products that support communication and readiness of Games-time plans.

Required Competencies

·       Qualifications in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Spatial Science, or a related discipline relevant to mapping work.

·       Strong proficiency with the Esri ArcGIS Pro desktop application to view, edit, manage, and analyze spatial data.

·       Experience publishing feature services to the ArcGIS Online cloud environment to support interactive web maps and operational dashboards.

·       Ability to communicate technical GIS concepts clearly to a range of audiences, from planners to operational leaders.

·       Bring 3+ years of GIS experience turning operational and spatial data into accurate maps and visualizations for decision-makers.

Valued Experience

• Experience interpreting AutoCAD drawings associated with a major event.

• Familiarity with terminology and acronyms used in the Olympic and Paralympic Movement.

• A proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.

• Experience mapping transportation or venue operations for major events.

What We Offer

• Build mapping products that transportation and venue teammates rely on for Games planning.

• Gain cross-functional exposure to transport, venue, and city operations across the Games.

• Develop transferable GIS and spatial analysis skills on a once-in-a-generation event.

• Contribute to shared Games readiness alongside a collaborative transportation team.

What This Role Means for the Games

Clear maps help transportation teams see how people and vehicles will move around Games venues and across the city. Your work will support informed decisions and help partners and teammates understand transport plans before and during the Games.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

·       Available to work onsite in our Downtown Los Angeles-based office.

·       The majority of work will be conducted in an office setting, requiring extended periods of time using computers, phones, and other office equipment.

·       The LA28 office is an open floorplan working environment; employees must be able to work efficiently in an open cubicle environment.

·       Hours of work may vary, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, especially during peak event periods.

·       Perform other duties as required; the role will evolve over time and may include operational responsibilities during the Olympic and Paralympic Games.

·       During the Games, you may assist in the Transport Operations Center or at an Olympic and Paralympic venue.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position is $70,500 - $82,000. The pay scale provided is the range that LA28 reasonably expects to pay as starting base compensation for this role. All LA28 compensation remains subject to final determination based on individual candidate qualifications, experience, or other reasonable criteria consistent with LA28's operational business needs and applicable law.

LA28 is an equal opportunity employer. To read our full Equal Opportunity and Accommodation statements, please visit LA28 Careers Page.

The successful candidate is a strong technical contributor who enjoys working directly with advanced tools, thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced laboratory environment, and takes pride in delivering quality and timely results for clients.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer (Compliance) - Moveworks
jobs.description:
Security compliance is still mostly manual work: screenshots, spreadsheets, and evidence pulled together by hand in the weeks before an audit. We want to run it the opposite way. This role builds the automation so evidence collection and control monitoring happen continuously, and we could pass an audit in any given month because the system is always current. You will treat compliance as code, and you will care about getting the controls right, not just getting them checked. Your mission will be to replace legacy compliance processes with intelligent, automated platforms that scale effortlessly. We want someone who looks at traditional compliance and thinks, "There has to be a better way." You are an AI-native engineer who knows how and when to apply AI across the entire compliance engineering lifecycle—from writing software and automating evidence collection to validating controls, generating documentation, streamlining audits, and building the next generation of compliance automation.

This is an IC tech lead role. You will be hands on.

You will own the software engineering behind our compliance certifications, leading technical engagements with external auditors for international certifications and regulations such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, etc. Rather than treating audits as periodic projects, you will build and operate systems that keep our controls continuously validated and our evidence continuously available. Success means audits become a confirmation of how we already operate.

Your vision will color the blueprint of our compliance strategy, propelling Moveworks not just to meet the future but to define it. Ready to make a monumental impact? Join us and transform the essence of compliance at Moveworks.

What you get to do in this role:

• Build and own automated evidence collection pipelines that integrate with cloud infrastructure, identity providers, source control, ticketing systems, and other security tooling.
• Design and implement continuous control monitoring, ensuring compliance is measured in real time rather than only during audit periods.
• Challenge the status quo of compliance. Replace manual, paper-driven processes with software and engineering-first systems. We're looking for builders who believe compliance should be automated, elegant, and designed—not buried in paperwork.
• Own the technical strategy for future certifications and regulatory frameworks, evaluating new requirements and designing scalable solutions that minimize operational overhead.
• Use AI where it fits. Apply LLMs and agents to map controls to evidence, validate it, and flag drift.
• Spearhead international compliance initiatives such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, etc.
• Navigate auditor relationships with adept expertise, ensuring smooth and compliant audits.
• Lead and drive the charge in partnering with key stakeholders to ensure compliance and controls are effectively implemented, and any findings are remediated.
• Create and transform documentation such as policies, procedures, and other compliance written material.

To be successful in this role you have:

• 8+ years of experience in software engineer/information security roles, with a specific focus on security compliance and risk management.
• Fluency in Japanese, including reading, writing, and speaking, is required (ISMAP).
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CISM, CISSP, CISA) are preferred.
• A bias to remove manual work. When you see a recurring manual task, your instinct is to automate it away.
• Demonstrated experience in developing, managing, and implementing security policies and compliance frameworks such as ISMAP, IRAP, C5, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, NIST, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type 2.
• Knowledge of security principles, controls, and technologies/products.
• Familiarity with cloud security practices and cloud provider compliance standards (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Expertise with AWS services.
• Exceptional communication, written, and presentation skills capable of engaging a wide range of stakeholders.
• Skills in identifying security risks, implementing mitigation strategies, and driving remediation end-to-end.

jobs.title: Event Operations Specialist - Registration
jobs.description:
Why Work at Mercer Advisors?

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron’s to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology here.

Job summary

The Event Operations Specialist - Registration is our Cvent specialist for external events and campaigns. You own the Cvent registration experience from start to finish: building registration sites, managing invitations and attendee data, supporting check-in at live events when necessary, setting up registration for events run by other team members, and making sure every, campaign, registration, and attendance record flows cleanly (and accurately) into Salesforce. You also manage your own portfolio of virtual events, and you act as the department’s project manager, keeping work organized and helping streamline how the team operates. You work closely with the email marketing team, the content team (copywriters, designers, and others), local offices, and event specialists to make registering for a Mercer Advisors event convenient, polished, and on brand.

Essential job functions

Cvent registration site build and administration

• Build and launch Cvent registration websites, forms, and confirmation pages for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, using reusable templates that reflect Mercer Advisors branding.

• Partner with the content team (copywriters, designers, and others) on registration site copy, imagery, branding, and request, review, and approve assets so every site is polished and on brand.

• Partner with the email marketing team to align registration sites with invitation, reminder, and follow-up emails, coordinating timing, messaging, links, and registration tracking before each send.

• Configure Cvent registration paths with conditional logic, multiple attendee types (such as clients, prospects, guests, and team members), capacity limits, waitlists, and approval workflows.

• Test every Cvent registration site end to end before launch, proofing content, logic, confirmation emails, and reporting for accuracy.

• Serve as the Cvent power user for local events, maintaining account standards, templates, user access, and data integrity, and documenting the build process so others can follow it.

• Confirm registration pages and communications meet accessibility, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Attendee management and communications

• Manage the attendee experience from invitation through post-event follow-up, using Cvent for invite sends, RSVP tracking, confirmations, reminders, and waitlist management.

• Establish and maintain invitation lists in partnership with local offices and the email marketing team, and provide registration data and segments that support targeted sends.

• Serve as the point of contact for registration questions, and resolve attendee issues quickly and courteously.

• Administer post-event surveys in Cvent, monitor results, and share feedback with the event team to improve future events.

Virtual event portfolio

• Own a portfolio of virtual events from planning through post-event follow-up, including timelines, run of show, speaker and presenter coordination, and attendee communications.

• Build and manage the registration and virtual event setup in Cvent or a comparable virtual event platform, and run technical rehearsals and day-of support.

• Track attendance and engagement, send post-event surveys and follow-ups, and report results and leads to local offices and marketing leadership.

• Set up registration for events managed by other team members, balancing your own virtual event schedule with those requests.

Data, reporting, and Salesforce

• Create and manage Salesforce campaigns for each local event, and keep Cvent registration and attendance data aligned with Salesforce.

• Reconcile registration, check-in, and no-show data across sources so attendance is accurate and ROI can be tracked.

• Build Cvent reports on registration pace, attendance, and results for local offices and marketing leadership.

• Make sure all leads from an event are systematically documented and tracked.

Department project management and process improvement

• Act as the department project manager, tracking event timelines, deliverables, task ownership, and approvals so every project stays visible and on schedule.

• Manage intake of event and registration requests from local offices and the marketing team, and prioritize work against deadlines and capacity.

• Identify ways to streamline department processes, then document and implement improved workflows, registration standards, and reusable templates and best practices.

• Keep department documentation, checklists, and training materials current so team members can follow consistent processes.

• Build strong working relationships with the email marketing team, content team, local offices, and event specialists, sharing clear timelines, event briefs, and deadlines.

• Support broader event logistics as capacity allows, including vendor coordination, budget tracking, and collateral.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

• Minimum two years of hands-on Cvent experience, including building complete registration websites, configuring conditional logic and attendee types, managing invitations and attendee data, and running Cvent reports.

• Minimum three years of experience in event registration, event technology, or event planning.

• Experience managing virtual events from planning through execution, and managing multiple projects at once.

• Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM system.

• Strong Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and mail merges.

• Exceptional attention to detail and proofreading skills.

• Clear, friendly written and verbal communication, and a collaborative approach to working with email marketing, copywriters, designers, local offices, and vendors.

• Ability to manage multiple events and deadlines, and to make sound judgment calls in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to support events in multiple markets from a remote position.

• Ability to travel 10% to 15%.

Preferred qualifications

• Cvent certification.

• Certified Meeting Professional (CMP).

• Experience as a project manager or in an operations role, including process documentation and improvement.

• Experience integrating Cvent with Salesforce.

• Experience with Cvent OnArrival, Cvent event apps, and onsite badge printing technology.

• Experience with other registration platforms (such as EventSpark, Swoogo, or Bizzabo).

• Working knowledge of HTML or CSS.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

• Experience supporting client-facing events in financial services or another regulated industry.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications.  This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range

$63,750—$75,000 USD

Benefits:

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees.   Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

• Company Paid Basic Life & AD&D Insurance

• Company Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• Supplemental Life & AD&D; Short-Term Disability; Accident; Critical Illness; and Hospital Indemnity Insurance

• Three Cigna medical plans offerings including two High Deductible Health Plans and a Traditional Co-Pay medical plan.

• Kaiser Medical plans available in California

• Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions if enrolled in either HDHP medical plan.

• Two comprehensive Dental Plans

• Vision Insurance Plan

• Dependent Care Savings Account for child and dependent care.

• 14 Company Paid Holidays including a full week off at Thanksgiving.

• Generous paid time off program for vacation and sick days

• Employee Assistance Plan

• Family Medical Leave

• Paid Parental Leave (8 weeks)

• Maternity benefits utilizing company paid STD, any supplemental STD, plus Parental Leave (8 weeks) to provide time for recovery, baby bonding, and enjoying your family time.

• Adoption Assistance Reimbursement Program

• Company Paid Concierge Services for you and your loved ones for the spectrum of caring needs for your aging parents, young children, life’s challenges and more.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with both Traditional and Roth plans with per pay period match as well as an after-tax option

• Pet Insurance

• Personalized financial planning and guidance from Mercer Advisors professionals, offered at preferred employee pricing

We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting.
