jobs.title: Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician (Full-Time) - White Plains, NY
jobs.location: White Plains, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors.

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($27.00 - $48.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are.

Solo.io is reimagining infrastructure for cloud and AI. We unite secure, seamless cloud connectivity with AI-ready, agentic infrastructure, and leading enterprises worldwide trust us to securely connect their applications, services, and AI workloads across any environment.

Joining Solo means working at the center of how enterprises adopt AI: on open source projects built in the open with a global community, alongside the people who created them, for customers who are among the largest in the world. If you want to help organizations accelerate innovation, scale intelligently, and put modern AI agents to work, we’d love to meet you. Learn more at www.solo.io.

About the role.

Solo.io is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to drive pipeline across our Central and West regions. You'll be the main Marketing partner for regional Sales. That means deciding which accounts and audiences to reach, building the programs that engage them, and making sure engagement turns into pipeline.

The role combines ABM, field and community events, and sales activation. One week you might run an executive dinner; the next, a developer meetup, an ABM campaign for named accounts, or the plan for a major industry event. You'll work closely with Sales, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and the open-source community teams.

This role may require occasional travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Solo does not provide sponsorships at this time.

Job Description:

Own regional growth

• Work with Central and West Sales leaders and AEs to build regional plans tied to pipeline goals, priority accounts, and territory whitespace.

• Be an embedded, integral member of the regional sales team, not a service desk. Join their planning, understand their territories, and bring program ideas to the table. Share regular updates on what's launching, what's coming, and which accounts are engaging.

• Use account and pipeline data, along with AI-powered research and automation, to decide where to invest. For example, focus on the cities with the most account density and open pipeline.

• Help design the AI-powered workflows that automate account research, program setup, and reporting, so more of your time goes to strategy and Sales.

Run account-based programs

• Align with AEs on priority accounts, then engage key personas with targeted content, landing pages, retargeting, direct mail and gifting, and outreach.

• Run focused ABM motions, such as converting open-source users to enterprise customers.

• Track account engagement and agree with Sales on follow-up so activity turns into conversations and pipeline.

Lead field and community programs

• Plan and run executive dinners, advisory boards, customer events, workshops, meetups, community days, and sponsored conferences.

• Choose events by audience fit, account coverage, and pipeline potential, not by attendance alone.

• Own every phase of an event: pre-event promotion, onsite experience, and post-event follow-up. That includes logistics, vendors, swag, and speakers.

• Support flagship events like KubeCon with targeted account plans, side events, and parties.

Extend company campaigns

• Bring company-wide launches, webinars, and content programs to Central and West audiences, using paid, social, and digital channels.

• Work with Product Marketing so messaging stays current on product, competition, and market trends.

• Turn successful regional programs into repeatable plays for other territories.

Measure and optimize

• Report on account engagement, pipeline created and influenced, and how far opportunities progress.

• Keep the regional calendar, budget, and results visible to Sales and Marketing leadership.

Job Requirements:

• 4–7+ years in B2B growth, demand generation, field marketing, or ABM, ideally in enterprise tech or SaaS.

• A track record of building territory- or account-specific programs directly with AEs and Sales leaders.

• Hands-on experience running events end to end, from executive dinners and workshops to conferences and community meetups.

• ABM experience with named or strategic accounts.

• Comfort with AI and a real interest in using it. You'll work hands-on with our internal AI platform, where many of our marketing automations run, and help shape how it supports regional programs.

• Skill at managing many programs, vendors, budgets, and deadlines at once, with strong attention to detail.

• A habit of judging programs by pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics.

• Clear communication and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

• Experience with developer, open-source, cloud-native, Kubernetes, networking, security, or AI audiences is a plus. Curiosity and a fast grasp of technical buyers matter just as much.

What you’ll love about Solo.

At Solo, our culture is all about hiring great people, creating a fun and fast-paced work culture, and letting our teams work with our customers to successfully solve their challenges.

Solo works collaboratively with our customers, partners and open source communities to deliver technology innovation, technology solutions, architectural best-practices, and hands-on education. Solo uses a unique engagement model with our customers that allows us to quickly make them successful, and continue to work closely with them as their production environments grow.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States now and in the future as Solo is unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Solo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

The company may use AI tools to help sort applicants based on job related criteria. However, the hiring team decides who moves forward and no employment decisions are made by AI.

jobs.title: Store Manager - Corners of Brookfield
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Storage
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.



If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.



*Note: This position requires presence in our Bellevue or San Francisco office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.


About the Role

Customers come to Lambda for compute, and then decide whether to stay based on where their data lives. Weights, checkpoints, and training sets are the part of the workload that is expensive to move and painful to lose, so storage is where a GPU rental turns into a cloud a customer builds on.

As a product manager on the Foundational Infrastructure team, you will own a meaningful part of defining where customer data lives on Lambda and how it reaches the GPUs. The domain covers the storage customers attach to an instance and the storage that outlives it, from local disk through block volumes to shared and object storage. It covers how customers get large datasets in and keep them current, and what throughput they can count on when thousands of processes read the same data at once or checkpoint into it together. It covers what customers are promised about durability, isolation, and key handling before an enterprise will put production on us. It covers how capacity is tiered, partitioned between shared and dedicated, metered, and priced, including what data transfer costs and who pays for it. Much of the stack is vendor-provided today, and deciding what Lambda should own instead is part of the work. You will work across these areas depending on which customer needs are burning hottest, alongside the other product managers on the team.

Most of this is the feature set a mature cloud already has and Lambda does not have yet. A neocloud is not a hyperscaler, though, and copying that list wholesale is the wrong instinct. Part of the job is judgment about which of those capabilities matter here and which carry cost we should not pay. The other part is that AI workloads read and write in patterns these primitives were never designed for, and deciding where that difference should change the product is the more interesting half.

Great product managers at Lambda are defined by three things: insight, influence, and execution. Insight means you look at the data, determine what it means for customers and business, and then figure out what to do about it. But, a great idea doesn't mean anything in a vacuum. That is where influence comes in. Influence means you take that idea and get others to want to buy into it; you win over engineers, designers, executives, and partners without relying on authority. But a great idea that everyone is excited about doesn't matter unless it is delivered to customers. Execution means you work with the right people to get the idea launched, then measure and iterate. We hire product managers who learn new domains fast and reason rigorously from evidence. Deep storage platform experience at a cloud provider is highly desired.

If you have built storage products at a cloud provider and want to do it again somewhere the answers are not settled, we'd love to hear from you.

We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and skills, and we are excited to hear from candidates who can bring unique perspectives to our team. If you do not exactly meet this description but believe you may be a good fit, please still apply and help us understand your readiness for this role.

What You'll Do

 - Find the Real Problem: Get close to customers, deals, escalations, and support on On-Demand GPU Instances and 1-Click Clusters, and work out what is actually blocking them on data rather than what they asked for.

 - Decide What Matters: Rank and sequence the work across the storage portfolio, and be honest about what Lambda is not doing this year and why.

 - Write the Definition: Produce requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria precise enough that engineering builds from them without a translation layer.

 - Price and Package It: Decide how capacity, performance, and data transfer are metered, priced, and packaged across On-Demand GPU Instances, 1-Click Clusters, and Lambda's private cloud offerings, including whether storage should bill alongside the GPUs it serves or on its own.

 - Deliver With Engineering: Work through the build with the storage teams and the vendors behind parts of the stack today, make the tradeoff calls that come up mid-flight, and keep scope honest against the date.

 - Land the Launch: Set launch criteria that cover the operational readiness a storage product needs, including durability, recovery, and what customers are told when data is at risk, and get documentation, pricing, sales, and support in place before it goes live rather than after.

 - Measure and Iterate: Define what success looks like before launch, then go find out whether it happened, using adoption and real workload performance rather than opinion.

 - Make the Call Stick: Take a position on contested tradeoffs, write it down well enough that people can disagree with it precisely, and keep owning the decision after it is made.

 - Work as a Group: Partner with the other product managers on foundational infrastructure and with the teams that own compute, networking, orchestration, security, and commerce, so the pieces land as one product.

You

 - Have 7+ years of product management experience, including time on storage products at a hyperscaler, neocloud, or comparable cloud provider.

 - Have shipped storage that external customers ran production workloads on, in object, file, or block.

 - Understand the storage path well enough to reason with engineers about throughput, latency, consistency, and what happens to a workload when a device or a node fails.

 - Understand how data placement and read and write patterns show up as performance for distributed training and large-scale inference.

 - Have owned a product where durability and day two behavior mattered as much as launch, including recovery, capacity exhaustion, and what customers are told when something breaks.

 - Have owned pricing, packaging, or metering for an infrastructure product, including the data transfer side of it.

 - Can tell which parts of a hyperscaler playbook transfer to an AI cloud and which are cost without benefit.

 - Have worked with storage vendors and open source storage systems, and can decide what Lambda should build against what it should buy.

 - Able to define iterative plans that move an organization from the current state towards the desired outcome.

 - Communicate plainly, write well, and make decisions easier for people who do not all share the same context.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with object storage and S3-compatible interfaces, including the compatibility gaps that matter to customers porting from a hyperscaler.

 - Experience with parallel or shared file systems at high throughput, and with the quality of service controls that keep one tenant from taking the whole system.

 - Experience with block storage, snapshots, or the storage path behind instance boot and recovery.

 - Experience moving bulk data into a cloud, including resume, integrity verification, and throughput the customer can watch.

 - Experience with encryption at rest, key management, and tenant isolation in a multi-tenant storage system.

 - Familiarity with how storage traffic crosses a high performance fabric, like remote direct memory access or GPUDirect Storage.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.




About Lambda

 - Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

 - Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

 - We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

 - Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

 - We offer generous cash & equity compensation

 - Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

 - 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

 - Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Supply Chain Specialist to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you will own the end-to-end purchase order lifecycle, serving as a vital bridge between Engineering, Data Center Operations, Finance, and our supplier network. By ensuring rigorous tracking and timely receiving, you will provide critical operational support to deployment teams while maintaining pristine system records.

This is a hands-on position tailor-made for a detail-oriented professional who values data integrity, streamlined processes, and diligent execution. You will gain firsthand insight into how state-of-the-art AI data centers are built, playing a direct role in scaling our procurement infrastructure as the organization grows.

What You’ll Do

Procurement Operations

 - Request Triage & Validation: Evaluate incoming purchase requests and verify program details, site information, ship-to locations, line items, and NetSuite coding against vendor quotes.

 - Vendor Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure suppliers are fully onboarded and payable within the AP platform prior to PO issuance, collaborating closely with Security and Legal team as needed.

 - PO Issuance & Order Management: Release approved purchase orders, secure vendor order acknowledgements, and reconcile discrepancies in pricing, quantities, part numbers, or ship dates prior to fulfillment.

 - Lifecycle Maintenance: Manage change orders, cancellations, and recurring agreements for ongoing software subscriptions and services.

Invoices, Payments & Tax Compliance

 - Financial Reconciliation: Partner with Accounting and Accounts Payable to resolve invoice, credit, or change-order discrepancies with vendors.

 - Payment Coordination: Coordinate prepayments and expedited disbursements with the Finance department when operational needs require.

 - Tax Administration: Apply accurate sales tax treatments and appropriate tax exemption certificates tailored to each operational site.

Vendor Management & Continuous Improvement

 - Vendor Records & Database Integrity: Oversee new vendor onboarding while maintaining pristine records, supplier master data, and primary points of contact.

 - Supplier Performance Tracking: Monitor vendor compliance regarding on-time delivery metrics and invoice accuracy.

 - Specialized Procurement: Execute approved online vendor purchases designated for data center operations.

 - Audit Readiness: Maintain fully audit-compliant procurement documentation by archiving all quotes, approvals, and receipts directly within the ERP system and AP platform.

Logistics, Receiving & Returns

 - Partner with the Logistics Manager and RMA Lead regarding shipping schedules, delivery tracking, and returns to ensure complete alignment on open purchase orders.

 - Receiving & Inventory Control: Log item receipts including tracking numbers, serial numbers, and landed costs.

 - Returns & Credit Reconciliation: Ensure supplier credits, refunds, and replacement items resulting from product returns are accurately reflected on corresponding POs and vendor bills.



Who You Are

Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and hands-on professional experience.

 - 2+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or logistics, with a strong preference for technology hardware or data center environments.

 - Hands-on experience executing purchase orders, receipts, and invoices within an ERP system (NetSuite experience is strongly preferred).

 - Working knowledge of the three-way matching process, standard payment terms, and the structural connection between procurement and accounts payable.

 - Advanced skills in Excel or Google Sheets preferred

 - A sharp eye for discrepancies, ensuring part numbers, quantities, and ship-to locations align perfectly across documentation.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective coordination with external suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.

 - Outstanding organizational skills and follow-through to manage open orders and track shipments simultaneously.

 - Other Insurance Options, such as Pet & Legal Insurance

jobs.title: BNA/CNA Training Class - December 2026
jobs.description:
Nursing Assistant Training

Miller's is proud to provide training for those interested in a career as a Certified Nursing Assistant free of charge. Each student is required to complete class room training and clinical training. Upon completion, students must pass the state exam to become a Certified Nurse's Aide. See below for more details on training.

Classroom Instruction

Each student is required to complete 36-40 hours of classroom work. All students are required to pass (with 80%) all of the tests administered during the classroom portion. (Each student has 3 attempts to pass)

If a student does not pass the classroom phase of the course they will not be placed into the clinicals.

Clinical Practicum

Each student is required to complete 75 hours of supervised practicum in a long-term care facility. During the practicum, the student must perform all required skills successfully. The first 16 hours of practicum is with the class instructor. Absence during this time will result in being excused from the program.

During the practicum, the student may be assigned to work with a preceptor who will assist the student in organization and time management. At the completion of the program the preceptor as well as the instructor will be given an evaluation sheet to complete regarding the students progress during the clinical.

All skills checklists booklets (RCP’s) not signed during the classroom must be demonstrated and signed off during the clinicals by the clinical instructor, or other licensed nursing professional. Completed checklist (RCP) must be submitted at the completion of the clinicals with all required skills completed or will not be eligible for the required state exam.

A “clinical sign-in record” is supplied to each student. This form must be completed by the student and signed by a qualified licensed professional on a daily basis. The student must include the following information on the sheet: date and actual hours worked, signature of student, cosigned by licensed supervisor.

Additional Information

Students are required to pass a criminal background check along with a TB test and physical prior to starting the course. Attendance to all classroom sessions is mandatory in order to meet the program requirements as set by the Indiana State Department of Health. Unsatisfactory performance or attendance issues may result in dismissal from the course/program. Students should check with the facility for details on the dress code requirements.

When a student that successfully completes the course he/she will be awarded a certificate of completion, will get a scheduled test date, and will have the scheduled test paid for by Miller’s Merry Manor if hired and in good standing as an employee. If the student does not pass the 1st test it may be retaken and paid for by Miller’s a second time. If not an employee, your application and certificate of completion will be given to you to schedule your own test at your own expense.

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering MCO
jobs.description:
The weaponization of AI is driving a paradigm shift in the cyber security industry from proactive to preemptive security:  clients must now invest more intelligence and effort in understanding their vulnerabilities before their adversaries do (Open AI).  The only way to achieve this is to simulate future attack scenarios at scale, and to run them in high fidelity digital replicas of production environments (Gartner/Forrester).  SimSpace serves as the AI Proving Grounds to generate hypersynthetic data which pressure tests controls, tools, teams, and agentic capabilities in full kill chain attacks hidden in realistic environmental traffic and patterns of life. 



Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform was initially conceived to assist in Offensive Cyber Operations (OCO), to quickly replicate target environments to conduct mission rehearsal of human operators and their tools to deny (disrupt, degrade, destroy) or deceive (manipulate or exfiltrate data) adversaries.  The company has since expanded to serve over a dozen allied governments in OCO/DCO as well as critical infrastructure enterprises around the world.  The company is actively investing in the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe and the Middle East through direct sales and channel partners.  SimSpace has launched the AI Proving Grounds Consortium, leading the revolution by creating an open platform for the InfoSec ecosystem to train, validate and operationalize their agentic capabilities before committing to production.



Why join SimSpace?

We are a team united by a shared purpose and four core values: Serve to Protect, Acquire Understanding, Teamwork without Borders, and Operate as Innovators. We value candid, constructive feedback and create opportunities for personal, professional, and financial growth. Our vision, “Defend the Free World,” drives our mission: “Defeat Any Adversary in Any Cyber Terrain at Machine Speed.”



How Do We Work?

We listen to customers and colleagues, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into meaningful results. We expect everyone to embrace emerging technologies, simplify and automate work, and use AI to learn, solve problems, and help deliver quality with speed. We apply human judgment and take responsibility for outcomes. Whether remote or office-based, we collaborate across teams and time zones.



We invite you to apply today!




JOB SUMMARY

You will build and lead a fullstack team, with an emphasis on backend engineering, for AI Proving Grounds (AIPG). The team builds user and attack emulation workflows that customers can configure, observe and repeat across applications and execution environments.



You will lead as a hands-on player-coach, regularly implementing and debugging software, tests and automation with the team. You also own hiring, development, capacity and workflow delivery. The Staff Engineer leads design and integration across features; you coach engineers to take ownership.



MCO delivers the integrated workflow. AIPG DEN provides user-emulation capabilities, Scenario Development provides adversary content, and range and platform teams retain their shared services. For example, MCO might connect a simulated employee's application actions to verified results and recovery. Agree responsibilities and partner capacity before committing to work that spans teams.




WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING AT SIMSPACE?

 - Agree with the Director which roles to hire first, how to onboard them and where interim technical support will come from. Build the new team around fullstack engineers with strong backend skills.

 - Define a useful workflow with Product and partner teams. State what MCO will deliver, what it excludes, which interfaces it uses, how success will be verified and who receives the result.

 - Lead work from configuration through execution, verified effects, diagnosis and recovery. Agree changes to shared components with the teams that own them.

 - Review architecture and code with the Staff Engineer. Write focused changes and investigate difficult failures while helping engineers take ownership of features.

 - Establish integration tests that verify identities, intended effects, compatibility and cleanup. Improve repeatability with tested automation and reviewed AI-assisted development.

 - Coach engineers through feedback and career development. Include support, maintenance and dependencies in the plan, and explain which work moves when priorities or capacity change.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The Director and Product will agree initial priorities and timing with you, based on staffing and partner commitments.

 - A workflow plan states MCO's deliverable, partner commitments, technical boundaries, hiring priorities and interim coverage.

 - A user or attack emulation workflow runs from configuration to verified effects, with diagnosis and recovery when execution fails.

 - The team can repeat delivery using automated tests, useful diagnostics and clear release and support responsibilities.




WHAT ARE THE QUALIFICATIONS TO APPLY?

 - Experience managing and developing software engineers through hiring, onboarding, coaching, feedback and delivery accountability.

 - Evidence of building or expanding an engineering team or capability, with technical ownership shared across the team.

 - Production fullstack experience with strong backend engineering, recent personal implementation of software, tests or automation, and diagnosis across service boundaries.

 - Experience delivering workflows that connect applications, APIs and execution systems, working with frontend and environment specialists.

 - Practical understanding of asynchronous state, permissions, compatibility, automated testing, observability and recovery from partial failures.

 - Experience turning unclear requests into agreed scope, coordinating work across independently owned systems and preparing the result for operational handover.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You delegate meaningful decisions, give direct feedback and help engineers work independently.

 - You resolve ownership and priority conflicts openly and judge progress by usable workflows and reliable operation.




NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT REQUIRED

 - Experience with cybersecurity, simulation, user automation or agent workflows.

 - Experience with Windows or Linux, browser or desktop integration, or virtualized execution.

 - Experience with Go, Python or modern frontend development. You can develop adjacent runtime and infrastructure skills with specialists.




OUR TECH STACK INCLUDES

The work spans Go and Python services, application APIs, browser and execution integrations, containers and automated tests. Fullstack experience and strong backend engineering are central to the role.




WE’RE PROUD TO OFFER A COMPETITIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE PACKAGE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR WELL-BEING, GROWTH, AND SUCCESS:

 - Compensation. Base salary range: $160,000 - $220,000, reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

 - Health & Wellness. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans—coverage starts on day one!

 - Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

 - Financial Well-Being. Plan for your future with a 401(k)-retirement savings plan featuring a company match.

 - Flexible Time Off. Take the time you need with unlimited vacation and dedicated health & wellness days. SimSpace provides flexible solutions to meet the diverse work-life needs of team members.

 - Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

 - Ownership Opportunities: Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

 - Referral Rewards: Earn $1,500–$3,500 for every qualified hire through our employee referral program.

 - Peloton Interactive Wellness Program: Full- and partial- subsidized membership plans and equipment discounts to help you reach your personalized fitness goals.

 - Continuous Learning: Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

 - Social Connections: Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

 - Extra Perks: Legal plan coverage, pet insurance, wellness reimbursements, and more to simplify life’s details.
   
   



SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.



SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, in accordance with applicable law. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact careers@simspace.com.

jobs.title: Product Operations Lead, Booking Platform
jobs.description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering the next generation of entrepreneurs to build thriving travel advisory businesses. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel industry with AI woven through every part of the advisor's workflow, plus global supplier relationships, personalized training, and a vibrant community, all in one place. That's what lets advisors build businesses that scale, while their taste and service create trips no algorithm alone could plan. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time.

We're mission-driven and obsessed with our customers, and we believe humans and AI are both essential: the best work here comes from people and technology at their best, together. That's not just a philosophy about our product, it's how we build our team. Everyone at Fora gets hands-on with frontier AI tooling as part of the job. At Fora, you'll learn to be AI-fluent, with real experience applying AI to solve problems day to day, wherever you sit in the company.

Founded in 2021, Fora has grown to a team of 250+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we closed a $60 million Series D led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued backing from Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've been named a LinkedIn Top Startup (2024), one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies (2023 and 2025), and one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies (2026).

Come build something that hasn't existed before.

About The Role

Every booking an advisor makes depends on systems most of them never see: supplier connections, rates, booking data, and the processes that catch problems before they reach a client. On Booking Operations, you’ll keep those systems reliable, working issues from the first escalation to the fix that stops them recurring, and helping shape how a growing team operates as Fora scales.

This is a hands-on role on a small team that builds. You’ll ship tools, automations and processes that replace manual work and make bookings more reliable, using frontier AI tooling every day. You’ll report to the Product Operations Manager, Booking Platform, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Support. Decisions happen quickly, the work has visibility with leadership, and you’ll see its impact in what advisors experience. The team is still growing, so the person who sets the standard early has room to grow with it.

Key Responsibilities

• Own operational workflows across the booking platform and supplier ecosystem, including escalations, rate parity and supplier outreach, and supplier data upkeep (rates, perks, loyalty programs, contacts).

• Work escalations end to end, finding the root cause and fixing the underlying pattern, not just the ticket.

• Build automations and tools that reduce manual work and improve booking accuracy, using AI tools, workflow automation, and SQL.

• Track platform health with dashboards and queries, and flag trends before they reach advisors.

• Get Support and Operations ready for booking product launches and keep processes documented, through help center content, SOPs, routing, and escalation paths.

Requirements

• 4-6 years in product operations or a similar role.

• Uses AI tools daily and has built at least one AI-powered workflow, agent, or automation that replaced manual work.

• Has owned an operational workflow end to end, with a metric they reported on and improved.

• Has led a root-cause review of a recurring issue that resulted in a shipped fix.

• Writes their own SQL and has built dashboards or reports that others use to make decisions.

• Has written SOPs, runbooks, or ticket specs that others used without a walkthrough.

• Has written operational tickets that engineering scoped and shipped.

• Has turned an unscoped problem into a defined process, tool, or ticket without a spec to start from.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience in travel technology, hotel distribution, or two-sided marketplaces, including working knowledge of GDS, rates, or supplier content.

• Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar.

• Has helped get a support team ready for a product launch (help center content, routing, escalation paths).

Compensation

The indicative range for this role is $93k-116k + equity. Where a candidate lands within in the range reflects their experience and the scope of responsibility they bring.

• Unlimited vacation

• Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)

• Dental & Vision Insurance

• Wellhub Memberships

• 401k plan with company match

• Commuter Benefits

• Supplemental Life Insurance

• Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior AI web software Engineer
jobs.description:
Experian Partner Solutions is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine."

Predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling.

We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character. You will report to the director of web development.

• Manage web software end-to-end – develop, and support it in production. Ownership does not stop at the merge.
• Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line.
• Decompose features into work an agent can build reliably, and write the prompts and specs that make that possible.
• Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and Api design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases.
• Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your Api.
• Use AI to create test suites and regression coverage, then look for what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases.

Agentic Responsibilities

• Break complex features into AI-manageable tasks.
• Review AI-generated code for bugs, security, and architecture issues.
• Write prompts that produce quality code.
• Use AI for testing while recognizing its limitations.
• Demonstrate architecture and system-design judgment.
• Understand where AI performs well and where it fall short.

• 5+ years experience building and shipping production web software, with ownership of what you built after it went live.
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
• You will have experience in JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work in React and Node; expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome.
• Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry cost.
• Server-side or full-stack web work — Node services, APIs, and the integrations that connect a customer-facing product to the systems behind it.
• Practical web security awareness: injection and XSS vectors, authentication and session handling, dependency risk, and safe handling of sensitive data.
• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD, automated test and build tooling.

jobs.title: Business Systems & Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.
TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.


We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.


We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Lead, Business Systems & Analytics, you will be the first dedicated business systems hire at TwelveLabs. Your job will be to implement enduring systems & analytics architecture across TwelveLabs. Clear systems of record, data that flows between them without human intervention, and a reporting layer every team can trust.

This is deliberately a hybrid role. Roughly half of your time will be around systems. This involves owning the stack, running implementations, building integrations, and setting master data standards across the business. The other half is analytics - turning that clean data into the dashboards and metric definitions that leadership and the board actually run the company on. We are hiring for someone who wants both halves, because the two reinforce each other: nobody builds good reporting on a stack they don't understand, and nobody designs a good stack without knowing what has to come out the other end.

You will report to the Head of Finance and start as an individual contributor with company-wide scope. Finance and the core business systems are the first priority, but this role is horizontal by design. GTM, People, and Engineering are all customers, and we expect you to operate credibly with any of them. As the function grows, this seat is the foundation for a team.




ABOUT OUR BUSINESS SYSTEMS STACK

 - ERP: Campfire

 - Expenses: Ramp

 - Banking: JP Morgan Access

 - EPM: Pigment

 - CRM: HubSpot

 - Payment Processing & Usage Metering: Metronome, Stripe & AWS Marketplace

 - Data Warehouse & BI: Databricks




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Own the business systems architecture end to end. Define the system of record for every critical data object (customer, vendor, employee, entity, department, contract) and enforce it, so that the same question asked in two systems returns the same answer.

 - Build and maintain the integrations between our core platforms

 - Own master data integrity across a multi-entity, global corporate structure including chart of accounts, department and cost center mapping.

 - Build the company's reporting and analytics layer in Databricks. We are laying ground truth for the company across all business metrics (ARR, burn, runway, headcount, gross margin, unit economics). Model them in the warehouse, and surface them in dashboards teams can self-serve from

 - Lead systems evaluation and implementation projects: build the requirements, run the vendor evaluation, negotiate alongside Finance, manage the implementation, and own the post-launch adoption

 - Automate manual workflows relentlessly, including agentic and AI-assisted automation, and document everything so the automation survives you rather than depending on you

 - Act as the translator between technical and business stakeholders: you should be able to sit with a data engineer in the morning and a department head in the afternoon and be useful in both conversations. Pipeline and CRM data hygiene with GTM, headcount and compensation reporting with People, cost attribution and infrastructure spend with Engineering

 - Establish the standards, documentation, and runbooks that let this function scale into a team





YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - 8+ years in business systems, BizOps, RevOps, analytics engineering, or finance systems, ideally spending a large amount of that time at a growth stage startup.

 - Hands-on involvement, if not ownership, of core systems of record including ERPs, CRMs and HRIS’.

 - SQL fluency and genuine comfort working in a cloud data warehouse; dbt or an equivalent transformation framework is a strong plus

 - A track record of building integrations between systems, whether through native connectors, an iPaaS, or direct API work in Python or similar

 - Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency data structures, and an appreciation for why entity attribution matters

 - Demonstrated ability to work across functions with no formal authority — influence, clear communication, and follow-through

 - A documentation instinct: you build for handoff, not for job security

 - Strong intellectual curiosity and a desire to dive deep into cutting-edge multimodal foundation models

 - Ability to be on-site at our San Francisco (Jackson Square) office at least three days a week




BENEFITS AND PERKS

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual Learning & Development stipend to invest in your growth

💼 Global offices in San Francisco and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

🛂 VISA support where applicable

🚆 Transportation stipend (SF onsite only)

🍲 Daily lunch & dinner provided (SF onsite only)

jobs.title: Partner Engagement Manager, V Corps
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Secret

In person in Fort Knox, KY




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As a Partner Engagement Manager at Onebrief, you're the customer's trusted technical partner. You serve as the subject-matter expert, maintaining power-user-level fluency in the platform. You stay current on product updates, translating new releases into practical impact for the specific workflows your customer relies on. You act as the primary line of communication between the customer and Onebrief — as the product evolves, you deliver ongoing, role-specific training to ensure users adopt new capabilities rather than getting stuck on outdated workflows. You bridge the technical gap between engineering and the customer, explaining product behavior in terms their staff can actually act on.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Clearly communicate user needs to the product team. Maintain a high product proficiency, and excite the customer about each product improvement.

 - Understand, request, and effectively leverage Company resources to meet the goals of the Company.

 - Lead or support exercises.

 - Use your observations of our users to recommend product improvements.

 - Identify gaps between existing directorate workflows and effective Onebrief usage, then drive adoption through hands-on configuration, user coaching, and workflow optimization.

 - When responding to incidents (product is unavailable, broken, or not delighting the customer), coordinate with the customer and our product engineering team.

 - Instill the Onebrief brand image.

 - Align your team’s efforts to deliver the best customer experience, while coordinating with fellow Partner Engagement Managers to ensure planning and workflows remain synchronized across commands.

 - Enable our expansion to Allies and Partners.

 


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven experience in leading operational planning within a military context, preferably at multi-star headquarters.

 - Exposure to large staff planning, through classical training in Professional Military Education or through service experience

 - Familiarity and experience with major military planning exercises and the protocols for software deployment on classified networks.

 - Proven ability to expand business presence within a customer location with emphasis on software or technology solutions.

 - Experience in customer support, both face-to-face and remote, and capability to respond to incidents coordinating with customers and product engineering teams.

 - Strong technical skills to master our application, troubleshoot issues and liaise with customers on technical matters.

 - Proven ability to navigate large government organizations, solve bureaucratic challenges, and deliver successful outcomes.

 - You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DOD facilities and installations.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - You’re technically adept. You don’t need to code, but you do need to be savvy. Can you become a power user of our product and talk engineering with the customer?

 - Customers trust you. You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, develop rapport, align diverse perspectives, and communicate with clarity and influence.

 - You’re intense about our mission. It’s a core part of who you are

 - You’re proactive and adaptable. You see a problem and get to work. You’re comfortable working autonomously or in a cross-functional team, especially in a fast-paced or ambiguous setting

 - You communicate clearly, concisely, and candidly. Our Company relies on you to assess the situation within your account and effectively communicate your assessment and recommendations to inform strategic decisions.

 


INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Partner Engagement Manager will:

 - Opinion and expertise are valued by the customer and company alike (rapport/trust)

 - Learns quick, identifies opportunities and drives progress within the account (forward-leaning/ bias for action)

 - Open-minded and able to pivot when priorities shift (adaptability/ humility)

In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. jobs.title: Senior Staff Privacy Engineer - Moveworks
jobs.description:
Our AI products rely on sensitive data to enable customers to get work done. With this in mind, privacy is a crucial part of ensuring that data is handled properly throughout the workflow, from what we collect and how we use it to the controls we apply across models, tools, logs and data pipelines. In this role, you will be a key privacy engineer, writing code and shaping the architecture and protections across our products. You will improve sensitive data detection and masking, assess the privacy risks of ML models, and own the implementation of customer data-use and retention controls. You will work with our Privacy, ML, Security, Product and Infrastructure teams from design through production.

This is a Senior Staff individual contributor role. You will be hands on, setting technical direction across teams and writing production code.

What you get to do in this role:

• Assess, benchmark and select ML models and techniques that meet our privacy requirements. Build representative evaluation datasets and compare detection coverage, false positives, latency, cost and the impact on product quality.
• Own the implementation of those models in our products, from prototype through production. Train or fine-tune where needed, build the surrounding services and APIs, and optimize inference performance and reliability.
• Build and deploy sensitive data detection, masking, redaction and tokenization for structured and unstructured data across logs, traces, APIs, analytics and annotation tools. Implement consistent controls for when data is masked and who can access the unmasked content.
• Build privacy evaluations for ML models and the systems around them, including memorization, training-data extraction, membership inference and sensitive data disclosure through retrieval or tool use. Implement mitigations and add regression tests to model and product release workflows.
• Write and maintain code that enforces customer requirements for data use, access, retention and deletion across services and data stores, including the distinction between permitted inference, evaluation, annotation and training.
• Prototype and implement privacy-preserving approaches to evaluation and synthetic data. Measure privacy risk and utility, validate the assumptions behind the approach, and integrate suitable solutions into our ML pipelines.
• Conduct privacy design reviews with engineering, identify gaps in proposed data flows and architectures, and own or partner on the code changes needed to address them. Build reusable components and engineering standards that help teams apply these protections consistently.
• Monitor privacy controls and models in production, investigate failures, and ship improvements. Use error analysis and production feedback to improve detection quality, address regressions and close customer-reported privacy issues.

What success looks like in your first year:

• ML models selected and deployed for priority privacy use cases, with measured improvements in detection quality and acceptable production latency and cost.
• Shared masking and data protection components integrated into the highest-priority product surfaces, with automated tests for coverage and access behavior.
• Repeatable privacy evaluations running as part of model and product releases, with findings translated into shipped fixes.
• Priority data-use, retention and deletion requirements implemented and verified in production, with monitoring that identifies failures.

To be successful in this role you have:

• Typically 7+ or more years building production software, including substantial experience in privacy engineering and applied ML.
• Strong Python skills and experience with Go, Java, C++ or another production systems language. You have shipped, tested and operated production software.
• Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting and deploying ML models, including dataset curation, model adaptation or fine-tuning, error analysis and model serving.
• Experience building sensitive data detection and masking systems, including their accuracy, performance and integration tradeoffs.
• Experience assessing privacy risks in ML and LLM systems and implementing mitigations. You can explain what your tests establish and where uncertainty remains.
• Deep understanding of data minimization, pseudonymization, anonymization and re-identification risk, including the limits of removing direct identifiers.
• Experience building data protection and lifecycle controls in distributed cloud systems.
• A record of taking ambiguous engineering problems from design through delivery, setting technical direction across teams and mentoring engineers.

Preferred experience:

• Applying differential privacy or other privacy-enhancing technologies, including evaluating their assumptions and privacy-utility tradeoffs.
• Privacy engineering for agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings or synthetic datasets.
• Experience in enterprise, multi-tenant or regulated environments, and translating privacy requirements such as GDPR and CCPA into technical controls.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $201,300 - $352,300, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits.  Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure.  Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location.  We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.

Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Auto Product Development Manager
jobs.description:
Quick Summary

You'll design new insurance products and features, then drive their rollout across new and existing states. 5+ years of Auto product development experience preferred.



Who We Are

Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it hardest. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive.

Using data, technology, and thoughtful human support, we're building products that are clear, fair, and help homeowners feel confident — so homeowners aren't left behind when they need help most.

Founded in 2016, Kin is a remote-first employer with Kinfolk across more than 35 states. We serve customers in 14 states (and counting). Our disciplined growth, strong customer satisfaction, and focus on long-term sustainability foster outstanding growth, attract marquee investors, and earn recognition and accolades, including:

- Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work, Midsize Companies (2021-2026)

- Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers (2026)

- Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Forbes' Fintech 50 (2023-2026)

- Great Places to Work Certified (2024-2026)

Most importantly, we're building Kin to be a place where people do meaningful work with real impact — for our customers, our communities, and each other. We're excited to tell you more about how you can contribute to our rapid growth, strong unit economics, profitability, and excellent customer ratings. To learn more about how we work and what we're building, visit kin.com http://kin.com and see how we work (https://www.linkedin.com/company/kin-insurance/life/kin/).



The Opportunity

We're looking for an Auto Pricing and Risk Manager to help us build the next generation of Auto insurance products and coverages as well as expand Kin's footprint across states. This role sits at the intersection of pricing strategy and product development — turning market insight and risk analysis into new coverage options, rating features, and pricing enhancements that customers actually feel.

This is a hands-on, builder-focused role. You won't be managing a team — you'll be directly shaping the products and features that power Kin's growth, from initial concept through launch in both new and existing states. Your work will directly influence how competitively and confidently Kin can enter new markets and deepen its presence in current ones.



Your Responsibilities

 - Design and develop new insurance products, rules, coverages, and enhancements that improve competitiveness and customer value

 - Lead state expansion efforts by building and launching pricing models for new states, and optimizing existing state models for performance

 - Own the research and proposal of new products, rules, coverages, and enhancements

 - Own the end-to-end rollout process, from initial pricing analysis through launch and post-launch monitoring

 - Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance pricing accuracy, uncover emerging risk patterns, and accelerate analytical workflows

 - Partner cross-functionally with actuarial, product, and compliance teams to ensure new features are technically sound and regulator-ready

 - Build and maintain dashboards and KPIs that track the performance of newly launched products and pricing features

 - Translate market and competitive research into concrete product recommendations and pricing adjustments

 - Identify opportunities for pricing innovation ahead of state expansion, ensuring readiness for regulatory review and market entry



Success in This Role

In your first 6–12 months at Kin, success is less about checking boxes and more about the impact you create. You'll use your skills and judgment to take ownership of meaningful work, improve how we operate, and help move Kin's mission forward. Along the way, you'll deliver outcomes that make a real difference for both Kinfolk and the homeowners we serve.

By the end of your first year, you should feel confident in your role, trusted as an owner, and proud of the progress you've helped make.

 - New pricing products or features have been successfully launched, showing meaningful impact to growth goals

 - State expansion pricing models are built, validated, and ready for regulatory submission

 - AI/ML tools are actively integrated into the pricing development workflow, improving speed or accuracy of analysis

 - Cross-functional partners trust this person's product recommendations and rely on their analysis to make launch decisions



What You'll Bring

 - 5+ years of insurance product development experience; personal auto insurance experience preferred but not necessary

 - Demonstrated experience building or launching new insurance products, features, or rating enhancements

 - Experience supporting state expansion efforts, including new-state pricing model development and regulatory readiness

 - Hands-on experience applying AI and machine learning tools to pricing, underwriting, or risk workflows, with measurable results

 - Strong understanding of regulatory modeling and compliance requirements across multiple states

 - Ability to translate market research and competitive analysis into concrete pricing and product recommendations

 - Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with actuarial, product, and compliance teams without formal authority over those teams



How We Hire

We believe a great hiring experience should be clear, respectful, and human. We will accept applications for this position until January 18th. While our recruiting team uses AI tools for efficiency, resumes are still screened by Kin's in-house recruiters, and candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are made by recruiters and hiring teams. Rest assured, real people make real decisions.

The hiring process and timeline for each role will vary, depending on the position. However, here are some things you can expect from us:

 - Prompt updates and feedback following interviews

 - Interviews with recruiters, hiring managers, and members of teams

 - Skills assessment relevant to the position, if applicable

 - Genuine, thoughtful human interaction at every step


HOW WE WORK

We don’t just hire for skills. We hire for alignment. Kinfolk bring diverse perspectives, but we’re united by a shared set of values that shape how we work and how we show up for each other and our customers.

Run through walls, together - Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. We assume the best in each other and challenge ideas, not intentions. We show up, work hard, and play to each other's strengths — because that’s how great teams win.

Raise the bar. Drop the ego - Attitudes are contagious. Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. Like professional sports teams, we win by working in sync. We show up, work hard, and play to each other’s strengths.

Act like an owner - We are owners, fully accountable for achieving Kin’s mission. That requires positive, proactive, big-picture thinking well beyond our job descriptions. Ask questions, Take ownership. Do the right thing, even when it‘s hard. Because when Kin thrives, so do you. And so do our customers.

Operate lean. Deliver more - We build efficiency into everything we do. Each dollar we save gets reinvested to deliver more to our customers: better pricing, more products, and new innovations. We work smarter by relentlessly prioritizing and using technology, including AI, to multiply our impact. Lean is about focus, not deprivation. Lean isn't a limitation — it's our competitive advantage.

Keep asking ‘What if?’ - We value curiosity. To make insurance better for our customers, we experiment. We embrace insights. And we base decisions on data rather than assumptions. We see setbacks as opportunities for growth and are always learning and improving. Both individually and as a company.




WHERE WE WORK

We are a remote-first company with offices in Chicago, IL and St. Petersburg, FL where teams can come together for collaboration.

For Sales Agents and Customer Service Agents: These roles sit in any of the following 32 states: AL, AZ, CO, FL, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI.

For all other positions, these roles can sit in any of the following 41 states: AL, AR, AZ, CA (exempt only), CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in one of the states listed above.

For remote technical positions located in Canada, we are only able to hire individuals who reside in Ontario. Applicants must be able to live and work full-time in Ontario to be considered.

State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.




EEOC STATEMENT

Kin is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We don't just accept difference – we honor it, nurture it, and celebrate it. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Kin welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
