jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Platform - Moveworks
jobs.description:
The Role

We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

What you get to do in this role:

• Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations
• Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge.
• Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing
• Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO
• Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation
• Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes
• Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration
• Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates.
• Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains.
• Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production.

To be successful in this role you have:

You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas:

• Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing
• Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling
• Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees
• Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)
• Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics
• gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns
• Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation

Required:

• 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems
• Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)
• Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale
• Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models
• Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

Relevant past experience:

• Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning.
• Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking.
• Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection.
• Research or applied work in machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, information retrieval, or ranking and relevance.

jobs.title: Strategic Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
About Pallet

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

About the Opportunity

Everything people use has to be made, stored, and moved. Pallet builds AI that runs those physical operations: the warehouses, trucks, and supply chains behind everyday life. Our ambition is to accelerate material abundance by helping companies produce and deliver more at lower cost.

We're a Series B company that has raised $70M and grown ARR 10x in the last year.

Advisors, private equity firms, venture capital firms, and technology companies work alongside the operators we sell to. The right introduction from one of them can open a new account or move an active deal forward. You'll build that channel for Pallet.

The role in one paragraph

You'll build and run Pallet's strategic partnerships: a referral motion that turns advisors, private equity firms, venture capital firms, and technology companies into qualified sales pipeline. You'll build the relationships, earn specific introductions through a credible operating case, and work with Sales to convert them into pipeline. This is a hands on role.

Why Pallet, and why now

• If you're currently in a partnerships role, this is your opportunity to own the whole channel. Build the entire investment firm channel rather than one segment of an established program.

• If you're currently in an investing role, this is an opportunity to build a business. Move from advising portfolio companies to building a business that changes supply chains run.

• If you want to become a technology go-to-market leader. Build a program that accelerates our business development and commercial efforts.

• Join at the right moment. Pallet is a Series B company that has raised $70M and grown ARR 10x in the last year. We have the opportunity of a startup, with the resources of a large organization.

How you will make an impact

• Prioritize firms by portfolio fit, operating influence, and buying reasons. Map relevant companies and buyers.

• Build relationships with operating partners, value creation teams, investment professionals, VC platform teams, and advisors. Earn specific introductions through a credible operating case.

• Write memos naming the buyer, problem, and reason to meet. Coordinate outreach and follow through with account owners.

• Build repeatable portfolio programs: diagnostics, operator workshops, preferred vendor arrangements, and case studies.

• Advance live deals through executive introductions.

• Maintain relationships, introductions, and opportunities. Report conversion, stage progression, closed revenue, and time to opportunity by partner.

• In your first 90 days, select priority firms, launch initial portfolio engagements, and establish an introduction to opportunity baseline.

Preferred experience

• Roughly 5 to 10 years of experience in partnerships, sales, consulting, investing, or another high intensity client-facing role.

• A track record of building networks, in a professional or personal capacity.

• The ability to explain operational use cases through capacity, cost to serve, margin, or service.

• Clear and high-EQ verbal and written communication.

• Motivation from a commercial target, with pipeline and revenue as the measure.

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Location

• SF or NYC, with 50% travel

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this role is $180,000 to $240,000 OTE, 70/30 split, plus equity, depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and opportunities for growth. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.

Our Benefits

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

• 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits

• 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation

• ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance

• ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

• 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff

• 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future

• 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families

• 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend

• 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area and New York employees

• 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office

• 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space for remote employees

• 📸 Free professional headshot

• 🍔 Daily catered lunches and dinners provided in office

• 💪 Complimentary On-Site Gym: Our SF office has a fully equipped gym

• ✈️ Onboarding trip to one of our offices if you work remotely

• 🥤 Monthly happy hours

• 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity

We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Accommodations

As a member of the Agentic AI Harness & Quality team, you will have all the tools of modern agentic AI engineering at your disposal, from frontier LLMs and tools to all the infrastructure needed to tune, evaluate, and serve AI agents in production. We are an eval-driven, data-centric team, and you will have the assistance of a world-class annotation team to build error-free, inclusive, and privacy-preserving datasets for tuning and evals.

You will push the envelope of AI performance in production, in every meaning of the word “performance”: not just accuracy and quality of outputs, but also latency, reliability, and capability of the end-to-end user-facing system as a whole. Successful AI engineers on the team are motivated to design and maintain high-performing compound AI systems.

Our team indexes on increasing our ability to move fast, solving challenging product and engineering challenges, and pushing the envelope of agent reliability and value provided to customers. Your work will impact our team’s core objective to build the highest-performing enterprise assistant platform the world has ever seen, in close collaboration with other functions within Moveworks and ServiceNow as a whole.

What you get to do in this role:

• Apply software engineering and compound AI system engineering to create lasting value for all our customers
• Drive quality in agent behavior, both in terms of increasing success rate at achieving goals set by end users and decreasing misbehavior in the customer business environment
• Take on exciting and difficult challenges in AI harness engineering, such as agent cognitive architecture, eval benchmark creation, context engineering, generative UI, dynamic agent orchestration, multimodal I/O such as image and voice, multilinguality, conversational memory management, reasoning strategies, grounding and verifiability for generated text, deployment safety, and automatic harness optimization
• Read, discuss, and build on the latest AI research and open-source repositories and models

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering TPA
jobs.description:
The weaponization of AI is driving a paradigm shift in the cyber security industry from proactive to preemptive security:  clients must now invest more intelligence and effort in understanding their vulnerabilities before their adversaries do (Open AI).  The only way to achieve this is to simulate future attack scenarios at scale, and to run them in high fidelity digital replicas of production environments (Gartner/Forrester).  SimSpace serves as the AI Proving Grounds to generate hypersynthetic data which pressure tests controls, tools, teams, and agentic capabilities in full kill chain attacks hidden in realistic environmental traffic and patterns of life. 



Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform was initially conceived to assist in Offensive Cyber Operations (OCO), to quickly replicate target environments to conduct mission rehearsal of human operators and their tools to deny (disrupt, degrade, destroy) or deceive (manipulate or exfiltrate data) adversaries.  The company has since expanded to serve over a dozen allied governments in OCO/DCO as well as critical infrastructure enterprises around the world.  The company is actively investing in the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe and the Middle East through direct sales and channel partners.  SimSpace has launched the AI Proving Grounds Consortium, leading the revolution by creating an open platform for the InfoSec ecosystem to train, validate and operationalize their agentic capabilities before committing to production.



Why join SimSpace?

We are a team united by a shared purpose and four core values: Serve to Protect, Acquire Understanding, Teamwork without Borders, and Operate as Innovators. We value candid, constructive feedback and create opportunities for personal, professional, and financial growth. Our vision, “Defend the Free World,” drives our mission: “Defeat Any Adversary in Any Cyber Terrain at Machine Speed.”



How Do We Work?

We listen to customers and colleagues, challenge assumptions, and turn ideas into meaningful results. We expect everyone to embrace emerging technologies, simplify and automate work, and use AI to learn, solve problems, and help deliver quality with speed. We apply human judgment and take responsibility for outcomes. Whether remote or office-based, we collaborate across teams and time zones.



We invite you to apply today!




JOB SUMMARY

You will lead TPA's evaluation and scoring work for AI Proving Grounds (AIPG). The team turns evaluation methods into software that helps customers see what an agent did, what evidence supports its assessment and how results compare.



TPA's software engineers and Data Scientists will report directly to you. As a hands-on player-coach, you will regularly implement and debug software, tests and automation while developing the team and owning delivery. The Staff Engineer leads design across features. Evaluation specialists review method validity; engineering makes the implementation reliable and keeps results traceable to evidence.




WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING AT SIMSPACE?

 - Hire, coach and develop software engineers and Data Scientists through clear expectations and regular feedback. Arrange scientific mentorship and method review with the appropriate specialists.

 - Define assessment questions, reference cases, evidence requirements and acceptance criteria with Product and evaluation specialists before expanding the work.

 - Lead delivery from execution coordination through evidence capture, scoring and usable results. Agree shared infrastructure, frontend work and operating support with the teams that provide them.

 - Review architecture and code with the Staff Engineer. Write focused changes, such as a test harness or integration fix, while helping engineers take ownership and keeping time for people leadership.

 - Build tests for missing evidence, incompatible versions, interrupted runs and misleading results. Use AI-assisted development with code review, tests and security checks.

 - Keep a ranked plan that accounts for support and maintenance. Raise changes in scope, dependencies or staffing early, and agree who will operate the capability before release.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The Director and Product will agree initial priorities and timing with you, based on staffing and partner commitments.

 - The team has a reviewed assessment plan with methods, reference cases, known limitations and named reviewers.

 - An assessment workflow produces results that can be traced to evidence and clearly reports missing or inconclusive inputs.

 - Engineers and Data Scientists understand their responsibilities and use a capacity plan that covers hiring, support and maintenance.




WHAT ARE THE QUALIFICATIONS TO APPLY?

 - Experience managing software engineers through hiring, coaching, performance feedback and career development, with the ability to coach Data Scientists using role-appropriate goals and specialist support.

 - Recent experience personally implementing, testing and debugging production software, with the ability to review designs and diagnose service failures.

 - Experience delivering work across software and analytical, modeling or research disciplines, with clear engineering and specialist responsibilities.

 - Experience turning data-processing or analytical methods into supported software through tested APIs, reproducible inputs and observable results.

 - Ability to reason about asynchronous execution, data integrity, access control and recovery, and explain how tests expose incorrect or unsupported results.

 - Evidence of bringing an uncertain problem through a supported release by choosing scope, securing dependencies and improving delivery through automation.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You invite challenge, explain trade-offs and raise uncertainty early enough for the team to act.

 - You give specialists useful feedback, respect their judgment and help them deliver a working product together.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager, Tacit Ranger
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

• Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) for programs within CHAOS Aeronautics acts as the single supply chain point of contact for the program and a member of its Integrated Product Team (IPT).

• Complete ownership of the program supply chain plan, including subcontract negotiation and management, supplier cost and schedule performance, and sourcing of aeronautics commodities in compliance with government procurement requirements.

• Day-to-day collaboration with Program Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Contracts, Program Finance, Quality, Legal, and the Procurement organization, which handles standard material buys.

• This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports initially. As the team grows, the role may expand to include buyers assigned to the program.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as the single supply chain point of contact for assigned programs, representing supply chain on the IPT and in program reviews.

• Negotiate and manage subcontracts, including terms, pricing, schedule, and flowdowns, coordinating with Legal, which provides final approval.

• Coordinate with Procurement on regular material buys so that demand, lead times, and supplier commitments align with the program schedule.

• Own supplier cost performance for the program, including Estimate at Completion (EAC) and Control Account Manager (CAM) responsibilities.

• Report variances and risks to Program Management and Program Finance.

• Partner with Engineering on long-lead items and drawing release scheduling so that sourcing is sequenced to the design and build plan.

• Identify and qualify sources of supply for gaps in the program supply base, in coordination with Supplier Quality, and document sourcing decisions and rationale.

• Source and manage aeronautics commodities, such as machined and fabricated structures, composites, castings and forgings, avionics and electrical components, propulsion hardware, and special processes.

• Apply government procurement requirements to program purchasing, including FAR and DFARS flowdowns, specialty metals, counterfeit parts prevention, DPAS ratings, and ITAR/EAR export controls. Support Foreign Military Sales requirements where applicable.

• Maintain program supply chain risk visibility, including supplier delivery performance, single-source exposure, and lead-time and cost risk, with documented mitigation plans.

• Follow and help develop Supply Chain policies, procedures, and tools that support purchasing system compliance and audit readiness.

• As the team scales, provide work direction to assigned buyers and contribute to hiring, onboarding, and development.

• Travel: up to 25% (e.g., supplier visits and internal team reviews).

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, or another related field or equivalent work experience.

• 10+ years of supply chain, procurement, or program supply chain experience in aerospace, aeronautics, or defense.

• Hands-on experience sourcing and managing aeronautics commodities and the suppliers that provide them.

• Working knowledge of government procurement requirements, including FAR and DFARS flowdowns, and experience applying them to subcontracts and purchase orders.

• Experience negotiating subcontracts and managing supplier cost, schedule, and performance against a program baseline.

• Ability to work in a matrixed, IPT-based environment and communicate with Program, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, and Legal stakeholders.

Preferred Requirements:

• Professional certifications are strongly preferred, such as CPIM or CSCP (ASCM), CPSM (ISM), or PMP.

• Experience supporting a Contractor Purchasing System Review (CPSR) or operating within a government-approved purchasing system.

• Experience with ITAR/EAR compliance in a purchasing context and with Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs.

• Experience contributing to EAC development and earned value or CAM responsibilities.

• Experience in a high-growth or startup environment, including building processes alongside a developing team.

• Prior experience leading or mentoring buyers or other supply chain staff.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $180,000-$230,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Staff Software Engineer to join a dynamic team focused on building cutting-edge, customer-facing AI Developer products. This role is ideal for a senior technical leader who combines deep software engineering expertise with hands-on experience in applied AI, developer experience (DevX), modern web technologies, and the Node.js/TypeScript ecosystem.

As a Staff Engineer, you will help shape the technical direction and architecture of AI-powered developer experiences, solve complex engineering challenges, and influence engineering practices across the team. You will work closely with product, engineering, and cross-functional partners to take products from concept and architecture through implementation and delivery.

What you get to do in this role:

• Drive technical architecture and design for complex, scalable, customer-facing AI Developer products and platform capabilities.
• Build high-quality, clean, scalable, and reusable software while establishing and championing engineering best practices around architecture, code quality, testing, performance, and maintainability.
• Partner with product owners and engineering leaders to translate business and customer requirements into technical strategy, architecture, and execution plans.
• Own key capabilities end to end, from technical design and implementation through test automation, production readiness, delivery, and ongoing improvement.
• Design intuitive and extensible developer experiences that enable customers to easily extend, customize, and integrate platform functionality to meet their needs.
• Apply AI and emerging technologies to developer workflows and experiences, identifying opportunities to improve developer productivity and create differentiated product capabilities.
• Lead the design and implementation of new products and major features while continuously improving the scalability, reliability, and performance of existing capabilities.
• Navigate ambiguous and technically complex problems, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and provide clear technical direction.
• Collaborate across engineering teams and organizational boundaries to drive alignment on architecture, APIs, frameworks, and shared technical standards.
• Mentor and influence engineers across the team, raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on technical leadership.

To be successful in this role you have:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including experience designing and delivering complex, scalable production systems.
• Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js; Java experience is a plus.
• Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, developer tools, or AI-enabled product experiences, with an understanding of how AI/LLM capabilities can be effectively integrated into production software.
• Strong understanding of developer experience (DevX) and a passion for building frameworks, platforms, APIs, tools, and experiences that make developers more productive.
• Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, software architecture, design patterns, APIs, and performance/scale considerations.
• Experience with modern UI frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
• Demonstrated ability to design and influence large-scale technical architectures and make sound engineering decisions across multiple components or services.
• Experience owning complex initiatives from architecture through production delivery, including assessing technical trade-offs and managing long-term maintainability.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous technical environments.
• Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying on direct authority.
• Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards through architecture reviews, design discussions, code reviews, and technical guidance.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $166,500 - $291,400, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and onboarding a portfolio of 10-15 high-value partners, collaborating with them to develop joint go-to-market (GTM) strategies that are valuable to not only Attentive, but our partners too. Your goal is to leverage these partnerships to sell our SMS, email, and AI products to customers, directly impacting our revenue growth.

This hybrid role is based in our New York office, with in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday each week.

• Pipeline Management: Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline, tracking partner-led opportunities and ensuring progress towards revenue targets.

• Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to drive partner enablement and joint success.

• Performance Analysis: Monitor partner performance, analyzing sales data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Reporting: Provide regular updates and reports on partner activities, pipeline status, and revenue forecasts to senior leadership.

Your Expertise

• At least 7 years of experience in partner development, channel sales, or business development, preferably within the SaaS or digital marketing space.

• Proven track record of managing strategic partnerships and achieving revenue targets. Experience managing large agency and SI partnerships is a big bonus.

• Strong understanding of SMS, email, and AI marketing solutions.

• Can show clear evidence of how you are leveraging AI and building agents to build productive partnerships

• Willing to travel and build in-person relationships with partners and customers

• Ability to develop and execute joint GTM strategies with partners.

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales data and identify trends.

• Highly self-motivated and able to thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

You'll get competitive perks and benefits, from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Full-Time) - Orange, CT
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced knowledge in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• A strong communicator; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• A strong multitasker, able to thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($18.00 - $26.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Partnerships Lead, Emerging Products
jobs.description:
Who We Are

HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab. Combining startup agility with HP’s global scale, we’re building intelligent technologies that redefine how the world works, creates, and collaborates.

We’re assembling a diverse, world-class team—engineers, designers, researchers, and product minds—focused on creating an intelligent ecosystem across HP’s portfolio. Together, we’re developing intuitive, adaptive solutions that spark creativity, boost productivity, and make collaboration seamless.

We create breakthrough solutions that make complex tasks feel effortless, teamwork more natural, and ideas more impactful—always with a human-centric mindset.

By embedding AI advancements into every HP product and service, we’re expanding what’s possible for individuals, organisations, and the future of work.

Join us as we reinvent work, so people everywhere can do their best work.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead, Emerging Products to bring new HP IQ capabilities to market and build new lines of business. You’ll secure partners, agents, and endpoints that integrate with and enable HP IQ’s agentic intelligence layer across HP’s hardware ecosystem, helping build a scalable partner platform.

This hands-on role combines partnership strategy, end-to-end business development, and partner management. You’ll identify which partners to pursue and define the business and contractual terms. Working with Product, Engineering, and early adopters, you’ll shape vertical-specific products and applications, pilot use cases, and translate what you learn into commercial offerings.

You’ll own the business case and path to market for these opportunities—from deal structure and pricing to co-marketing and go-to-market execution—with a focus on scaling the partner ecosystem.

What You Might Do

• Define the partnership and business model strategy for emerging offerings: determine how HP IQ and its partners create and capture value, and prioritize opportunities based on product fit, customer demand, partner interest, and commercial potential.

• Identify, pitch, and secure ISVs, AI companies, developers, service providers, and other partners whose agents, applications, and endpoints expand HP IQ’s capabilities.

• Identify, pitch, and secure early adopters for vertical-specific products and applications. Lead pilots to test use cases, then use the results to refine the product and commercial opportunity.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Design to define integration requirements and deliver partner integrations for HP IQ’s agentic intelligence layer.

• Structure and negotiate agreements, pricing, and commercial terms in collaboration with Legal and Finance, aligning partner incentives with HP IQ’s business objectives.

• Build a scalable partner platform and ecosystem. Use partner and customer feedback to refine the roadmap and improve how partners integrate, launch, and grow.

Essential Qualifications

• 4+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, or similar.

• A track record of sourcing and closing technology partnerships, negotiating agreements, and bringing integrations or new offerings to market.

• Experience working directly with product and engineering teams, with the technical fluency to define partnership opportunities involving APIs, AI capabilities, software platforms, and connected devices.

• Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to build business cases, evaluate partner economics, set pricing, and negotiate terms.

• Experience defining partnership and business model strategies: assessing markets and ecosystems, choosing where to partner, and translating those choices into priorities and investment recommendations.

• Ability to build senior-level partner relationships and align cross-functional teams to deliver agreements, integrations, and launches.

• Must be based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

Preferred Skills

• MBA

• Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or venture building focused on new technology businesses.

• Experience translating early-stage opportunities into pilots and commercial plans as products and business models evolve.

• Experience building ISV, developer, or application ecosystems for AI products or software platforms.

• Experience with consumer electronics, intelligent devices, wearables, or other hardware/software products.

• Experience working with both startups and large technology companies.

Salary: $151,850- $223,950

Compensation & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

The salary range for this role is listed above. Final salary offered is based upon multiple factors including individual job-related qualifications, education, experience, knowledge and skills.

At HP IQ, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health insurance

• Dental insurance

• Vision insurance

• Long term/short term disability insurance

• Employee assistance program

• Flexible spending account

• Life insurance

• Generous time off policies, including; 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure 11 paid holidays Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

Why HP IQ?

HP IQ is HP’s new AI innovation lab, building the intelligence to empower humanity—reimagining how we work, create, and connect to shape the future of work.

• Innovative Work Help shape the future of intelligent computing and workplace transformation.

• Autonomy and Agility Work with the speed and focus of a startup, backed by HP’s scale.

• Meaningful Impact Build AI-powered solutions that help people and organisations thrive.

• Flexible Work Environment Freedom and flexibility to do your best work.

• Forward-Thinking Culture We learn fast, stay future-focused, and imagine what comes next—together.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, and the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed as a Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

WHO YOU ARE

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match ($25.00 - $44.00/hr)

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 10 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Video is 90% of the world's data. Most of it is invisible to machines.
TwelveLabs builds the intelligence layer to change that. Our multimodal AI models understand video the way humans do — across sight, sound, and motion — and power production-scale AI workloads across media, entertainment, sports, security, and government.


We have raised more than $210 million from NEA, Radical Ventures, Amazon, NVIDIA, Snowflake, Databricks, Index Ventures, NAVER Ventures, Korea Investment Partners, Quadrille Capital, Red Bull Ventures, and AI pioneers including Fei-Fei Li, Silvio Savarese, and Alexandr Wang.


We are a global company, headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seoul, New York, and London, and employees around the world. We believe the differences in our cultural, educational, and life experiences make our products stronger. Building technology that understands the world in all its complexity requires people who see it from every angle. We are looking for individuals who are driven by hard problems and want their work to matter. Come build it with us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

TwelveLabs works with several types of partners, including hyperscalers, data platforms, AI data infrastructure providers, ISVs, channel partners, and we continue to expand our partnerships. Each partner has its own programs, field teams and internal structure. Those partnerships only grow as fast as the operations and strategy behind them: opportunities registered on time, partner pipeline in sync with our CRM, field teams enabled and our time spent on the motions that produce revenue.

As Partnerships Operations Manager, you’ll own the operational layer across all of our partners. You’ll work closely with our partnerships leadership (Head of Partnerships, Partner Management and Ecosystem Partnerships) to drive revenue through our partners. That means running partner operations cleanly, and also bringing a point of view on where we invest: which motions to lean into with each partner, whether that’s events, field enablement or joint sales plays. You’ll learn how each partner organization works and use data that matters to them to shape their priorities. We’re still building this function from scratch, so the processes you create will become our standard.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Build a point of view on where partner investment pays off. Use pipeline and win data to recommend which motions to lean into with each partner, whether that’s events, field enablement or joint sales plays, and which to drop.

 - Learn how each partner organization works: who owns budget, how their field teams are measured and what their leadership tracks. Use that to get TwelveLabs prioritized, and make the case for joint investment with data points that matter to them.

 - Design repeatable joint sales plays with partner field teams, and measure which ones produce qualified pipeline and closed revenue.

 - Bring the data and recommendations to quarterly business reviews and joint planning sessions with partner stakeholders.

 - Act as program owner for each partner: maintain our presence in their partner portals, including listings, program tiers, certifications and compliance deadlines.

 - Own co-sell operations end to end: register and track opportunities, keep partner systems in sync with our CRM, manage funding and credit submissions, and run marketplace and channel transactions with Sales, Finance and Legal.

 - Build partner pipeline reporting, including sourced vs. influenced revenue, deal velocity, forecast and ROI by partner and by program.

 - Run the partner engagement calendar with Partner Marketing and our SA team, covering events, field enablement and co-marketing, from planning through follow-up and impact tracking.

 - Build the operating model and playbooks so any seller can run a co-sell motion with any partner, and so new partners can be onboarded quickly.

 - Build AI automations and agent workflows into partner operations, for work like opportunity registration, funding submissions, data hygiene and reporting, and keep improving them as volume grows.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5-7 years in partnerships, alliances, partner operations, sales operations or RevOps at a B2B SaaS, data or cloud company.

 - Have run co-sell with at least one major cloud or data platform partner. Hands-on AWS experience (Partner Central, ACE, funding and credits such as SCA) is strongly preferred; Snowflake, GCP or Azure partner programs also count.

 - Have recommended where to put partner time and budget, backed it with data and can show what happened afterward.

 - Have worked through a large partner’s internal structure to get something done: found the right owner, learned what they’re measured on and made the case in their terms.

 - Have built or run joint sales plays, field enablement or partner events that produced qualified pipeline and closed-won revenue.

 - Have designed or run parts of a partner program, such as tiers, incentives, MDF, deal registration or partner payouts.

 - Are data-driven and comfortable owning pipeline metrics, forecasting and reporting.

 - Have built AI workflows or automations (with Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools) that took manual work off a team, and want to do the same for partner operations.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and in the room, both internally and externally.

 - Like ambiguous, high-growth environments where you can build processes from nothing and own them.

 - Have worked across Sales, Marketing, Product and Engineering, and like being the person who connects them.

 - Are curious about video AI and want a central role in building its partner ecosystem.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at an ISV that sold with or through AWS, Snowflake or VAST Data, or time on the partner side (for example, as an AWS PDM).

 - Experience setting up channel or ISV partner programs, including reseller terms and deal registration.

 - Experience integrating ACE or another partner portal with a CRM.

 - Experience with AI/ML, data infrastructure or developer-focused products.




BENEFITS AND PERKS

🤝 An open and inclusive culture and work environment

🚀 Work closely with a collaborative, mission-driven team on cutting-edge AI technology

🏥 Full health, dental, and vision benefits

🌴 Extremely flexible PTO and parental leave policy. Office closed the week of Christmas and New Years

💪 Monthly wellness stipend

📚 Annual Learning & Development stipend to invest in your growth

💼 Global offices in San Francisco and Seoul, and coworking office memberships for remote team members

🛂 VISA support where applicable

🚆 Transportation stipend (SF & NY onsite only)

🍲 Daily meal support (SF & NY onsite only)



If someone contacted you about this role and you’d like to verify they’re a member of our team, please email careers@twelvelabs.io

They will partner across People Analytics, HR Technology, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business functions to help ensure that people data is trusted, well-defined, consistently used, and prepared to support reporting, analytics, and emerging AI use cases.

Responsibilities

• Support the People Data Governance operating model by helping maintain clear data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation paths.
• Partner with data owners, data stewards, analytics teams, and technical partners to document and operationalize consistent governance processes.
• Coordinate data certification activities, including defining certification requirements, documenting review criteria, tracking approvals, and maintaining certification records.
• Help establish and maintain standards for trusted data products, certified metrics, business definitions, and approved data sources.
• Support data quality processes by documenting rules, monitoring issues, coordinating remediation, and tracking quality improvements with business and technical partners.
• Partner with stakeholders to identify the business impact of data quality issues and establish appropriate ownership and resolution plans.
• Develop and maintain business glossaries, data dictionaries, metadata documentation, lineage information, ownership records, and related governance materials.
• Support master and reference data management practices that improve the consistency and usability of people data across systems and reporting solutions.
• Create repeatable governance workflows, templates, playbooks, standards, and documentation that enable teams to apply governance practices consistently.
• Facilitate working sessions, governance reviews, decision forums, and stakeholder discussions across business and technical teams.
• Support governance adoption through communications, training materials, office hours, onboarding resources, and change-management activities.
• Track governance priorities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and action items, and provide clear updates to program leaders and stakeholders.
• Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, HR Technology, Engineering, and People Analytics teams to support responsible data access, usage, sharing, and retention practices.
• Help assess governance requirements for analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases involving people data.
• Support the development of governance automation, monitoring, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve the scalability and effectiveness of the program.
• Identify opportunities to simplify governance processes, reduce manual work, and improve the experience of data owners, stewards, producers, and consumers.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Business, Human Resources, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3+ years of experience in data governance, data management, data stewardship, data quality, metadata management, analytics, or a related discipline.
• Experience supporting or implementing data governance operating models, standards, policies, processes, or controls.
• Background documenting business definitions, data ownership, data lineage, data quality rules, or certification requirements.
• Experience coordinating work across business, analytics, and technical stakeholders.
• Ability to create process documentation, standards, templates, playbooks, or training materials.
• Experience facilitating meetings, working sessions, or decision-making discussions with cross-functional partners.
• Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, dependencies, decisions, and follow-up items.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience delivering technical or analytics projects in a large, matrixed organization, preferably within HR, People Analytics, or workforce-related domains.
• Hands-on experience with several of the following technologies (deep expertise in every tool is not required): SQL/T-SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Excel-based analytical solutions.
• Experience with ETL processes and data pipelines, including data modeling, reporting and dashboard development, and data reconciliation and validation.
• Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Azure, or similar ecosystems.
• Familiarity with APIs and system integrations.
• Demonstrated problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a pragmatic, outcome-oriented approach.
• Experience establishing data ownership and stewardship models in a large, complex, matrixed organization.
• Experience with policy setting, including data standards, business rules definition, data access governance, privacy, security, retention, and responsible data-use practices.
• Familiarity with data catalog, data quality, metadata management, data lineage, or master data management tools.
• Working knowledge of SQL and HR systems, analytics, and reporting environments (e.g., Workday, Power BI, Visier, or similar) sufficient to partner effectively with technical teams.
• Understanding of how upstream HR business processes affect downstream data quality, analytics, and AI outcomes.
• Experience supporting data certification, certified metrics, semantic models, or governed reporting environments.
• Experience working with sensitive, confidential, or regulated data.
• Interest in using automation and AI to scale governance practices, and familiarity with AI data readiness concepts.
• Demonstrated documentation, facilitation, and change management skills, with the ability to make governance concepts clear and practical for non-technical audiences.
• Demonstrated stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence without authority and drive adoption.
• Experience working in Agile delivery models such as Scrum and Kanban.

How You Will Lead

You will lead through collaboration, organization, and influence. You will bring structure to complex governance work, help partners understand their responsibilities, and turn broad governance objectives into practical and repeatable processes.

You can communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, facilitate alignment across teams, and document decisions and requirements in a way that supports consistent execution. You are comfortable working across multiple functions and helping teams balance data accessibility, quality, privacy, security, governance, and business needs.

Suggested Skills

• Data Governance
• Data Stewardship
• Data Quality
• Metadata Management
• Master Data Management
• People Analytics

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Nurse (Relief) - Orange, CT
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Credentialed Veterinary Technician, you’re part of a team that thrives on the front lines of emergency veterinary care where every second counts. You’ll handle a wide range of cases, from minor to complex emergencies, collaborating with our doctors and team in delivering gold standard, emotionally intelligent care. You’ll jump into triage, treatments, diagnostics, anesthesia, monitoring, and critical care nursing, all while being a steady, compassionate presence for pet parents in their most stressful moments. This role is for someone who wants to do the work they were trained to do (and more), continue growing their skills, and help people and their pets when they need it most.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Treat every patient and person like they matter—because they do! You keep people and pets together and stay by their side through tests, treatments, and everything in between

• Jump into action, delivering nursing care, treatments, and emotional support in the most critical moments, from first triage to discharge

• Bring the meds, the monitoring, the mastery—from IVs and CRIs to blood transfusions and beyond

• Communicate like a teammate and think like a leader, helping shape plans and keep care flowing

• Be ready to perform CPR like the trained RECOVER rockstar you are (not only do we offer training, we have the highest number of RECOVER CPR professionals and instructors in the industry!)

• All the techy stuff—from diagnostics and imaging to sample collection and placing tubes

• Anesthesia, even for our most fragile patients? You’ve got it.

• Use all the advanced techniques in your toolkit: central lines, endoscopy, ultrasounds, and more

WHAT YOU NEED

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s degree or higher in veterinary technology from an AVMA accredited program strongly preferred

• Credentialed as a veterinary technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) in the state the VEG practice is located is required; VTS in ECC, internal medicine or anesthesia/analgesia is a plus and will lead to extra considerations in compensation.

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred

• Basic computer skills and a comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator and calm under pressure; ready to lend a hand to support those around you

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation ($ - $) and 401k match

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
jobs.description:
Role Description

You are the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of accounts where the focus is helping customers adopt ServiceNow and realise the business value it delivers. You are accountable for adoption progress and customer success across your portfolio. This is a post-sales relationship role — you are the consistent presence the customer relies on, and the foundation from which strategic partnership is built. You can walk a customer through their success plan, identify risks before they escalate, and have a credible conversation about the value the platform is delivering. This role combines the orchestration and relationship management skills that keep customers on track, lead value conversations, and drive business outcomes.

What you get to do in this role:

• Hold clear accountability within your account portfolio — for adoption (entitlements, deployment,consumption and usage) and customer satisfaction
• Build alignment and sponsorship with senior leaders in the customer. Understand the key stakeholders across IT, the business units and procurement, and the relevant partners; map them against ServiceNow's relationships, assess how strong each one is, and close the gap
• Have value-led conversations with customer stakeholders at Director and VP level — able to articulate what the platform has delivered, what the next opportunity looks like, and beginning to shape how the customer thinks about their roadmap
• Build and maintain success plans tied to customer business outcomes, agreeing value realisation measures with the customer and tracking progress against them
• Drive adoption of AI and agentic capabilities on your accounts. Identify where customers are entitled but not yet deploying, and work with the account team to move them from entitlement to live use and measurable outcomes
• Identify adoption and renewal risks early and act on them, using our standard risk process and securing approvals where needed. Manage escalations, engaging the right resources and driving the resolution plan to closure
• Establish standard governance structures within ServiceNow teams and in partnership with the customer, so decisions have a clear path and accountability is driven towards a successful outcome
• Advise and support customer implementations of ServiceNow — whether delivered by Expert Services, a ServiceNow partner or the customer's own team — so delivery stays aligned to the outcomes in the success plan

• Orchestrate delivery across the account team and broader ServiceNow ecosystem — coordinating with TAS, Expert Services and Partners to ensure each intervention is set up to deliver the right outcome for the customer
